Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is.en:
Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes
explosive compounds to develop in its shell.
Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

Manger du soufre dans son habitat volcanique est la cause
des composés explosifs se développent dans sa coquille.
Ses excréments sont également dangereusement explosifs.

Der Verzehr von Schwefel in seinem vulkanischen Lebensraum ist die Ursache

If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it
has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on
ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.

Si tu lèches la glace qui recouvre son visage, tu le trouveras
a un goût légèrement salé. Cette espèce chevauchait ici
courants océaniques venus d’une terre froide et lointaine.

tiene un sabor ligeramente salado. Esta especie cabalgó aquí
Corrientes oceánicas de una tierra fría y lejana.

來自寒冷、遙遠的陸地的洋流。

ha un sapore leggermente salato. Questa specie cavalcava qui

If you lick the ice covering its face, y.de:

hat einen leicht salzigen Geschmack. Diese Art ritt hier weiter
Meeresströmungen aus einem kalten, fernen Land.
If you lick the ice covering its face, y.pt-br:

tem um sabor levemente salgado. Esta espécie andou aqui em
correntes oceânicas de uma terra fria e distante.

apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack,
they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
It electrifies its claws and tears its o.es:
Electrifica sus garras y desgarra a sus oponentes.
aparte con ellos. Incluso si esquivan su ataque,
Serán electrocutados por las chispas voladoras.
It electrifies its claws and tears its o.fr:
Il électrise ses griffes et déchire ses adversaires
à part avec eux. Même s'ils esquivent son attaque,
ils seront électrocutés par les étincelles volantes.
It electrifies its claws and tears its o.de:
Es elektrisiert seine Krallen und zerreißt seine Gegner
getrennt von ihnen. Selbst wenn sie seinem Angriff ausweichen,
Sie werden durch die fliegenden Funken einen Stromschlag erleiden.
It electrifies its claws and tears its o.pt-br:
Eletrifica suas garras e rasga seus oponentes
além deles. Mesmo que eles evitem seu ataque,
eles serão eletrocutados pelas faíscas voadoras.
It electrifies its claws and tears its o.zh-tw:
它給它的爪子通電並撕裂它的對手
與他們分開。就算躲過了它的攻擊，
他們會被飛濺的火花觸電。
It electrifies its claws and tears its o.it:
Elettrizza i suoi artigli e dilania i suoi avversari
a parte loro. Anche se schivano il suo attacco,
saranno fulminati dalle scintille volanti.

It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.en:
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to
close in on them while they're blinded, but since
Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.es:
Arroja arena a los ojos de su presa y trata de
acercarse a ellos mientras están cegados, pero desde
Sandygast es tan lento que la presa tiende a escapar.
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.fr:
Il jette du sable dans les yeux de sa proie et tente de
rapprochez-vous d'eux pendant qu'ils sont aveuglés, mais depuis
Sandygast est si lent que la proie a tendance à s'échapper.
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.it:
Lancia la sabbia negli occhi della preda e ci prova
avvicinateli mentre sono accecati, ma da allora
Sandygast è così lento che la preda tende a scappare.
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.de:
Es wirft Sand in die Augen seiner Beute und versucht es auch
Nähere dich ihnen, während sie geblendet sind, aber seitdem
Sandygast ist so langsam, dass die Beute dazu neigt, zu entkommen.
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.zh-tw:
它把沙子扔進獵物的眼睛裡，並試圖
在他們失明的時候接近他們，但自從
桑迪加斯特行動緩慢，獵物往往會逃跑。
It flings sand into the eyes of its prey.pt-br:
Ele joga areia nos olhos de sua presa e tenta
aproxime-se deles enquanto estão cegos, mas desde
Sandygast é tão lento que a presa tende a escapar.

It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.en:
It gazes at the stars to predict the future. It acts
somewhat detached because it has seen the end
of all existence.
It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.fr:
Il regarde les étoiles pour prédire l’avenir. Il agit
un peu détaché car il a vu la fin
de toute existence.
It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.es:
Mira las estrellas para predecir el futuro. Actúa
algo desapegado porque ha visto el final
de toda existencia.
It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.de:
Es blickt in die Sterne, um die Zukunft vorherzusagen. Es wirkt
etwas distanziert, weil es das Ende gesehen hat
aller Existenz.
It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.it:
Guarda le stelle per predire il futuro. Agisce
un po’ distaccato perché ha visto la fine
di tutta l'esistenza.
It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.zh-tw:
它凝視星星來預測未來。它的作用
有點超然，因為它已經看到了結局
所有存在的。
It gazes at the stars to predict the fut.pt-br:
Ele olha para as estrelas para prever o futuro. Ele atua
um pouco desapegado porque viu o fim
de toda a existência.

It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.en:
It gets excited when it sees a dance it
doesn't know. This hard worker practices
diligently until it can learn that dance.
It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.fr:
Il s'excite quand il voit une danse
ne sait pas. Ce travailleur acharné pratique
avec diligence jusqu'à ce qu'il puisse apprendre cette danse.
It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.es:
Se emociona cuando ve un baile.
no lo sabe. Este trabajador practica
diligentemente hasta que pueda aprender ese baile.
It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.zh-tw:
當它看到舞蹈時它會興奮
不知道。這個勤奮的人練習
勤奮地練習，直到它能學會那種舞蹈。
It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.pt-br:
Fica animado quando vê uma dança
não sabe. Este trabalhador pratica
diligentemente até que possa aprender essa dança.
It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.de:
Es wird aufgeregt, wenn es jemanden tanzen sieht
weiß es nicht. Dieser harte Arbeiter übt
fleißig, bis es diesen Tanz lernen kann.
It gets excited when it sees a dance it\.it:
Si emoziona quando vede qualcuno ballarlo
non lo sa. Questa pratica del gran lavoratore
diligentemente finché non possa imparare quella danza.

It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.en:
It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its
allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.fr:
Il a un corps et un cœur en acier. Cela a fonctionné avec son
alliés pour punir les gens lorsqu'ils blessent des Pokémon.
It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.it:
Ha un corpo e un cuore d'acciaio. Ha funzionato con il suo
alleati per punire le persone quando feriscono i Pokémon.
It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.de:
Es hat einen Körper und ein Herz aus Stahl. Es hat mit seinem funktioniert
Verbündete, um Menschen zu bestrafen, wenn sie Pokémon verletzen.
It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.es:
Tiene cuerpo y corazón de acero. Funcionó con su
aliados para castigar a las personas cuando lastiman a Pokémon.
It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.pt-br:
Tem corpo e coração de aço. Funcionou com seu
aliados para punir as pessoas quando elas machucam Pokémon.
It has a body and heart of steel. It wor.zh-tw:
它有鋼鐵般的身體和鋼鐵般的心臟。它與它的
當人們傷害神奇寶貝時，盟友會懲罰他們。

It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.en:
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its
long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.es:
Tiene un carácter agresivo. Apuñala a su presa con su
Boca larga y estrecha para drenar los fluidos de la presa.
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.de:
Es hat eine aggressive Natur. Es ersticht die Beute damit
Langes, schmales Maul, um die Flüssigkeiten der Beute abzuleiten.
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.it:
Ha una natura aggressiva. Trafigge la preda con il suo
bocca lunga e stretta per drenare i liquidi della preda.
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.fr:
Il a un caractère agressif. Il poignarde ses proies avec son
bouche longue et étroite pour drainer les fluides de la proie.
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.pt-br:
Tem uma natureza agressiva. Ele apunhala a presa com seu
boca longa e estreita para drenar os fluidos da presa.
It has an aggressive nature. It stabs pr.zh-tw:
它具有攻擊性。它用它的刺刺獵物
長而窄的嘴可以排出獵物的體液。

It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.en:
It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs
that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter,
astringent flavor—they're not suitable as food.
It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.fr:
Il possède d’excellentes capacités de régénération. Jambes
qu'une Mareanie a perdu a un très amer,
saveur astringente – ils ne conviennent pas comme aliment.
It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.es:
Tiene excelentes capacidades regenerativas. Piernas
que una Mareanie ha perdido tiene una muy amarga,
sabor astringente: no son adecuados como alimento.
It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.zh-tw:
它具有出色的再生能力。腿
Mareanie 失去了一個非常痛苦的人，
味道澀，不適合作為食品。
It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.it:
Ha eccellenti capacità rigenerative. Gambe
che un Mareanie ha perso ha un sapore molto amaro,
sapore astringente: non sono adatti come cibo.
It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.pt-br:
Possui excelentes capacidades regenerativas. Pernas
que uma Mareanie perdeu é muito amarga,
sabor adstringente - eles não são adequados como alimento.
It has excellent regenerative capabiliti.de:
Es verfügt über hervorragende Regenerationsfähigkeiten. Beine
Dass eine Mareanie verloren hat, hat einen sehr bitteren,
adstringierender Geschmack – sie sind nicht als Lebensmittel geeignet.

It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.en:
It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush
anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.fr:
Il a un pouvoir phénoménal. Il écrasera sans pitié
quiconque ou quoi que ce soit qui intimide les petits Pokémon.
It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.es:
Tiene un poder fenomenal. Aplastará sin piedad
cualquier persona o cosa que intimide a los Pokémon pequeños.
It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.pt-br:
Tem um poder fenomenal. Ele irá esmagar impiedosamente
qualquer pessoa ou qualquer coisa que intimide pequenos Pokémon.
It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.zh-tw:
它具有驚人的力量。它將無情地碾壓
任何欺負小神奇寶貝的人或事物。
It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.it:
Ha un potere fenomenale. Lo schiaccerà senza pietà
chiunque o qualunque cosa faccia il prepotente contro i Pokémon piccoli.
It has phenomenal power. It will mercile.de:
Es hat eine phänomenale Kraft. Es wird gnadenlos zermalmen
irgendjemand oder irgendetwas, das kleine Pokémon schikaniert.

It is born with a wondrous power that le.en:
It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond
with any kind of Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.fr:
Il est né avec un pouvoir merveilleux qui lui permet de créer des liens
avec n'importe quel type de Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.es:
Nace con un poder maravilloso que le permite unirse.
con cualquier tipo de Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.zh-tw:
它與生俱來就有一種奇妙的力量，可以讓它結合在一起
與任何種類的神奇寶貝。
It is born with a wondrous power that le.it:
Nasce con un potere meraviglioso che gli consente di legarsi
con qualsiasi tipo di Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.de:
Es wird mit einer wundersamen Kraft geboren, die es verbindet
mit jeder Art von Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.pt-br:
Nasce com um poder maravilhoso que lhe permite unir-se
com qualquer tipo de Pokémon.

It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.en:
It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict.
If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.fr:
Il est docile et préfère éviter les conflits.
Toutefois, s’il est dérangé, il peut riposter férocement.
It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.es:
Es dócil y prefiere evitar los conflictos.
Sin embargo, si se le molesta, puede devolver el golpe ferozmente.
It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.zh-tw:
它性格溫順，喜歡避免衝突。
然而，如果受到干擾，它可能會猛烈反擊。
It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.de:
Es ist fügsam und geht Konflikten lieber aus dem Weg.
Wenn es jedoch gestört wird, kann es heftig zurückschlagen.
It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.pt-br:
É dócil e prefere evitar conflitos.
Se perturbado, porém, pode contra-atacar ferozmente.
It is docile and prefers to avoid confli.it:
È docile e preferisce evitare i conflitti.
Se disturbato, tuttavia, può contrattaccare ferocemente.

It is highly popular among female Traine.en:
It is highly popular among female Trainers for its
sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
It is highly popular among female Traine.es:
Es muy popular entre las entrenadoras por su
pelaje sublime. No guarda nido.
It is highly popular among female Traine.fr:
Il est très populaire parmi les dresseuses pour son
fourrure sublime. Il ne garde pas de nid.
It is highly popular among female Traine.it:
È molto popolare tra le Allenatrici per il suo
pelliccia sublime. Non mantiene il nido.
It is highly popular among female Traine.zh-tw:
由於它的特點，深受女性訓練師的歡迎
高貴的皮毛。它不築巢。
It is highly popular among female Traine.pt-br:
É muito popular entre as treinadoras por seu
pele sublime. Não mantém ninho.
It is highly popular among female Traine.de:
Es erfreut sich bei weiblichen Trainern großer Beliebtheit
erhabenes Fell. Es hält kein Nest.

It is said to have the ability to grant.en:
It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for
just one week every thousand years.
It is said to have the ability to grant.es:
Se dice que tiene la capacidad de conceder cualquier deseo de
sólo una semana cada mil años.
It is said to have the ability to grant.fr:
On dit qu'il a la capacité d'exaucer n'importe quel souhait
juste une semaine tous les mille ans.
It is said to have the ability to grant.pt-br:
Diz-se que tem a capacidade de realizar qualquer desejo de
apenas uma semana a cada mil anos.
It is said to have the ability to grant.zh-tw:
據說有能力實現任何願望
每千年只有一周。
It is said to have the ability to grant.it:
Si dice che abbia la capacità di esaudire qualsiasi desiderio
solo una settimana ogni mille anni.
It is said to have the ability to grant.de:
Ihm wird die Fähigkeit nachgesagt, jeden Wunsch zu erfüllen
nur eine Woche alle tausend Jahre.

It lays traps of electrified threads nea.en:
It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests
of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are
not yet good at flying.
It lays traps of electrified threads nea.es:
Pone trampas de hilos electrificados cerca de los nidos.
de Pokémon pájaro, con el objetivo de atrapar polluelos que son
Todavía no soy bueno volando.
It lays traps of electrified threads nea.fr:
Il pose des pièges de fils électrifiés à proximité des nids
de Pokémon oiseaux, visant à piéger les poussins qui sont
pas encore doué pour voler.
It lays traps of electrified threads nea.it:
Piazza trappole di fili elettrizzati vicino ai nidi
di Pokémon uccello, con l'obiettivo di intrappolare i pulcini che lo sono
non ancora bravo a volare.
It lays traps of electrified threads nea.de:
Es legt Fallen aus elektrifizierten Fäden in der Nähe der Nester
von Vogel-Pokémon, die darauf abzielen, Küken zu fangen
noch nicht gut im Fliegen.
It lays traps of electrified threads nea.pt-br:
Coloca armadilhas de fios eletrificados perto dos ninhos
de Pokémon pássaros, com o objetivo de capturar filhotes que estão
ainda não é bom em voar.
It lays traps of electrified threads nea.zh-tw:
它在巢穴附近放置帶電線陷阱
鳥類神奇寶貝，旨在誘捕小雞
還不擅長飛行。

It lives among the tall grass and in for.en:
It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels
attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.
It lives among the tall grass and in for.fr:
Il vit parmi les herbes hautes et dans les forêts. Il repousse
attaque en soulevant les pointes sur son arrière.
It lives among the tall grass and in for.es:
Vive entre la hierba alta y en los bosques. repele
ataca levantando las púas en su parte trasera.
It lives among the tall grass and in for.zh-tw:
它生活在高高的草叢和森林中。它排斥
通過抬起背部的尖刺進行攻擊。
It lives among the tall grass and in for.it:
Vive tra l'erba alta e nelle foreste. Respinge
attacca sollevando gli spuntoni sul retro.
It lives among the tall grass and in for.de:
Er lebt im hohen Gras und in Wäldern. Es stößt ab
Er greift an, indem er die Stacheln an seinem Rücken anhebt.
It lives among the tall grass and in for.pt-br:
Vive entre a grama alta e nas florestas. Isso repele
ataca levantando os espinhos em sua parte traseira.

It lives at the water's edge where it is.en:
It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny.
It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and
becomes active at night.
It lives at the water's edge where it is.fr:
Il vit au bord de l'eau où il fait beau.
Il dort sur un lit d'herbe aquatique le jour et
devient actif la nuit.
It lives at the water's edge where it is.es:
Vive a la orilla del agua donde hace sol.
Duerme sobre un lecho de hierba acuática durante el día y
se vuelve activo por la noche.
It lives at the water's edge where it is.it:
Vive in riva al mare dove c'è il sole.
Di giorno dorme su un letto d'erba acquatica e
diventa attivo di notte.
It lives at the water's edge where it is.de:
Es lebt am Wasser, wo es sonnig ist.
Tagsüber schläft es auf einem Bett aus Wassergras
wird nachts aktiv.
It lives at the water's edge where it is.zh-tw:
它生活在陽光充足的水邊。
白天它睡在水草床上，
晚上變得活躍。
It lives at the water's edge where it is.pt-br:
Vive à beira da água, onde faz sol.
Ele dorme em uma cama de grama aquática durante o dia e
torna-se ativo à noite.

It lives deep within the forest. Even af.en:
It lives deep within the forest. Even after evolving
into this splendid form, it hasn't given up on its
petty misdeeds and pranks.
It lives deep within the forest. Even af.fr:
Il vit au plus profond de la forêt. Même après avoir évolué
sous cette forme splendide, il n'a pas abandonné son
petits méfaits et farces.
It lives deep within the forest. Even af.es:
Vive en lo profundo del bosque. Incluso después de evolucionar
en esta espléndida forma, no ha renunciado a su
pequeñas fechorías y bromas.
It lives deep within the forest. Even af.it:
Vive nel profondo della foresta. Anche dopo l'evoluzione
in questa splendida forma, non ha rinunciato alla sua
piccoli misfatti e scherzi.
It lives deep within the forest. Even af.de:
Es lebt tief im Wald. Auch nach der Weiterentwicklung
in diese herrliche Form gebracht hat, hat es nicht aufgegeben
Kleinigkeiten und Streiche.
It lives deep within the forest. Even af.zh-tw:
它生活在森林深處。即使進化後
進入這個輝煌的形式，它並沒有放棄它的
輕微的錯誤行為和惡作劇。
It lives deep within the forest. Even af.pt-br:
Ele vive nas profundezas da floresta. Mesmo depois de evoluir
nesta forma esplêndida, não desistiu de sua
pequenos delitos e brincadeiras.

It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.en:
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to
create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.fr:
Il vit tranquillement dans la forêt profonde. On dit de
Créez des vents froids d'hiver avec les ventilateurs qu'il contient.
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.es:
Vive tranquilamente en lo profundo del bosque. se dice que
Crea vientos fríos de invierno con los ventiladores que sostiene.
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.pt-br:
Ele vive tranquilamente nas profundezas da floresta. Diz-se que
crie ventos frios de inverno com os ventiladores que contém.
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.zh-tw:
它安靜地生活在密林深處。據說
用它所持有的風扇製造寒冷的冬風。
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.it:
Vive tranquillamente nella foresta profonda. Si dice
crea freddi venti invernali con i fan che contiene.
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It.de:
Es lebt ruhig im tiefen Wald. Es heißt
Erzeugen Sie mit den darin enthaltenen Ventilatoren kühle Winterwinde.

It loves to bite and yank people's hair.en:
It loves to bite and yank people's hair from
behind without warning, just to see their
shocked reactions.
It loves to bite and yank people's hair.es:
Le encanta morder y arrancarle el pelo a la gente.
detrás sin previo aviso, sólo para ver sus
reacciones de sorpresa.
It loves to bite and yank people's hair.pt-br:
Ele adora morder e arrancar o cabelo das pessoas
atrás sem avisar, só para ver seus
reações chocadas.
It loves to bite and yank people's hair.fr:
Il adore mordre et arracher les cheveux des gens.
derrière sans prévenir, juste pour voir leur
réactions choquées.
It loves to bite and yank people's hair.de:
Es liebt es, Menschen in die Haare zu beißen und auszureißen
ohne Vorwarnung zurück, nur um sie zu sehen
schockierte Reaktionen.
It loves to bite and yank people's hair.it:
Ama mordere e strappare i capelli alle persone
dietro senza preavviso, solo per vederli
reazioni scioccate.
It loves to bite and yank people's hair.zh-tw:
牠喜歡咬人並拉扯人的頭髮
毫無徵兆的落後，只是為了看到他們
震驚的反應。

It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.en:
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp.
Once it finds someone whose death is near,
it will trail quietly after them.
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.es:
Acecha en las ciudades, haciéndose pasar por una lámpara.
Una vez que encuentra a alguien cuya muerte está cerca,
los seguirá silenciosamente.
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.fr:
Il rôde dans les villes, se faisant passer pour une lampe.
Une fois qu'il trouve quelqu'un dont la mort est proche,
il les suivra tranquillement.
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.zh-tw:
它潛伏在城市中，假裝是一盞燈。
一旦它發現某人快要死了，
它會悄悄地跟在他們後面。
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.it:
Si nasconde nelle città, fingendo di essere una lampada.
Una volta trovato qualcuno la cui morte è vicina,
li seguirà silenziosamente.
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.pt-br:
Espreita nas cidades, fingindo ser uma lâmpada.
Uma vez que encontra alguém cuja morte está próxima,
ele seguirá silenciosamente atrás deles.
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a l.de:
Es lauert in Städten und gibt vor, eine Lampe zu sein.
Sobald es jemanden findet, dessen Tod nahe ist,
es wird ihnen leise folgen.

It nests deep inside a cave. Food there.en:
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce,
so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that
moves and attempt to eat it.
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there.es:
Anida en lo profundo de una cueva. Allí la comida escasea,
por lo que Deino hundirá sus dientes en cualquier cosa que
se mueve e intenta comérselo.
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there.fr:
Il niche au fond d’une grotte. La nourriture y est rare,
donc Deino mordra à pleines dents dans tout ce qui
bouge et essaie de le manger.
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there.it:
Nidifica nel profondo di una grotta. Il cibo lì è scarso,
quindi Deino affonderà i denti in qualsiasi cosa
si muove e tenta di mangiarlo.
It nests deep inside a cave. Food there.de:

low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with
its tail.

Il protège sa peau en recouvrant son corps de

Protege su piel cubriendo su cuerpo con

Es schützt seine Haut, indem es seinen Körper damit bedeckt
zarte Blasen. Unter seiner fröhlichen Atmosphäre,
Es behält seine Umgebung im Auge.

Quando avista sua comida favorita, Bounsweet,
Aipom fica animado e ataca.

50 mph.

Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémo.es: Cambia el Pokémon Activo de tu rival a la Banca. (Tu oponente elige el nuevo Pokémon Activo).
Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémo.de: Tauschen Sie das aktive Pokémon Ihres Gegners auf die Bank aus. (Dein Gegner wählt das neue Aktive Pokémon.)
Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémo.it: Scambia il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario nella panchina. (Il tuo avversario sceglie il nuovo Pokémon attivo.)
Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémo.fr: Remplacez le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire par le Banc. (Votre adversaire choisit le nouveau Pokémon Actif.)
Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémo.zh-tw: 將對手的活躍神奇寶貝移至替補席。 （你的對手選擇新的活躍神奇寶貝。）
Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémo.pt-br: Troque o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente para o Banco. (Seu oponente escolhe o novo Pokémon Ativo.)

Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.en: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.es: Cambia este Pokémon por 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.
Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.fr: Échangez ce Pokémon avec 1 de vos Pokémon de Banc.
Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.zh-tw: 將此寶可夢與你的 1 個備戰寶可夢交換。
Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.pt-br: Troque este Pokémon por 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco.
Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.it: Scambia questo Pokémon con 1 dei tuoi Pokémon in panchina.
Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Bench.de: Tausche dieses Pokémon gegen eines deiner Bank-Pokémon aus.

Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez 2 {M} Énergie de votre Zone d'Énergie et attachez-la à l'un de vos Pokémon de Banc.
Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Toma 2 {M} de Energía de tu Zona de Energía y únelas a 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.
Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi 2 Energie {M} dalla tua Zona Energetica e assegnale a 1 dei tuoi Pokémon in panchina.
Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區獲取 2 {M} 能量並將其附加到你的 1 只後備神奇寶貝身上。
Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue 2 {M} Energias da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-as a 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco.
Take 2 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Nimm 2 {M}-Energie aus deiner Energiezone und lege sie an eines deiner Bank-Pokémon an.

Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez une Énergie {L} de votre Zone d'Énergie et attachez-la à ce Pokémon.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {L} dalla tua Zona Energetica e assegnala a questo Pokémon.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Toma una Energía {L} de tu Zona de Energía y únela a este Pokémon.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Nimm eine {L}-Energie aus deiner Energiezone und lege sie an dieses Pokémon an.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區取出一個{L}能量並將其附加到該神奇寶貝上。
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue uma Energia {L} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a a este Pokémon.

Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to each of your Drifblim and Mismagius.
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez une énergie {P} de votre zone d'énergie et attachez-la à chacun de vos Drifblim et Mismagius.
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Toma una Energía {P} de tu Zona de Energía y únela a cada uno de tus Drifblim y Mismagius.
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Nimm eine {P}-Energie aus deiner Energiezone und lege sie an jeden deiner Drifblim und Mismagius an.
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區取出一個 {P} 能量並將其附加到你的 Drifblim 和 Mismagius 上。
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue uma Energia {P} da sua Zona de Energia e anexe-a a cada um dos seus Drifblim e Mismagius.
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {P} dalla tua Zona Energetica e assegnala a ciascuno dei tuoi Drifblim e Mismagius.

Thanks to the special membrane covering.en:
Thanks to the special membrane covering its
eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in
the middle of the night.
Thanks to the special membrane covering.es:
Gracias a la membrana especial que cubre su
ojos, puede ver claramente su entorno, incluso en
media noche.
Thanks to the special membrane covering.fr:
Grâce à la membrane spéciale recouvrant son
yeux, il peut voir clairement son environnement, même dans
le milieu de la nuit.
Thanks to the special membrane covering.zh-tw:
由於其上覆蓋有特殊的薄膜
眼睛能看清周圍的情況，即使在
半夜。
Thanks to the special membrane covering.it:
Grazie alla speciale membrana che lo ricopre
occhi, può vedere chiaramente ciò che lo circonda, anche dentro
nel mezzo della notte.
Thanks to the special membrane covering.pt-br:
Graças à membrana especial que cobre o seu
olhos, ele pode ver claramente o que está ao seu redor, mesmo em
no meio da noite.
Thanks to the special membrane covering.de:
Dank der speziellen Membran, die es bedeckt
Mit seinen Augen kann es seine Umgebung auch im Dunkeln klar erkennen
mitten in der Nacht.

The balloons it inflates with its nose g.en:
The balloons it inflates with its nose grow
larger and larger as it practices day by day.
The balloons it inflates with its nose g.de:
Die Ballons, die es mit seiner Nase aufbläst, wachsen
größer und größer, je mehr es Tag für Tag praktiziert.
The balloons it inflates with its nose g.es:
Los globos que infla con su nariz crecen
más y más grande a medida que se practica día a día.
The balloons it inflates with its nose g.fr:
Les ballons qu'il gonfle avec son nez grandissent
de plus en plus grand à mesure qu'il s'entraîne jour après jour.
The balloons it inflates with its nose g.zh-tw:
它用鼻子吹的氣球長大了
隨著它日復一日的練習，它變得越來越大。
The balloons it inflates with its nose g.it:
I palloncini che gonfia con il naso crescono
sempre più grande man mano che si esercita giorno dopo giorno.
The balloons it inflates with its nose g.pt-br:
Os balões que ele infla com o nariz crescem
cada vez maior à medida que pratica dia após dia.

The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.en:
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth
of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.es:
El más grande de todos los Pokémon. Puede sumergirse a una profundidad
de casi 10.000 pies con una sola respiración.
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.pt-br:
O maior de todos os Pokémon. Ele pode mergulhar a uma profundidade
de quase 10.000 pés com apenas uma respiração.
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.zh-tw:
所有神奇寶貝中最大的。它可以潛到很深的地方
只需一口氣就可以飛近 10,000 英尺。
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.it:
Il più grande di tutti i Pokémon. Può immergersi in profondità
di quasi 10.000 piedi con un solo respiro.
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.fr:
Le plus gros de tous les Pokémon. Il peut plonger en profondeur
de près de 10 000 pieds en une seule respiration.
The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive.de:
Das größte aller Pokémon. Es kann bis in eine Tiefe tauchen
von fast 10.000 Fuß mit nur einem Atemzug.

The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.en:
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body
is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce
right off.
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.es:
El pelaje negro que cubre el cuerpo de este Pokémon
es denso y elástico. Incluso los colmillos afilados rebotan
inmediatamente.
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.fr:
La fourrure noire qui recouvre le corps de ce Pokémon
est dense et élastique. Même les crocs pointus rebondissent
tout de suite.
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.it:
La pelliccia nera che ricopre il corpo di questo Pokémon
è denso ed elastico. Anche le zanne affilate rimbalzano
subito.
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.zh-tw:
覆蓋這只神奇寶貝身體的黑色皮毛
緻密且有彈性。即使鋒利的獠牙也會彈跳
馬上。
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.de:
Das schwarze Fell, das den Körper dieses Pokémon bedeckt
ist dicht und federnd. Sogar scharfe Reißzähne hüpfen
sofort los.
The black fur that covers this Pokémon's.pt-br:
O pelo preto que cobre o corpo deste Pokémon
é denso e elástico. Até as presas afiadas saltam
imediatamente.

The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.en:
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the
true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it
drains people's lives away.
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.fr:
L'œil bleu sur le garde-main de l'épée est le
véritable corps de Honedge. Avec son vieux drap, il
draine la vie des gens.
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.es:
El ojo azul en el guardamano de la espada es el
verdadero cuerpo de Honedge. Con su tela vieja,
drena la vida de las personas.
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.de:
Das blaue Auge am Handschutz des Schwertes ist das
wahrer Körper von Honedge. Mit seinem alten Stoff, es
raubt den Menschen das Leben.
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.zh-tw:
劍護手上的藍色眼睛是
洪內奇的真身。用它的舊佈，
耗盡人們的生命。
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.pt-br:
O olho azul no protetor de mão da espada é o
verdadeiro corpo de Honedge. Com seu pano velho,
drena a vida das pessoas.
The blue eye on the sword's handguard is.it:
L'occhio azzurro sul paramano della spada è il
vero corpo di Honedge. Con la sua vecchia stoffa, esso
prosciuga la vita delle persone.

The extension and contraction of its mus.en:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's
in trouble.
The extension and contraction of its mus.fr:
L'extension et la contraction de ses muscles
produit de l’électricité. Sa fourrure brille quand elle est
en difficulté.
The extension and contraction of its mus.es:
La extensión y contracción de sus músculos.
genera electricidad. Su pelaje brilla cuando está
en problemas.
The extension and contraction of its mus.it:
L'estensione e la contrazione dei suoi muscoli
genera elettricità. La sua pelliccia si illumina quando lo è
nei guai.
The extension and contraction of its mus.pt-br:
A extensão e contração de seus músculos
gera eletricidade. Seu pelo brilha quando está
em apuros.
The extension and contraction of its mus.de:
Die Dehnung und Kontraktion seiner Muskeln
erzeugt Strom. Sein Fell leuchtet, wenn es ist
in Schwierigkeiten.
The extension and contraction of its mus.zh-tw:
肌肉的伸展和收縮
發電。當它的皮毛髮光時
遇到麻煩了。

The females are fussier than the males..en:
The females are fussier than the males. If another
creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll
peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.
The females are fussier than the males..es:
Las hembras son más quisquillosas que los machos. si otro
criatura ensucia las alas de una hembra Rookidee,
picotear al delincuente implacablemente con furia ardiente.
The females are fussier than the males..fr:
Les femelles sont plus capricieuses que les mâles. Si un autre
créature salit les ailes d'une femelle Rookidee, ça va
picorer le délinquant sans relâche dans une rage brûlante.
The females are fussier than the males..zh-tw:
雌性比雄性更挑剔。如果另一個
生物弄髒了雌性菜鳥的翅膀，它會
憤怒中無情地啄擊罪犯。
The females are fussier than the males..it:
Le femmine sono più esigenti dei maschi. Se un altro
creatura sporca le ali di una femmina Rookidee, lo farà
beccare incessantemente l'autore del reato con rabbia ardente.
The females are fussier than the males..de:
Die Weibchen sind wählerischer als die Männchen. Wenn ein anderer
Wenn eine Kreatur die Flügel eines Rookidee-Weibchens beschmutzt, dann wird es das tun
picke den Täter unerbittlich in brennender Wut.
The females are fussier than the males..pt-br:
As fêmeas são mais agitadas que os machos. Se outro
criatura sujar as asas de uma fêmea de Rookidee, ela
bicar o agressor implacavelmente com uma raiva ardente.

The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.en:
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just
the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that
blows opponents away and damages them.
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.es:
La fuerza de la fuerte voz de este Pokémon no es sólo
el sonido, también es la onda de presión del aire que
derriba a los oponentes y los daña.
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.fr:
La force de la voix forte de ce Pokémon n'est pas seulement
le son, c'est aussi l'onde de pression de l'air qui
souffle les adversaires et les endommage.
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.it:
La forza della voce forte di questo Pokémon non è eccezionale
il suono... è anche l'onda della pressione dell'aria
spazza via gli avversari e li danneggia.
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.zh-tw:
這只神奇寶貝響亮聲音的力量不僅僅是
聲音——也是氣壓波
將對手吹走並對其造成傷害。
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.pt-br:
A força da voz alta deste Pokémon não é apenas
o som - é também a onda de pressão do ar que
afasta os oponentes e os causa danos.
The force of this Pokémon's loud voice i.de:
Die Kraft der lauten Stimme dieses Pokémon ist nicht einfach
das Geräusch – es ist auch die Welle des Luftdrucks
bläst Gegner weg und fügt ihnen Schaden zu.

The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.en:
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it in a
state of constant excitement. It pierces enemies
with its two large horns before shredding them.
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.es:
La influencia de la Mega Evolución lo deja en un
estado de excitación constante. Atraviesa a los enemigos
con sus dos grandes cuernos antes de desmenuzarlos.
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.fr:
L'influence de Mega Evolution le laisse dans un
état d’excitation constante. Il transperce les ennemis
avec ses deux grosses cornes avant de les déchiqueter.
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.zh-tw:
超級進化的影響使其陷入了困境
持續興奮的狀態。它刺穿敵人
用它的兩個大角，然後將它們撕碎。
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.it:
L'influenza della Mega Evoluzione lo lascia in a
stato di continua eccitazione. Trafigge i nemici
con le sue due grandi corna prima di triturarle.
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.de:
Der Einfluss von Mega Evolution lässt es in einem
Zustand ständiger Aufregung. Es durchdringt Feinde
mit seinen zwei großen Hörnern, bevor er sie zerfetzt.
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves i.pt-br:
A influência da Mega Evolução deixa-o em uma
estado de excitação constante. Ele perfura os inimigos
com seus dois grandes chifres antes de triturá-los.

The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.en:
The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes.
It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.fr:
Les parties feuillues agissent comme des couteaux pour trancher les ennemis.
Il crache un fluide qui dissout tout.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.es:
Las partes frondosas actúan como cortadores para atacar a los enemigos.
Escupe un fluido que lo disuelve todo.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.de:
Die Blattteile dienen als Messer zum Aufschlitzen von Feinden.
Es spuckt eine Flüssigkeit aus, die alles auflöst.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.pt-br:
As partes folhosas atuam como cortadores para cortar os inimigos.
Cospe um fluido que dissolve tudo.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.zh-tw:
葉狀部分充當切割敵人的刀具。
它噴出一種可以溶解一切的液體。
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.it:
Le parti frondose fungono da taglienti per squarciare i nemici.
Sputa un fluido che scioglie tutto.

The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.en:
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over
3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely
approaching it will cause severe burns.
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.fr:
La crinière d'un Pyroar mâle se réchauffe jusqu'à
3 600 degrés Fahrenheit pendant la bataille. Simplement
s’en approcher provoquerait de graves brûlures.
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.es:
La melena de un Pyroar macho se calienta al máximo
3.600 grados Fahrenheit durante la batalla. Simplemente
acercarse a él provocará quemaduras graves.
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.it:
La criniera di un Pyroar maschio si surriscalda
3.600 gradi Fahrenheit durante la battaglia. Semplicemente
avvicinarsi causerà gravi ustioni.
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.zh-tw:
雄性 Pyroar 的鬃毛溫度升高到超過
戰鬥期間溫度為 3,600 華氏度。僅僅是
接近它會導致嚴重燒傷。
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.de:
Die Mähne eines männlichen Pyroars erhitzt sich auf über 100 °C
3.600 Grad Fahrenheit während des Kampfes. Nur
Bei Annäherung kann es zu schweren Verbrennungen kommen.
The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to ov.pt-br:
A juba de um Pyroar macho esquenta
3.600 graus Fahrenheit durante a batalha. Apenas
aproximar-se dele causará queimaduras graves.

The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.en:
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its head.
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.fr:
La géologie riche en métaux de l'habitat de ce Pokémon
lui a fait développer des moustaches d'acier sur la tête.
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.it:
La geologia ricca di metalli dell'habitat di questo Pokémon
gli ha fatto sviluppare baffi d'acciaio sulla testa.
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.es:
La geología rica en metales del hábitat de este Pokémon
le hizo desarrollar bigotes de acero en la cabeza.
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.pt-br:
A geologia rica em metais do habitat deste Pokémon
fez com que desenvolvesse bigodes de aço em sua cabeça.
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.zh-tw:
該神奇寶貝棲息地富含金屬的地質
導致它的頭上長出了鋼須。
The metal-rich geology of this Pokémon's.de:
Die metallreiche Geologie des Lebensraums dieses Pokémon
verursachte, dass es stählerne Barthaare auf seinem Kopf entwickelte.

The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.en:
The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by
battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane
will grow.
The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.es:
Cuanto más entrena un Litleo su cuerpo y espíritu
luchando contra enemigos poderosos, más caliente es su melena
crecerá.
The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.fr:
Plus un Litleo entraîne son corps et son esprit en
combattant de puissants ennemis, plus sa crinière est chaude
va grandir.
The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.zh-tw:
Litleo 對其身體和精神的訓練越多
與強大的敵人作戰，它的鬃毛越熱
會成長。
The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.de:
Je mehr ein Litleo seinen Körper und Geist trainiert
Je mehr er gegen mächtige Feinde kämpft, desto heißer ist seine Mähne
wird wachsen.
The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.pt-br:
Quanto mais um Litleo treina seu corpo e espírito
lutando contra inimigos poderosos, mais quente será sua juba
crescerá.
The more a Litleo trains its body and sp.it:
Più un Litleo allena il suo corpo e il suo spirito
combattendo potenti nemici, più calda è la sua criniera
crescerà.

The moves it uses to take down its prey.en:
The moves it uses to take down its prey would
make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued
prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.
The moves it uses to take down its prey.fr:
Les mouvements qu'il utilise pour abattre sa proie seraient
rendre jaloux un artiste martial. Il rentre discrètement
proie sous ses bras pour les transporter jusqu'à son nid.
The moves it uses to take down its prey.es:
Los movimientos que utiliza para derribar a su presa
poner celoso a un artista marcial. Se esconde tenue
presa bajo sus brazos para llevarlas a su nido.
The moves it uses to take down its prey.zh-tw:
它用來擊倒獵物的動作
讓武者嫉妒。它褶皺柔和
將獵物夾在腋下，然後將它們帶回巢穴。
The moves it uses to take down its prey.it:
Le mosse che usa per abbattere la preda lo sarebbero
rendere geloso un artista marziale. Si nasconde sottomesso
prede sotto le sue braccia per portarle al suo nido.
The moves it uses to take down its prey.pt-br:
Os movimentos que ele usa para derrubar suas presas seriam
deixar um artista marcial com ciúmes. Ele fica subjugado
presa debaixo dos braços para carregá-la até o ninho.
The moves it uses to take down its prey.de:
Die Bewegungen, mit denen es seine Beute zur Strecke bringt, würden es tun
einen Kampfkünstler eifersüchtig machen. Es wirkt gedämpft
Beute unter seinen Armen, um sie zu seinem Nest zu tragen.

The one with the best drumming technique.en:
The one with the best drumming techniques
becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle
disposition and values harmony among its group.
The one with the best drumming technique.es:
El que tiene mejores técnicas de percusión.
se convierte en el jefe de la tropa. tiene un suave
disposición y valores de armonía entre su grupo.
The one with the best drumming technique.fr:
Celui avec les meilleures techniques de batterie
devient le chef de la troupe. Il a une douceur
Disposition et valeurs harmonie au sein de son groupe.
The one with the best drumming technique.de:
Der mit den besten Trommeltechniken
wird zum Chef der Truppe. Es hat eine sanfte
Gemüt und schätzt die Harmonie innerhalb seiner Gruppe.
The one with the best drumming technique.it:
Quello con le migliori tecniche di batteria
diventa il capo della truppa. Ha un carattere delicato
disposizione e valori armonia all'interno del suo gruppo.
The one with the best drumming technique.pt-br:
Aquele com as melhores técnicas de bateria
torna-se o chefe da tropa. Tem uma suavidade
disposição e valoriza a harmonia entre seu grupo.
The one with the best drumming technique.zh-tw:
擊鼓技術最好的人
成為部隊的老大。它有一種溫柔
性格和價值觀的群體之間的和諧。

The scent its body gives off enraptures.en:
The scent its body gives off enraptures those
who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of
love for Spritzee.

unos a otros para pulir sus habilidades para crear problemas.

This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar.
It uses nimble steps to approach opponents,
then knocks them out with electric punches.
