Quando ele encarar um inimigo, ele usará
uma mistura de movimentos psi, como hipnose e
Confusão.

When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.en:
When it sucks in a large volume of seawater,
it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton
of food daily.
When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.fr:
Lorsqu'il aspire un grand volume d'eau de mer,
cela devient comme une grosse balle rebondissante. Ça mange une tonne
de nourriture quotidiennement.
When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.de:
Wenn es eine große Menge Meerwasser ansaugt,
es wird wie ein großer, hüpfender Ball. Es frisst eine Tonne
Essen täglich.
When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.es:
Cuando aspira un gran volumen de agua de mar,
se vuelve como una pelota grande que rebota. come una tonelada
de comida diariamente.
When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.it:
Quando aspira un grande volume di acqua di mare,
diventa come una grande palla rimbalzante. Ne mangia una tonnellata
di cibo ogni giorno.
When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.zh-tw:
當它吸入大量海水時，
它變得像一個大的有彈性的球。牠吃了一噸
每天的食物。
When it sucks in a large volume of seawa.pt-br:
Quando suga um grande volume de água do mar,
torna-se como uma bola grande e saltitante. Come uma tonelada
de comida diariamente.

When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.en:
When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it
gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even
notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.
When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.fr:
Quand il bat des rythmes rapides au combat, il
est tellement pris par le rythme qu'il ne peut même pas
remarquez qu'il a déjà assommé son adversaire.
When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.es:
Cuando toca ritmos rápidos en la batalla,
queda tan atrapado en el ritmo que ni siquiera
Observa que ya ha noqueado a su oponente.
When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.zh-tw:
當它在戰鬥中敲出急促的節拍時，
完全陷入節奏以至於無法
請注意，它已經擊敗了對手。
When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.pt-br:
Quando está tocando batidas rápidas na batalha,
fica tão preso no ritmo que nem consegue
observe que ele já nocauteou seu oponente.
When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.de:
Wenn es im Kampf schnelle Beats trommelt, ist es
verfängt sich so sehr im Rhythmus, dass es gar nicht mehr funktioniert
Beachten Sie, dass es seinen Gegner bereits KO geschlagen hat.
When it's drumming out rapid beats in ba.it:
Quando suona ritmi rapidi in battaglia, esso
rimane così preso dal ritmo che non lo farà nemmeno
nota che ha già messo KO il suo avversario.

When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.en:
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus coating
its entire body becomes more concentrated—
it'll dissolve anything.
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.fr:
Lorsque Sliggoo sent un danger, la couche de mucus
son corps tout entier devient plus concentré—
ça va dissoudre n'importe quoi.
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.pt-br:
Quando Sliggoo sente o perigo, a camada de muco
todo o seu corpo fica mais concentrado -
isso dissolverá qualquer coisa.
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.it:
Quando Sliggoo avverte il pericolo, si ricopre di muco
il suo intero corpo diventa più concentrato—
dissolverà qualsiasi cosa.
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.zh-tw:
當 Sligoo 感覺到危險時，粘液塗層
整個身體變得更加集中——
它會溶解任何東西。
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.es:
Cuando Sliggoo siente peligro, la capa de moco
todo su cuerpo se vuelve más concentrado—
disolverá cualquier cosa.
When Sliggoo senses danger, the mucus co.de:
Wenn Sliggoo eine Gefahr spürt, bildet sich eine Schleimschicht
sein ganzer Körper wird konzentrierter –
es wird alles auflösen.

When they see an enemy, their tails stan.en:
When they see an enemy, their tails stand high,
and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their
cheek pouches.
When they see an enemy, their tails stan.es:
Cuando ven un enemigo, levantan la cola,
y escupen las semillas de las bayas almacenadas en sus
bolsas en las mejillas.
When they see an enemy, their tails stan.fr:
Quand ils voient un ennemi, ils ont la queue haute,
et ils crachent les graines des baies stockées dans leur
poches pour les joues.
When they see an enemy, their tails stan.it:
Quando vedono un nemico, tengono alta la coda,
e sputano i semi delle bacche conservate nelle loro
tasche per le guance.
When they see an enemy, their tails stan.de:
Wenn sie einen Feind sehen, strecken sie ihren Schwanz hoch,
und sie spucken die Samen der in ihnen gelagerten Beeren aus
Backentaschen.
When they see an enemy, their tails stan.zh-tw:
當它們看到敵人時，它們的尾巴會高高豎起，
他們吐出儲存在他們的漿果中的種子
頰袋。
When they see an enemy, their tails stan.pt-br:
Quando eles veem um inimigo, suas caudas ficam erguidas,
e cuspiram as sementes das frutas armazenadas em seus
bolsas nas bochechas.

When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.en: When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't get any points for it.
When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.fr: Lorsque ce Pokémon est mis KO, lancez une pièce. Si c'est face, votre adversaire ne peut obtenir aucun point.
When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.es: Cuando este Pokémon quede fuera de combate, lanza una moneda. Si sale cara, tu oponente no podrá obtener ningún punto por ello.
When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.it: Quando questo Pokémon viene messo KO, lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, il tuo avversario non potrà ottenere alcun punto.
When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.zh-tw: 當這只神奇寶貝被擊倒時，擲硬幣。如果出現正面，您的對手將無法獲得任何分數。
When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.pt-br: Quando este Pokémon for nocauteado, jogue uma moeda. Se der cara, seu oponente não poderá ganhar nenhum ponto por isso.
When this Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a.de: Wenn dieses Pokémon kampfunfähig ist, wirf eine Münze. Bei „Kopf“ kann Ihr Gegner dafür keine Punkte bekommen.

When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.en:
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice
startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder.
It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.es:
Cuando Whismur llora, el sonido de su propia voz
lo sobresalta, haciendo que el Pokémon llore aún más fuerte.
Llora hasta agotarse y luego se queda dormido.
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.fr:
Quand Whismur pleure, le son de sa propre voix
le fait sursauter, faisant pleurer le Pokémon encore plus fort.
Il pleure jusqu'à épuisement, puis il s'endort.
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.pt-br:
Quando Whismur chora, o som de sua própria voz
assusta, fazendo o Pokémon chorar ainda mais alto.
Ele chora até ficar exausto e depois adormece.
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.zh-tw:
當威斯莫哭泣時，是它自己的聲音
嚇到了它，讓神奇寶貝哭得更大聲。
它會哭到筋疲力盡，然後就睡著了。
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.it:
Quando Whismur piange, il suono della sua stessa voce
lo spaventa, facendo piangere il Pokémon ancora più forte.
Piange fino allo sfinimento, poi si addormenta.
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own.de:
Wenn Whismur weint, erklingt seine eigene Stimme
erschreckt es und lässt das Pokémon noch lauter weinen.
Es weint, bis es erschöpft ist, dann schläft es ein.

Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.en:
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky,
schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of
the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.fr:
Chaque fois qu'une pleine lune apparaît dans le ciel nocturne,
des bancs de Jellicent se rassemblent près de la surface de
la mer, attendant que leurs proies apparaissent.
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.es:
Cada vez que hay luna llena en el cielo nocturno,
Las escuelas de Jellicent se reúnen cerca de la superficie de
el mar, esperando que aparezca su presa.
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.pt-br:
Sempre que uma lua cheia paira no céu noturno,
cardumes de Jellicent se reúnem perto da superfície de
o mar, esperando que suas presas apareçam.
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.zh-tw:
每當一輪滿月掛在夜空中時，
傑利森特學校聚集在地表附近
大海裡，等待著獵物的出現。
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.de:
Immer wenn ein Vollmond am Nachthimmel hängt,
Schulen von Jellicent versammeln sich nahe der Oberfläche von
das Meer und wartet auf das Erscheinen ihrer Beute.
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night.it:
Ogni volta che la luna piena è sospesa nel cielo notturno,
le scuole di Jellicent si riuniscono vicino alla superficie di
il mare, in attesa che appaia la loro preda.

Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.en: Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by the Pokémon this card is attached to, draw a card.
Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.fr: Chaque fois que le Pokémon de votre adversaire est mis KO par les dégâts d'une attaque utilisée par le Pokémon auquel cette carte est attachée, piochez une carte.
Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.es: Siempre que el Pokémon de tu rival quede Fuera de combate por el daño de un ataque utilizado por el Pokémon al que está unida esta carta, roba una carta.
Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.pt-br: Sempre que o Pokémon do seu oponente for Nocauteado pelo dano de um ataque usado pelo Pokémon ao qual esta carta está ligada, compre uma carta.
Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.zh-tw: 每當對手的寶可夢因這張卡所附著的寶可夢的攻擊而被擊倒時，抽一張卡。
Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.it: Ogni volta che il Pokémon del tuo avversario viene messo KO dai danni di un attacco utilizzato dal Pokémon a cui è assegnata questa carta, pesca una carta.
Whenever your opponent's Pokémon is Knoc.de: Immer wenn das Pokémon deines Gegners durch Schaden durch einen Angriff des Pokémon, an das diese Karte angelegt ist, kampfunfähig wird, ziehe eine Karte.

With a voice like a human child's, it cr.en:
With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to
lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost
among the trees.
With a voice like a human child's, it cr.fr:
Avec une voix semblable à celle d'un enfant humain, il crie
attirer les adultes au plus profond de la forêt et les perdre
parmi les arbres.
With a voice like a human child's, it cr.es:
Con una voz como la de un niño humano, clama a
atraer a los adultos hacia las profundidades del bosque, haciéndolos perderse
entre los árboles.
With a voice like a human child's, it cr.it:
Con una voce simile a quella di un bambino umano, grida
attira gli adulti nel profondo della foresta, facendoli perdere
tra gli alberi.
With a voice like a human child's, it cr.zh-tw:
它用像人類孩子一樣的聲音呼喊著
引誘成年人進入森林深處，讓他們迷路
樹木之間。
With a voice like a human child's, it cr.de:
Mit einer Stimme wie die eines Menschenkindes schreit es
locken Erwachsene tief in den Wald und verirren sie
zwischen den Bäumen.
With a voice like a human child's, it cr.pt-br:
Com uma voz como a de uma criança humana, clama para
atrair adultos para as profundezas da floresta, fazendo com que eles se percam
entre as árvores.

With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.en:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its
prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also
consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.fr:
Avec ses griffes acérées, ce Pokémon lui transperce
proie, puis il les picote. Même si c'est aussi
consomme des baies, c'est un carnivore dans l'âme.
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.es:
Con sus afiladas garras, este Pokémon perfora su
presa, y luego los picotea. Aunque también
consume bayas, es un carnívoro de corazón.
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.it:
Con i suoi artigli affilati, questo Pokémon lo trafigge
preda, e poi li becca. Anche se anche
consuma bacche, è un carnivoro in fondo.
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.de:
Mit seinen scharfen Krallen durchbohrt dieses Pokémon seine
Beute, und dann pickt es nach ihnen. Obwohl es auch
isst Beeren, ist im Herzen ein Fleischfresser.
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.zh-tw:
這只神奇寶貝用鋒利的爪子刺穿自己的身體
獵物，然後啄食它們。雖然這也
以漿果為食，本質上是肉食動物。
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierc.pt-br:
Com suas garras afiadas, este Pokémon perfura seus
presa, e então ele os bica. Embora também
consome frutas vermelhas, é um carnívoro de coração.

With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.en:
With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is
more agile and active than it appears.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.es:
Con nervios de acero, nada puede perturbarlo. es
más ágil y activo de lo que parece.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.fr:
Avec des nerfs d’acier, rien ne peut la perturber. C'est
plus agile et actif qu’il n’y paraît.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.zh-tw:
有著鋼鐵般的意志，沒有什麼可以擾亂它。它是
比看上去更加敏捷和活躍。
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.it:
Con nervi d’acciaio, nulla può turbarlo. Lo è
più agile e attivo di quanto sembri.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.pt-br:
Com nervos de aço, nada pode perturbá-lo. É
mais ágil e ativo do que parece.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.de:
Mit Nerven aus Stahl kann es nichts aus der Ruhe bringen. Es ist
agiler und aktiver als es scheint.

With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.en:
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its
target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten—
Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.es:
Con la boca sobre su vientre, Dusknoir se traga su
objetivo completo. El alma es lo único que se come.
Dusknoir arroja el cuerpo antes de partir.
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.fr:
La bouche sur le ventre, Dusknoir avale son
cibler l'ensemble. L'âme est la seule chose mangée—
Dusknoir dégorge le corps avant de partir.
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.it:
Con la bocca sulla pancia, Dusknoir lo ingoia
obiettivo intero. L'anima è l'unica cosa che si mangia—
Dusknoir vomita il corpo prima di partire.
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.zh-tw:
黑夜將嘴放在腹部，將其吞下
目標整體。靈魂是唯一被吃掉的東西——
暮色在離開前吐出了屍體。
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.pt-br:
Com a boca na barriga, Dusknoir engole
alvo inteiro. A alma é a única coisa comida -
Dusknoir despeja o corpo antes de partir.
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir sw.de:
Mit dem Mund auf dem Bauch schluckt Dusknoir es
Ziel ganz. Die Seele ist das Einzige, was gegessen wird –
Dusknoir spuckt den Körper aus, bevor er geht.

Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.en: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a Supporter card you find there and discard it.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.pt-br: Seu oponente revela sua mão. Escolha uma carta de Apoiador que encontrar lá e descarte-a.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.fr: Votre adversaire révèle sa main. Choisissez une carte Supporter que vous y trouvez et défaussez-la.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.es: Tu oponente revela su mano. Elige una carta de Partidario que encuentres allí y deséchala.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.it: Il tuo avversario rivela la sua mano. Scegli una carta Aiuto che trovi lì e scartala.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.de: Ihr Gegner deckt seine Hand auf. Wähle eine Unterstützerkarte, die du dort findest, und wirf sie ab.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.zh-tw: 你的對手亮出了他們的牌。選擇您在那裡找到的一張支持者卡並將其丟棄。

Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.en: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.es: El Pokémon Activo de tu rival ahora está Dormido.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.fr: Le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est désormais Endormi.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.pt-br: O Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora está Adormecido.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.zh-tw: 你對手的活躍神奇寶貝現在處於睡眠狀態。
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.it: Il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è addormentato.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now As.de: Das aktive Pokémon deines Gegners schläft jetzt.

Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.en: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.fr: Le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est désormais Brûlé.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.es: El Pokémon Activo de tu rival ahora está Quemado.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.de: Das aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ist jetzt verbrannt.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.zh-tw: 你對手的活躍神奇寶貝現在被燒毀了。
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.it: Il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è ora bruciato.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Bu.pt-br: O Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora está Queimado.

Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.en: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.es: El Pokémon Activo de tu rival ahora está Confundido.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.de: Das aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ist jetzt verwirrt.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.it: Il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è ora confuso.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.pt-br: O Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora está Confuso.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.zh-tw: 你對手的戰鬥寶可夢現在處於混亂狀態。
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Co.fr: Le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est désormais Confus.

Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.en: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.es: El Pokémon Activo de tu rival ahora está Envenenado.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.pt-br: O Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora está Envenenado.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.zh-tw: 你對手的戰鬥寶可夢現在中毒了。
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.fr: Le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est désormais Empoisonné.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.it: Il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario ora è avvelenato.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Po.de: Das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ist jetzt vergiftet.

1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.en: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 4 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 50 damage to it.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.zh-tw: 隨機選擇 1 只對手的神奇寶貝 4 次。每次選擇一隻神奇寶貝，對其造成 50 點傷害。
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.fr: Un des Pokémon de votre adversaire est choisi au hasard 4 fois. Pour chaque fois où un Pokémon est choisi, il subit 50 dégâts.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.es: Se elige 4 veces a un Pokémon aleatorio de tu rival. Haz a cada uno 50 puntos de daño por cada vez que haya resultado elegido.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.it: Per 4 volte, un Pokémon avversario viene scelto a caso. Ogni volta che un Pokémon viene scelto in questo modo, subisce 50 danni.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.de: 4 Mal wird zufällig 1 Pokémon des Gegners ausgewählt. Füge jedes Mal, wenn ein Pokémon ausgewählt wird, diesem Pokémon 50 Schadenspunkte zu.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.pt-br: 4 vezes, um Pokémon do oponente é escolhido aleatoriamente. Para cada vez que um Pokémon for escolhido, cause 50 pontos de dano a ele.

A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.en: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.zh-tw: 僅由肌肉組成的身體使得這只神奇寶貝用觸手進行的格鬥動作非常強大。
A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.fr:
Son corps est un amas de muscles. La puissance des prises
d'étranglement qu'il exécute avec ses tentacules est saisissante.
A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.es:
Todo su cuerpo es una mole de puro músculo.
Utiliza los tentáculos para ejecutar técnicas de
estrangulamiento con una formidable potencia.
A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.it:
Il suo corpo è un ammasso di muscoli.
È in grado di stritolare con una potenza
formidabile grazie ai suoi tentacoli.
A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.de:
Sein Körper besteht gänzlich aus Muskeln.
Die schiere Stärke seines Würgegriffs, bei dem
es seine Tentakel einsetzt, ist sagenhaft.
A body made up of nothing but muscle mak.pt-br:
O corpo composto unicamente de músculos deste
Pokémon torna os seus movimentos de chave com
os tentáculos incrivelmente poderosos.

A common sight in forests and woods. It.en: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
A common sight in forests and woods. It.zh-tw: 森林和樹林中常見的景象。它在地面上拍打翅膀，揚起令人眼花繚亂的沙子。
A common sight in forests and woods. It.fr:
On l'aperçoit souvent dans les forêts. Avec ses ailes,
il brasse l'air près du sol pour projeter du sable.
A common sight in forests and woods. It.es:
Muy común en bosques y selvas.
Aletea al nivel del suelo para levantar la gravilla.
A common sight in forests and woods. It.it:
Molto comune in boschi e foreste, sbatte le ali
a livello del suolo per sollevare sabbia accecante.
A common sight in forests and woods. It.de:
Ein vorwiegend in Wäldern lebendes Pokémon,
das zur Verteidigung mit den Flügeln Sand aufwirbelt.
A common sight in forests and woods. It.pt-br:
Uma visão comum nas florestas. Ele agita suas
asas no chão para levantar uma areia cegante.

A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.en: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.zh-tw: 聰明又善良的神奇寶貝，它在海面上滑行，周圍迴響著優美的歌聲。
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.fr:
C'est un Pokémon doux et intelligent.
Il vogue sur la mer en émettant un chant
magnifique.
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.es:
Este Pokémon posee una notable inteligencia
y un corazón de oro. Entona un canto
melodioso mientras surca el mar.
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.it:
È un Pokémon intelligente e dall'animo
gentile. Solca i mari facendo riecheggiare
il suo canto dolce e melodioso.
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.de:
Ein intelligentes und herzensgutes Pokémon.
Während es auf dem Meer schwimmt, lässt es
seinen herrlichen Gesang erklingen.
A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glid.pt-br:
Este Pokémon esperto e bondoso flutua
na superfície do oceano, enquanto sua
linda canção ecoa ao redor.

A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.en: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.zh-tw: 罕見的膽怯的精靈寶可夢，一旦感覺到有人就會逃跑並躲起來。
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.fr:
Ce Pokémon s'apparente à une petite fée
qui n'apparaît que rarement devant les humains.
Il court se cacher dès qu'il ressent une présence.
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.es:
Este Pokémon de aspecto feérico, raramente
visto por los humanos, corre a esconderse
en cuanto detecta que hay alguien cerca.
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.it:
Timido Pokémon Fata, molto raro a
vedersi. Scappa e si nasconde non
appena avverte la presenza delle persone.
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.de:
Ein feenhaftes und scheues Pokémon,
das sofort die Flucht ergreift, wenn es
Menschen wahrnimmt.
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely see.pt-br:
Um tímido Pokémon fada raramente visto,
corre e esconde-se assim que percebe
a presença de pessoas.

A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.en: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.zh-tw: 由於突變而被發現的雙頭寶可夢。它的運行速度超過每小時 60 英里。
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.fr:
Ce Pokémon à deux têtes est le résultat d'une
soudaine mutation. Il peut courir jusqu'à 100 km/h.
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.es:
Este Pokémon de dos cabezas es el
resultado de una mutación. Cuando corre,
puede alcanzar casi 100 km por hora.
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.it:
Pokémon a due teste, scoperto a seguito di
un'improvvisa mutazione. Può correre a 100 km/h.
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.de:
Dieses zweiköpfige Pokémon gilt als plötzliche
Mutation. Es rennt bis zu 100 km/h schnell.
A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered.pt-br:
Um Pokémon com duas cabeças que foi
descoberto como uma mutação repentina.
Ele corre a mais de 100 km/h.

All it does is sleep during the daytime..en: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
All it does is sleep during the daytime..zh-tw: 它所做的就是在白天睡覺。晚上，它眼睛會發光，在自己的領地巡邏。
All it does is sleep during the daytime..fr:
Il passe ses journées à dormir. La nuit venue,
il patrouille sur son territoire, les yeux brillants.
All it does is sleep during the daytime..es:
Durante el día, se dedica a dormir.
De noche, vigila su territorio con un brillo en los ojos.
All it does is sleep during the daytime..it:
Di giorno non fa che dormire, mentre la notte
perlustra il suo territorio con gli occhi luccicanti.
All it does is sleep during the daytime..de:
Es schläft den ganzen Tag. Nachts patrouilliert es
sein Revier mit glühenden Augen.
All it does is sleep during the daytime..pt-br:
Tudo o que este Pokémon faz é dormir
durante o dia. À noite, patrulha seu
território com seus olhos brilhantes.

Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.en: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.zh-tw: 這種神奇寶貝幾乎無法移動，只有在遇到危險時才能硬化外殼來保護自己。
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.fr:
Incapable de se déplacer de lui-même,
il se défend en durcissant sa carapace.
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.es:
Casi incapaz de moverse, este Pokémon solo
puede endurecer su caparazón para protegerse.
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.it:
Quasi incapace di muoversi, questo Pokémon può
solo indurire il proprio guscio per proteggersi.
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.de:
Dieses Pokémon kann sich kaum bewegen.
Bei drohender Gefahr verhärtet es seinen Panzer.
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon.pt-br:
Quase incapaz de se mover, esse Pokémon
pode apenas endurecer sua carapaça para
se proteger quando está em perigo.

Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.en: Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.
Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.zh-tw: 儘管袋鼠肚子上懷著孩子，但袋鼠的腳步卻很快。它通過快速刺擊來恐嚇對手。
Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.fr:
Porter son petit dans sa poche ventrale ne
l'empêche pas d'avoir un bon jeu de jambes.
Ses coups rapides intimident ses ennemis.
Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.es:
Aunque lleve una cría en el marsupio, su
juego de pies no pierde ligereza. Abruma
al rival con ráfagas de ágiles puñetazos.
Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.it:
Ha un agile gioco di gambe, nonostante si porti
appresso il cucciolo nel marsupio ventrale.
Intimidisce gli avversari con jab velocissimi.
Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.de:
Obwohl es sein Junges im Beutel trägt, bewegt
sich dieses Pokémon äußerst leichtfüßig. Gegner
schreckt Kangama mit blitzschnellen Schlägen ab.
Although it's carrying its baby in a pou.pt-br:
Apesar de carregar seu bebê na bolsa em
sua barriga, Kangaskhan é veloz. Intimida
seus oponentes com golpes rápidos.

Although its fur has many admirers, it i.en: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
Although its fur has many admirers, it i.zh-tw: 雖然它的皮毛有很多崇拜者，但由於它反复無常的卑鄙行為，很難作為寵物飼養。
Although its fur has many admirers, it i.fr:
Sa magnifique fourrure suscite l'admiration, mais il est difficile
à apprivoiser en raison de son caractère rétif.
Although its fur has many admirers, it i.es:
Aunque es muy admirado por el pelaje,
es difícil de entrenar como mascota
porque enseguida suelta arañazos.
Although its fur has many admirers, it i.it:
Molti lo vogliono come Pokémon da compagnia
per via dello splendido pelo, ma non va preso
sotto gamba perché graffia facilmente.
Although its fur has many admirers, it i.de:
Aufgrund seines schönen Fells wollen viele ein
Snobilikat im Haus haben. Es ist jedoch schwer
erziehbar, da es sehr schnell kratzt.
Although its fur has many admirers, it i.pt-br:
Apesar de sua pelugem ser admirada por muitos,
é difícil criá-lo como um Pokémon de estimação
por causa de sua maldade inconstante.

An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.en: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.
An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.zh-tw: 一幅古老的畫卷顯示，人們被它奔跑穿過草原的動作所吸引。
An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.fr:
Une vieille estampe montre que les êtres
humains étaient fascinés par ses mouvements
lorsqu'il courait dans les champs.
An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.es:
Cuenta un antiguo pergamino que la gente se
quedaba fascinada al verlo correr por las praderas.
An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.it:
Dal disegno su un'antica pergamena si vede come
le sue corse sui prati incantassero le persone.
An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.de:
Eine alte Bildrolle zeigt, dass die Menschen
von dem Anblick über Wiesen rennender
Arkani verzaubert waren.
An ancient picture scroll shows that peo.pt-br:
Um antigo pergaminho mostra que pessoas eram
cativadas por seu movimento enquanto este
Pokémon corria pelas pradarias.

An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.en: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.zh-tw: 敵人如果將目光從三個頭中的任何一個身上移開——哪怕只是一秒鐘——都會被狠狠地啄一下。
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.fr:
Un ennemi ne faisant pas attention à l'une
des trois têtes pendant une seconde se fait picorer.
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.es:
Más vale no perder de vista ninguna de las tres cabezas.
De lo contrario, el número de picotazos será enorme.
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.it:
Occorre fare attenzione a tutte le sue tre teste,
altrimenti si rischia d'essere colpiti duramente.
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.de:
Lässt ein Feind auch nur einen der
drei Köpfe für nur eine Sekunde aus
den Augen, wird er sofort gepickt.
An enemy that takes its eyes off any of.pt-br:
Um inimigo que tire os olhos de qualquer uma
das três cabeças, mesmo que por apenas um
segundo, será bicado gravemente.

An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.en: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.zh-tw: 力量不足、可憐的神奇寶貝。在極少數情況下，它可能會跳得很高，但永遠不會超過七英尺。
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.fr:
Un Pokémon tout à fait pathétique. En de très
rares occasions, il est capable de sauter haut,
mais jamais à plus de deux mètres.
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.es:
Un Pokémon desvalido y patético. A veces es
capaz de saltar alto, pero rara vez más de 2 m.
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.it:
Un Pokémon debole e patetico. Nelle rare
occasioni in cui spicca alti salti, non riesce
comunque a raggiungere i due metri.
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.de:
Ein schwaches und jämmerliches Pokémon.
Manchmal gelingen ihm hohe Sprünge,
aber über 2 m kommt es selten hinaus.
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It ma.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é patético e nem um pouco
poderoso. Às vezes, até pula bem alto,
mas nunca mais de dois metros.

Artillery platforms built into the walls.en: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
Artillery platforms built into the walls.zh-tw: 建在古城堡城牆上的砲台是古魯克可以發射能量束的棲息地。
Artillery platforms built into the walls.fr:
Les murs des châteaux de jadis disposaient de créneaux,
par lesquels les Golemastoc pouvaient tirer leurs rayons d'énergie.
Artillery platforms built into the walls.es:
En los muros de antiguos castillos se hallan
plataformas desde las que los Golurk podían
disparar sus rayos como si fueran cañones.
Artillery platforms built into the walls.it:
Nelle mura degli antichi castelli si trovano
dei basamenti, simili a quelli dei cannoni, dai
quali i Golurk potevano sparare i loro raggi.
Artillery platforms built into the walls.de:
In uralten Festungen finden sich heute noch
Sockel, die Golgantes beim Abfeuern seiner
Strahlen wohl als Halt dienen sollten.
Artillery platforms built into the walls.pt-br:
Plataformas de artilharia construídas nas paredes
de castelos antigos eram usadas por Golurk como
poleiros, de onde disparavam seus feixes de energia.

As it digs through the ground, it absorb.en: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
As it digs through the ground, it absorb.zh-tw: 當它挖掘地面時，它會吸收許多堅硬的物體。這就是它的身體如此堅固的原因。
As it digs through the ground, it absorb.fr:
Il absorbe des éléments solides en creusant le sol,
ce qui le rend plus robuste.
As it digs through the ground, it absorb.es:
Al abrirse paso bajo tierra, va absorbiendo todo lo que
encuentra. Eso hace que su cuerpo sea así de sólido.
As it digs through the ground, it absorb.it:
Scava nel terreno assorbendo gli oggetti
più duri per irrobustire il suo corpo.
As it digs through the ground, it absorb.de:
Wenn es sich durch die Erde gräbt,
nimmt es viele harte Gegenstände auf,
die seinen Körper erhärten.
As it digs through the ground, it absorb.pt-br:
Ao cavar o chão, absorve vários objetos rígidos,
tornando o seu corpo extremamente sólido.

As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.en: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand.
As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.zh-tw: 只要這只神奇寶貝在活動區域​​，對手就不能使用手牌中的任何支持者卡。
As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.fr: Tant que ce Pokémon est sur le Poste Actif, votre adversaire ne peut pas jouer de carte Supporter de sa main.
As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.es: Mientras este Pokémon esté en el Puesto Activo, tu rival no puede jugar ninguna carta de Partidario de su mano.
As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.it: Fintanto che questo Pokémon è in posizione attiva, il tuo avversario non può giocare le carte Aiuto che ha in mano.
As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.de: Solange dieses Pokémon in der Aktiven Position ist, kann dein Gegner keine Unterstützerkarten aus seiner Hand spielen.
As long as this Pokémon is in the Active.pt-br: Enquanto este Pokémon estiver no Campo Ativo, o seu oponente não poderá usar nenhuma carta de Apoiador da mão dele.

At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.en: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.zh-tw: 在其使用壽命結束時，美錄金屬會生鏽並分崩離析。留下的小碎片最終將重生為美錄坦。
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.fr:
En fin de vie, son corps rouille et se brise en mille morceaux.
Ces derniers renaissent ensuite sous forme de Meltan.
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.es:
Al final de su vida, su cuerpo se oxida y se
hace pedazos. Poco tiempo después, estos
fragmentos que quedan dan vida a varios Meltan.
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.it:
Alla fine della sua esistenza, si arrugginisce e
cade a pezzi. Dopo un po' di tempo, i resti del
suo corpo tornano in vita sotto forma di Meltan.
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.de:
Geht sein Leben dem Ende zu, rostet sein Körper
und fällt auseinander. Kurz darauf erwachen die
verbliebenen Fragmente als Meltan zum Leben.
At the end of its life-span, Melmetal wi.pt-br:
No fim de sua vida, Melmetal enferrujará e se
despedaçará. Os pequenos cacos que ficarem
para trás eventualmente renascerão como Meltan.

Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.en: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.zh-tw: 因為它可以使用各種招式，許多科學家認為喵是神奇寶貝的祖先。
Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.fr:
Nombre de scientifiques voient en lui l'ancêtre des Pokémon
car il maîtrise toutes leurs capacités.
Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.es:
Varios científicos lo consideran el antecesor de los
Pokémon porque usa todo tipo de movimientos.
Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.it:
Poiché sa usare qualsiasi mossa,
molti scienziati ritengono che Mew
sia l'antenato di tutti i Pokémon.
Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.de:
Es beherrscht alle möglichen Attacken, daher sieht
man in ihm den Vorfahren aller Pokémon.
Because it can use all kinds of moves, m.pt-br:
Como pode usar todos os tipos de movimentos,
muitos cientistas acreditam que Mew seja
o ancestral dos Pokémon.

Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.en: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.
Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.zh-tw: 由於一些阿曼人在被恢復後設法逃脫或被人類釋放到野外，這個物種正在成為一個問題。
Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.fr:
Ce Pokémon commence à poser problème,
car certains spécimens se sont enfuis ou
ont été relâchés après avoir été ressuscités.
Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.es:
Varios ejemplares han escapado o bien han
sido liberados tras su restauración, lo que
comienza a suscitar una serie de problemas.
Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.it:
Questo Pokémon si sta rivelando un problema
perché a volte fugge o viene liberato dopo
essere stato rigenerato.
Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.de:
Diese Pokémon entwickeln sich allmählich zu
einem Problem, da einige wiederbelebte
Exemplare fliehen oder freigelassen werden.
Because some Omanyte manage to escape af.pt-br:
Alguns Omanyte escapam após serem restaurados
ou são soltos por pessoas na natureza. Por conta
disso, esta espécie está se tornando um problema.

Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.en: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.zh-tw: 這些神奇寶貝從污泥中誕生，現在聚集在污染的地方並增加了體內的細菌。
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.fr:
Torrent de boue devenu Pokémon, il vit dans
les lieux les plus insalubres pour que le nombre
de microbes qu'il héberge augmente.
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.es:
Formados a partir de lodo, los Grimer se
juntan en lugares sucios para aumentar
el número de gérmenes de su cuerpo.
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.it:
Un Pokémon nato dalla melma. Predilige
i posti sporchi perché gli permettono
di aumentare la sua carica batterica.
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.de:
Diese aus Schlamm entstandenen Pokémon
scharen sich an dreckigen Orten, um ihre
körpereigenen Bakterien zu kultivieren.
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gath.pt-br:
Nascidos no lodo, esses Pokémon agora
reúnem-se em locais poluídos e aumentam
a quantidade de bactérias em seus corpos.

By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.en: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.zh-tw: 通過使下巴脫臼，它可以吞下比自己大的獵物。吃完飯後，它會蜷縮起來休息。
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.fr:
Il peut se déboîter la mâchoire pour avaler tout rond des proies
plus grosses que lui. Il se replie ensuite sur lui-même pour digérer.
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.es:
Es capaz de desencajar la mandíbula para
engullir presas enteras mayores que él mismo,
tras lo cual se enrosca para descansar.
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.it:
Può sganciare la mandibola per ingoiare
intere prede più grosse di lui. Dopo il pasto,
si arrotola su se stesso per riposarsi.
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.de:
Es hängt seinen Kiefer aus und verschlingt so
selbst größere Beute am Stück. Danach rollt
es sich zusammen und ruht sich aus.
By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow p.pt-br:
Desloca a própria mandíbula para engolir presas
maiores que si mesmo. Depois de uma refeição,
se enrosca e descansa.

Carrying food through Fearow's territory.en: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
Carrying food through Fearow's territory.zh-tw: 通過費羅領地運送食物是很危險的。它會瞬間把你的食物搶走！
Carrying food through Fearow's territory.fr:
Si vous vous promenez sur le territoire
d'un Rapasdepic en transportant de la nourriture,
vous risquez de vite la voir s'envoler !
Carrying food through Fearow's territory.es:
Es peligroso pasear con comida por su
territorio, ya que supone exponerse a que en
cualquier momento se abalance para robarla.
Carrying food through Fearow's territory.it:
Chi attraversa il suo territorio portando
con sé del cibo corre il rischio di vederselo
strappare via in men che non si dica.
Carrying food through Fearow's territory.de:
Wer Essbares dabeihat, sollte sich nicht in
Ibitaks Revier begeben, da sonst ein Überfall
aus heiterem Himmel droht.
Carrying food through Fearow's territory.pt-br:
Transportar alimento através do território
de Fearow é perigoso, porque este Pokémon
roubará a comida em um instante!

Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.en: Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, take a {W} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon.
Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.zh-tw: 選擇你的 1 個 {W} 神奇寶貝，然後擲硬幣，直到出現反面。對於每個頭，從你的能量區取出一個 {W} 能量並將其附加到該神奇寶貝上。
Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.fr: Choisissez un de vos Pokémon {W} et lancez une pièce jusqu'à ce que vous obteniez pile. Pour chaque côté face, prenez une Énergie {W} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-la à ce Pokémon.
Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.es: Elige 1 de tus Pokémon {W}, y luego lanza 1 moneda hasta que salga cruz. Por cada cara, une 1 Energía {W} de tu área de Energía a ese Pokémon.
Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.it: Scegli uno dei tuoi Pokémon {W}, poi lancia una moneta finché non esce croce. Ogni volta che esce testa, prendi un'Energia {W} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a quel Pokémon.
Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.de: Wähle 1 deiner {W}-Pokémon und wirf anschließend so lange 1 Münze, bis sie Zahl zeigt. Lege pro Kopf 1 {W}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an jenes Pokémon an.
Choose 1 of your {W} Pokémon, and flip a.pt-br: Escolha 1 dos seus Pokémon {W}, e jogue uma moeda até sair coroa. Para cada cara, pegue uma Energia {W} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a àquele Pokémon.

Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.en: Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s attacks and use it as this attack. If this Pokémon doesn’t have the necessary Energy to use that attack, this attack does nothing.
Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.zh-tw: 選擇對手寶可夢的1只攻擊，作為這次攻擊。如果該神奇寶貝沒有使用該攻擊所需的能量，則該攻擊不會執行任何操作。
Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.fr: Choisissez l'une des attaques des Pokémon de votre adversaire et utilisez-la en tant que cette attaque. Si ce Pokémon n'a pas l'Énergie nécessaire pour utiliser cette attaque, cette attaque ne fait rien.
Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.es: Elige 1 de los ataques de los Pokémon de tu rival y úsalo para este ataque. Si este Pokémon no tiene la Energía necesaria para usar ese ataque, este ataque no hace nada.
Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.it: Scegli un attacco dei Pokémon del tuo avversario e usalo al posto di questo attacco. Se questo Pokémon non ha l'Energia necessaria per quell'attacco, questo attacco non ha effetto.
Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.de: Wähle 1 Attacke der Pokémon deines Gegners und setze sie als diese Attacke ein. Wenn dieses Pokémon nicht die für jene Attacke notwendige Energie hat, hat diese Attacke keine Auswirkungen.
Choose 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon’s at.pt-br: Escolha 1 dos ataques dos Pokémon do seu oponente e use como este ataque. Se este Pokémon não tiver a Energia necessária para atacar, este ataque não fará nada.

Cloyster that live in seas with harsh ti.en: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh ti.zh-tw: 生活在潮汐洶湧的海洋中的蛤蚌，其貝殼上長有又大又尖的尖刺。

Les Crustabri vivant dans des mers aux courants
forts développent des dards particulièrement
imposants et aiguisés sur leur coquille.
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh ti.es:
A los Cloyster que viven en las fuertes corrientes
marinas les crecen largas y afiladas púas en la concha.

Ai Cloyster che vivono in mari con forti correnti
crescono grandi aculei appuntiti sul guscio.
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh ti.de:

Strömung leben, entwickeln große
und scharfe Stacheln an ihrer Schale.
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh ti.pt-br:
Cloyster que vivem em mares com correntes
intensas desenvolvem espinhos grandes
e afiados em suas conchas.

Despite their elegant appearance, they c.en: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
Despite their elegant appearance, they c.zh-tw: 儘管外表優雅，但它們卻能有力地扇動翅膀，飛翔千里。
Despite their elegant appearance, they c.fr:
Un Pokémon gracieux, mais aussi robuste. Il peut voler
des milliers de kilomètres grâce à ses ailes puissantes.
Despite their elegant appearance, they c.es:
Aunque no lo parezca por su grácil
elegancia, puede batir con fuerza las
alas y volar durante miles de kilómetros.
Despite their elegant appearance, they c.it:
Non è solo elegante. Con il poderoso battito d'ali riesce
a volare per migliaia di chilometri senza fermarsi.
Despite their elegant appearance, they c.de:
Sie wirken zerbrechlich, aber ihre starken Schwingen
tragen sie in einem Stück bis zu 1000 km weit.
Despite their elegant appearance, they c.pt-br:
Apesar de sua aparência elegante, podem bater
as asas com vigor e voar por milhares de quilômetros.

Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.en: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.
Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.zh-tw: 椰蛋樹的三個腦袋分別在思考著不同的想法。三人似乎對彼此都不太感興趣。
Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.fr:
Chacune de ses trois têtes pense de manière autonome.
Elles ne semblent s'intéresser qu'à elles-mêmes.
Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.es:
Cada una de las tres cabezas piensa
de forma independiente y apenas
muestra interés por el resto.
Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.it:
Le sue tre teste ragionano in
modo indipendente. Sembra
che ciascuna pensi solo a sé.
Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.de:
Jeder der drei Köpfe hat einen
eigenen Willen und scheint sich
nur für sich selbst zu interessieren.
Each of Exeggutor's three heads is think.pt-br:
Cada uma das três cabeças de Exeggutor está
pensando em coisas diferentes. Elas não parecem
se interessar umas pelas outras.

Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.en: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.zh-tw: 發出強大的聲波使其疲憊不堪。之後，它將會有一段時間無法飛翔。
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.fr:
Émettre des ondes sonores ultra-puissantes le fatigue tellement
qu'il n'a plus de forces pour voler.
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.es:
Tras emitir sus potentísimas ondas,
queda tan exhausto que es incapaz
de volar durante un tiempo.
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.it:
Dopo aver emesso delle potentissime onde sonore
è così stanco da non poter volare per un po'.
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.de:
Hat es besonders starke Ultraschallwellen
ausgestoßen, wird es so müde, dass es für
eine Weile nicht fliegen kann.
Emitting powerful sound waves tires it o.pt-br:
Emitir ondas sonoras poderosas faz com
que fique cansado. Depois, não consegue
voar por um tempo.

Even though its body is extremely skinny.en: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
Even though its body is extremely skinny.zh-tw: 儘管它的身體極其瘦弱，但捕捉獵物的速度卻快得驚人。
Even though its body is extremely skinny.fr:
Même si son corps est très frêle, ce Pokémon
est extrêmement rapide quand il attaque ses adversaires.
Even though its body is extremely skinny.es:
Aunque su cuerpo es extremadamente delgado,
es muy rápido a la hora de capturar sus presas.
Even though its body is extremely skinny.it:
Sebbene abbia un corpo magrissimo, sa essere
molto rapido quando si scaglia sulla preda.
Even though its body is extremely skinny.de:
Obwohl sein Körper sehr schmal ist,
schnappt es blitzschnell nach Beute.
Even though its body is extremely skinny.pt-br:
Mesmo tendo um corpo extremamente magro,
é estupidamente rápido para pegar suas presas.

Females are more sensitive to smells tha.en: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.
Females are more sensitive to smells tha.zh-tw: 女性比男性對氣味更敏感。覓食時，它們會用鬍鬚檢查風向並保持在捕食者的下風處。
Females are more sensitive to smells tha.fr:
Son odorat est plus développé que celui du mâle.
Quand Nidoran♀ cherche à manger, il reste dans
le sens du vent, qu'il détecte avec ses vibrisses.
Females are more sensitive to smells tha.es:
Posee un olfato más fino que los Nidoran♂. Usa
los bigotes para percibir la dirección del viento y
buscar comida a sotavento de sus depredadores.
Females are more sensitive to smells tha.it:
È più sensibile agli odori rispetto ai maschi.
Capta le correnti d'aria con le vibrisse e si
posiziona sottovento per cercare le prede.
Females are more sensitive to smells tha.de:
Sie sind geruchsempfindlicher als Nidoran♂.
Auf Nahrungssuche folgen sie der Windrichtung,
die sie mit ihren Tasthaaren ermitteln.
Females are more sensitive to smells tha.pt-br:
As fêmeas possuem um olfato mais aguçado.
Ao procurar por comida, usam seus bigodes para
checar a direção do vento e evitar predadores.

Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pok.fr: Lancez une pièce. Si c'est face, le Pokémon Défenseur ne peut pas attaquer pendant le prochain tour de votre adversaire.
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pok.es: Lanza 1 moneda. Si sale cara, el Pokémon Defensor no puede atacar durante el próximo turno de tu rival.
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pok.it:
Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, durante il prossimo
turno del tuo avversario, il Pokémon difensore non può
attaccare.
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pok.de: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Kopf kann das Verteidigende Pokémon während des nächsten Zuges deines Gegners nicht angreifen.
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pok.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se sair cara, o Pokémon Defensor não poderá atacar durante o próximo turno do seu oponente.

Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.en: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.zh-tw: 拋一枚硬幣。如果正面，此攻擊會造成 40 點額外傷害。如果是反面，這只神奇寶貝也會對自己造成 20 點傷害。
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.es: Lanza una moneda. Si sale cara, este ataque hace 40 puntos de daño más. Si sale cruz, este Pokémon también se hace 20 puntos de daño a sí mismo.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.fr: Lancez une pièce de monnaie. Si c’est face, cette attaque inflige 40 dégâts supplémentaires. Si c'est pile, ce Pokémon s'inflige également 20 dégâts.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.it: Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, questo attacco infligge 40 danni in più. Se esce croce, questo Pokémon infligge anche 20 danni a se stesso.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se der cara, este ataque causa 40 de dano a mais. Se sair coroa, este Pokémon também causa 20 de dano a si mesmo.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.de: Wirf eine Münze. Bei „Kopf“ fügt dieser Angriff 40 Schadenspunkte mehr zu. Bei „Zahl“ fügt sich dieses Pokémon außerdem selbst 20 Schadenspunkte zu.

Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.en: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon into their deck.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.zh-tw: 拋一枚硬幣。如果出現正面，對手將其活躍神奇寶貝洗入牌組。
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.es: Lanza una moneda. Si sale cara, tu oponente baraja sus Pokémon Activos en su mazo.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.it: Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, il tuo avversario rimischia i suoi Pokémon attivi nel suo mazzo.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.fr: Lancez une pièce de monnaie. Si c'est face, votre adversaire mélange son Pokémon Actif dans son deck.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.de: Wirf eine Münze. Bei „Kopf“ mischt dein Gegner sein Aktives Pokémon in sein Deck.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shu.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se der cara, seu oponente embaralhará seus Pokémon Ativos em seu deck.

For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.en: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.zh-tw: 對於 Poliwag 來說，游泳比走路更容易。它腹部的漩渦圖案實際上是神奇寶貝通過皮膚顯現出來的內臟的一部分。
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.fr:
Il est plus à l'aise dans l'eau que sur la terre ferme.
Le motif de spirale sur son ventre est en fait une
partie de ses organes visibles à travers la peau.
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.es:
Es más ágil en el agua que en la tierra.
La espiral de su vientre no es más que parte
de sus vísceras que se ven a través de la piel.
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.it:
È più portato per il nuoto che per la corsa.
Il motivo spiraliforme sul ventre è parte dei
suoi organi interni visibili in trasparenza.
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.de:
Quapsel kann besser schwimmen als laufen.
Das Spiralmuster auf seinem Bauch ist ein Teil
seiner Innereien, der durch die Haut sichtbar ist.
For Poliwag, swimming is easier than wal.pt-br:
Para Poliwag, nadar é mais fácil do que andar.
A espiral em sua barriga é, na verdade, parte dos órgãos
deste Pokémon que pode ser vista através de sua pele.

For protection, it releases a horrible s.en: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
For protection, it releases a horrible s.zh-tw: 為了保護自己，它會從頭上的天線釋放出可怕的惡臭來驅趕敵人。
For protection, it releases a horrible s.fr:
Pour se protéger, il émet par ses antennes
une odeur nauséabonde qui fait fuir ses ennemis.
For protection, it releases a horrible s.es:
Para protegerse, despide un hedor horrible por
las antenas con el que repele a sus enemigos.
For protection, it releases a horrible s.it:
Per proteggersi emette un puzzo terribile dalle
antenne sul capo, con cui tiene lontani i nemici.
For protection, it releases a horrible s.de:
Als Schutz vor Feinden sondert es einen übel
riechenden Gestank mit seinen Antennen ab.
For protection, it releases a horrible s.pt-br:
Para se proteger, libera um fedor horrível das
antenas na cabeça para afastar seus inimigos.

Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.en: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.
Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.zh-tw: 霜蛾用觸角感知氣流。它的鱗片在寒冷的空氣中飄浮，使它們像雪一樣落下。
Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.fr:
Ce Pokémon perçoit les courants d'air grâce
à ses antennes. Il lance ses écailles dans l'air
glacé, et elles tombent comme de la neige.
Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.es:
Puede percibir con sus antenas las corrientes
atmosféricas. Impregna sus escamas de frío
y las hace caer como si fuera nieve.
Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.it:
Percepisce le correnti d'aria grazie alle
antenne. Impregna di aria gelida le sue
scaglie per farle poi cadere a mo' di nevicata.
Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.de:
Mit seinen Fühlern kann es Veränderungen in der
Atmosphäre wahrnehmen. Seinen mit Kälte
versetzten Flügelstaub lässt es wie Schnee rieseln.
Frosmoth senses air currents with its an.pt-br:
Frosmoth sente as correntes de ar com suas
antenas. Arremessa suas escamas no ar gélido,
fazendo com que caiam como neve.

Geodude that have lived a long life have.en: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.
Geodude that have lived a long life have.zh-tw: 壽命很長的晶石的所有邊緣都被磨平，直到完全變圓。他們的性格也很沉穩、安靜。
Geodude that have lived a long life have.fr:
Les aspérités de Racaillou s'adoucissent au fil
des années, tout comme sa personnalité.
Il devient tout lisse, tout rond, et tout calme.
Geodude that have lived a long life have.es:
Con la edad, su temperamento se amansa
y su cuerpo se va alisando hasta adquirir
una forma completamente redonda.
Geodude that have lived a long life have.it:
Col passare degli anni le asperità del suo corpo
vengono levigate, rendendolo perfettamente
rotondo, e il suo carattere si fa più tranquillo.
Geodude that have lived a long life have.de:
Mit dem Alter verliert es zunehmend seine
Kantigkeit, bis es vollkommen rund und auch
charakterlich immer ausgeglichener wird.
Geodude that have lived a long life have.pt-br:
Geodude que já viveram muito são completamente
redondos, porque todas as irregularidades foram polidas
pelo tempo. Sua natureza também se torna calma e tranquila.

Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon..zh-tw: 治療該寶可夢造成的 10 點傷害。
Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon..es: Cura 10 puntos de daño de este Pokémon.
Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon..pt-br: Cure 10 pontos de dano deste Pokémon.

Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémo.en: Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémon.
Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémo.zh-tw: 治療你的 1 只 {G} 神奇寶貝造成的 50 點傷害。
Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémo.it: Cura 50 danni da 1 dei tuoi Pokémon {G}.
Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémo.es: Cura 50 puntos de daño de 1 de tus {G} Pokémon.
Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémo.pt-br: Cure 50 de dano de 1 dos seus Pokémon {G}.
Heal 50 damage from 1 of your {G} Pokémo.fr: Soignez 50 dégâts d'un de vos {G} Pokémon.

Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.en: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝所造成的傷害與你對對手的活躍神奇寶貝造成的傷害相同。
Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.fr: Soignez ce Pokémon du nombre de dégâts que vous avez infligés au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire.
Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.es: Cura a este Pokémon el mismo número de puntos de daño que hayas infligido al Pokémon Activo de tu rival.
Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.it: Cura questo Pokémon da una quantità di danni pari a quelli inflitti al Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario.
Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.de: Heile bei diesem Pokémon genauso viel Schaden, wie du dem Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners zugefügt hast.
Heal from this Pokémon the same amount o.pt-br: Cure deste Pokémon a mesma quantidade de dano que você causou ao Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente.

Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.en: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.zh-tw: 隱藏在纏結的藤蔓之下，即使藤蔓被扯斷，藤蔓也會不停地生長，這只神奇寶貝的真實面貌仍然是個謎。
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.fr:
On ne sait toujours pas ce qui se cache sous ses lianes.
Même si on les coupe, elles repoussent à l'infini.
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.es:
Sus lianas no dejan de crecer aunque se le desprendan.
Aún se desconoce qué aspecto tiene sin ellas.
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.it:
Non è ancora chiaro quale sia il vero aspetto
celato dietro alle sue liane, che crescono
all'infinito anche dopo essere state recise.
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.de:
Seine wahre Gestalt ist weiterhin ein Mysterium,
da sie von Ranken verdeckt wird, die unaufhörlich
nachwachsen, selbst wenn sie abreißen.
Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that gr.pt-br:
Esconde-se sob um emaranhado de trepadeiras que
crescem sem parar mesmo se forem arrancadas.
A verdadeira aparência deste Pokémon permanece um mistério.

Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.en: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.zh-tw: 馬鞭草棲息在水流平緩的海洋中。如果這只神奇寶貝受到攻擊，它會吐出漆黑的墨水並逃跑。
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.fr:
Il vit dans les mers calmes. Quand on l'attaque,
il crache de l'encre noire et profite de la diversion
pour s'enfuir.
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.es:
Habita en mares de aguas tranquilas.
Si se siente en peligro, expulsará por la
boca una densa tinta negra para poder huir.
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.it:
Vive in mari dalle correnti tranquille.
Quando viene attaccato spruzza inchiostro
nero e ne approfitta per fuggire.
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.de:
Es lebt in Meeren mit ruhigem Gezeitenstrom.
Wird es angegriffen, versprüht es tiefschwarze
Tinte und ergreift daraufhin die Flucht.
Horsea makes its home in oceans with gen.pt-br:
Horsea vive em oceanos com correntezas
tranquilas. Quando está sob ataque, este
Pokémon cospe tinta preta e escapa.

If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.en: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.zh-tw: 如果暴露在月光下，它就會開始移動。它在夜間四處遊蕩以傳播種子。
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.fr:
Il ne bouge que lorsqu'il est exposé aux rayons de la lune.
Il se déplace alors pour disséminer ses graines.
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.es:
Se mueve al exponerse a la luz de la luna.
Merodea por la noche para esparcir sus semillas.
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.it:
Inizia a muoversi quando è illuminato dalla luce
lunare. Di notte se ne va in giro a spargere semi.
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.de:
Wird es vom Mondschein getroffen, bewegt es
sich. Nachts wandert es weite Wege, um seine
Samen zu verstreuen.
If exposed to moonlight, it starts to mo.pt-br:
Ao ser exposto à luz da lua, começa
a se mover. Aventura-se por aí durante
a noite para espalhar suas sementes.

If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.en: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.zh-tw: 如果雙胞胎 Koffing 中的一個膨脹，另一個就會收縮。它不斷地混合有毒氣體。
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.fr:
Si l'un des deux Smogo se gonfle, l'autre se dégonfle.
Ils mélangent leurs gaz en permanence.
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.es:
Si uno de los gemelos Koffing se
infla, el otro se desinfla. Mezclan
constantemente sus venenosos gases.
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.it:
Se un gemello Koffing si sgonfia, l'altro si gonfia.
I gas velenosi dei due si mischiano continuamente.
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.de:
Pumpt sich eines der zwei Smogon auf, lässt das
andere Luft ab. So findet ein Giftgasaustausch statt.
If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the.pt-br:
Se um dos gêmeos Koffing inflar, o outro
esvazia, misturando constantemente
seus gases venenosos.

If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.en: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.zh-tw: 如果這只神奇寶貝附加了至少 2 個額外的 {W} 能量，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 60 點。
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.fr: Si ce Pokémon a au moins 2 Énergies {W} de plus, cette attaque inflige 60 dégâts supplémentaires.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.es: Si este Pokémon tiene por lo menos 2 Energías {W} adicionales unidas a él, este ataque hace 60 puntos de daño más.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.it: Se questo Pokémon ha almeno 2 Energie {W} extra assegnate, questo attacco infligge 60 danni in più.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon mindestens 2 extra {W}-Energien angelegt sind, fügt diese Attacke 60 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {W}.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver pelo menos 2 Energia {W} extra ligada a ele, este ataque causará 60 pontos de dano a mais.

If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.en: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W} Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.
If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.zh-tw: 如果這只神奇寶貝附加了至少 3 個額外的 {W} 能量，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 70 點。
If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.fr: Si ce Pokémon a au moins 3 Énergies {W} supplémentaires attachées, cette attaque inflige 70 dégâts supplémentaires.
If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.es: Si este Pokémon tiene al menos 3 Energías {W} extra unidas, este ataque hace 70 puntos de daño más.
If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver pelo menos 3 energias {W} extras anexadas, este ataque causará 70 de dano a mais.
If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.it: Se questo Pokémon ha almeno tre Energie {W} extra assegnate, questo attacco infligge 70 danni in più.
If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra {W}.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon mindestens 3 zusätzliche {W}-Energien angelegt sind, fügt dieser Angriff 70 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.en: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.zh-tw: 如果這只神奇寶貝粘稠的唾液沾到你身上而你又不把它清理掉，就會出現強烈的瘙癢感。而且瘙癢感也不會消失。
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.fr:
Si sa salive gluante entre en contact avec la peau
et qu'on ne l'essuie pas bien, elle provoque de
terribles démangeaisons qui ne s'arrêtent jamais.
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.es:
Si sus lametones no se tratan a tiempo,
su saliva pegajosa y urticante puede
provocar picores persistentes.
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.it:
La sua saliva appiccicosa provoca
un prurito terribile che non dà tregua
se le parti leccate non vengono ripulite.
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.de:
Wäscht man sich nach der Berührung mit seinem
klebrigen Speichel nicht, setzt bald ein starker
Juckreiz ein, der nicht mehr zu stoppen ist.
If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on.pt-br:
Se você entrar em contato com a saliva grudenta
deste Pokémon e não se limpar, sentirá uma
coceira intensa. E a coceira não parará.

If you visit a beach at the end of summe.en: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.
If you visit a beach at the end of summe.zh-tw: 如果您在夏末訪問海灘，您將能夠看到成群的 Staryu 以穩定的節奏發光。
If you visit a beach at the end of summe.fr:
Lorsqu'on se rend en bord de mer à la fin
de l'été, on peut voir des groupes de Stari
clignoter à un rythme régulier.
If you visit a beach at the end of summe.es:
A finales de verano, se pueden ver grupos
de Staryu en la orilla de la playa sincronizando
el brillo de sus núcleos a ritmo regular.
If you visit a beach at the end of summe.it:
Alla fine dell'estate, sui litorali è
possibile osservare gruppi di Staryu
che emettono luce a un ritmo regolare.
If you visit a beach at the end of summe.de:
Bei spätsommerlichen Strandbesuchen kann man
Gruppen von Sterndu begegnen, deren Kerne in
gleichmäßigem Rhythmus aufblinken.
If you visit a beach at the end of summe.pt-br:
Se for à praia perto do fim do verão, você
verá grupos de Staryu iluminados em um
ritmo contínuo.

If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.en: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.zh-tw: 如果對手的活躍寶可夢受到傷害，則這次攻擊造成的傷害增加 60 點。
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.fr: Si le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire a subi des dégâts, cette attaque inflige 60 dégâts de plus.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.es: Si el Pokémon Activo de tu rival ya tiene daño, este ataque hace 60 puntos de daño más.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.it: Se il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è danneggiato, questo attacco infligge 60 danni in più.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.de: Wenn dem Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners bereits Schaden zugefügt wurde, fügt diese Attacke 60 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has da.pt-br: Se o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente estiver danificado, este ataque causará 60 pontos de dano a mais.

If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.en: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.zh-tw: 如果對手的活躍寶可夢中毒，則這次攻擊造成的傷害增加 50 點。
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.fr: Si le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est Empoisonné, cette attaque inflige 50 dégâts de plus.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.es: Si el Pokémon Activo de tu rival está Envenenado, este ataque hace 50 puntos de daño más.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.it: Se il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è avvelenato, questo attacco infligge 50 danni in più.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.de: Wenn das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners vergiftet ist, fügt diese Attacke 50 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.pt-br: Se o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente estiver Envenenado, este ataque causará 50 pontos de dano a mais.

In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.en: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.zh-tw: 到了秋天，它的身體會變得更加肥胖，準備向伴侶求婚。它呈現出美麗的色彩。
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.fr:
En automne, à la saison des amours, il fait des réserves
de graisse et arbore des couleurs chatoyantes.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.es:
En otoño gana algo de peso para atraer a posibles
parejas y se cubre de llamativos colores.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.it:
In autunno ingrassa in previsione della stagione
degli amori e assume colori sgargianti.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.de:
Im Herbst legt es an Gewicht zu
und erscheint in prächtigen Farben,
um so einen Partner anzulocken.
In autumn, its body becomes more fatty i.pt-br:
No outono, ganha peso para atrair
possíveis companheiros. Adorna-se
em lindas cores.

In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.en: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.zh-tw: 在戰鬥中，它會以極快的速度拍打翅膀，將劇毒粉塵釋放到空氣中。
In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.fr:
En combat, il bat des ailes très rapidement pour
projeter de la poudre toxique sur ses ennemis.
In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.es:
Aletea a gran velocidad para lanzar al aire
sus escamas extremadamente tóxicas.
In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.it:
Sbatte le ali a gran velocità per liberare
le sue polveri tossiche nell'aria.
In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.de:
Wenn es sehr schnell mit den Flügeln schlägt,
setzt es hochgiftigen Flügelstaub frei.
In battle, it flaps its wings at great s.pt-br:
Durante as batalhas, bate as asas muito rápido
para liberar uma poeira altamente tóxica no ar.

In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.en: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.zh-tw: 一分鐘內，訓練有素的Mienfoo可以用手臂砍100多次。
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.fr:
Les Kungfouine bien entraînés sont capables d'asséner
plus de cent coups par minute du tranchant de la main.
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.es:
Un Mienfoo bien entrenado es capaz de
propinar más de cien golpes por minuto.
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.it:
I Mienfoo più allenati sono in grado di sferrare
più di 100 colpi al minuto con il taglio della mano.
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.de:
Ein gut trainiertes Lin-Fu kann in einer Minute
über 100 Schläge ausführen.
In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo ca.pt-br:
Um Mienfoo bem treinado é capaz de usar seus braços
para dar mais de 100 golpes por minuto.

Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.en: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.zh-tw: 吸入的空氣被帶到其火囊中，被加熱，並以高達 3,000 華氏度以上的火焰的形式呼出。
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.fr:
Sa glande enflammée chauffe l'air qu'il inspire.
Il l'exhale ensuite sous forme de flamme
atteignant les 1 700 °C.
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.es:
Calienta el aire que inhala en su saca
de fuego y lo expulsa a 1700 °C.
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.it:
L'aria che inspira si infiamma passando per la
sacca ardente che ha nel corpo, per poi essere
espirata alla temperatura di 1.700 ºC.
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.de:
Es speichert Atemluft in einem Flammensack.
Dort erhitzt es sie auf 1700 °C, um sie als
Flammen auszuspucken.
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac,.pt-br:
O ar inalado é transportado para sua bolsa
de chamas, aquecido e exalado quando
o fogo atinge mais de 1600 ºC.

It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.en: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.
It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.zh-tw: 如果它感覺到有人在看它，它就會變得非常憤怒。它會追逐任何遇到它目光的人。
It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.fr:
Il devient fou furieux s'il se sent observé
et pourchasse tout être qui croise son regard.
It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.es:
Se pone furioso si nota que alguien lo
está mirando. Persigue a cualquiera
que establezca contacto visual con él.
It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.it:
Diventa furioso se si sente osservato.
Insegue chiunque incontri il suo sguardo.
It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.de:
Spürt Rasaff, dass jemand es anblickt, wird es
rasend vor Wut. Es verfolgt jeden, der es wagt,
seinen Blick zu erwidern.
It becomes wildly furious if it even sen.pt-br:
Fica incrivelmente furioso se perceber que
está sendo observado. Persegue qualquer
um que o encarar.

It begins walking on its hind legs after.en: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
It begins walking on its hind legs after.zh-tw: 進化後，它開始用後腿行走。它可以用角在巨石上打孔。
It begins walking on its hind legs after.fr:
L'évolution a permis à ce Pokémon de marcher
sur ses pattes postérieures. Il peut faire des trous
dans les rochers en utilisant sa corne.
It begins walking on its hind legs after.es:
Cuando evoluciona, comienza a andar
con las patas traseras. Es capaz de
horadar rocas con el cuerno que tiene.
It begins walking on its hind legs after.it:
Dopo l'evoluzione inizia a muoversi sulle zampe
posteriori. Con il corno può perforare la roccia.
It begins walking on its hind legs after.de:
Nach seiner Entwicklung geht es aufrecht auf
seinen Hinterbeinen. Mit seinem Horn kann es
Löcher in Felsen bohren.
It begins walking on its hind legs after.pt-br:
Após evoluir, começa a andar com
suas pernas traseiras. Consegue furar
rochedos com seu chifre.

It can be found near the sea. The large.en: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
It can be found near the sea. The large.zh-tw: 它可以在海邊附近找到。如果將大鉗子從插座中拔出，它們就會重新長出來。
It can be found near the sea. The large.fr:
On trouve ce Pokémon près de la mer.
Ses grosses pinces peuvent repousser
si elles sont arrachées.
It can be found near the sea. The large.es:
Es fácil encontrarlo cerca del mar. Las largas pinzas
que tiene vuelven a crecer si se las quitan de su sitio.
It can be found near the sea. The large.it:
Lo si può trovare vicino al mare. Le grandi
chele, se si staccano, ricrescono.
It can be found near the sea. The large.de:
Es kommt vor allem nahe dem Meer vor.
Die großen Scheren wachsen nach, wenn
sie vom Körper abgetrennt wurden.
It can be found near the sea. The large.pt-br:
Estes Pokémon vivem perto do mar e
suas grandes pinças crescem de volta
se forem arrancadas.

It can sense the feelings of others by t.en: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.
It can sense the feelings of others by t.zh-tw: 它可以通過用角觸碰他人來感知他人的感受。自 5000 年前以來，這個物種就一直在幫助人們工作。
It can sense the feelings of others by t.fr:
Il peut ressentir les émotions de ses adversaires
en les touchant avec ses cornes. Il aide les êtres
humains dans leurs travaux depuis 5 000 ans.
It can sense the feelings of others by t.es:
Puede percibir cómo se siente alguien tocándolo
con los cuernos. Lleva ayudando a los humanos
en sus labores desde hace 5000 años.
It can sense the feelings of others by t.it:
Riesce a percepire lo stato d'animo di
chiunque tocchi con le corna. Aiuta gli esseri
umani nelle loro attività da 5.000 anni.
It can sense the feelings of others by t.de:
Berührt es sein Gegenüber mit den Hörnern, kann
es dessen Gefühle erspüren. Seit 5000 Jahren
geht es den Menschen bei der Arbeit zur Hand.
It can sense the feelings of others by t.pt-br:
É capaz de saber o que os outros estão sentindo só
de tocá-los com seus chifres. Esta espécie tem ajudado
as pessoas com suas tarefas há mais de 5.000 anos.

It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.en: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.zh-tw: 它可以通過精確控制投擲覆蓋著氣泡的鵝卵石，將空罐子擊中最遠一百英尺。
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.fr:
Il est capable de lancer des pierres recouvertes
de mousse avec une précision suffisante pour
toucher une canette vide à 30 m.
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.es:
Puede lanzar piedras envueltas en
burbujas con tal puntería que acierta
latas vacías a 30 metros de distancia.
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.it:
Lancia dei sassi racchiusi in bolle di schiuma.
È talmente preciso da riuscire a colpire
una lattina vuota a 30 m di distanza.
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.de:
Es kann kleine in Blasen gehüllte Steine mit
solcher Präzision werfen, dass es selbst
30 m entfernte Dosen problemlos trifft.
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with.pt-br:
Pode atirar seixos cobertos em bolhas com
controle preciso, atingindo latas vazias a
30 metros de distância.

It can't run properly when it's newly bo.en: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
It can't run properly when it's newly bo.zh-tw: 剛出生的時候是不能正常運行的。當它與其他同類賽跑時，它的腿會變得更加強壯。
It can't run properly when it's newly bo.fr:
À la naissance, il ne court pas très vite. C'est en faisant
la course avec ses camarades qu'il se muscle les jambes.
It can't run properly when it's newly bo.es:
Al nacer es un poco lento, pero va
fortaleciendo las patas paulatinamente
al disputar carreras con sus congéneres.
It can't run properly when it's newly bo.it:
Appena nato non è un buon corridore, ma col tempo
irrobustisce le sue zampe rincorrendo i suoi simili.
It can't run properly when it's newly bo.de:
Nach der Geburt fällt ihm das Laufen schwer.
Die Wettrennen, die es sich mit seinen Freunden
liefert, stärken jedoch seine Beinmuskulatur.
It can't run properly when it's newly bo.pt-br:
Nasce sem saber correr muito bem, mas, à medida
que corre com outros da sua espécie, suas pernas
vão ficando mais fortes.

It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.en: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.zh-tw: 它爬上懸崖，朝山頂走去。一旦到達山頂，它就會按原路滾落。
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.fr:
Il escalade les falaises pour en atteindre
les sommets. Une fois tout en haut, il se
laisse rouler par le chemin d'où il est arrivé.
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.es:
Escala los riscos de las montañas
y, una vez alcanzada la cima,
desciende rodando por los senderos.
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.it:
Scala le pareti scoscese delle montagne e, una volta
raggiunta la vetta, rotola giù lungo lo stesso percorso.
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.de:
Es klettert Berghänge bis zum Gipfel empor.
Einmal oben angekommen, rollt es über den
Bergpfad sogleich wieder hinunter.
It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward t.pt-br:
Escala penhascos em direção ao cume
da montanha. Assim que atinge o topo,
rola para baixo pelo mesmo caminho que veio.

It concentrates the weak electric charge.en: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
It concentrates the weak electric charge.zh-tw: 它集中細胞發出的微弱電荷並發射邪惡的閃電。
It concentrates the weak electric charge.fr:
Il concentre la faible charge électrique générée par chacune
