de ses cellules pour projeter de puissants éclairs.
It concentrates the weak electric charge.es:
Concentra la débil actividad eléctrica de
sus células para lanzar dañinas descargas.
It concentrates the weak electric charge.it:
Concentra la debole carica elettrica emessa
dalle sue cellule per lanciare potenti scariche.
It concentrates the weak electric charge.de:
Es sammelt die schwache elektrische
Energie, die von seinen Zellen ausgeht,
und feuert starke Blitze ab.
It concentrates the weak electric charge.pt-br:
Ele concentra as cargas elétricas fracas emitidas
por suas células e lança raios elétricos enfeitiçados.

It creates throwing stars out of compres.en: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
It creates throwing stars out of compres.zh-tw: 它用壓縮水製造出飛濺的星星。當它旋轉並高速拋出它們時，這些恆星可以將金屬分成兩半。
It creates throwing stars out of compres.fr:
Il transforme des jets d'eau sous pression en redoutables
shuriken. Une fois lancés, ils tournent si vite qu'ils peuvent
même couper le métal.
It creates throwing stars out of compres.es:
Comprime el agua y crea estrellas ninja con
las que ataca al enemigo. Cuando las hace girar
a gran velocidad, cortan en dos hasta el metal.
It creates throwing stars out of compres.it:
Crea lame d'acqua micidiali che ruotano ad alta
velocità e, se lanciate, possono perforare il metallo.
It creates throwing stars out of compres.de:
Es stellt Wurfsterne aus komprimiertem Wasser
her, die durch ihre hohe Drehgeschwindigkeit
beim Werfen sogar Metall durchtrennen.
It creates throwing stars out of compres.pt-br:
Cria estrelas ninja de água comprimida.
Ao girá-las e atirá-las em alta velocidade,
as estrelas podem dividir metais ao meio.

It crushes its foe under its heavy body.en: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body.zh-tw: 它用沉重的身體壓碎敵人，使其昏厥。在緊要關頭，它會縮回殼內。
It crushes its foe under its heavy body.fr:
Il écrase ses adversaires de tout son poids
pour leur faire perdre connaissance.
Il rentre dans sa carapace s'il se sent en danger.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body.es:
Para acabar con su enemigo, lo aplasta
con el peso de su cuerpo. En momentos
de apuro, se esconde en el caparazón.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body.it:
Mette KO gli avversari schiacciandoli sotto il corpo
possente. Se è in difficoltà, può ritrarsi nella corazza.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body.de:
Es begräbt seine Gegner mit seinem enormen
Körpergewicht. Wenn es in einer aussichtslosen
Lage steckt, zieht es sich in seinen Panzer zurück.
It crushes its foe under its heavy body.pt-br:
Esmaga seus inimigos com seu corpo pesado
até que desmaiem. Quando está em apuros,
se esconde dentro do seu casco.

It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.en: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.zh-tw: 它會溶解併吞噬金屬。它通過在體內循環液態金屬來產生能量。
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.fr:
Il se nourrit du métal qu'il fait fondre, et produit de l'énergie
en faisant circuler du métal liquide dans son corps.
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.es:
Funde metales para ingerirlos.
Una vez licuados, los hace circular por el
interior de su cuerpo para generar energía.
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.it:
Fonde il metallo per cibarsene, e lo fa
circolare nel suo corpo per produrre energia.
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.de:
Es schmilzt Metall ein und frisst es.
In seinem Körper wandelt es das flüssig
gewordene Metall in Energie um.
It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating.pt-br:
Dissolve e come metal. Este Pokémon gera energia
quando metal líquido corre pelo seu corpo.

It eats snow that has accumulated on the.en: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.
It eats snow that has accumulated on the.zh-tw: 牠吃地上積雪。牠喜歡柔軟的、剛落下的雪，所以它會吃著爬上山的路，瞄準山頂。
It eats snow that has accumulated on the.fr:
Il se nourrit de la neige qui s'accumule au sol.
Il la préfère fraîche et va jusqu'au sommet des
montagnes en mangeant la neige sur son chemin.
It eats snow that has accumulated on the.es:
Se alimenta de la nieve acumulada en el terreno.
Como adora la suave nieve virgen, irá comiendo
montaña arriba hasta llegar a la cima.
It eats snow that has accumulated on the.it:
Si nutre della neve accumulata sul terreno.
Predilige quella fresca e soffice, che mangia
man mano che avanza verso la cima dei monti.
It eats snow that has accumulated on the.de:
Es ernährt sich von am Boden angesammeltem
Schnee. Da es weichen Neuschnee bevorzugt,
frisst es sich bergauf bis zum Gipfel vor.
It eats snow that has accumulated on the.pt-br:
Alimenta-se da neve acumulada no chão. Prefere
neve fofa que acabou de cair, então comerá a
neve no caminho até o topo da montanha.

It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.en: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.zh-tw: 它從嘴裡發射超聲波來檢查周圍的情況。即使在狹窄的洞穴中，祖巴特也能熟練地飛行。
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.fr:
Il sonde les environs en émettant des ultrasons
avec sa bouche, et peut ainsi se frayer un chemin
même dans les grottes les plus étroites.
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.es:
Emite ondas ultrasónicas por la boca
para escrutar el entorno, lo que le permite
volar con pericia por cuevas angostas.
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.it:
Sonda l'ambiente circostante emettendo
ultrasuoni dalla bocca. In questo modo riesce
a volteggiare agilmente anche in caverne strette.
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.de:
Über den Mund stößt es Ultraschallwellen aus,
um seine Umgebung zu erkunden. So kann es
selbst in engen Höhlen geschickt umherfliegen.
It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth.pt-br:
Emite ondas ultrassônicas de sua boca para
verificar os arredores. Zubat voa com certa
destreza mesmo em cavernas apertadas.

It grinds its teeth with great force to.en: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.
It grinds its teeth with great force to.zh-tw: 它用很大的力氣磨牙，刺激大腦。它從頭上的突起發射出這一過程中產生的精神能量。
It grinds its teeth with great force to.fr:
Ce Pokémon grince fortement des dents afin de
stimuler son cerveau. Il projette ensuite l'énergie
psychique ainsi créée par l'appendice sur sa tête.
It grinds its teeth with great force to.es:
Estimula su cerebro al rechinar los dientes con
fuerza. Libera el poder psíquico que genera
por la protuberancia que tiene en la cabeza.
It grinds its teeth with great force to.it:
Fa stridere i denti per stimolare il proprio
cervello e creare così onde psichiche, che
poi emette dalla protuberanza sulla testa.
It grinds its teeth with great force to.de:
Es knirscht stark mit den Zähnen, um sein Gehirn
zu stimulieren. Die dabei erzeugten Psycho-Kräfte
setzt es über den Fortsatz an seinem Kopf frei.
It grinds its teeth with great force to.pt-br:
Range os dentes com muita força para estimular
o seu cérebro. Lança energia psíquica criada durante
este processo pela protuberância em sua cabeça.

It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.en: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.zh-tw: 它具有野蠻的本質。在戰鬥中，它會揮舞著火焰般的尾巴，並用鋒利的爪子進行砍殺。
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.fr:
Il est très brutal. En combat, il se sert de ses griffes acérées
et de sa queue enflammée pour mettre en pièces ses adversaires.
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.es:
Este Pokémon de naturaleza agresiva
ataca en combate con su cola llameante
y hace trizas al rival con sus afiladas garras.
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.it:
Ha un'indole feroce. Usa la coda fiammeggiante come
una frusta e lacera l'avversario con gli artigli affilati.
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.de:
Es ist brutal veranlagt. Im Kampf schlägt es mit
seinem brennenden Schweif um sich und schlitzt
Gegner mit seinen scharfen Klauen auf.
It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it.pt-br:
Possui uma natureza bárbara. Em batalha, chicoteia
com sua cauda de fogo e corta com suas garras afiadas.

It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.en: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.zh-tw: 它具有勇敢和值得信賴的本性。它無所畏懼地對抗更大更強的敵人。
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.fr:
Courageux et fidèle, il se dresse vaillamment devant
ses ennemis même s'ils sont plus puissants que lui.
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.es:
De naturaleza valiente y honrada, se enfrenta
sin miedo a enemigos más grandes y fuertes.
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.it:
Coraggioso e affidabile, si oppone senza
paura anche a nemici più grandi e forti di lui.
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.de:
Es ist von Natur aus tapfer und vertrauenswürdig
und scheut auch vor Gegnern nicht zurück,
die größer und stärker sind als es selbst.
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. I.pt-br:
Tem uma natureza corajosa e leal e enfrenta
sem medo adversários maiores e mais fortes.

It has a preference for hot things. When.en: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
It has a preference for hot things. When.zh-tw: 它對熱的東西有偏愛。據說下雨時，蒸汽會從它的尾尖噴出。
It has a preference for hot things. When.fr:
Il préfère ce qui est chaud. En cas de pluie,
de la vapeur se forme autour de sa queue.
It has a preference for hot things. When.es:
Prefiere las cosas calientes. Dicen que cuando
llueve le sale vapor de la punta de la cola.
It has a preference for hot things. When.it:
Ama le cose calde. Si dice che quando piove
gli esca vapore dalla punta della coda.
It has a preference for hot things. When.de:
Dieses Pokémon bevorzugt heiße Dinge.
Bei Regen soll seine Schwanzspitze dampfen.
It has a preference for hot things. When.pt-br:
Prefere coisas quentes. Quando chove, dizem
que solta vapor pela ponta de sua cauda.

It has a psychic power that enables it t.en: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
It has a psychic power that enables it t.zh-tw: 它擁有一種精神力量，能夠扭曲周圍的空間並預見未來。
It has a psychic power that enables it t.fr:
Grâce à ses pouvoirs psychiques, il peut distordre
l'espace-temps et ainsi voir l'avenir.
It has a psychic power that enables it t.es:
Con sus poderes psíquicos puede deformar
el espacio a su alrededor y predecir el futuro.
It has a psychic power that enables it t.it:
Sfruttando i suoi poteri psichici, può distorcere
lo spazio circostante per prevedere l'avvenire.
It has a psychic power that enables it t.de:
Seine Psycho-Kräfte erlauben es ihm,
den Raum um sich selbst zu verformen
und so in die Zukunft zu sehen.
It has a psychic power that enables it t.pt-br:
Possui um poder psíquico que lhe permite distorcer
o espaço ao seu redor e ver o futuro.

It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.en: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.zh-tw: 它有非常細膩的皮毛。注意不要讓它生氣，否則它可能會不斷膨脹並用身體猛烈撞擊。
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.fr:
Il a une très belle fourrure. Mieux vaut éviter de le mettre
en colère, ou il gonflera avant d'attaquer de tout son corps.
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.es:
Tiene un pelaje muy fino. Se recomienda no enfadarlo,
o se inflará y golpeará con todo su cuerpo.
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.it:
Ha un pelo molto fino. Attenzione a non farlo adirare,
perché può gonfiarsi e caricare con tutto il suo peso.
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.de:
Es hat sehr feines Fell. Doch Vorsicht: Verärgert
man Knuddeluff, bläst es sich stark auf und stürzt
sich mit seinem ganzen Körper auf einen.
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to.pt-br:
Ele tem a pele muito fina. Tome cuidado para
não zangá-lo ou ele pode inflar permanentemente
e golpear com uma pancada de corpo.

It has an incredibly high level of intel.en: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
It has an incredibly high level of intel.zh-tw: 它具有令人難以置信的高水平智力。有人說阿拉卡扎姆記得發生在它身上的一切，從出生到死亡。
It has an incredibly high level of intel.fr:
Doué d'une intelligence hors du commun,
ce Pokémon serait capable de conserver tous
ses souvenirs, de sa naissance jusqu'à sa mort.
It has an incredibly high level of intel.es:
Posee una capacidad intelectual fuera de
lo común que le permite recordar todo lo
sucedido desde el instante de su nacimiento.
It has an incredibly high level of intel.it:
Possiede un intelletto estremamente elevato
e si dice sia in grado di ricordare ogni evento
della sua vita, dalla nascita alla morte.
It has an incredibly high level of intel.de:
Es verfügt über extrem hohe Intelligenz und soll
sich an alles erinnern können, was zwischen seiner
Geburt und seinem Tod passiert.
It has an incredibly high level of intel.pt-br:
Tem um nível de inteligência incrivelmente alto.
Alguns dizem que Alakazam se lembra de tudo
que acontece na sua vida, do nascimento até a morte.

It has the world's largest petals. With.en: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
It has the world's largest petals. With.zh-tw: 它擁有世界上最大的花瓣。每走一步，花瓣就會抖落出大量有毒花粉。
It has the world's largest petals. With.fr:
Il possède les plus gros pétales au monde, qui sèment
d'épais nuages de pollen toxique à chacun de ses pas.
It has the world's largest petals. With.es:
Tiene los pétalos más grandes del mundo.
Al caminar, de ellos se desprenden
densas nubes de polen tóxico.
It has the world's largest petals. With.it:
Ha i petali più grandi del mondo.
Ad ogni suo passo, i petali liberano
fitte nubi di polline tossico.
It has the world's largest petals. With.de:
Es besitzt die größten Blütenblätter
der Welt. Bei jedem Schritt streut es
große Mengen an Giftpollen zu Boden.
It has the world's largest petals. With.pt-br:
Tem as maiores pétalas do mundo.
A cada passo, as pétalas se agitam
e liberam pesadas nuvens de pólen tóxico.

It has three poisonous stingers on its f.en: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
It has three poisonous stingers on its f.zh-tw: 它的前腿和尾巴上有三根毒刺。它們被用來反复刺傷敵人。
It has three poisonous stingers on its f.fr:
Il se sert de ses trois aiguillons empoisonnés
pour attaquer sans relâche ses adversaires.
It has three poisonous stingers on its f.es:
Tiene 3 aguijones venenosos en sus patas y cola.
Suelen pinchar a sus enemigos repetidas veces.
It has three poisonous stingers on its f.it:
Possiede tre aculei velenosi sulle zampe anteriori
e sull'addome con cui punge i nemici ripetutamente.
It has three poisonous stingers on its f.de:
Dieses Pokémon verfügt über drei Giftstachel.
Es kann seine Gegner damit wiederholt stechen.
It has three poisonous stingers on its f.pt-br:
Ele possui três ferrões venenosos nas patas
dianteiras e na cauda. Eles são usados para
picar repetidamente o inimigo.

It is constantly wracked by a headache..en: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
It is constantly wracked by a headache..zh-tw: 它經常被頭痛所折磨。當頭痛變得劇烈時，它就會開始使用神秘的力量。
It is constantly wracked by a headache..fr:
Ce Pokémon a tout le temps la migraine.
Quand la douleur devient trop intense,
il se met à utiliser des pouvoirs mystérieux.
It is constantly wracked by a headache..es:
Padece continuamente dolores de
cabeza. Cuando son muy fuertes,
empieza a usar misteriosos poderes.
It is constantly wracked by a headache..it:
È costantemente tormentato dal mal di testa.
Quando il dolore si fa particolarmente
intenso, inizia a usare strani poteri.
It is constantly wracked by a headache..de:
Es wird permanent von Kopfschmerzen
geplagt. Wird der Schmerz stärker,
setzt es geheimnisvolle Kräfte ein.
It is constantly wracked by a headache..pt-br:
Sofre constantemente de dor de cabeça.
Quando ela se intensifica, este Pokémon
começa a usar poderes misteriosos.

It is encased in a shell that is harder.en: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
It is encased in a shell that is harder.zh-tw: 它被包裹在比鑽石還硬的殼裡。然而，它的內部卻出奇的柔軟。
It is encased in a shell that is harder.fr:
Une coquille plus dure que le diamant le protège.
Il est toutefois étonnamment tendre à l'intérieur.
It is encased in a shell that is harder.es:
Está metido en una concha más dura que el
diamante, pero tiene un cuerpo muy blando.
It is encased in a shell that is harder.it:
La conchiglia esterna è più dura del diamante.
L'interno, invece, è sorprendentemente morbido.
It is encased in a shell that is harder.de:
Seine Schale ist härter als Diamant. Im Inneren ist
es jedoch überraschend weich.
It is encased in a shell that is harder.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é envolto em uma concha
mais dura que diamante. O seu interior,
porém, é surpreendentemente macio.

It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.en: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.zh-tw: 它非常緩慢且愚蠢。當受到攻擊時，它需要五秒鐘的時間才會感到疼痛。
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.fr:
Ce Pokémon est très lent et apathique.
Il lui faut cinq secondes pour ressentir
la douleur provoquée par une attaque.
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.es:
Increíblemente lento y torpe. Tarda cinco
segundos en sentir dolor si lo atacan.
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.it:
Incredibilmente lento e tonto, ci
mette cinque secondi a percepire
il dolore dopo essere stato colpito.
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.de:
Ein unglaublich träges und einfältiges Pokémon.
Wenn es angegriffen wird, bemerkt es den
Schmerz erst fünf Sekunden später.
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It take.pt-br:
É extremamente lento e tonto. Demora uns cinco
segundos para sentir dor após sofrer um ataque.

It is not satisfied unless it eats over.en: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over.zh-tw: 它每天不吃超過880磅的食物就不會滿足。當牠吃完飯後，它會立即睡覺。
It is not satisfied unless it eats over.fr:
Ronflex n'est pas satisfait tant qu'il n'a pas avalé
ses 400 kg de nourriture quotidienne. Dès qu'il
a fini, il commence une sieste pour digérer.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over.es:
No se encuentra satisfecho hasta haber
ingerido 400 kg de comida cada día.
Cuando acaba de comer, se queda dormido.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over.it:
Dopo aver trangugiato i suoi immancabili 400 kg
di cibo quotidiani, cade in un sonno profondo.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over.de:
Es muss über 400 kg Nahrung am Tag fressen,
um satt zu werden. Ist es mit dem Essen fertig,
schläft es sofort ein.
It is not satisfied unless it eats over.pt-br:
Não se satisfaz a menos que coma mais de
400 kg de alimentos todos os dias. Quando
termina de comer, dorme imediatamente.

It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.en: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.
It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.zh-tw: 它被認為是長壽的象徵。如果它的殼上有藻類，那麼疣龜就很老了。
It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.fr:
Il est considéré comme un symbole de longévité.
On reconnaît les spécimens les plus âgés
à la mousse qui pousse sur leur carapace.
It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.es:
Se lo considera un símbolo de longevidad.
Los ejemplares más ancianos tienen
musgo sobre el caparazón.
It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.it:
È considerato un simbolo di longevità. Se c'è del
muschio sul suo guscio, significa che è molto anziano.
It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.de:
Es gilt als Symbol für Langlebigkeit.
Sehr alte Exemplare erkennt man daran,
dass ihr Panzer mit Algen übersät ist.
It is recognized as a symbol of longevit.pt-br:
É um símbolo estabelecido de longevidade.
Se seu casco possui algas, Wartortle é muito velho.

It is said that happiness will come to t.en: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
It is said that happiness will come to t.zh-tw: 據說，看到Clefairy在滿月下跳舞的人會得到幸福。
It is said that happiness will come to t.fr:
On dit que ceux qui voient danser un groupe de Mélofée
sous la pleine lune connaîtront un grand bonheur.
It is said that happiness will come to t.es:
Se dice que la felicidad llegará
a quien vea un grupo de Clefairy
bailando a la luz de la luna llena.
It is said that happiness will come to t.it:
Si dice che vedere un gruppo di Clefairy ballare
con la luna piena sia di ottimo auspicio.
It is said that happiness will come to t.de:
Eine Ansammlung von Piepi bei Vollmond tanzen
zu sehen, soll ein glückliches Leben verheißen.
It is said that happiness will come to t.pt-br:
Acredita-se que a felicidade virá para aqueles
que virem um grupo de Clefairy dançando sob
a lua cheia.

It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.en: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.
It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.zh-tw: 據說在海洋的某個地方有一座島嶼，這些島嶼就聚集在那裡。只有他們住在那裡。
It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.fr:
On dit qu'il existe une île quelque part dans l'océan où
ces Pokémon se réunissent pour vivre paisiblement.
It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.es:
Dicen que viven en una isla en algún
lugar del océano que solo ellos habitan.
It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.it:
Si dice che questi Pokémon si riuniscano su
un'isola in mezzo all'oceano dove vivono solo loro.
It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.de:
Man sagt, dass es irgendwo im Meer
eine Insel gibt, auf der sie sich
versammeln. Nur sie leben dort.
It is said that somewhere in the ocean l.pt-br:
Acredita-se que em algum lugar no oceano
é possível encontrar uma ilha onde estes
Pokémon se reúnem. Só eles moram lá.

It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.en: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.zh-tw: 據說它的壽命有1000歲，每條尾巴都充滿了超自然的力量。
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.fr:
On dit qu'il vit 1 000 ans et que chacune
de ses queues a un pouvoir magique.
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.es:
Cuentan que llega a vivir hasta mil
años y que cada una de las colas
posee poderes sobrenaturales.
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.it:
Dicono che viva un millennio. Ognuna delle
sue code è dotata di un potere magico.
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.de:
Man sagt, es lebe 1000 Jahre und jedem seiner
Schweife wohnen übernatürliche Kräfte inne.
It is said to live 1,000 years, and each.pt-br:
Dizem que vive 1.000 anos e que cada uma das
suas caudas é cheia de poderes sobrenaturais.

It is waiting for the moment to evolve..en: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
It is waiting for the moment to evolve..zh-tw: 它正在等待進化的時刻。在這個階段，它只能變硬，所以它保持不動以避免攻擊。
It is waiting for the moment to evolve..fr:
En attendant sa prochaine évolution, il ne peut que durcir
sa carapace et rester immobile pour éviter de se faire attaquer.
It is waiting for the moment to evolve..es:
Como en este estado solo puede
endurecer su coraza, permanece
inmóvil a la espera de evolucionar.
It is waiting for the moment to evolve..it:
In attesa di evolversi, l'unica cosa che può
fare è indurire la sua corazza, quindi rimane
immobile per evitare di essere attaccato.
It is waiting for the moment to evolve..de:
In diesem Zustand wartet es auf die Entwicklung.
Es kann nur seinen Panzer erhärten, daher bewegt
es sich nicht, um nicht angegriffen zu werden.
It is waiting for the moment to evolve..pt-br:
Metapod está aguardando o momento certo para
evoluir. Neste estágio, só consegue endurecer,
então permanece imóvel para evitar ataques.

It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.en: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.zh-tw: 牠喜歡潛伏在黑暗中，用氣態的手輕拍肩膀。它的觸碰引起無盡的顫抖。
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.fr:
Il adore se tapir dans l'ombre et faire frissonner
ses proies pour l'éternité en leur touchant l'épaule.
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.es:
Le gusta acechar en la oscuridad y tocarles el
hombro a sus víctimas con su mano gaseosa.
Estas se quedan temblando para siempre.
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.it:
Adora stare in agguato nei luoghi bui e toccare
le spalle delle vittime con le sue mani gassose.
Il suo tocco causa brividi incontenibili.
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.de:
Es lauert gern im Dunkeln und tippt Leuten mit
seiner gasförmigen Hand auf die Schulter.
Seine Berührung erzeugt endloses Schaudern.
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap sho.pt-br:
Gosta de se esconder no escuro e bater nos
ombros dos outros com sua mão gasosa.
Seu toque causa arrepios que não acabam mais.

It lives about one yard underground, whe.en: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
It lives about one yard underground, whe.zh-tw: 它生活在地下約一碼處，以植物根部為食。它有時出現在地面上。
It lives about one yard underground, whe.fr:
Ce Pokémon vit un mètre sous terre et se nourrit
de racines. Il apparaît parfois à la surface.
It lives about one yard underground, whe.es:
Vive 1 m por debajo del suelo, donde se alimenta
de raíces. A veces también aparece en la superficie.
It lives about one yard underground, whe.it:
Vive un metro sottoterra, dove si nutre
di radici. Talvolta compare in superficie.
It lives about one yard underground, whe.de:
Dieses Pokémon lebt 1 m unter der
Erde. Es frisst Wurzeln und kommt
hin und wieder an die Oberfläche.
It lives about one yard underground, whe.pt-br:
Vive cerca de 1 metro embaixo da terra,
onde se alimenta de raízes de plantas.
Algumas vezes, são vistos acima da terra.

It lives close to water. Its long tail i.en: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
It lives close to water. Its long tail i.zh-tw: 它生活在靠近水的地方。它的長尾巴上有脊狀鰭，經常被誤認為是美人魚的尾巴。
It lives close to water. Its long tail i.fr:
Il vit au bord de l'eau. Sa queue semblable à celle
d'un poisson lui donne l'apparence d'une sirène.
It lives close to water. Its long tail i.es:
Vive cerca del agua. Su cola termina en una
aleta parecida a la de un pez, por lo que hay
gente que lo confunde con una sirena.
It lives close to water. Its long tail i.it:
Vive vicino all'acqua. Sulla punta della coda ha una
pinna, per questo alcuni lo scambiano per una sirena.
It lives close to water. Its long tail i.de:
Dieses Pokémon lebt nahe an Gewässern.
Wegen seiner fischähnlichen Schwanzflosse wird
es manchmal für eine Meerjungfrau gehalten.
It lives close to water. Its long tail i.pt-br:
Este Pokémon vive perto da água. A sua longa
cauda é coberta por uma barbatana e muitas
vezes é confundida com a de uma sereia.

It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.en: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.zh-tw: 它成群生活在樹頂。如果它看不到自己的群體，它就會因為孤獨而被激怒。
It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.fr:
Il vit en groupe au sommet des arbres. S'il perd
ses congénères de vue, la solitude le rend furieux.
It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.es:
Vive en grupos en las copas de
los árboles. Si pierde de vista a su
manada, se siente solo y se enfada.
It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.it:
Vivono in branchi in cima agli alberi. Se perdono
il contatto con il gruppo s'infuriano per la solitudine.
It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.de:
Es lebt mit Artgenossen in Baumkronen.
Verliert es sie aus den Augen, wird es
vor Einsamkeit sofort zornig.
It lives in groups in the treetops. If i.pt-br:
Vive em grupo no topo de árvores.
Se perde seu grupo de vista, a solidão
deixa este Pokémon furioso.

It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.en: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.zh-tw: 它生活在溫暖的淺水中。如果遇到敵人，它會吐出內臟來攻擊敵人。
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.fr:
Il vit dans les eaux chaudes des hauts-fonds.
S'il croise un ennemi, il l'attaque en lui crachant
ses organes internes au visage.
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.es:
Vive en los cálidos bajíos de las playas. Si se
topa con un enemigo, ataca golpeándolo sin
cesar con las entrañas que expulsa por la boca.
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.it:
Vive vicino alle spiagge in acque calde e poco
profonde. Quando si imbatte in un nemico, lo
attacca espellendo gli organi interni dalla bocca.
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.de:
Es lebt in warmen Küstengewässern. Trifft es auf
einen Gegner, öffnet es den Mund und lässt zum
Angriff seine Organe hervorschnellen.
It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it.pt-br:
Vive em águas rasas e quentes. Se encontra
um inimigo, cospe seus órgãos internos
para enchê-lo de socos.

It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.en: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.zh-tw: 牠喜歡在乾燥的沙地的沙礫中沐浴。通過沙浴，神奇寶貝可以去除附著在身體上的污垢和水分。
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.fr:
Il aime se rouler dans le sable des zones
désertiques pour se débarrasser des traces
de terre et d'humidité qui lui collent à la peau.
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.es:
Le gusta revolcarse por la arena seca para eliminar
todo rastro de suciedad y humedad en la piel.
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.it:
Ama rotolarsi nella sabbia delle zone
desertiche, per rimuovere ogni traccia
di sporcizia e umidità dal suo corpo.
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.de:
Es badet sehr gern im trockenen Sand.
Dadurch befreit es seinen Körper von
Schmutz und Feuchtigkeit.
It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sa.pt-br:
Adora banhar-se na areia ressecada. Ao
fazer isso, este Pokémon se livra da sujeira
e da umidade grudadas em seu corpo.

It loves to drink other creatures' blood.en: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.
It loves to drink other creatures' blood.zh-tw: 牠喜歡喝其他生物的血。據說，如果它發現其他同類挨餓，有時它會分享它收集的血液。
It loves to drink other creatures' blood.fr:
Le sang des êtres vivants est son péché mignon.
On dit qu'il partage parfois ce précieux breuvage
avec ses congénères affamés.
It loves to drink other creatures' blood.es:
Le encanta chuparles la sangre a los seres
vivos. En ocasiones comparte la preciada
colecta con otros congéneres hambrientos.
It loves to drink other creatures' blood.it:
Va matto per il sangue di altre creature. Si dice
che a volte lo condivida con i compagni affamati.
It loves to drink other creatures' blood.de:
Das Blut anderer Lebewesen ist seine Leibspeise.
Man sagt, dass es das abgesaugte Blut manchmal
mit hungrigen Artgenossen teilt.
It loves to drink other creatures' blood.pt-br:
Ama beber o sangue de outras criaturas. Dizem que,
se encontra outros de sua espécie passando fome,
às vezes compartilha o sangue que recolheu.

It quickly swings its four arms to rock.en: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
It quickly swings its four arms to rock.zh-tw: 它迅速揮動四隻手臂，從各個角度不斷地出拳和砍擊，震撼對手。
It quickly swings its four arms to rock.fr:
Il peut bouger ses quatre bras à grande vitesse
et frapper du poing ou du tranchant de la main
dans toutes les directions sans se fatiguer.
It quickly swings its four arms to rock.es:
Mueve rápidamente sus cuatro brazos
para asestar incesantes golpes y
puñetazos desde todos los ángulos.
It quickly swings its four arms to rock.it:
Agita velocemente le quattro braccia tempestando
gli avversari di pugni e colpi da ogni direzione.
It quickly swings its four arms to rock.de:
Es verwendet seine vier Arme, um seine
Gegner unermüdlich mit schnellen Schlägen
aus allen Winkeln einzudecken.
It quickly swings its four arms to rock.pt-br:
Ele balança velozmente seus quatro braços para
atingir seus oponentes com socos e pancadas
incessantes de todos os ângulos.

It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.en: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.
It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.zh-tw: 它記得牠吃下的每一個夢。它很少吃掉成年人的夢想，因為孩子們的夢想更美味。
It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.fr:
Ce Pokémon se souvient de tous les rêves
qu'il a avalés. Il mange rarement les songes
d'adultes, car ceux des enfants ont meilleur goût.
It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.es:
Recuerda todos los sueños que engulle.
Raramente come sueños de adultos
porque los de los niños están más ricos.
It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.it:
Ricorda ogni singolo sogno che mangia.
Mangia raramente i sogni degli adulti,
perché quelli dei bambini sono più buoni.
It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.de:
Es kann sich an jeden gefressenen Traum erinnern.
Die Träume von Kindern schmecken ihm besser,
weshalb es die von Erwachsenen nur selten frisst.
It remembers every dream it eats. It rar.pt-br:
Ele lembra cada sonho que come. Raramente
come sonhos de adultos, pois os das crianças
são mais saborosos.

It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.en: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.zh-tw: 它滾動移動。如果地面不平坦，撞擊到凸塊時突然的震動可能會導致爆炸。
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.fr:
Il se déplace en roulant. Si le sol est cabossé,
les chocs le font exploser.
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.es:
Se mueve rodando. Si el terreno es
irregular, una chispa provocada por
algún bache lo hará explotar.
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.it:
Rotola per spostarsi. Se il terreno è
irregolare, può esplodere all'improvviso
a causa dell'urto contro un dosso.
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.de:
Es bewegt sich rollend fort. Rollt es über
unebenen Boden, kann es plötzlich explodieren.
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneve.pt-br:
Ele rola para se mover. Quando o solo está
desnivelado, um solavanco repentino após
um baque pode fazê-lo explodir.

It scatters cotton all over the place as.en: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
It scatters cotton all over the place as.zh-tw: 它像惡作劇一樣把棉花撒得到處都是。如果它被弄濕了，它就會變得太重而無法移動，並且別無選擇，只能為它的惡作劇負責。
It scatters cotton all over the place as.fr:
Il joue de mauvais tours en répandant son coton.
Si on le mouille, il s'alourdit et ne peut plus
bouger, ce qui l'oblige à s'avouer vaincu.
It scatters cotton all over the place as.es:
Este travieso Pokémon se divierte esparciendo
bolas de algodón. Al mojarlo, su peso aumenta
tanto que no logra moverse y se da por vencido.
It scatters cotton all over the place as.it:
Si diverte a spargere cotone ovunque.
Se gli si versa dell'acqua addosso, diventa
troppo pesante per muoversi e si arrende.
It scatters cotton all over the place as.de:
Es verstreut Watte, um Leute zu ärgern. Es hört
damit auf, wenn es nass wird, weil es dann zu
schwer ist und sich nicht mehr bewegen kann.
It scatters cotton all over the place as.pt-br:
Gosta de pregar peças, espalhando algodão por todo canto.
Se este Pokémon se molhar, ficará pesado demais para se mover
e será obrigado a lidar com as consequências das suas traquinagens.

It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.en: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.zh-tw: 它從胸部和背部分泌出靈活的氣泡。氣泡可以減少受到攻擊時受到的傷害。
It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.fr:
Sa poitrine et son dos sécrètent une mousse
qui lui permet de subir moins de dégâts en
amortissant le choc des attaques.
It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.es:
Secreta burbujas tanto por la espalda como
por el pecho. Gracias a la elasticidad de estas,
puede parar ataques y reducir el daño recibido.
It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.it:
Dal petto e dalla schiena secerne una schiuma che gli
permette di attutire i danni causati dagli attacchi nemici.
It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.de:
Es stößt aus Brust und Rücken elastische Blasen aus,
mit denen es gegnerische Angriffe abfängt und so
den erlittenen Schaden verringert.
It secretes flexible bubbles from its ch.pt-br:
Liberam bolhas flexíveis do peito e das costas.
As bolhas reduzem os danos que sofreriam
ao serem atacados.

It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.en: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.zh-tw: 隨著它變大，它會脫落多層皮膚。在此過程中，它受到急流瀑布的保護。
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.fr:
Ce Pokémon grandit en muant à répétition. Lors de
ce processus, il s'abrite derrière une puissante cascade.
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.es:
Durante la etapa de crecimiento, muda muchas
veces de piel y se protege mediante una cascada.
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.it:
Cresce cambiando ripetutamente la
pelle. Durante la muta, si protegge tra
le acque impetuose di una cascata.
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.de:
Es häutet sich, um zu wachsen. Dabei wird es von
einem tosenden Wasserfall beschützt.
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows.pt-br:
Troca de pele várias vezes à medida que cresce. Durante
este processo, é protegido por uma cachoeira agitada.

It shoots cotton from its body to protec.en: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
It shoots cotton from its body to protec.zh-tw: 它從體內射出棉花來保護自己。如果它遇到颶風強度的風，它可能會被送到地球的另一邊。
It shoots cotton from its body to protec.fr:
Il sème du coton pour se protéger.
Il lui arrive d'être emporté par une
tempête à l'autre bout du monde.
It shoots cotton from its body to protec.es:
Lanza bolas de algodón para defenderse.
A veces, la fuerza de un tifón llega a
arrastrarlo hasta el otro extremo del mundo.
It shoots cotton from its body to protec.it:
Si difende creando una nuvola di cotone. A volte viene
trasportato fino all'altro capo del mondo dai tifoni.
It shoots cotton from its body to protec.de:
Sie schützen sich, indem sie Watte verstreuen.
Manche werden vom Wind bis ans andere Ende
der Welt getragen.
It shoots cotton from its body to protec.pt-br:
Dispara algodão do seu corpo para se proteger.
Se este Pokémon for carregado por um furacão,
pode ir parar do outro lado da Terra.

It slashes through grass with its sharp.en: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
It slashes through grass with its sharp.zh-tw: 它用鋒利的鐮刀砍伐草地，移動速度太快，人眼無法追踪。
It slashes through grass with its sharp.fr:
Il fauche les herbes avec ses lames acérées.
Ses mouvements sont si rapides qu'ils sont
imperceptibles à l'œil nu.
It slashes through grass with its sharp.es:
Avanza por la hierba con sus afiladas guadañas,
más rápido de lo que el ojo humano puede percibir.
It slashes through grass with its sharp.it:
Si fa strada tra l'erba grazie alle
lame affilate, muovendosi troppo
velocemente per l'occhio umano.
It slashes through grass with its sharp.de:
Es bahnt sich mit seinen scharfen Sicheln so
schnell einen Weg durch das Gras, dass es dabei
für das menschliche Auge unsichtbar ist.
It slashes through grass with its sharp.pt-br:
Corta a grama com suas foices afiadas
e se move tão rápido que o olho humano
não consegue enxergá-lo.

It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.en: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.zh-tw: 它噴出的火熱得足以融化巨石。它可能會因噴出火焰而引起森林火災。
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.fr:
Son souffle brûlant peut faire fondre la roche.
Il est parfois la cause d'incendies de forêt.
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.es:
Escupe un fuego tan caliente que funde las
rocas. Causa incendios forestales sin querer.
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.it:
Sputa fiamme incandescenti in grado di fondere
le rocce. A volte causa incendi boschivi.
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.de:
Dieses Pokémon kann mit seinem
Feueratem Felsen schmelzen.
Es verursacht ab und zu Waldbrände.
It spits fire that is hot enough to melt.pt-br:
Cospe chamas quentes o bastante para
derreter rochedos. Estas chamas podem
causar incêndios florestais.

It stores flammable gas in its body and.en: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
It stores flammable gas in its body and.zh-tw: 它在體內儲存可燃氣體並用它來產生熱量。它腹部的黃色部分變得特別熱。
It stores flammable gas in its body and.fr:
Il produit de la chaleur grâce au gaz inflammable
qu'il emmagasine dans son corps. La partie jaune
de son abdomen est particulièrement brûlante.
It stores flammable gas in its body and.es:
Genera calor consumiendo el gas inflamable que
almacena en su cuerpo. Los círculos amarillos
del abdomen están particularmente calientes.
It stores flammable gas in its body and.it:
Genera calore grazie ai gas combustibili
accumulati nel suo corpo. Le parti gialle
del suo addome sono particolarmente calde.
It stores flammable gas in its body and.de:
Mit dem entzündlichen Gas in seinem Körper
erzeugt es Hitze. Die gelben Stellen an seinem
Bauch werden besonders heiß.
It stores flammable gas in its body and.pt-br:
Seu corpo armazena gás inflamável, que usa para
gerar calor. As marcas amarelas na sua barriga
ficam especialmente quentes.

It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.en: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.zh-tw: 飯後在海灘上曬日光浴。體溫升高有助於消化。
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.fr:
Après manger, il s'étale de tout son long sur les plages
de sable fin. Le soleil le réchauffe et facilite sa digestion.
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.es:
Le gusta tenderse al sol en la playa
después de comer, ya que aumentar su
temperatura corporal le facilita la digestión.
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.it:
Dopo mangiato prende il sole sulla spiaggia
per far aumentare la sua temperatura
corporea e favorire la digestione.
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.de:
Nach einer Mahlzeit genießt es ein Sonnenbad
am Strand. Durch die erhöhte Körpertemperatur
wird seine Verdauung unterstützt.
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. T.pt-br:
Toma sol na praia após as refeições.
O aumento em sua temperatura
corporal ajuda na digestão.

It taunts its prey and lures them into n.en: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.
It taunts its prey and lures them into n.zh-tw: 它會嘲弄獵物，將它們引誘到狹窄的岩石區域，然後向它們噴灑有毒氣體，使它們頭暈並把它們打倒。
It taunts its prey and lures them into n.fr:
Il provoque ses proies afin de les attirer dans
d'étroites zones rocheuses, puis il les étourdit
avec son gaz toxique avant de les achever.
It taunts its prey and lures them into n.es:
Provoca a sus presas para conducirlas a zonas
rocosas y estrechas, donde las aturde con un
gas venenoso antes de acabar con ellas.
It taunts its prey and lures them into n.it:
Provoca le sue prede e le attira in stretti luoghi rocciosi,
per poi stordirle con il suo gas velenoso e abbatterle.
It taunts its prey and lures them into n.de:
Es provoziert seine Beute und lockt sie
in enge Felsspalten, wo es sie dann mit
Giftgas ins Taumeln bringt und erlegt.
It taunts its prey and lures them into n.pt-br:
Provoca suas presas e as atrai para áreas estreitas
e rochosas. Em seguida, espirra sobre elas um gás
tóxico para deixá-las atordoadas e dar o bote.

It uses its docile-looking face to lull.en: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull.zh-tw: 它用它看起來溫順的臉來讓敵人陷入自滿，然後用它巨大的、無情的下巴撕咬。
It uses its docile-looking face to lull.fr:
Trompés par son visage innocent, ses ennemis se font happer
par ses énormes mâchoires et ne peuvent plus s'échapper.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull.es:
Con su cara inocente hace que el rival se confíe
y, al bajar la guardia, le da un mordisco con sus
enormes fauces del que no se puede liberar.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull.it:
Distrae i nemici con la sua faccia innocente,
per poi azzannarli con le sue possenti mascelle.
Non molla la presa a nessun costo.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull.de:
Mit seinem friedlichen Gesicht wiegt es Gegner
in Sicherheit und beißt dann mit seinem riesigen
Kiefer zu. Danach gibt es kein Entkommen mehr.
It uses its docile-looking face to lull.pt-br:
Usa seu rosto dócil para fazer seus inimigos
complacentes e então os morde com suas
mandíbulas enormes sem dar trégua.

It was created by a scientist after year.en: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
It was created by a scientist after year.zh-tw: 它是由一位科學家經過多年可怕的基因剪接和 DNA 工程實驗而創造出來的。
It was created by a scientist after year.fr:
Il est le fruit de nombreuses expériences
génétiques horribles et malsaines.
It was created by a scientist after year.es:
Fue creado por un científico tras años de
horribles experimentos de ingeniería genética.
It was created by a scientist after year.it:
Creato da uno scienziato dopo anni di
orribili esperimenti di ingegneria genetica.
It was created by a scientist after year.de:
Dieses Pokémon ist das Resultat eines jahrelangen
und skrupellosen Experimentes.
It was created by a scientist after year.pt-br:
Foi criado por cientistas através de anos
de experimentos genéticos terríveis com
manipulação de DNA.

It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.en: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.zh-tw: 它將對手包裹在氣體般的身體中，通過皮膚毒害獵物，慢慢削弱獵物的力量。
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.fr:
Il enveloppe ses proies dans le nuage de gaz
que forme son corps et les empoisonne à travers
leur peau afin de les affaiblir petit à petit.
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.es:
Su estrategia consiste en envolver al rival con su
cuerpo gaseoso y envenenarlo a través de la piel.
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.it:
Avvolge le prede nel corpo gassoso
e le indebolisce lentamente facendo
penetrare il veleno nella loro pelle.
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.de:
Es hüllt seine Beute in seinen Gaskörper ein
und schwächt sie, indem es sie nach und nach
über die Haut vergiftet.
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like bo.pt-br:
Envolve o oponente em seu corpo gasoso,
enfraquecendo sua presa lentamente
e a envenenando pela pele.

It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..en: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..zh-tw: 是傳說中的鳥神奇寶貝之一。當莫爾特雷斯拍動它的火焰翅膀時，它們會閃爍出耀眼的紅光。
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..fr:
Il s'agit d'un des Pokémon oiseaux légendaires.
Des flammes rouges d'une grande beauté
étincellent lorsqu'il bat des ailes.
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..es:
Una de las aves legendarias. Al batir las alas, las llamas
que las envuelven emiten un hermoso fulgor rojo.
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..it:
Uno dei leggendari Pokémon alati. Quando
sbatte le ali, le fiamme che le circondano
brillano di uno splendido rosso acceso.
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..de:
Schlägt dieses Legendäre Vogel-Pokémon mit
den Flügeln, so leuchten die Flammen an seinen
Schwingen in einem bezaubernden Rot.
It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon..pt-br:
É um dos lendários Pokémon pássaro.
Quando Moltres bate suas asas em chamas,
solta faíscas vermelhas brilhantes.

It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.en: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.zh-tw: 據說這只神奇寶貝美麗的藍色翅膀是由冰製成的。急蟲飛過雪山，長長的尾巴在身後飄揚。
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.fr:
On raconte que ses belles plumes bleues sont
faites de glace. Sa longue queue flotte au vent
lorsqu'il vole au-dessus des monts enneigés.
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.es:
Se dice que sus bellas alas azules se
componen de hielo. Vuela en torno a las
montañas nevadas con su larga cola al viento.
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.it:
Si dice che le sue splendide ali azzurre siano
composte di ghiaccio. Vola fra le montagne
innevate facendo ondeggiare la sua lunga coda.
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.de:
Seine wunderschönen blauen Flügel sollen aus Eis
bestehen. Es fliegt über schneebedeckte Berge,
während sein langer Schweif hinter ihm flattert.
It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful.pt-br:
Dizem que as lindas asas azuis deste Pokémon
são feitas de gelo. Articuno sobrevoa montanhas
com sua longa cauda balançando atrás de si.

It's the males that raise the offspring..en: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.
It's the males that raise the offspring..zh-tw: 養育後代的是雄性。當海德拉撫養幼崽時，它們背上的刺會分泌出更濃烈的毒液。
It's the males that raise the offspring..fr:
Les mâles s'occupent des petits, et tant qu'ils en
ont à élever, le venin contenu dans leurs épines
dorsales devient beaucoup plus fort.
It's the males that raise the offspring..es:
En esta especie, es el macho quien se ocupa de
la prole. Durante la época de cría, el veneno de
las púas de su espalda se vuelve más potente.
It's the males that raise the offspring..it:
Il maschio si occupa dei piccoli. Quando li alleva, il
veleno degli aculei dorsali diventa denso e potente.
It's the males that raise the offspring..de:
Männlichen Seemon obliegt es, den Nachwuchs
großzuziehen. In diesem Zeitraum ist das Gift in
ihren Rückenstacheln stärker und dickflüssiger.
It's the males that raise the offspring..pt-br:
São os machos que cuidam das crias. Enquanto
Seadra criam os mais jovens, os espinhos em suas
costas secretam um veneno mais grosso e potente.

It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.en: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.zh-tw: 它厚厚地覆蓋著骯髒、邪惡的污泥。它的毒性如此之大，連它的腳印都含有毒。
It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.fr:
Ce Pokémon est recouvert d'une épaisse couche
de boue crasseuse. Il est si toxique que même
ses traces de pas sont empoisonnées.
It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.es:
Está cubierto por un repugnante lodo.
Es tan tóxico que hasta su rastro es venenoso.
It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.it:
Coperto di melma sudicia, è così tossico
che persino le sue impronte sono velenose.
It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.de:
Der schmutzige Schleim dieses Pokémon
ist extrem toxisch. Selbst die Spuren,
die es hinterlässt, enthalten Gift.
It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile.pt-br:
É coberto por uma camada grossa
de lodo nojento. É tão tóxica que até
seus rastros são venenosos.

It's very curious, but its means of inve.en: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
It's very curious, but its means of inve.zh-tw: 它很好奇，但它調查事物的手段是嘗試用觸手猛擊它們。對食物的尋找是將其帶到陸地上的原因。
It's very curious, but its means of inve.fr:
Il se rend sur la terre ferme pour se nourrir.
Très curieux, son premier réflexe est de frapper
tout ce qu'il voit avec ses tentacules.
It's very curious, but its means of inve.es:
Emerge a tierra firme en busca de alimento. Su
extrema curiosidad lo induce a golpear con los
tentáculos todo lo que entra en su campo visual.
It's very curious, but its means of inve.it:
Si spinge sulla terraferma in cerca di cibo.
È molto curioso e colpisce con i tentacoli
tutto quello che entra nel suo campo visivo.
It's very curious, but its means of inve.de:
Zur Futtersuche kommt es an Land. Es ist sehr
neugierig, weshalb es alles, was es sieht,
zunächst einmal mit seinen Tentakeln haut.
It's very curious, but its means of inve.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é muito curioso, mas seu método de
investigar as coisas é socando-as com seus tentáculos.
Só vem para a terra firme à procura de comida.

Its ability to evolve into many forms al.en: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
Its ability to evolve into many forms al.zh-tw: 它進化成多種形態的能力使其能夠順利、完美地適應任何環境。
Its ability to evolve into many forms al.fr:
Ses multiples évolutions lui permettent
de s'adapter à tout type de milieu naturel.
Its ability to evolve into many forms al.es:
Es capaz de evolucionar de muchas maneras
para adaptarse sin problemas a cualquier medio.
Its ability to evolve into many forms al.it:
La capacità di evolversi in diverse specie gli permette
di adattarsi perfettamente a qualsiasi tipo di ambiente.
Its ability to evolve into many forms al.de:
Um sich jeder Umgebung perfekt anpassen zu
können, ist es in der Lage, sich zu verschiedenen
Pokémon zu entwickeln.
Its ability to evolve into many forms al.pt-br:
Sua capacidade de evoluir para muitas formas
permite que se adapte fácil e perfeitamente
a qualquer ambiente.

Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.en: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.zh-tw: 它的身體裡充滿了毒氣。它漂浮在垃圾堆中，尋找未加工的腐爛垃圾的煙霧。
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.fr:
Son corps est gonflé de gaz toxique. Il se rend dans les décharges,
attiré par l'odeur des déchets alimentaires en décomposition.
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.es:
Su cuerpo está lleno a rebosar de gas venenoso.
Acude a los vertederos atraído por el putrefacto
olor que emana de los desperdicios.
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.it:
Il suo corpo è gonfio di gas velenosi. Va nelle
discariche attratto dall'odore di rifiuti putrescenti.
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.de:
Sein Körper ist zum Bersten voll mit Giftgas.
Angelockt vom fauligen Geruch verrottender
Abfälle, lungert es auf Müllhalden herum.
Its body is full of poisonous gas. It fl.pt-br:
Seu corpo é cheio de gás venenoso. Flutua
para lixões à procura dos gases exalados
por lixo apodrecido.

Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.en: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.zh-tw: 它的身體是堅實的肌肉。當在寒冷的海洋中游泳時，波利瓦斯會用其令人印象深刻的手臂擊碎流冰並向前推進。
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.fr:
Cette véritable montagne de muscles peut
se frayer un chemin même dans les eaux glaciales
en éclatant la banquise avec ses bras robustes.
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.es:
Su cuerpo es puro músculo. Logra
abrirse paso por aguas gélidas partiendo
el hielo con sus fornidos brazos.
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.it:
Il suo corpo è un ammasso di muscoli. Nuota
anche nei mari più freddi frantumando il ghiaccio
fluttuante con le braccia vigorose per farsi strada.
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.de:
Sein ganzer Körper besteht fast nur aus Muskeln.
In kalten Meeren zerschlägt es mit seinen starken
Armen Treibeis, um voranzukommen.
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming.pt-br:
Seu corpo é puro músculo. Quando nada por mares
gelados, Poliwrath usa seus braços incríveis para
esmagar o gelo à frente e abrir caminho.

Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.en: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.zh-tw: 它的身體會分泌油脂，這種神奇寶貝會將油脂塗在巢穴上作為塗層，以保護巢穴免受灰塵侵害。辛奇諾連一丁點都不能容忍。
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.fr:
Il ne supporte pas de voir le moindre grain de poussière.
Il utilise l'huile qu'il sécrète pour recouvrir son nid
d'un revêtement protecteur.
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.es:
Es tan sumamente pulcro que no puede ver
ni una mota de polvo. La grasa que exuda
por el cuerpo le sirve de película protectora.
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.it:
È un maniaco della pulizia e non sopporta la
vista neanche di un granello di polvere. Riveste
la tana del grasso che trasuda dal suo corpo.
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.de:
Es ist sehr reinlich und duldet nicht mal das
kleinste Staubkorn. Es beschichtet sein Nest
mit dem Öl, das sein Körper absondert.
Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon.pt-br:
Seu corpo secreta um óleo que este Pokémon
espalha sobre seu ninho para protegê-lo de poeira.
Cinccino não suporta nem um grãozinho de sujeira.

Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.en: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.zh-tw: 它的捲曲羊毛是一種非常有效的緩衝墊，即使這只神奇寶貝從懸崖上掉下來，也能毫髮無傷地重新站到底部。
Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.fr:
Son pelage frisé est doux et rebondi comme un coussin.
Une telle toison le protègerait même s'il chutait d'une falaise.
Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.es:
Su lana rizada es tan acolchada que no se hace
daño ni aunque se caiga por un precipicio.
Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.it:
Il suo vello riccioluto gli fornisce una
perfetta imbottitura. Non si farebbe nulla
nemmeno cadendo da un precipizio.
Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.de:
Sein stark gelocktes Fell hat eine sehr polsternde
Wirkung. Selbst eine Klippe hinunterzufallen
macht ihm nichts aus.
Its curly fleece is such an effective cu.pt-br:
Sua lã cacheada é um amortecedor tão eficaz
que este Pokémon pode desabar de um precipício
e se levantar em seguida, completamente ileso.

Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.en: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.zh-tw: 它的背鰭、胸鰭和尾鰭在水中優雅地波動。這就是為什麼它被稱為水舞者。
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.fr:
Ses nageoires dorsales, pectorales
et caudales ondulent avec élégance.
Il est surnommé le " danseur des flots ".
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.es:
Sus aletas pectorales, caudal y dorsal ondean gráciles
en el agua. Por eso se le llama el Bailarín Acuático.
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.it:
Le pinne su dorso, petto e coda ondeggiano con
grazia. Perciò viene chiamato "danzatore d'acqua".
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.de:
Seine Brust-, Rücken- und Schwanzflossen
bewegen sich anmutig. Daher nennt man es
den "Wassertänzer".
Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave.pt-br:
As suas barbatanas nas costas, peito e cauda
agitam-se com elegância na água. É por isso que
este Pokémon é conhecido como o bailarino das águas.

Its incisors grow continuously throughou.en: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.
Its incisors grow continuously throughou.zh-tw: 它的門牙在其一生中不斷生長。如果門牙太長，這只神奇寶貝就會無法進食，最終會餓死。
Its incisors grow continuously throughou.fr:
Ses incisives poussent tout au long de sa vie.
Si elles dépassent une certaine longueur,
il ne peut plus s'alimenter et meurt de faim.
Its incisors grow continuously throughou.es:
Sus incisivos crecen durante toda su vida.
Si aumentan demasiado de tamaño, no
puede alimentarse y muere de inanición.
Its incisors grow continuously throughou.it:
I suoi incisivi continuano a crescere per
tutta la vita. Se si allungano troppo, non
riesce più a nutrirsi e muore di fame.
Its incisors grow continuously throughou.de:
Seine Nagezähne wachsen sein ganzes Leben
über. Werden sie allzu lang, kann es damit nicht
mehr fressen und verhungert.
Its incisors grow continuously throughou.pt-br:
Seus incisivos crescem continuamente durante toda
a sua vida, mas se ficarem longos demais, este Pokémon
não conseguirá comer e morrerá de fome.

Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.en: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.zh-tw: 其大而堅硬的鉗子具有萬馬力的力量。但由於體型太大，移動起來很不便。
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.fr:
Sa grosse pince est dotée d'une puissance
incommensurable. Sa taille imposante
la rend toutefois difficile à utiliser.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.es:
La pinza tan grande que tiene posee
una fuerza de 10 000 CV, pero le
cuesta moverla por su gran tamaño.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.it:
La chela più grande sprigiona una
potenza di 10.000 CV. Le dimensioni
gli rendono difficili gli spostamenti.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.de:
Die Kraft seiner großen und harten Schere
entspricht 10 000 PS. Durch die Größe ist sie
aber auch äußerst unhandlich und sperrig.
Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-hor.pt-br:
Sua pinça grande e dura possui a força de
10.000 cavalos-vapor. No entanto, por ser
tão grande, movê-la é um incômodo.

Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.en: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.zh-tw: 它肌肉發達的身體如此強大，必須佩戴節能帶才能調節其動作。
Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.fr:
Son corps est si puissant qu'il lui faut
une ceinture pour maîtriser sa force.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.es:
Su musculoso cuerpo es tan fuerte que usa un
cinto antifuerza para controlar sus movimientos.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.it:
Il suo corpo muscoloso è così forte che usa
una cintura per contenere la sua potenza.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.de:
Dieses Pokémon ist superstark. Es kann sich nur
mit einem kraftregulierenden Gürtel bewegen.
Its muscular body is so powerful, it mus.pt-br:
Sua massa muscular é tão poderosa que ele
precisa usar um cinto de economia de energia
para controlar seus movimentos.

Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.en: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.zh-tw: 它的雌蕊散發著令人難以置信的惡臭。可怕的惡臭可導致 1.25 英里外的人暈厥。
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.fr:
Ses pistils sécrètent une odeur incroyablement fétide qui fait
perdre connaissance à ses adversaires jusqu'à 2 km à la ronde.
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.es:
Libera un fétido olor por los pistilos.
El fuerte hedor hace perder el conocimiento a
cualquiera que se encuentre en un radio de 2 km.
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.it:
I pistilli emanano un puzzo orribile, capace
di far svenire chiunque nel raggio di 2 km.
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.de:
Sein Stempel sondert einen unglaublich faulen
Gestank ab. Dieser stechende Geruch kann selbst
bis zu 2 km entfernte Gegner bewusstlos machen.
Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odo.pt-br:
Seus pistilos exalam um odor incrivelmente
desagradável. Este mau cheiro pode causar
desmaios a 2 km de distância.

Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.en: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.zh-tw: 它的植物在吸收太陽能時就會開花。它不斷移動以尋找陽光。
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.fr:
Sa plante donne une grosse fleur quand
elle absorbe les rayons du soleil. Il est toujours
à la recherche des endroits les plus ensoleillés.
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.es:
La planta florece cuando absorbe energía solar,
lo cual le obliga a buscar siempre la luz del sol.
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.it:
Il fiore sboccia assorbendo energia solare.
Si muove continuamente in cerca di luce.
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.de:
Es nutzt Solarenergie als Nahrung und
bringt so seine große Blume zum Blühen.
Es geht dorthin, wo die Sonne scheint.
Its plant blooms when it is absorbing so.pt-br:
Sua planta floresce ao absorver energia solar,
por isso este Pokémon vive em busca da luz do sol.

Its punches slice the air. They are laun.en: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
Its punches slice the air. They are laun.zh-tw: 它的拳頭劃破空氣。它們以如此高的速度發射，即使是輕微的擦傷也可能導致燒傷。
Its punches slice the air. They are laun.fr:
Ses poings fendent l'air. Ils sont si rapides
qu'un simple frôlement peut causer une brûlure.
Its punches slice the air. They are laun.es:
Sus puñetazos cortan el aire. Son tan veloces que
el mínimo roce podría causar una quemadura.
Its punches slice the air. They are laun.it:
I suoi pugni fendono l'aria a una tale velocità che
basta venire sfiorati per riportare una scottatura.
Its punches slice the air. They are laun.de:
Seine Fäuste zerschneiden regelrecht die Luft.
Sie sind so schnell, dass selbst die geringste
Berührung Verbrennungen verursacht.
Its punches slice the air. They are laun.pt-br:
Seus murros cortam o ar. São tão
velozes que um simples toque pode
causar uma queimadura.

Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.en: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.zh-tw: 它魯莽的本性導致它在必須保護自己的領地時敢於對抗其他神奇寶貝，甚至是大型神奇寶貝。
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.fr:
Un Pokémon téméraire qui n'hésite pas
à affronter des Pokémon plus gros que lui
pour protéger son territoire.
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.es:
Su temperamento temerario hace que no
dude en enfrentarse a rivales mucho más
grandes a la hora de defender su territorio.
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.it:
Temerario di natura, per difendere
il proprio territorio non esita a lanciarsi
anche contro avversari più grandi di lui.
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.de:
Wenn es um die Verteidigung seines Reviers
geht, schreckt das draufgängerische Habitak
selbst vor großen Pokémon nicht zurück.
Its reckless nature leads it to stand up.pt-br:
Sua natureza descuidada leva Spearow a
encarar até Pokémon maiores quando
precisa proteger o seu território.

Its strange cries sound like human langu.en: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.
Its strange cries sound like human langu.zh-tw: 它奇怪的叫聲聽起來像人類的語言。有一些音樂家為 Jynx 創作歌曲供其演唱。
Its strange cries sound like human langu.fr:
Ses étranges cris s'apparentent à des mots. Certains musiciens
lui composent des chansons pour qu'il les interprète.
Its strange cries sound like human langu.es:
Sus particulares gritos recuerdan al lenguaje
humano. Algunos artistas han compuesto
temas específicamente para estos Pokémon.
Its strange cries sound like human langu.it:
Emette strani versi che ricordano il linguaggio
umano. Alcuni compositori scrivono melodie
appositamente per farle cantare ai Jynx.
Its strange cries sound like human langu.de:
Sein sonderbarer Ruf klingt fast wie die Sprache
der Menschen. Manche Musiker schreiben sogar
eigens Lieder, damit Rossana sie singen kann.
Its strange cries sound like human langu.pt-br:
Seu grito estranho soa como fala humana.
Certos músicos compõem canções
especificamente para Jynx cantar.

Its tail discharges electricity into the.en: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
Its tail discharges electricity into the.zh-tw: 它的尾巴會向地面釋放電流，以保護它免受電擊。
Its tail discharges electricity into the.fr:
Il se protège des décharges grâce à sa queue,
qui dissipe l'électricité dans le sol.
Its tail discharges electricity into the.es:
Su cola actúa como toma de tierra
y descarga electricidad al suelo, lo
que le protege de los calambrazos.
Its tail discharges electricity into the.it:
La sua coda scarica elettricità a terra,
proteggendolo dalle scosse elettriche.
Its tail discharges electricity into the.de:
Mithilfe seines Schweifs entlädt es Elektrizität
in den Boden, um sich auf diese Weise vor
elektrischen Schlägen zu schützen.
Its tail discharges electricity into the.pt-br:
Sua cauda descarrega a eletricidade
no solo, protegendo-o contra choques.

Its three heads bob separately up and do.en: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
Its three heads bob separately up and do.zh-tw: 它的三個頭分別上下擺動，以鬆動附近的土壤，使其更容易挖洞。
Its three heads bob separately up and do.fr:
Ses trois têtes pilonnent le sol pour le rendre
friable et ainsi faciliter l'excavation.
Its three heads bob separately up and do.es:
Sus tres cabezas suben y bajan para remover
la tierra cercana y facilitar así la excavación.
Its three heads bob separately up and do.it:
Le tre teste si muovono alternativamente per ammorbidire
il terreno e renderlo così più facile da scavare.
Its three heads bob separately up and do.de:
Seine drei Köpfe bewegen sich abwechselnd
hinauf und hinunter, um das Erdreich um sich
herum zu lockern und leichter graben zu können.
Its three heads bob separately up and do.pt-br:
Suas três cabeças movem-se separadamente
pra cima e pra baixo para amaciarem o solo
ao redor, facilitando a escavação.

Its transformation ability is perfect. H.en: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.
Its transformation ability is perfect. H.zh-tw: 其變形能力堪稱完美。然而，如果讓它笑，它就無法保持其偽裝。
Its transformation ability is perfect. H.fr:
Il excelle dans l'art de la métamorphose, mais
si on le fait rire, il ne pourra rester déguisé.
Its transformation ability is perfect. H.es:
Su habilidad para transformarse es perfecta,
pero, si se le hace reír, perderá la fuerza
y no podrá mantenerse transformado.
Its transformation ability is perfect. H.it:
Sa trasformarsi in maniera perfetta, ma se
lo si fa ridere perde subito il travestimento.
Its transformation ability is perfect. H.de:
Seine Verwandlungskunst ist perfekt. Bringt man
es jedoch zum Lachen, fliegt seine Tarnung auf.
Its transformation ability is perfect. H.pt-br:
Sua capacidade de transformação é perfeita.
No entanto, se o fizerem rir, ele não poderá
manter seu disfarce.

Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.en: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.zh-tw: 它的整個身體都是由肌肉組成的。儘管它只有人類兒童那麼大，但它可以將 100 個成年人拋擲出去。
Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.fr:
Son corps est essentiellement composé de muscles.
Même s'il fait la taille d'un petit enfant,
il peut soulever 100 adultes avec ses bras.
Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.es:
Es una masa de músculos y, pese a su
pequeño tamaño, tiene fuerza de sobra
para levantar en brazos a 100 personas.
Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.it:
Il suo corpo è formato interamente da
muscoli. Non è più alto di un bambino,
ma può sollevare e lanciare 100 adulti.
Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.de:
Sein ganzer Körper besteht aus Muskeln. Auch
wenn es nur so groß wie ein Menschenkind ist,
kann es 100 Erwachsene jonglieren.
Its whole body is composed of muscles. E.pt-br:
Seu corpo é inteiramente composto por músculos.
Apesar de ter o tamanho de uma criança humana,
consegue arremessar 100 adultos.

Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.en: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.zh-tw: Kabutops 將獵物切成薄片並吸出液體。丟棄的身體部位成為其他神奇寶貝的食物。
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.fr:
Il lacère sa proie pour boire ses fluides corporels,
puis jette son corps en pâture à d'autres Pokémon.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.es:
Despedaza a las presas que atrapa para
sorber sus fluidos y deja los restos para que
otros Pokémon den buena cuenta de ellos.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.it:
Lacera le prede e ne succhia i fluidi corporei.
I resti diventano poi cibo per altri Pokémon.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.de:
Kabutops schlitzt seine Beute auf und saugt ihre
Körpersäfte aus. Die Überreste dienen als
Nahrung für andere Pokémon.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks.pt-br:
Kabutops despedaça sua presa e drena seus
fluidos. As partes do corpo descartadas se
tornam comida para outros Pokémon.

Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.en: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.zh-tw: 瑪格瑪用火消滅獵物。但一旦它意識到自己已經把它想要的獵物燒成了焦脆的東西，它就會後悔這個習慣。
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.fr:
Il achève ses proies avec ses flammes, mais
il lui arrive de les calciner accidentellement,
à son plus grand regret.
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.es:
Abate a sus presas con las llamas
que genera y con frecuencia acaba
reduciéndolas a carbonilla por accidente.
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.it:
Abbatte le sue prede con le fiamme, ma
finisce per carbonizzarle accidentalmente,
con suo grande rammarico.
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.de:
Magmar erlegt seine Beute mit Feuer. Manchmal
röstet es diese zu seinem Bedauern so stark,
dass sie versehentlich verkohlt.
Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. Bu.pt-br:
Magmar incendeia suas presas, mas sempre se
arrepende ao perceber que as reduziu a cinzas.

Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.en: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.zh-tw: 許多發電廠都飼養著地面型神奇寶貝，以防御前來尋求電力的電擊獸。
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.fr:
De nombreuses centrales électriques gardent
des Pokémon Sol à proximité afin d'empêcher
les Élektek de leur voler de l'électricité.
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.es:
Es habitual que las centrales eléctricas cuenten
con Pokémon de tipo Tierra para hacer frente
a los Electabuzz ávidos de electricidad.
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.it:
Molte centrali elettriche utilizzano
Pokémon di tipo Terra per difendersi
dagli Electabuzz a caccia di elettricità.
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.de:
In vielen Elektrizitätswerken werden Pokémon
vom Typ Boden eingesetzt, um Elektek davon
abzuhalten, den dortigen Strom anzuzapfen.
Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokém.pt-br:
Muitas usinas mantêm Pokémon de tipo Terrestre
por perto. Fazem isso para protegê-las de Electabuzz
que aparecem em busca de eletricidade.

Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.en: Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Pokémon to your Raichu, Electrode, or Electabuzz in the Active Spot.
Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.zh-tw: 將所有 {L} 能量從你的後備神奇寶貝轉移到活動地點的雷丘、電極或電擊獸上。
Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.fr: Déplacez toutes les Énergies {L} de vos Pokémon de Banc vers Raichu, Électrode ou Élektek sur le Poste Actif.
Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.es: Mueve todas las Energías {L} de tus Pokémon en Banca a tu Raichu, tu Electrode o tu Electabuzz en el Puesto Activo.
Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.it: Sposta tutte le Energie {L} dai tuoi Pokémon in panchina al tuo Raichu, Electrode oppure Electabuzz in posizione attiva.
Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.de: Verschiebe alle {L}-Energien von Pokémon auf deiner Bank auf dein Raichu, Lektrobal oder Elektek in der Aktiven Position.
Move all {L} Energy from your Benched Po.pt-br: Mova todas as Energias {L} dos seus Pokémon no Banco para seu Raichu, Electrode ou Electabuzz no Campo Ativo.

Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.en: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.zh-tw: 尼多女王更擅長防守而不是進攻。這款神奇寶貝擁有像盔甲一樣的鱗片，可以保護它的孩子免受任何類型的攻擊。
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.fr:
Il est plus doué pour se défendre que pour
attaquer. Grâce à son blindage d'écailles,
il protège ses petits de toute agression.
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.es:
Su defensa destaca sobre la capacidad ofensiva.
Usa las escamas del cuerpo como una coraza
para proteger a su prole de cualquier ataque.
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.it:
Più abile nella difesa che nell'attacco,
protegge i cuccioli da qualunque
attacco grazie alla corazza di squame.
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.de:
Sie sind eher defensiv als offensiv veranlagt.
Mit ihren panzerartigen Schuppen schützen sie
ihre Jungen vor jeglichen Angriffen.
Nidoqueen is better at defense than offe.pt-br:
Nidoqueen é melhor na defensiva. Com suas
escamas parecidas com uma armadura,
protege seus filhotes de qualquer ataque.

Often found in forests and grasslands. I.en: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
Often found in forests and grasslands. I.zh-tw: 常見於森林和草原。它的頭頂上有一個約兩英寸長的鋒利有毒倒刺。
Often found in forests and grasslands. I.fr:
On trouve souvent ce Pokémon dans les forêts
et les hautes herbes. L'aiguillon de 5 cm
sur sa tête contient un venin très toxique.
Often found in forests and grasslands. I.es:
Suele habitar bosques y praderas.
Tiene un afilado y venenoso aguijón
de unos 5 cm encima de la cabeza.
Often found in forests and grasslands. I.it:
Vive soprattutto nei boschi e nei prati. Sul capo
ha un affilato e velenoso pungiglione lungo 5 cm.
Often found in forests and grasslands. I.de:
Es lebt bevorzugt in Wäldern und in hohem Gras.
Auf dem Kopf trägt es einen circa 5 cm langen,
spitzen, giftigen Stachel.
Often found in forests and grasslands. I.pt-br:
Encontrado frequentemente em florestas e
pradarias. Possui uma farpa afiada e tóxica
de cerca de 5 cm em cima da cabeça.

Once during your turn, you may do 20 dam.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du einem Pokémon deines Gegners 20 Schadenspunkte zufügen.
Once during your turn, you may do 20 dam.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você pode causar 20 pontos de dano a 1 dos Pokémon do seu oponente.

Once during your turn, you may heal 20 d.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez soigner 20 dégâts de chacun de vos Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 20 d.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes curar 20 puntos de daño a cada uno de tus Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 20 d.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi curare ciascuno dei tuoi Pokémon da 20 danni.
Once during your turn, you may heal 20 d.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 20 Schadenspunkte bei jedem deiner Pokémon heilen.
Once during your turn, you may heal 20 d.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá curar 20 pontos de dano de cada um dos seus Pokémon.
