Once during your turn, you may look at t.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez regarder la première carte du dessus de votre deck.
Once during your turn, you may look at t.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes mirar la primera carta de tu baraja.
Once during your turn, you may look at t.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi guardare la prima carta del tuo mazzo.
Once during your turn, you may look at t.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du dir die oberste Karte deines Decks anschauen.
Once during your turn, you may look at t.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá olhar a carta de cima do seu baralho.

Once during your turn, you may switch ou.en: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
Once during your turn, you may switch ou.zh-tw: 在你的回合中，你可以將對手的活躍神奇寶貝切換到替補席上。 （你的對手選擇新的活躍神奇寶貝。）
Once during your turn, you may switch ou.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez transférer le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire sur le Banc. (Votre adversaire choisit le nouveau Pokémon Actif.)
Once during your turn, you may switch ou.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes cambiar el Pokémon Activo de tu rival a la Banca. (Tu oponente elige el nuevo Pokémon Activo).
Once during your turn, you may switch ou.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners auf die Bank tauschen. (Dein Gegner wählt das neue Aktive Pokémon.)
Once during your turn, you may switch ou.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você pode trocar o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente para o Banco. (Seu oponente escolhe o novo Pokémon Ativo.)
Once during your turn, you may switch ou.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi mettere in panchina il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario. (Il tuo avversario sceglie il nuovo Pokémon attivo.)

Once during your turn, you may take 1 {P.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez prendre une Énergie {P} de votre zone Énergie et l'attacher au Pokémon {P} sur le Poste Actif.
Once during your turn, you may take 1 {P.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes unir 1 Energía {P} de tu área de Energía al Pokémon {P} en el Puesto Activo.
Once during your turn, you may take 1 {P.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi prendere un'Energia {P} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnarla al Pokémon {P} in posizione attiva.
Once during your turn, you may take 1 {P.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 1 {P}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an dein Aktives {P}-Pokémon anlegen.
Once during your turn, you may take 1 {P.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá pegar 1 Energia {P} da sua Zona de Energia e ligá-la ao Pokémon {P} no Campo Ativo.

Once during your turn, you may take a {L.en: Once during your turn, you may take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may take a {L.zh-tw: 在你的回合中，你可以從你的能量區取出一個{L}能量並將其附加到這只神奇寶貝身上。
Once during your turn, you may take a {L.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes tomar una Energía {L} de tu Zona de Energía y unirla a este Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may take a {L.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi prendere un'Energia {L} dalla tua Zona Energetica e assegnarla a questo Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may take a {L.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez prendre une Énergie {L} de votre Zone d'Énergie et l'attacher à ce Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may take a {L.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você pode pegar uma Energia {L} da sua Zona de Energia e associá-la a este Pokémon.

Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.en: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.zh-tw: 一旦出現，就會橫衝直撞。它會一直憤怒，直到摧毀周圍的一切。
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.fr:
Lorsqu'il apparaît, il saccage tout. Sa fureur
ne se calme pas tant qu'il n'a pas tout détruit.
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.es:
Cuando aparece, monta en cólera. No deja
de estar furioso hasta que lo destruye todo.
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.it:
Quando esce allo scoperto in preda alla furia,
non si placa finché non ha raso al suolo ogni cosa.
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.de:
Taucht es auf, randaliert es. Es beruhigt sich erst,
wenn es alles um sich zerstört hat.
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. I.pt-br:
Assim que aparece, ele causa tumulto
e fica enfurecido até destruir tudo em volta.

One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.en: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.zh-tw: 只要一隻日光蟲在陽光下伸展開來，就可以產生足夠的電力來為一座城市供電。
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.fr:
Lorsqu'il déploie sa collerette pour emmagasiner
la lumière du soleil, il génère à lui seul assez
d'électricité pour alimenter une grande ville.
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.es:
Al extender su gorguera y exponerse a la luz
solar, genera la energía eléctrica suficiente para
cubrir el consumo de una metrópoli entera.
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.it:
L'energia prodotta da un Heliolisk quando apre
il suo collare in un luogo soleggiato è sufficiente
a soddisfare il fabbisogno di una metropoli.
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.de:
Stellt es seine kragenartigen Hautlappen auf und
absorbiert damit Sonnenlicht, kann ein Elezard
genug Strom für eine Großstadt produzieren.
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with it.pt-br:
Um único Heliolisk tomando banho de sol com
suas cristas abertas consegue produzir energia
o suficiente para abastecer uma cidade inteira.

Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.en: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.zh-tw: 即使是強大的敵人，Pawniard 也會無所畏懼地挑戰。緊要關頭，它會緊貼對手，用全身的刀刃刺穿他們。
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.fr:
Il n'hésite pas à s'attaquer à ses ennemis,
même les plus féroces. Il s'accroche à eux et les
transperce en utilisant les lames sur son corps.
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.es:
Desafía sin temor a enemigos poderosos.
Si es necesario, se aferra al rival y le clava
las cuchillas que le recubren el cuerpo.
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.it:
Sfida anche i nemici più potenti senza timore.
Se necessario, si aggrappa all'avversario e lo
trafigge con le lame che ha sul corpo.
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.de:
Furchtlos stellt es sich selbst starken Gegnern.
Im Ernstfall hält es sich an ihnen fest und sticht
mit den vielen Klingen an seinem Körper zu.
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even.pt-br:
Pawniard desafiará bravamente até oponentes mais
poderosos. Num piscar de olhos, aproxima-se de sua
vítima e a perfura com as lâminas que cobrem o seu corpo.

People say that it fled from its enemies.en: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.
People say that it fled from its enemies.zh-tw: 人們說它是為了躲避敵人而用後足的小蹼在阿羅拉的一個島嶼之間游動。
People say that it fled from its enemies.fr:
Les petites palmes de ses pattes postérieures
lui permettraient de se rendre d'île en île
à la nage afin d'échapper à ses prédateurs.
People say that it fled from its enemies.es:
Las pequeñas membranas que tiene en las
patas traseras le permiten nadar entre las islas
de Alola y escapar así de sus depredadores.
People say that it fled from its enemies.it:
Si dice che sia sfuggito ai nemici nuotando
da un'isola all'altra grazie alle minuscole
membrane tra le dita delle zampe posteriori.
People say that it fled from its enemies.de:
Auf der Flucht vor seinen Feinden nutzt es die
Schwimmhäute an seinen Hinterläufen, um von
Insel zu Insel zu schwimmen.
People say that it fled from its enemies.pt-br:
Dizem que fugiu dos seus inimigos
usando seus pés palmados para nadar
de ilha em ilha em Alola.

Poison oozes from all over its body. It.en: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.
Poison oozes from all over its body. It.zh-tw: 毒液從它的全身散發出來。在夜間捕捉被光吸引的小蟲子寶可夢。
Poison oozes from all over its body. It.fr:
Son corps sécrète un poison redoutable. La nuit, il capture
de petits Pokémon Insecte attirés par la lumière.
Poison oozes from all over its body. It.es:
Rezuma veneno por todo su cuerpo.
De noche, atrapa y come pequeños
Pokémon insecto atraídos por la luz.
Poison oozes from all over its body. It.it:
Da tutto il suo corpo trasuda veleno.
Di notte cattura piccoli Pokémon
Coleottero attratti dalla luce.
Poison oozes from all over its body. It.de:
Aus seinem ganzen Körper tritt Gift aus.
Es fängt und frisst nachts kleine Käfer-Pokémon,
die von Licht angelockt wurden.
Poison oozes from all over its body. It.pt-br:
Veneno escorre de todo o seu corpo. Durante a
noite, captura pequenos Pokémon inseto que são
atraídos pela luz.

Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.en: Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.zh-tw: 從你的卡組中隨機將 1 只 {G} 神奇寶貝加入你的手牌。
Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.fr: Mettez 1 Pokémon {G} aléatoire de votre deck dans votre main.
Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.es: Pon 1 Pokémon {G} aleatorio de tu mazo en tu mano.
Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.it: Metti nella tua mano 1 Pokémon {G} casuale dal tuo mazzo.
Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.pt-br: Coloque 1 Pokémon {G} aleatório do seu baralho na sua mão.
Put 1 random {G} Pokémon from your deck.de: Nimm 1 zufälliges {G}-Pokémon aus deinem Deck auf deine Hand.

Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.en: Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck onto your Bench.
Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.zh-tw: 從你的牌組中隨機將 1 張 Nidoran♂ 放到你的替補席上。
Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.es: Coloca 1 Nidoran♂ aleatorio de tu mazo en tu Banca.
Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.fr: Mettez 1 Nidoran♂ aléatoire de votre deck sur votre banc.
Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.de: Lege 1 zufälligen Nidoran♂ aus deinem Deck auf deine Bank.
Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.pt-br: Coloque 1 Nidoran♂ aleatório do seu deck no seu Banco.
Put 1 random Nidoran♂ from your deck ont.it: Metti 1 Nidoran♂ casuale dal tuo mazzo nella tua panchina.

Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.en: Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Spot into your hand.
Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.zh-tw: 將活躍點中的 Muk 或 Weez 放入手上。
Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.fr: Ajoutez votre Grotadmorv ou votre Smogogo sur le Poste Actif à votre main.
Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.es: Pon a tu Muk o a tu Weezing que esté en el Puesto Activo en tu mano.
Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.it: Riprendi in mano il tuo Muk o Weezing in posizione attiva.
Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.de: Nimm dein Sleimok oder Smogmog in der Aktiven Position auf deine Hand.
Put your Muk or Weezing in the Active Sp.pt-br: Coloque seu Muk ou Weezing do Campo Ativo na sua mão.

Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.en: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.zh-tw: 據說它們生活在叢林深處的巨大聚居地，儘管沒有人從那裡回來過。
Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.fr:
On dit qu'il vit en colonie dans la jungle,
mais personne n'en est jamais revenu
vivant pour le confirmer.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.es:
Dicen que vive en grandes colonias en el interior
de las junglas, aunque nadie ha podido verificarlo.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.it:
Pare che viva in grandi colonie nel cuore della giungla,
ma nessuno è mai tornato da lì per raccontarlo.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.de:
Dieses Pokémon soll in großen Kolonien
tief im Dschungel leben, doch niemand
kann dies bestätigen.
Said to live in huge colonies deep in ju.pt-br:
Diz-se que vivem em enormes colônias nas
profundezas das florestas, embora ninguém
jamais tenha conseguido voltar de lá.

Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.en: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.
Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.zh-tw: 薩拉茲用毒氣讓對手頭暈目眩，然後用誘人的動作迷惑他們，將他們變成忠誠的僕人。
Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.fr:
Il étourdit ses adversaires avec son gaz toxique,
puis il les asservit en exécutant une danse envoûtante.
Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.es:
Convierte a sus rivales en devotos súbditos
tras marearlos con su gas venenoso y seducirlos
con los cautivadores movimientos de su cuerpo.
Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.it:
Trasforma gli avversari in seguaci stordendoli con del
gas tossico per poi sedurli con movenze ammalianti.
Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.de:
Zuerst benebelt es Gegner mit Giftgas, um sie
danach mit fesselnden Körperbewegungen zu
betören und zu ergebenen Dienern zu machen.
Salazzle makes its opponents light-heade.pt-br:
Salazzle deixa os oponentes zonzos com seu
gás venenoso, depois os cativa com movimentos
fascinantes para transformá-los em servos leais.

Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.en: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.zh-tw: 盯著腹部的漩渦會讓人昏昏欲睡。波利維爾的這一特徵已被用來代替搖籃曲來讓孩子們入睡。
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.fr:
Il suffit de fixer la spirale sur son ventre pour
s'assoupir. On se sert parfois de lui à la place
d'une berceuse pour endormir les enfants.
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.es:
Mirar fijamente la espiral de su vientre provoca
somnolencia, por lo que puede usarse como
alternativa a las nanas para dormir a los niños.
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.it:
Chi fissa a lungo il disegno spiraliforme sul ventre
si assopisce, tant'è che Poliwhirl lo utilizza al
posto della ninnananna per far dormire i piccoli.
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.de:
Wer länger auf seine Bauchspirale blickt, wird
schläfrig. Manche Leute nutzen dies anstelle
eines Schlaflieds, damit ihre Kinder einschlafen.
Staring at the swirl on its belly causes.pt-br:
Olhar para a espiral em sua barriga causa sonolência.
Esta característica de Poliwhirl tem sido usada no lugar
de canções de ninar para ajudar crianças a dormir.

State-of-the-art technology was used to.en: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.
State-of-the-art technology was used to.zh-tw: Porygon 的製造採用了最先進的技術。它是第一個通過計算機編程創建的人造神奇寶貝。
State-of-the-art technology was used to.fr:
C'est le premier Pokémon au monde à avoir
été créé à partir de programmes informatiques,
grâce à une technologie de pointe.
State-of-the-art technology was used to.es:
Se trata del primer Pokémon del mundo
creado a partir de códigos de programación
gracias al uso de tecnología de vanguardia.
State-of-the-art technology was used to.it:
È il primo Pokémon della storia a essere
stato creato tramite programmi, grazie
all'impiego di tecnologie all'avanguardia.
State-of-the-art technology was used to.de:
Es ist weltweit das erste künstliche Pokémon,
das dank neuester Technologien mittels
Computerprogrammen erschaffen wurde.
State-of-the-art technology was used to.pt-br:
Tecnologia de ponta foi usada na criação
de Porygon. Foi o primeiro Pokémon artificial
criado por meio de um programa de computador.

Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.en: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.zh-tw: 強大但不太聰明，這只神奇寶貝甚至可以用它的衝鋒鏟粉碎摩天大樓。
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.fr:
Costaud, mais pas très intelligent, ce Pokémon est capable
de détruire un immeuble entier en fonçant dessus.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.es:
Su inteligencia es limitada, aunque posee una
fuerza tan considerable que le permite incluso
derribar rascacielos con solo embestirlos.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.it:
È molto forte, benché non particolarmente brillante.
Se si scaglia contro un grattacielo può raderlo al suolo.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.de:
Dieses Pokémon ist zwar nicht besonders klug,
aber dafür so stark, dass es durch Rammen sogar
Hochhäuser zum Einsturz bringen kann.
Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon.pt-br:
Forte, mas não muito brilhante, este Pokémon
pode estilhaçar até mesmo um arranha-céu
com suas investidas poderosas.

Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.en: Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.zh-tw: 將對手的活躍神奇寶貝移至替補席。 （你的對手選擇新的活躍神奇寶貝。）
Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.fr: Échangez le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire avec l'un de ses Pokémon de Banc. (Votre adversaire choisit le nouveau Pokémon Actif.)
Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.es: Mueve el Pokémon Activo de tu rival a la Banca. (Tu rival elige el nuevo Pokémon Activo).
Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.it: Sposta il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario nella sua panchina. Il tuo avversario sceglie il nuovo Pokémon attivo.
Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.de: Wechsle das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners auf seine Bank aus. (Dein Gegner wählt das neue Aktive Pokémon.)
Switch out your opponent’s Active Pokémo.pt-br: Mande o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente para o Banco. (O seu oponente escolhe o novo Pokémon Ativo.)

Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to your Golem or Onix.
Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區獲取 1 個 {F} 能量並將其附加到你的魔像或 Onix 上。
Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez une Énergie {F} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-la à Grolem[Text:Char v="FOUR-PER-EM-SPACE" ][Text:AdditionalName v="ADDITIONAL_NAME_Alora" type="region" ] ou Onix.
Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Une 1 Energía {F} de tu área de Energía a tu Golem[Text:Char v="FOUR-PER-EM-SPACE" ][Text:AdditionalName v="ADDITIONAL_NAME_Alora" type="region" ] o a tu Onix.
Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {F} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a Golem[Text:Char v="FOUR-PER-EM-SPACE" ][Text:AdditionalName v="ADDITIONAL_NAME_Alora" type="region" ] oppure a Onix.
Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Lege 1 {F}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an [Text:AdditionalName v="ADDITIONAL_NAME_Alora" type="region" ]Geowaz oder Onix an.
Take 1 {F} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue 1 Energia {F} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a a Golem[Text:Char v="FOUR-PER-EM-SPACE" ][Text:AdditionalName v="ADDITIONAL_NAME_Alora" type="region" ] ou Onix.

Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區取出 1 {M} 能量並將其附加到這只神奇寶貝身上。
Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez une Énergie {M} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-la à ce Pokémon.
Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Une 1 Energía {M} de tu área de Energía a este Pokémon.
Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {M} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a questo Pokémon.
Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Lege 1 {M}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an dieses Pokémon an.
Take 1 {M} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue 1 Energia {M} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a a este Pokémon.

Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched {G} Pokémon.
Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區取出一個 {G} 能量並將其附加到你後備的 1 只 {G} 神奇寶貝上。
Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez une Énergie {G} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-la à l'un de vos Pokémon {G} de Banc.
Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Une 1 Energía {G} de tu área de Energía a 1 de tus Pokémon {G} en Banca.
Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {G} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a uno dei tuoi Pokémon {G} in panchina.
Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Lege 1 {G}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an 1 {G}-Pokémon auf deiner Bank an.
Take a {G} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue 1 Energia {G} da sua Zona de Energia e a 1 dos seus Pokémon {G} no Banco.

Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.en: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.
Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.zh-tw: Tentacool 並不是一個特別擅長游泳的人。當它尋找獵物時，它會在淺海表面漂流。
Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.fr:
Peu doué pour la natation, ce Pokémon
se contente de flotter à la surface des eaux
peu profondes pour chasser ses proies.
Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.es:
Sus facultades natatorias son más bien escasas,
por lo que se limita a flotar a la deriva en
aguas poco profundas en busca de alimento.
Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.it:
Non essendo molto abile a nuotare, va in cerca
di prede fluttuando in acque poco profonde.
Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.de:
Da Tentacha kein besonders guter Schwimmer ist,
treibt es in seichten Gewässern an der
Wasseroberfläche und sucht nach Beute.
Tentacool is not a particularly strong s.pt-br:
Tentacool não nada particularmente bem.
Flutua pela superfície de águas rasas
enquanto procura por sua presa.

Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.en: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.zh-tw: 由於其脂肪很厚，寒冷的海水根本不會打擾它，但在溫暖的海水中它很容易感到疲倦。
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.fr:
Sa couche de gras lui permet d'être à l'aise
dans les eaux les plus froides. Il a par contre
plus de mal à supporter les mers chaudes.
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.es:
La gruesa capa de grasa que le permite
nadar sin problemas en aguas frías le da
más de un sofoco en climas más cálidos.
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.it:
Grazie al suo spesso strato di grasso nuota
tranquillamente nell'acqua gelida. Nei mari
caldi rischia facilmente lo sfinimento.
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.de:
Kalte Meere machen ihm dank seiner dicken
Fettschicht nichts aus. Wärmere Gewässer
setzen ihm hingegen sehr zu.
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't.pt-br:
Graças a sua gordura, os mares gelados não
incomodam este Pokémon, mas ele fica cansado
facilmente em águas mornas.

The broadness of its hands may be no coi.en: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
The broadness of its hands may be no coi.zh-tw: 它的手如此寬大可能並非巧合——許多科學家認為它的手掌變大是為了表演啞劇。
The broadness of its hands may be no coi.fr:
De nombreux savants pensent que ses mains
se sont développées pour faire de la pantomime.
The broadness of its hands may be no coi.es:
Muchos estudiosos sostienen que el
desarrollo de sus enormes manos se debe
a su afán por practicar la pantomima.
The broadness of its hands may be no coi.it:
Molti studiosi ritengono che abbia sviluppato mani
così grandi perché gli sono utili per la mimica.
The broadness of its hands may be no coi.de:
Viele Forscher glauben, seine Hände hätten nur
deshalb so eine beachtliche Größe angenommen,
damit es Pantomime praktizieren kann.
The broadness of its hands may be no coi.pt-br:
Suas mãos talvez não sejam grandes
por acaso: muitos cientistas acreditam que
as palmas se alargaram para fazer mímica.

The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.en: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.
The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.zh-tw: 蟲子已經死得差不多了，背上的蘑菇成了主體。如果蘑菇脫落，蟲子就會停止移動。
The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.fr:
L'insecte est quasiment mort, à ce stade,
et le champignon est devenu le véritable cerveau.
Si on l'ôte de son dos, il ne peut plus bouger.
The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.es:
La mayor parte de su cuerpo está atrofiada,
excepto la seta del dorso, que controla al resto.
Si se desprende, Parasect ya no podrá moverse.
The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.it:
La parte essenziale di questo Pokémon,
praticamente morto, è costituita dal fungo sulla
sua schiena. Se si stacca, non può più muoversi.
The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.de:
Der Pilz auf seinem Rücken ist sein wichtigstes
Körperteil. Der Rest ist quasi leblos und kann
sich ohne den Pilz nicht bewegen.
The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroo.pt-br:
A maior parte do seu corpo está morta, exceto pelo cogumelo
que está nas suas costas e que controla o resto. Se o cogumelo
se desprender do corpo, este Pokémon não conseguirá se mover.

The claws on its feet are well developed.en: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.
The claws on its feet are well developed.zh-tw: 它腳上的爪子很發達。它可以將 Exeggcute 等獵物帶到 60 英里外的巢穴。
The claws on its feet are well developed.fr:
Grâce à ses griffes très puissantes, il est capable de transporter
des Noeunoeuf vers un nid éloigné de plus de 100 km.
The claws on its feet are well developed.es:
Tiene unas garras desarrolladas. Puede
atrapar un Exeggcute y transportarlo
desde una distancia de casi 100 km.
The claws on its feet are well developed.it:
Grazie ai potenti artigli può trasportare una preda
delle dimensioni di un Exeggcute per oltre 100 km.
The claws on its feet are well developed.de:
Die Krallen an seinen Füßen sind sehr ausgeprägt.
Es kann sogar ein Owei zu seinem Nest
in 100 km Entfernung tragen.
The claws on its feet are well developed.pt-br:
As garras nos seus pés são bem desenvolvidas.
Ele pode levar presas como Exeggcute para seu
ninho a mais de 100 km de distância.

The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.en: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon's spikes will feel when touched.
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.zh-tw: 沙斬生活的地區越乾燥，觸摸時神奇寶貝的尖刺就越堅硬、越光滑。
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.fr:
Plus son habitat est sec, plus ses épines
dorsales deviennent dures et lisses.
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.es:
Cuanto más seco es el terreno en el
que habita, más duras y lisas se vuelven
las púas que le recubren la espalda.
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.it:
Più secco è il territorio dove Sandslash vive,
più i suoi aculei dorsali diventano lisci e duri.
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.de:
Je trockener das Gebiet ist, in dem Sandamer
lebt, desto härter und glatter fühlen sich die
Stacheln an seinem Rücken an.
The drier the area Sandslash lives in, t.pt-br:
Quanto mais seca for a área onde Sandslash vive,
mais duros e lisos serão os espinhos deste Pokémon.

The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.en: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.zh-tw: 其頭部兩側的裝置發射的電磁波會排出反重力，使其能夠漂浮。
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.fr:
Les ondes électromagnétiques émises par ses extrémités
lui permettent de défier les lois de la gravité et de flotter.
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.es:
Las unidades laterales crean ondas
electromagnéticas que contrarrestan
la gravedad y le permiten flotar.
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.it:
Le onde elettromagnetiche generate dagli
elementi laterali neutralizzano la gravità
permettendogli di levitare a mezz'aria.
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.de:
Die seitlichen Module halten es in der Luft,
indem sie mit elektromagnetischen Wellen
die Schwerkraft überlisten.
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the.pt-br:
As ondas eletromagnéticas emitidas pelas
unidades nas laterais de sua cabeça geram
antigravidade, o que faz com que ele possa flutuar.

The fragrance of the garland on its head.en: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
The fragrance of the garland on its head.zh-tw: 它頭上的花環散發出的香味有放鬆的作用，但照顧它卻很困難。
The fragrance of the garland on its head.fr:
La fleur sur sa tête émet un parfum
qui apaise instantanément, mais
elle est très difficile à entretenir.
The fragrance of the garland on its head.es:
El aroma que despide la flor de su tocado
tiene efectos tranquilizantes, pero este
Pokémon requiere muchos cuidados.
The fragrance of the garland on its head.it:
Il fiore che ha sulla testa emette un profumo davvero
rilassante, ma è molto difficile prendersene cura.
The fragrance of the garland on its head.de:
Der Blumenschmuck auf seinem Kopf
sondert einen beruhigenden Duft ab,
ist jedoch nicht gerade pflegeleicht.
The fragrance of the garland on its head.pt-br:
A fragrância da guirlanda em sua cabeça possui um
efeito relaxante. Ela murcha quando não é bem
cuidada por um Treinador.

The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.en: The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.zh-tw: 雄性尼多蘭額頭上的角含有劇毒。這是一隻非常謹慎的神奇寶貝，總是拉緊它的大耳朵。
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.fr:
Sa corne frontale contient un puissant poison. Les grandes oreilles
de ce Pokémon très prudent sont constamment dressées.
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.es:
Mantiene sus grandes orejas levantadas, siempre
alerta. Si advierte peligro, ataca inoculando una
potente toxina con su cuerno frontal.
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.it:
Il corno sulla fronte è estremamente
velenoso. Di indole circospetta, rizza
costantemente le sue grandi orecchie.
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.de:
Das Horn auf seiner Stirn enthält ein starkes Gift.
Dieses Pokémon ist sehr vorsichtig und stellt
seine großen Ohren stets wachsam auf.
The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead co.pt-br:
O chifre na testa dos Nidoran machos contém
um veneno poderoso. Trata-se de um Pokémon
cauteloso, sempre esticando suas grandes orelhas.

The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.en: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.zh-tw: 它頭上的角已經萎縮了。人們認為，這樣做是為了讓尼多麗娜的孩子們在母親餵奶時不會被戳到。
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.fr:
On pense que sa corne frontale s'est atrophiée pour
lui permettre de nourrir ses petits sans les blesser.
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.es:
Se cree que el cuerno de la frente se le ha atrofiado
para evitar herir a sus crías al alimentarlas.
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.it:
Si pensa che il corno sulla fronte si sia
atrofizzato per evitare che Nidorina
punga i suoi cuccioli quando li nutre.
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.de:
Man geht davon aus, dass sich das Horn auf
ihrem Kopf zurückgebildet hat, damit sie ihre
Jungen nicht beim Füttern verletzen.
The horn on its head has atrophied. It's.pt-br:
O chifre em sua cabeça atrofiou. Acredita-se que
isso aconteceu para que os filhotes de Nidorina
não fossem espetados enquanto a mãe os alimenta.

The horns on its head provide a strong p.en: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.
The horns on its head provide a strong p.zh-tw: 它頭上的角具有強大的力量，能夠感知人們的情緒。
The horns on its head provide a strong p.fr:
Il perçoit très précisément les émotions humaines
grâce aux cornes rouges sur sa tête.
The horns on its head provide a strong p.es:
Gracias a los cuernos rojos de su cabeza,
puede captar lo que sienten las personas.
The horns on its head provide a strong p.it:
Ha la capacità di percepire le emozioni delle
persone grazie alle corna rosse che ha sul capo.
The horns on its head provide a strong p.de:
Mit den roten Hörnern auf seinem Kopf kann es
die Gefühle der Menschen genau erspüren.
The horns on its head provide a strong p.pt-br:
O chifre na sua cabeça lhe garante o poder
grandioso de sentir as emoções das pessoas.

The latest research has determined that.en: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.
The latest research has determined that.zh-tw: 最新研究確定，它胃部的圖案有20多種可能的排列方式。
The latest research has determined that.fr:
Une étude récente aurait recensé plus de vingt motifs différents
pouvant orner le devant du capuchon des Arbok.
The latest research has determined that.es:
Recientes estudios han llegado a identificar
hasta una veintena de patrones distintos
que puede presentar el motivo de su cuello.
The latest research has determined that.it:
Secondo gli studi più recenti, esistono più
di 20 varianti del disegno che ha sul ventre.
The latest research has determined that.de:
Jüngsten Forschungsergebnissen zufolge gibt
es mehr als 20 verschiedene Musterungen,
die Arboks Bauch aufweisen kann.
The latest research has determined that.pt-br:
Segundo as pesquisas mais recentes,
existem mais de 20 variações dos
padrões em sua barriga.

The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.en: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.zh-tw: 葉狀部分充當切割敵人的刀具。它噴出一種可以溶解一切的液體。
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.fr:
Ses membres en forme de feuilles permettent
à Boustiflor de trancher ses adversaires.
Il crache un fluide capable de tout dissoudre.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.es:
Las hojas que tiene actúan como cuchillas en combate.
Otra de sus armas es el corrosivo fluido que expulsa.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.it:
Si serve delle foglie laterali come lame contro i nemici.
Il fluido che secerne dalla bocca scioglie qualsiasi cosa.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.de:
Die Blätter werden eingesetzt, um Gegner
aufzuschlitzen. Dieses Pokémon spuckt eine
Flüssigkeit, die alles auflöst.
The leafy parts act as cutters for slash.pt-br:
As partes folhosas funcionam como cortadores
para dilacerar inimigos. Ele cospe um fluido
capaz de dissolver qualquer coisa.

The leaves on its head grow right back e.en: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
The leaves on its head grow right back e.zh-tw: 它頭上的葉子即使掉下來也會重新長出來。這些苦澀的葉子讓吃它們的人感到清爽。
The leaves on its head grow right back e.fr:
Les feuilles sur sa tête repoussent très vite.
Elles sont fort amères, mais elles revigorent
les corps les plus éreintés.
The leaves on its head grow right back e.es:
Las hojas de su cabeza vuelven a crecer
rápidamente aunque se caigan. A pesar
de ser amargas, restablecen la vitalidad.
The leaves on its head grow right back e.it:
Se le foglie sul suo capo cadono, ricrescono subito. Sono
molto amare, ma se masticate rimettono subito in forze.
The leaves on its head grow right back e.de:
Die Blätter auf seinem Kopf schmecken äußerst
bitter, wirken aber erfrischend. Fallen sie aus,
wachsen sie sofort nach.
The leaves on its head grow right back e.pt-br:
As folhas em sua cabeça crescem imediatamente
de volta mesmo quando caem. Essas folhas amargas
refrescam aqueles que as comem.

The more energy it charges up, the faste.en: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.
The more energy it charges up, the faste.zh-tw: 它充電的能量越多，速度就越快。但這也使得它更容易爆炸。
The more energy it charges up, the faste.fr:
Plus il accumule de l'énergie de type Électrik, plus il est rapide.
Mais il a aussi davantage de chances d'exploser.
The more energy it charges up, the faste.es:
Cuanta más energía almacena, mayor
velocidad alcanza, aunque aumenta
también el riesgo de que explote.
The more energy it charges up, the faste.it:
L'energia Elettro che immagazzina
lo fa andare sempre più veloce, ma
lo fa anche esplodere più facilmente.
The more energy it charges up, the faste.de:
Je mehr elektrische Energie es speichert, desto
schneller ist es. Allerdings steigt dabei auch das
Risiko, dass es explodiert.
The more energy it charges up, the faste.pt-br:
Quanto mais energia carrega, mais
velocidade ganha. Mas também aumenta
a sua probabilidade de explodir.

The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.en: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.zh-tw: 這種被稱為“tochukaso”的蘑菇正在控制這種細菌。即使蟲子騷擾了蘑菇，蘑菇也會叫它趕緊走開。
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.fr:
Les champignons, appelés tochukaso,
contrôlent l'insecte contre sa volonté.
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.es:
Las setas que tiene en el dorso,
llamadas tochukaso, controlan
al insecto contra su voluntad.
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.it:
I funghi che crescono sul dorso di questo
Pokémon, chiamati tochukaso, controllano
le sue azioni contro la sua volontà.
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.de:
Paras' Körper kann nicht nach seinem eigenen
Willen handeln, da er von Tochukaso, den Pilzen
auf seinem Rücken, kontrolliert wird.
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are c.pt-br:
Os cogumelos, conhecidos como tochukaso,
controlam o inseto. Quando o inseto perturba
os cogumelos, eles o mandam catar coquinho.

The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.en: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝翅膀上的莖可以作為劍來砍倒對手。在嚴峻的情況下，莖也可以作為食物。
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.fr:
Il tranche ses adversaires avec sa tige, qu'il manie comme
une épée. Quand la situation l'exige, il s'en nourrit.
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.es:
Blande el puerro que sujeta con un ala como si
se tratase de una espada para rebanar a su rival.
En caso de necesidad, se lo come para nutrirse.
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.it:
Colpisce gli avversari con un gambo, che
brandisce con l'ala come se fosse una spada.
In caso di necessità, può anche mangiarselo.
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.de:
Unter seinem Flügel trägt es eine Lauchstange,
die es wie ein Schwert gegen Feinde einsetzt und
welche ihm im Bedarfsfall auch als Nahrung dient.
The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wi.pt-br:
O caule que este Pokémon carrega em suas asas
serve como uma espada para cortar seus oponentes.
Em situações difíceis, ele também pode servir como alimento.

The way it brushes away grime with its t.en: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
The way it brushes away grime with its t.zh-tw: 它用尾巴刷掉污垢的方式在清潔時很有幫助。但它對一塵不染的關注可能會讓清潔變得更加麻煩。
The way it brushes away grime with its t.fr:
Il époussette les saletés avec sa queue. Il est d'une aide précieuse
pour faire le ménage, mais il est très tatillon sur la propreté.
The way it brushes away grime with its t.es:
Usa la cola para barrer la basurilla.
Su extrema pulcritud es tanto una ayuda
en la limpieza del hogar como un incordio.
The way it brushes away grime with its t.it:
Con la coda rimuove ogni traccia di sporco.
È di grande aiuto per le pulizie, ma la sua
pignoleria può diventare estenuante.
The way it brushes away grime with its t.de:
Es entfernt Schmutz mit seinem Schweif. Beim
Hausputz ist es eine große Hilfe, aber sein
Putzfimmel kann auch anstrengend werden.
The way it brushes away grime with its t.pt-br:
A maneira como este Pokémon varre a sujeira com
a cauda pode ser útil na hora de fazer uma faxina, mas
sua obsessão por limpeza pode tornar o processo uma chatice.

The wings are covered with dustlike scal.en: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
The wings are covered with dustlike scal.zh-tw: 翅膀上覆蓋著塵埃般的鱗片。它每次拍打翅膀時都會釋放出劇毒粉塵。
The wings are covered with dustlike scal.fr:
Ses ailes sont couvertes d'écailles poudreuses.
À chaque battement d'ailes, il laisse tomber
de la poudre hautement toxique.
The wings are covered with dustlike scal.es:
Tiene las alas cubiertas de escamas.
Cada vez que las bate, esparce un
polvillo sumamente venenoso.
The wings are covered with dustlike scal.it:
Le ali sono ricoperte di scaglie. Ogni volta che le
batte, viene liberata nell'aria una polvere velenosa.
The wings are covered with dustlike scal.de:
Seine Flügel sind mit staubähnlichen Schuppen
überzogen. Mit jedem Flügelschlag verstreut es
hochgiftigen Puder.
The wings are covered with dustlike scal.pt-br:
As suas asas são cobertas por escamas
semelhantes a poeira. Toda vez que bate
as asas, libera uma poeira altamente tóxica.

There is a plant seed on its back right.en: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
There is a plant seed on its back right.zh-tw: 從這只神奇寶貝出生的那天起，它的背上就有一顆植物種子。種子慢慢長大。
There is a plant seed on its back right.fr:
Il y a une graine sur son dos depuis sa naissance.
Elle grossit un peu chaque jour.
There is a plant seed on its back right.es:
Este Pokémon nace con una semilla en el
lomo, que brota con el paso del tiempo.
There is a plant seed on its back right.it:
Fin dalla nascita questo Pokémon ha sulla
schiena un seme che cresce lentamente.
There is a plant seed on its back right.de:
Dieses Pokémon trägt von Geburt an einen
Samen auf dem Rücken, der im Laufe der Zeit
keimt und wächst.
There is a plant seed on its back right.pt-br:
Este Pokémon já nasce com uma semente
nas costas. Aos poucos, a semente cresce.

There's a hole in its tail that allows i.en: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
There's a hole in its tail that allows i.zh-tw: 它的尾巴上有一個洞，可以讓它吸入保持火焰燃燒所需的空氣。如果洞被堵住，這只神奇寶貝就會生病。
There's a hole in its tail that allows i.fr:
Il aspire de l'air par le bout de sa queue
et produit ainsi sa fameuse langue de feu.
Si on lui bouche la queue, il se sent mal.
There's a hole in its tail that allows i.es:
Absorbe aire por el orificio de la cola
para prender las llamas que expulsa.
Si la abertura se obstruye, enferma.
There's a hole in its tail that allows i.it:
Aspira aria dal foro nella coda per produrre delle
fiamme. Se il foro viene tappato, inizia a sentirsi male.
There's a hole in its tail that allows i.de:
Es saugt über das Loch in seinem Schweif Luft für
seine Flammen ein. Eine Verstopfung des Lochs
schlägt Furnifraß sofort auf die Gesundheit.
There's a hole in its tail that allows i.pt-br:
O buraco em sua cauda permite que absorva
o ar necessário para manter seu fogo aceso.
Se o buraco for tampado, este Pokémon ficará doente.

These Pokémon judge one another based on.en: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.
These Pokémon judge one another based on.zh-tw: 這些神奇寶貝通過鉗子來判斷彼此。更厚、更令人印象深刻的鉗子更受異性歡迎。
These Pokémon judge one another based on.fr:
Ses cornes déterminent son rang au sein
du groupe. Plus elles sont imposantes, plus
les membres du sexe opposé l'apprécient.
These Pokémon judge one another based on.es:
Los Pinsir se juzgan entre ellos por la robustez
de la cornamenta. Cuanto más imponente sea,
más agradará a sus congéneres del sexo opuesto.
These Pokémon judge one another based on.it:
I Pinsir si giudicano a vicenda in base alle corna.
Quelli con corna grosse e imponenti hanno
più successo con gli esemplari dell'altro sesso.
These Pokémon judge one another based on.de:
Der Status eines Pinsirs hängt von seinen Hörnern
ab. Je dicker und stattlicher diese sind, desto
beliebter ist es beim anderen Geschlecht.
These Pokémon judge one another based on.pt-br:
Estes Pokémon se julgam de acordo com
suas pinças. As pinças mais grossas e notáveis
são mais populares com o gênero oposto.

They coil around foes and shock them wit.en: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
They coil around foes and shock them wit.zh-tw: 它們盤旋在敵人周圍，用看似簡單的圓形圖案的發電器官對他們進行電擊。
They coil around foes and shock them wit.fr:
Ses taches rondes sont des organes qui émettent de l'électricité.
Il s'enroule autour de ses proies et les électrocute.
They coil around foes and shock them wit.es:
Las motas redondas componen su
aparato electrificador. Enrolla a su rival
y deja que la corriente fluya por ellas.
They coil around foes and shock them wit.it:
I motivi circolari sono organi generatori di
corrente. Si avvolge al nemico premendoglieli
addosso per poi rilasciare una scarica elettrica.
They coil around foes and shock them wit.de:
Die runden Flecken sind Organe, die Strom
erzeugen. Es schlingt sich um seinen Gegner,
presst sie gegen ihn und aktiviert sie.
They coil around foes and shock them wit.pt-br:
Eles se enrolam nos adversários e disparam choques
com órgãos geradores de eletricidade que parecem
simplesmente ser padrões circulares.

They crawl out of the ocean using their.en: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
They crawl out of the ocean using their.zh-tw: 他們用手臂從海裡爬出來。它們會攻擊岸上的獵物，然後立即將其拖入大海。
They crawl out of the ocean using their.fr:
Il peut sortir de l'eau à la force de ses bras
pour attaquer des proies sur la rive et les
entraîner avec lui dans l'eau en un instant.
They crawl out of the ocean using their.es:
Sale del mar con la fuerza de sus brazos y ataca a sus
presas en la costa. Luego se las lleva de vuelta al mar.
They crawl out of the ocean using their.it:
Striscia fuori dal mare con la sola forza
dei propri arti. Poi attacca la preda a riva
e con un guizzo la trascina con sé in acqua.
They crawl out of the ocean using their.de:
Es kriecht mithilfe seiner Arme an Land,
stürzt sich auf seine Beute und zerrt sie
augenblicklich ins Meer.
They crawl out of the ocean using their.pt-br:
Rastejam para fora do oceano usando seus braços.
Eles atacam as presas na costa e as arrastam
imediatamente para a água.

They say that if it emits an aura from i.en: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
They say that if it emits an aura from i.zh-tw: 據說，如果它全身散發出氣息，天氣就會瞬間開始變化。
They say that if it emits an aura from i.fr:
On dit que lorsque tout son corps émet une aura,
les conditions climatiques se mettent à changer à vue d'œil.
They say that if it emits an aura from i.es:
Dicen que, cuando su cuerpo desprende un aura,
el tiempo empieza a cambiar inmediatamente.
They say that if it emits an aura from i.it:
Dicono che quando il suo corpo emana
un'aura, il tempo cambierà immediatamente.
They say that if it emits an aura from i.de:
Man sagt, wenn sein ganzer Körper eine
Aura ausstrahle, ändere sich augenblicklich
das Wetter in seiner Umgebung.
They say that if it emits an aura from i.pt-br:
Dizem que, se o seu corpo inteiro emitir uma aura,
o clima começará a mudar instantaneamente.

They were sculpted from clay in ancient.en: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
They were sculpted from clay in ancient.zh-tw: 它們在古代是用粘土雕刻而成的。沒有人知道為什麼，但其中一些人被迫不斷地排列巨石。
They were sculpted from clay in ancient.fr:
Ce Pokémon très ancien a été façonné avec
de l'argile. On ne sait pourquoi certains spécimens
n'ont de cesse d'aligner de grosses pierres.
They were sculpted from clay in ancient.es:
Un antiguo Pokémon creado a partir del barro.
Se desconoce el motivo por el que algunos
ejemplares colocan rocas grandes en hileras.
They were sculpted from clay in ancient.it:
È un Pokémon antico creato dall'argilla.
Non si sa perché, ma ad alcuni esemplari
piace creare file interminabili di grandi rocce.
They were sculpted from clay in ancient.de:
Sie bestehen aus Lehm und existieren schon sehr
lange. Einige von ihnen haben den unerklärlichen
Drang, große Felsen aneinanderzureihen.
They were sculpted from clay in ancient.pt-br:
Antigamente, eram esculpidos de argila.
Ninguém sabe a razão, mas alguns deles
são determinados a alinhar rochas sem parar.

This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.en: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.zh-tw: 這個神奇的神奇寶貝具有令人敬畏的平衡感。它可以從任何位置連續踢球。
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.fr:
Il possède un fantastique sens de l'équilibre, et peut donner
des rafales de coups de pied dans toutes les positions.
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.es:
Este Pokémon tiene un sentido del equilibrio
increíble. Puede dar patadas desde cualquier posición.
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.it:
Questo straordinario Pokémon ha
un grande equilibrio. Può tirare
raffiche di calci da qualsiasi posizione.
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.de:
Dieses Pokémon besitzt einen formidablen
Gleichgewichtssinn. Es kann in jeder Position
pausenlos zutreten.
This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sens.pt-br:
Este incrível Pokémon possui um ótimo equilíbrio.
Consegue chutar repetidamente de qualquer posição.

This attack also does 10 damage to each.en: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
This attack also does 10 damage to each.zh-tw: 這次攻擊還會對對手的後備神奇寶貝各造成 10 點傷害。
This attack also does 10 damage to each.fr: Cette attaque inflige également 10 dégâts à chacun des Pokémon de Banc de votre adversaire.
This attack also does 10 damage to each.es: Este ataque también hace 10 puntos de daño a cada uno de los Pokémon en Banca de tu rival.
This attack also does 10 damage to each.it: Questo attacco infligge anche 10 danni a ciascuno dei Pokémon nella panchina del tuo avversario.
This attack also does 10 damage to each.de: Dieser Angriff fügt außerdem jedem Pokémon auf der Bank deines Gegners 10 Schadenspunkte zu.
This attack also does 10 damage to each.pt-br: Este ataque também causa 10 pontos de dano a cada um dos Pokémon no Banco do seu oponente.

This attack does 20 more damage for each.en: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
This attack does 20 more damage for each.zh-tw: 對手的戰鬥寶可夢身上每附加一個能量，此攻擊就會造成 20 點額外傷害。
This attack does 20 more damage for each.fr: Cette attaque inflige 20 dégâts supplémentaires pour chaque Énergie attachée au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire.
This attack does 20 more damage for each.es: Este ataque hace 20 puntos de daño más por cada Energía unida al Pokémon Activo de tu rival.
This attack does 20 more damage for each.it: Questo attacco infligge 20 danni in più per ogni Energia assegnata al Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario.
This attack does 20 more damage for each.de: Dieser Angriff fügt 20 weitere Schadenspunkte für jede Energie zu, die an das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners angelegt ist.
This attack does 20 more damage for each.pt-br: Este ataque causa 20 pontos de dano a mais para cada Energia ligada ao Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente.

This attack does 30 damage for each of y.en: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched {L} Pokémon.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.zh-tw: 此攻擊對你的每個後備 {L} 神奇寶貝造成 30 點傷害。
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.es: Este ataque hace 30 daños por cada uno de tus Pokémon {L} en Banca.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.fr: Cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts pour chacun de vos Pokémon de Banc {L}.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.de: Dieser Angriff fügt jedem {L}-Pokémon auf deiner Bank 30 Schadenspunkte zu.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.pt-br: Este ataque causa 30 pontos de dano para cada um dos seus Pokémon {L} no Banco.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.it: Questo attacco infligge 30 danni per ciascuno dei tuoi Pokémon {L} in panchina.

This attack does 30 damage for each of y.en: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.zh-tw: 這次攻擊對你的每隻後備神奇寶貝造成 30 點傷害。
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.fr: Cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts pour chacun de vos Pokémon de Banc.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.es: Este ataque hace 30 puntos de daño por cada uno de tus Pokémon en Banca.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.it: Questo attacco infligge 30 danni per ogni Pokémon nella tua panchina.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.de: Diese Attacke fügt für jedes Pokémon auf deiner Bank 30 Schadenspunkte zu.
This attack does 30 damage for each of y.pt-br: Este ataque causa 30 pontos de dano para cada um dos seus Pokémon no Banco.

This attack does 50 more damage for each.en: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your Benched Nidoking.
This attack does 50 more damage for each.zh-tw: 此攻擊對你的每個後備尼多王造成 50 點額外傷害。
This attack does 50 more damage for each.es: Este ataque hace 50 daños más por cada uno de tus Nidoking en banca.
This attack does 50 more damage for each.de: Dieser Angriff verursacht 50 weitere Schadenspunkte für jeden deiner Nidokings auf der Bank.
This attack does 50 more damage for each.fr: Cette attaque inflige 50 dégâts supplémentaires pour chacun de vos Nidoking de banc.
This attack does 50 more damage for each.it: Questo attacco infligge 50 danni in più per ciascuno dei tuoi Nidoking in panchina.
This attack does 50 more damage for each.pt-br: Este ataque causa 50 de dano a mais para cada um dos seus Nidoking no Banco.

This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.en: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.zh-tw: 這是自古以來兇猛的寶可夢。顯然，即使是現代技術也無法生產出完美修復的標本。
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.fr:
On raconte qu'aujourd'hui encore, il est impossible de restaurer
à la perfection ce Pokémon féroce de l'ère préhistorique.
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.es:
Un feroz Pokémon de la época prehistórica al
que no bastan todos los avances tecnológicos
actuales para regenerar a la perfección.
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.it:
È un feroce Pokémon dell'antichità.
Pare che con la tecnologia odierna non
sia possibile rigenerarlo perfettamente.
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.de:
Selbst mit moderner Technologie scheint es
unmöglich, ein perfektes Exemplar von diesem
wilden urzeitlichen Pokémon zu reproduzieren.
This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient.pt-br:
Um Pokémon feroz de tempos antigos.
Pelo visto, nem a tecnologia moderna conseguiu
produzir um espécime restaurado com perfeição.

This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.en: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.zh-tw: 這種善良的神奇寶貝會產下營養豐富的蛋，並與受傷的神奇寶貝或人類分享。
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.fr:
Ce Pokémon très serviable distribue ses œufs hautement
nutritifs aux êtres humains et aux Pokémon blessés.
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.es:
Un generoso Pokémon que pone huevos muy
nutritivos y se los da a personas o Pokémon heridos.
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.it:
Un Pokémon altruista che depone
uova molto nutrienti e le condivide
con persone o Pokémon feriti.
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.de:
Ein freundliches Pokémon, das nahrhafte Eier
legt, um diese mit verletzten Pokémon und
Menschen zu teilen.
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritio.pt-br:
Este Pokémon gentil bota ovos bastante nutritivos
e os compartilha com pessoas ou Pokémon feridos.

This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itse.en: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itse.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝也會對自身造成 50 點傷害。
This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itse.es: Este Pokémon también se hace 50 daños a sí mismo.
This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itse.it: Questo Pokémon infligge anche 50 danni a se stesso.
This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itse.pt-br: Este Pokémon também causa 50 de dano a si mesmo.
This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itse.de: Dieses Pokémon fügt sich selbst außerdem 50 Schadenspunkte zu.

This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.en: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝以高達 150 英里/小時的速度在田野中奔跑，火熱的鬃毛在風中飄揚。
This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.fr:
Ce Pokémon traverse les plaines à plus de 240 km/h,
sa crinière flamboyante flottant au vent.
This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.es:
Su ardiente crin ondea al viento mientras atraviesa
extensas praderas a una velocidad de 240 km/h.
This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.it:
Sfreccia nelle praterie a una velocità di 240 km/h,
facendo sventolare la sua criniera ardente.
This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.de:
Die lodernde Mähne dieses Pokémon flattert im
Wind, wenn es mit einer Geschwindigkeit von
240 km/h über Felder und Wiesen galoppiert.
This Pokémon can be seen galloping throu.pt-br:
Este Pokémon pode ser encontrado galopando
nas pradarias, com sua crina de fogo ao vento,
a velocidades de até 240 km/h.

This Pokémon commands a group of several.en: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.
This Pokémon commands a group of several.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝指揮著一群由數名典當者組成的隊伍。在領土爭端中失敗的群體會被獲勝方吸收。
This Pokémon commands a group of several.fr:
Il dirige des cohortes de Scalpion. Les groupes qui sont vaincus
lors de guerres de territoires rejoignent les vainqueurs.
This Pokémon commands a group of several.es:
Dirige a varios Pawniard para conformar
grupos. Tras una disputa territorial, el
grupo victorioso incorpora a los vencidos.
This Pokémon commands a group of several.it:
Comanda dei gruppi di Pawniard. I gruppi
che risultano perdenti nelle lotte per il
territorio vengono assorbiti dai vincitori.
This Pokémon commands a group of several.de:
Es dient als Anführer einer Schar Gladiantri.
Nach Revierkämpfen werden die Verlierer in
die Gewinnerschar assimiliert.
This Pokémon commands a group of several.pt-br:
Este Pokémon lidera um grupo de Pawniard.
Os grupos que são derrotados em disputas
territoriais são incorporados ao lado vencedor.

This Pokémon generates electricity when.en: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.
This Pokémon generates electricity when.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝在消化食物時會產生電力。它用五顆堅硬的牙齒刮掉表面的海藻並吃掉它。
This Pokémon generates electricity when.fr:
Il génère de l'électricité lorsqu'il digère.
À l'aide de ses cinq dents très solides,
il racle les algues des rochers puis les mange.
This Pokémon generates electricity when.es:
Produce electricidad al digerir los alimentos.
Raspa las algas de las rocas con los cinco
duros dientes que tiene para comérselas.
This Pokémon generates electricity when.it:
Mentre digerisce il cibo, genera elettricità.
Usa i cinque durissimi denti per raschiare
via dalle cose le alghe di cui si nutre.
This Pokémon generates electricity when.de:
Bei der Verdauung erzeugt es Elektrizität.
Mit seinen fünf harten Zähnen schabt es
Algen von Oberflächen ab und frisst sie.
This Pokémon generates electricity when.pt-br:
Este Pokémon gera eletricidade ao digerir comida.
Usa seus cinco dentes rígidos para raspar alga
marinha de superfícies e se alimentar.

This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.en: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.
This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝有一個被稱為核心的器官。當海星釋放其強大的心靈力量時，該器官會發出七種顏色的光。
This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.fr:
S'il déchaîne son pouvoir psychique puissant,
son organe appelé " cœur " se met à briller
de sept couleurs.
This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.es:
Su órgano central, conocido como núcleo, brilla
con los colores del arcoíris cuando se dispone
a liberar sus potentes poderes psíquicos.
This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.it:
Quando scatena i suoi poteri psichici, l'organo
centrale, detto nucleo, brilla di sette colori diversi.
This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.de:
Das als Kern bezeichnete Organ dieses Pokémon
erstrahlt in den sieben Farben des Regenbogens,
wenn Starmie mächtige Psycho-Kräfte entfesselt.
This Pokémon has an organ known as its c.pt-br:
Este Pokémon tem um órgão que é conhecido como
seu núcleo. Este órgão brilha em sete cores diferentes
quando Starmie libera seus poderes psíquicos intensos.

This Pokémon has complete control over e.en: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.
This Pokémon has complete control over e.zh-tw: 該寶可夢完全掌控電力。有關於閃電鳥在漆黑的雷雲深處築巢的傳說。
This Pokémon has complete control over e.fr:
On dit que ce Pokémon capable de contrôler la foudre
installe son nid au creux des nuages d'orage noirs.
This Pokémon has complete control over e.es:
Posee el poder de controlar la electricidad
a su antojo. Según la creencia popular, anida
oculto en oscuros nubarrones de tormenta.
This Pokémon has complete control over e.it:
È in grado di controllare l'elettricità a
suo piacimento. Secondo le leggende,
fa il nido fra nere nubi temporalesche.
This Pokémon has complete control over e.de:
Zapdos kann Elektrizität manipulieren.
Überlieferungen nach soll sein Nest inmitten
pechschwarzer Gewitterwolken liegen.
This Pokémon has complete control over e.pt-br:
Este Pokémon tem controle absoluto da eletricidade.
Certas lendas afirmam que Zapdos faz seu ninho nas
profundezas escuras de nuvens de tempestades.

This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.en: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝克服了悲傷，進化出堅固的新身體。馬羅瓦克以骨頭為武器，勇敢地面對對手。
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.fr:
Il s'est endurci et a évolué depuis qu'il a réussi
à surmonter sa peine. Il utilise son os en guise
d'arme et affronte ses ennemis avec bravoure.
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.es:
Ha evolucionado tras fortalecerse y
superar su pena. Ahora lucha con arrojo
blandiendo su hueso a modo de arma.
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.it:
Si è evoluto dopo essersi temprato e aver
superato il lutto. Usa l'osso come un'arma
e lotta valorosamente contro i nemici.
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.de:
Als es seine Trauer überwand, entwickelte es sich
und wurde stärker. Mit seinem Knochen als Waffe
stellt sich Knogga mutig seinen Feinden.
This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evol.pt-br:
Lidou com sua tristeza para evoluir um
corpo novo e forte. Enfrenta seus oponentes
com bravura, empunhando um osso como arma.

This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.en: This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attacks.
This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝受到的攻擊傷害為 -10。
This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.fr: Ce Pokémon subit − 10 dégâts provenant des attaques.
This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.es: Los ataques hacen -10 puntos de daño a este Pokémon.
This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.it: Questo Pokémon subisce -10 danni dagli attacchi.
This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.de: Diesem Pokémon werden durch Attacken − 10 Schadenspunkte zugefügt.
This Pokémon takes -10 damage from attac.pt-br: Este Pokémon recebe −10 pontos de dano de ataques.

This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.en: This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attacks.
This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝受到的攻擊傷害為 -20。
This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.fr: Ce Pokémon subit − 20 dégâts provenant des attaques.
This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.es: Los ataques hacen -20 puntos de daño a este Pokémon.
This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.it: Questo Pokémon subisce -20 danni dagli attacchi.
This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.de: Diesem Pokémon werden durch Attacken − 20 Schadenspunkte zugefügt.
This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attac.pt-br: Este Pokémon recebe −20 pontos de dano de ataques.

This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.en: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝在睡覺時會使用其心靈力量。阿布拉的夢的內容會影響神奇寶貝所使用的力量。
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.fr:
Le contenu de ses rêves influe sur les pouvoirs
psychiques qu'il utilise dans son sommeil.
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.es:
Es capaz de usar sus poderes psíquicos aun
estando dormido. Al parecer, el contenido
del sueño influye en sus facultades.
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.it:
Il contenuto dei suoi sogni influisce sui suoi poteri
psichici, che può utilizzare anche mentre dorme.
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.de:
Es setzt seine Psycho-Kräfte selbst im
Schlaf ein. Der Inhalt seiner Träume hat
Einfluss auf die Kräfte, die es verwendet.
This Pokémon uses its psychic powers whi.pt-br:
Usa seus poderes psíquicos enquanto dorme.
O conteúdo dos sonhos de Abra afeta os
poderes que este Pokémon possui.

This species is almost entirely extinct..en: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.
This species is almost entirely extinct..zh-tw: 這個物種幾乎完全滅絕了。 Kabuto 每三天蛻皮一次，使它們的外殼變得越來越硬。
This species is almost entirely extinct..fr:
Ce Pokémon au bord de l'extinction mue tous les trois jours
et renforce ainsi davantage sa carapace.
This species is almost entirely extinct..es:
Un Pokémon casi extinto. Cada tres
días, muda el caparazón, que se va
endureciendo de forma progresiva.
This species is almost entirely extinct..it:
È un Pokémon sull'orlo dell'estinzione. Fa la muta
ogni tre giorni indurendo gradualmente il carapace.
This species is almost entirely extinct..de:
Dieses Pokémon ist so gut wie ausgestorben.
Sein Panzer wird immer härter, indem es sich
alle drei Tage häutet.
This species is almost entirely extinct..pt-br:
Esta espécie está quase extinta. Kabuto
mudam seus cascos a cada três dias,
tornando-os cada vez mais rígidos.

Though it may look like it's just a bunc.en: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
Though it may look like it's just a bunc.zh-tw: 雖然它看起來只是一堆雞蛋，但它是一隻真正的神奇寶貝。顯然，Exeggcute 是通過心靈感應與其他同類進行交流的。
Though it may look like it's just a bunc.fr:
Même s'il ressemble à un tas d'œufs,
il s'agit bien d'un Pokémon. Il paraît qu'ils
communiquent entre eux par télépathie.
Though it may look like it's just a bunc.es:
Pese a su aspecto de mera piña de huevos,
se trata de un Pokémon. Al parecer, sus
cabezas se comunican entre sí por telepatía.
Though it may look like it's just a bunc.it:
Somiglia a un mucchio di uova, ma è
un Pokémon a tutti gli effetti. Pare che
comunichi con i suoi simili telepaticamente.
Though it may look like it's just a bunc.de:
Owei mag zwar Eiern ähneln, ist aber ein echtes
Pokémon, das aus sechs Individuen besteht, die
wohl telepathisch miteinander kommunizieren.
Though it may look like it's just a bunc.pt-br:
Apesar de parecer só um monte de ovos, é um Pokémon
de verdade. Exeggcute se comunica com outros de sua
espécie por meio de telepatia.

Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.en: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.zh-tw: 三個磁鐵礦通過強大的磁力連接在一起。如果距離太近，就會出現耳痛。
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.fr:
Le lien magnétique qui rattache ces trois Magnéti est si puissant
qu'il fait mal aux oreilles si on s'en approche trop.
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.es:
Tres Magnemite se enlazan mediante una
intensa fuerza magnética. Provoca un fuerte
pitido en los oídos a quien se le acerque.
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.it:
Tre Magnemite sono uniti da una
potente forza magnetica. Se ci si
avvicina troppo, le orecchie fischiano.
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.de:
Drei Magnetilo sind durch ein starkes
Magnetfeld verbunden. In seiner Nähe
bekommt man Ohrensausen.
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong m.pt-br:
Três Magnemite estão vinculados por uma força
magnética muito poderosa. Se você chegar
muito perto, ficará com dor de ouvido.

To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.en: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.zh-tw: 為了保護它的訓練家，它會消耗所有的精神力來創造一個小黑洞。
To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.fr:
Prêt à tout pour protéger son Dresseur,
il peut aller jusqu'à épuiser sa force
mentale pour créer un mini trou noir.
To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.es:
Para proteger a su Entrenador,
emplea todo su poder psíquico en
crear un pequeño agujero negro.
To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.it:
Per proteggere l'Allenatrice o l'Allenatore
dal pericolo, utilizza tutti i poteri psichici di
cui dispone per creare un piccolo buco nero.
To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.de:
Wenn es seinen Trainer schützen will, nimmt es all
seine Psycho-Kräfte zusammen, um so ein kleines
schwarzes Loch zu erzeugen.
To protect its Trainer, it will expend a.pt-br:
Para proteger seu Treinador, gasta todo seu poder
psíquico para criar um pequeno buraco negro.

To steal the life of its target, it slip.en: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.
To steal the life of its target, it slip.zh-tw: 為了竊取目標的生命，它會潛入獵物的陰影中，靜靜地等待機會。
To steal the life of its target, it slip.fr:
Il se cache dans l'ombre de sa victime et attend
patiemment le bon moment pour lui voler sa vie.
To steal the life of its target, it slip.es:
Para quitarle la vida a su presa, se desliza en su
sombra y espera su oportunidad en silencio.
To steal the life of its target, it slip.it:
Per sottrarre energia alla vittima si
nasconde nella sua ombra e attende
in silenzio il momento opportuno.
To steal the life of its target, it slip.de:
Um Beute zu erlegen, versteckt es sich
in deren Schatten und wartet still auf
eine günstige Gelegenheit.
To steal the life of its target, it slip.pt-br:
Este Pokémon aguarda pela oportunidade
perfeita para se esconder na sombra de sua
presa e roubar a vida dela.

Until recently, people living in the mou.en: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.
Until recently, people living in the mou.zh-tw: 直到最近，生活在山里的人們都會騎在這些神奇寶貝的背上穿越山路。
Until recently, people living in the mou.fr:
Il y a encore peu, les personnes vivant dans
les zones montagneuses se déplaçaient à dos
de Cabriolaine.
Until recently, people living in the mou.es:
Hasta hace bien poco, los habitantes
de las montañas se desplazaban por sus
senderos a lomos de este Pokémon.
Until recently, people living in the mou.it:
Fino a poco tempo fa, la gente di montagna era solita
percorrere i sentieri montani in groppa a degli Skiddo.
Until recently, people living in the mou.de:
Bis vor Kurzem ritten die in den Bergen lebenden
Menschen auf dem Rücken dieses Pokémon, um
sich auf den Bergpfaden fortzubewegen.
Until recently, people living in the mou.pt-br:
Até pouco tempo, as pessoas vivendo em montanhas
montavam nas costas deste Pokémon para atravessá-las.

Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.en: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.zh-tw: 卡達布拉利用其精神力量在睡眠時懸浮。它用有彈性的尾巴作為枕頭。
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.fr:
Ses pouvoirs psychiques lui permettent de léviter en dormant.
Il utilise alors sa queue très souple comme un oreiller.
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.es:
Duerme suspendido en el aire gracias a sus
poderes psíquicos. La cola, de una flexibilidad
extraordinaria, hace las veces de almohada.
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.it:
I suoi poteri psichici gli permettono di
levitare mentre dorme. Come cuscino usa
la sua coda straordinariamente elastica.
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.de:
Kadabras Psycho-Kräfte ermöglichen es ihm,
schwebend zu schlafen. Seinen äußerst
elastischen Schweif nutzt es dabei als Kissen.
Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitat.pt-br:
Usando seu poder psíquico, Kadabra levita
enquanto dorme. Usa sua cauda elástica
como um travesseiro.

Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.en: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.zh-tw: 用有彈性的羊毛編織地毯，最終會得到更接近蹦床的東西。當你踏上它的那一刻，你就會開始彈跳。
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.fr:
La texture de sa laine est si élastique que
la surface des tapis fabriqués avec ce matériau
est aussi rebondissante que celle d'un trampoline.
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.es:
Su lana es muy flexible. Las alfombras tejidas con ella
adoptan una textura similar a la de las camas elásticas.
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.it:
I tappeti realizzati con i suoi peli sono
talmente elastici che saltandoci sopra
si rimbalza come su un trampolino.
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.de:
Spannt man einen aus den elastischen Haaren
von Zwollock gewobenen Teppich auf, kann man
darauf hüpfen wie auf einem Trampolin.
Weave a carpet from its springy wool, an.pt-br:
Tece um tapete feito de sua lã elástica, e o resultado
é algo semelhante a um trampolim. Você começará
a pular assim que pisar nele.

Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.en: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn't move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.zh-tw: 由於受到又大又重的砲彈的壓迫，奧馬斯塔無法快速移動。有人說它滅絕是因為它無法捕捉食物。
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.fr:
Il se serait éteint à cause de la taille et du poids
importants de sa coquille, qui le ralentissait
quand il chassait ses proies.
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.es:
Se cree que se extinguió porque el excesivo
tamaño y peso de su concha le impedían
moverse con rapidez para capturar presas.
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.it:
Si dice si sia estinto per via della conchiglia
grossa e pesante che, rendendo i suoi movimenti
impacciati, gli impediva di catturare le prede.
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.de:
Es starb wohl aus, weil seine Bewegungen durch
das große, schwere Gehäuse so langsam wurden,
dass es keine Beute mehr fangen konnte.
Weighed down by a large and heavy shell,.pt-br:
Por conta de seu grande casco, Omastar é
pesado e não se move rápido. Dizem que entrou
em extinção porque era incapaz de conseguir comida.

When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.en: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.zh-tw: 當呆呆獸在海裡狩獵時，它的尾巴被剝殼者咬住了。這使得它演變成 Slowbro。
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.fr:
Un jour, alors qu'un Ramoloss pêchait, un Kokiyas
s'est accroché à sa queue et l'a fait évoluer en Flagadoss.
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.es:
Según parece, cuando Slowpoke fue
a pescar al mar, un Shellder le mordió
la cola y así evolucionó a Slowbro.
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.it:
Uno Slowpoke che si trovava in
mare in cerca di cibo fu morso da
uno Shellder, evolvendosi in Slowbro.
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.de:
Als Flegmon im Meer jagen ging,
biss ein Muschas in seine Rute.
Dadurch entwickelte es sich zu Lahmus.
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea,.pt-br:
Quando um Slowpoke foi caçar no mar, sua cauda
foi mordida por um Shellder. Isso fez com que evoluísse
para um Slowbro.

When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.en: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.zh-tw: 當受到攻擊時，它會用羽毛濺起水花，在水花的掩護下逃脫。
When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.fr:
Quand on l'attaque, il s'ébroue et fait jaillir de la vapeur d'eau
de tout son corps. Il se cache dedans pour s'enfuir.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.es:
Cuando se ve atacado, las plumas que lo recubren
despiden ráfagas de agua que lo ayudan a escapar.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.it:
Quando viene attaccato schizza acqua
da tutte le piume del corpo. Fugge
dileguandosi in una nuvola di spruzzi.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.de:
Gerät es in Gefahr, versprüht es Wasser aus
seinem Federkleid und nutzt den Sprühregen,
um Reißaus zu nehmen.
When attacked, it uses its feathers to s.pt-br:
Quando atacado, usa as penas para
espirrar água e foge protegido pelo spray.

When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.en: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.zh-tw: 當魔像變老時，它們就會停止脫落外殼。那些活了很久很久的，貝殼上長滿了青苔。
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.fr:
Lorsqu'il arrive à un âge avancé, il arrête de muer.
Un Grolem ayant vécu très longtemps est recouvert
de mousse verte.
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.es:
A medida que envejece, pierde la facultad de
mudar la piel. Se han observado ejemplares de
edad avanzada totalmente cubiertos de musgo.
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.it:
Quando invecchia, non fa più la muta.
Il guscio dei Golem molto anziani si
ricopre di muschio tingendosi di verde.
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.de:
Im Alter hört es auf, sich zu häuten.
Der Panzer betagter Geowaz ist mit
dichtem, grünem Moos bewachsen.
When Golem grow old, they stop shedding.pt-br:
Ao envelhecer, Golem param de mudar de
carapaça. Os que viveram muitos e muitos
anos têm carapaças cobertas de musgo verde.

When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.en: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.zh-tw: 捕獵時，它會高速掠過水面，捕捉鯉魚等粗心的獵物。
When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.fr:
Il survole la surface de l'eau pour repérer
une proie et plonge en piqué pour l'attraper.
When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.es:
Cuando caza, vuela muy deprisa a ras del agua
y sorprende a inocentes presas como Magikarp.
When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.it:
Quando caccia, vola velocissimo sul pelo dell'acqua
e cattura ignare prede come Magikarp.
When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.de:
Dieses Pokémon schnellt bei der Jagd blitzschnell
unter Wasser, um seine ahnungslose Beute zu fangen.
When hunting, it skims the surface of wa.pt-br:
Quando caça, bate na superfície da água em
alta velocidade para capturar presas desavisadas,
como Magikarp.

When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.en: When it goes on a rampage, it's impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it's lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.zh-tw: 一旦爆發，就無法控制。但在與它生活了很長時間的尼多女王面前，尼多金平靜了下來。
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.fr:
Lorsqu'il s'énerve, il devient incontrôlable, mais il retrouve
son calme face à Nidoqueen, sa compagne de longue date.
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.es:
Una vez que se desboca, no hay quien lo pare. Solo se
calma ante Nidoqueen, su compañera de toda la vida.
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.it:
Quando si scatena non c'è modo di
fermarlo, ma davanti a Nidoqueen, la sua
compagna di lunga data, ritrova la calma.
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.de:
Gerät es in Rage, ist es nur schwer aufzuhalten.
Doch vor einem Nidoqueen, mit dem es schon
viele Jahre verbracht hat, zeigt es sich friedlich.
When it goes on a rampage, it's impossib.pt-br:
É impossível controlar Nidoking quando fica
enfurecido. Porém, a presença de uma Nidoqueen
com quem viveu por muito tempo o acalmará.
