When it heats up, its body temperature r.en: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
When it heats up, its body temperature r.zh-tw: 當它升溫時，它的體溫達到約 1,500 華氏度。它像鞭子一樣抽打身體並向敵人發起攻擊。
When it heats up, its body temperature r.fr:
Quand il génère de la chaleur, sa température
est d'environ 800 °C. Il se sert de son corps
comme d'un fouet pour sauter sur ses ennemis.
When it heats up, its body temperature r.es:
Cuando genera calor, su temperatura corporal
alcanza aproximadamente los 800 °C. Usa el
cuerpo a modo de látigo para lanzarse al ataque.
When it heats up, its body temperature r.it:
Quando genera calore, la temperatura del
suo corpo raggiunge gli 800 ºC. Si lancia
all'attacco usando il corpo come una frusta.
When it heats up, its body temperature r.de:
Wenn es Hitze erzeugt, beträgt seine Temperatur
etwa 800 °C. Es bewegt seinen Körper wie eine
Peitsche, um dann den Gegner anzuspringen.
When it heats up, its body temperature r.pt-br:
Ao se aquecer, seu corpo atinge temperaturas de
cerca de 800 ºC. Usa seu corpo como um chicote,
lançando-se contra seus inimigos.

When it is angered, it immediately disch.en: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
When it is angered, it immediately disch.zh-tw: 當它被激怒時，它會立即釋放臉頰眼袋中儲存的能量。
When it is angered, it immediately disch.fr:
Quand il s'énerve, il libère instantanément
l'énergie emmagasinée dans les poches de
ses joues.
When it is angered, it immediately disch.es:
Cuando se enfada, este Pokémon
descarga la energía que almacena en
el interior de las bolsas de las mejillas.
When it is angered, it immediately disch.it:
Quando s'arrabbia, libera subito l'energia
accumulata nelle sacche sulle guance.
When it is angered, it immediately disch.de:
Ist es wütend, entlädt sich augenblicklich die
Elektrizität, die es in seinen Backentaschen
gespeichert hat.
When it is angered, it immediately disch.pt-br:
Quando está com raiva, descarrega
imediatamente a energia armazenada
nas bolsas em suas bochechas.

When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.en: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.zh-tw: 當它鎖定敵人時，它會使用多種 psi 動作，例如催眠和混亂。
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.fr:
Lorsqu'il croise le regard de son adversaire, il utilise
de nombreux pouvoirs surnaturels comme l'hypnose.
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.es:
Cuando mira al enemigo, usa diversos
poderes psíquicos como la hipnosis.
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.it:
Quando cattura lo sguardo del
nemico, usa una varietà di poteri
psichici come, ad esempio, l'ipnosi.
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.de:
Es heißt, wenn dieses Pokémon einem Gegner
ins Auge blicke, setze es zahlreiche Psycho-Kräfte
wie beispielsweise Hypnose ein.
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it wil.pt-br:
Quando encara um inimigo, usa uma mistura de
movimentos psíquicos, como Hipnose e Confusão.

When it retracts its long neck into its.en: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.
When it retracts its long neck into its.zh-tw: 當它把長長的脖子縮進殼裡時，就會用力噴出水。
When it retracts its long neck into its.fr:
Quand il rentre son cou dans sa carapace,
il peut projeter de l'eau à haute pression.
When it retracts its long neck into its.es:
Cuando retrae su largo cuello en el caparazón,
dispara agua a una presión increíble.
When it retracts its long neck into its.it:
Quando ritrae il lungo collo dentro la
corazza sputa un vigoroso getto d'acqua.
When it retracts its long neck into its.de:
Zieht es seinen langen Hals in seinen Panzer
zurück, verspritzt es Wasser mit unbändiger Kraft.
When it retracts its long neck into its.pt-br:
Ao retrair o pescoço longo para dentro
do seu casco, lança um jato de água
muito poderoso.

When it swims at full speed using its lo.en: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
When it swims at full speed using its lo.zh-tw: 當它用長長的帶蹼的四肢全速游泳時，它的前額不知何故開始發光。
When it swims at full speed using its lo.fr:
Quand il nage à vitesse maximale grâce à
ses pattes palmées, son front se met à luire
pour une raison inconnue.
When it swims at full speed using its lo.es:
Cuando nada a toda velocidad usando sus largas
extremidades palmeadas, su frente comienza a brillar.
When it swims at full speed using its lo.it:
Quando nuota a tutta velocità con i suoi
lunghi arti palmati, la fronte gli si illumina.
When it swims at full speed using its lo.de:
Wenn es mit den Schwimmflossen an seinen
langen Gliedmaßen schnell durchs Wasser
schwimmt, beginnt seine Stirn zu glühen.
When it swims at full speed using its lo.pt-br:
Quando nada o mais rápido possível usando suas
longas membranas, a testa deste Pokémon
de alguma forma começa a brilhar.

When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.en: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.zh-tw: 當它巨大的眼睛晃動時，它會唱出神秘舒緩的旋律，讓敵人入睡。
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.fr:
Quand ses grands yeux luisent, il chante
une berceuse mystérieuse et agréable
qui pousse ses ennemis à s'endormir.
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.es:
Cuando le tiemblan sus redondos y adorables
ojos, entona una melodía agradable y misteriosa
con la que duerme a sus enemigos.
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.it:
Quando i suoi occhioni rotondi tremolano, canta
una misteriosa melodia che fa addormentare.
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.de:
Wenn seine Kulleraugen zu flackern beginnen,
singt es ein mysteriöses, wohlklingendes Lied,
das Zuhörer in Schlaf versetzt.
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mys.pt-br:
Quando seus enormes olhos ficam pesados,
canta uma melodia misteriosa e relaxante,
fazendo com que os inimigos adormeçam.

When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.en: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.
When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.zh-tw: 當面哨遇到真正有挑戰性的對手時，它會咬掉手臂上的毛來減輕自己的重量。
When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.fr:
Lorsqu'il fait face à un adversaire vraiment redoutable, il coupe
les poils de ses mains avec les dents pour améliorer son agilité.
When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.es:
Cuando se encuentra frente a un oponente
de categoría, se arranca parte del pelaje de
los brazos a mordiscos para ganar agilidad.
When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.it:
Se incontra un nemico veramente forte,
si strappa a morsi i peli degli arti per
alleggerirsi e guadagnare in agilità.
When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.de:
Begegnet es einem wahrhaft starken Gegner,
beißt es das Fell an seinen Armen ab, um an
Beweglichkeit zu gewinnen.
When Mienshao comes across a truly chall.pt-br:
Quando Mienshao se depara com um oponente
realmente desafiante, torna-se mais leve ao
arrancar o pelo de seus braços com a boca.

When spread, the frills on its head act.en: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.
When spread, the frills on its head act.zh-tw: 當展開時，它頭上的褶邊就像太陽能電池板一樣，為神奇寶貝的電動動作提供動力。
When spread, the frills on its head act.fr:
Il absorbe les rayons du soleil en dépliant la peau
de sa tête pour produire l'électricité nécessaire
à ses puissantes capacités Électrik.
When spread, the frills on its head act.es:
Extiende los pliegues de la cabeza para absorber
la luz del sol y convertirla en electricidad, con la
que realiza potentes ataques de tipo Eléctrico.
When spread, the frills on its head act.it:
Distende le pieghe sulla testa per raccogliere
la luce solare e produrre energia elettrica che
usa per sferrare potenti mosse di tipo Elettro.
When spread, the frills on its head act.de:
Es breitet die Hautlappen an seinem Kopf aus,
um mithilfe des Sonnenlichts Strom zu erzeugen
und mächtige Elektro-Attacken einzusetzen.
When spread, the frills on its head act.pt-br:
Quando abertas, as extensões na sua cabeça
servem como painéis solares, gerando a energia
usada em seus movimentos elétricos.

When Tauros begins whipping itself with.en: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.
When Tauros begins whipping itself with.zh-tw: 當金牛座開始用尾巴抽打自己時，這是一個警告，神奇寶貝即將以驚人的速度衝鋒。
When Tauros begins whipping itself with.fr:
Il faut prendre garde quand un Tauros fouette
son corps avec ses queues. Cela signifie qu'il
s'apprête à charger à une vitesse démentielle.
When Tauros begins whipping itself with.es:
Conviene tener cuidado si empieza a
fustigarse con las colas, pues es señal
de que va a cargar a máxima velocidad.
When Tauros begins whipping itself with.it:
Quando comincia a frustarsi con le sue stesse
code è pericoloso, in quanto è segno che sta
per partire alla carica a tutta velocità.
When Tauros begins whipping itself with.de:
Peitscht es seinen Körper mit seinen Schweifen
aus, ist Vorsicht geboten, denn es steht kurz
davor, mit Karacho auf sein Ziel loszustürmen.
When Tauros begins whipping itself with.pt-br:
Quando Tauros começa a chicotear a si mesmo
com suas caudas, é um aviso de que está prestes
a atacar com velocidade surpreendente.

When the bulb on its back grows large, i.en: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
When the bulb on its back grows large, i.zh-tw: 當它背上的球莖變大時，它似乎就失去了後腿站立的能力。
When the bulb on its back grows large, i.fr:
Son bulbe dorsal est devenu si gros qu'il ne peut
plus se tenir sur ses pattes postérieures.
When the bulb on its back grows large, i.es:
Cuando le crece bastante el bulbo del lomo, pierde
la capacidad de erguirse sobre las patas traseras.
When the bulb on its back grows large, i.it:
Il bulbo sulla schiena è cresciuto così tanto da
impedirgli di alzarsi in piedi sulle zampe posteriori.
When the bulb on its back grows large, i.de:
Sobald die Knospe auf seinem Rücken
groß wird, kann Bisaknosp nicht mehr
auf zwei Beinen stehen.
When the bulb on its back grows large, i.pt-br:
À medida que o bulbo nas costas deste Pokémon
cresce, ele parece perder a capacidade de se sustentar
apenas nas pernas de trás.

When the memory of its departed mother b.en: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.
When the memory of its departed mother b.zh-tw: 當它想起死去的母親時，它會流下眼淚，它的哭聲會在頭戴的頭骨中悲傷地迴響。
When the memory of its departed mother b.fr:
Lorsqu'il repense à sa mère défunte, ses sanglots résonnent
tristement sous le crâne qu'il porte sur la tête.
When the memory of its departed mother b.es:
Cuando llora al acordarse de su madre fallecida, su
llanto resuena en el cráneo que lleva en la cabeza.
When the memory of its departed mother b.it:
Quando piange pensando alla madre defunta,
i suoi lamenti riecheggiano tristemente
all'interno del teschio che ha in testa.
When the memory of its departed mother b.de:
Denkt Tragosso an seine verstorbene Mutter,
so weint es. Sein Schluchzen hallt dabei in dem
Schädel auf seinem Kopf klagend wider.
When the memory of its departed mother b.pt-br:
Quando a memória de sua falecida mãe traz
lágrimas aos seus olhos, seu choro ecoa com
tristeza pelo crânio que usa em sua cabeça.

When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.en: When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.zh-tw: 當刺傷獸頭上的紅色球體發出明亮的光芒時，請小心。神奇寶貝即將發射出一陣超聲波。
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.fr:
Il faut faire attention lorsque les globes rouges
sur sa tête se mettent à briller intensément,
car c'est qu'il s'apprête à émettre des ultrasons.
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.es:
Si las esferas rojas que tiene a ambos lados
de la cabeza brillan con intensidad, indica que
está a punto de lanzar ondas ultrasónicas.
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.it:
Meglio fare attenzione quando le sfere rosse
che ha sulla testa brillano intensamente, perché
vuol dire che sta per emettere ultrasuoni.
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.de:
Leuchten die roten Kugeln auf seinem Kopf stark
auf, ist Vorsicht geboten, da es kurz danach
Ultraschallwellen ausstoßen wird.
When the red orbs on Tentacruel's head g.pt-br:
Quando o orbe vermelho na cabeça de Tantacruel
brilha intensamente, cuidado: este Pokémon está
prestes a disparar uma rajada de ondas ultrassônicas.

When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.en: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.zh-tw: 當這只脾氣暴躁的神奇寶貝狂奔時，它會從鬃毛中向四面八方射出閃電。
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.fr:
De caractère violent, il envoie avec sa crinière des arcs
électriques de tous les côtés lorsqu'il se sent provoqué.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.es:
Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento. Cuando
se enoja, lanza rayos desde su crin en todas direcciones.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.it:
Ha un temperamento sanguigno.
Quando si arrabbia dalla criniera
lancia saette in ogni direzione.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.de:
Ein stürmischer Geselle. Wenn es
wütend ist, feuert es über seine Mähne
in alle Richtungen Stromsalven ab.
When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild.pt-br:
Quando esse Pokémon mal-humorado fica
nervoso, dispara raios de sua crina em
todas as direções.

When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.en: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.zh-tw: 當雷雲遮蓋天空時，它就會出現。它可以用鬃毛捕捉閃電並儲存電力。
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.fr:
Il apparaît quand le ciel est à l'orage. Il capte les éclairs
avec sa crinière et accumule de l'électricité.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.es:
Aparece cuando nubes envueltas en
rayos encapotan el cielo. Atrapa rayos
con su crin y almacena electricidad.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.it:
Appare quando il cielo si riempie di fulmini e saette.
Accumula elettricità attirando i fulmini con la criniera.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.de:
Es erscheint, wenn Gewitterwolken den
Himmel verdunkeln. Es fängt mit seiner
Mähne Blitze und hortet ihre Energie.
When thunderclouds cover the sky, it wil.pt-br:
Surge quando nuvens de tempestade cobrem
o céu. Pode capturar raios com sua crina e
armazenar a eletricidade.

While inside a cave, if you look up and.en: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.
While inside a cave, if you look up and.zh-tw: 在洞穴內，如果您抬頭看到牆壁上排列著許多心形標記，則證明 Woobat 居住在那裡。
While inside a cave, if you look up and.fr:
La présence de marques en forme de cœur sur les parois
des grottes indique la présence de Chovsourir à l'intérieur.
While inside a cave, if you look up and.es:
Si al alzar la vista en una cueva se ven marcas
con forma de corazón en las paredes, es señal
de que Woobat la ha convertido en su guarida.
While inside a cave, if you look up and.it:
Se alzando lo sguardo in una grotta si
vedono impronte a forma di cuore sulle
pareti, è segno che vi abitano dei Woobat.
While inside a cave, if you look up and.de:
Herzförmige Flecken an der Decke einer Höhle
sind ein sicheres Zeichen dafür, dass sie von
Fleknoil behaust wird.
While inside a cave, if you look up and.pt-br:
Se você estiver em uma caverna e vir várias
marcas com formato de coração nas paredes,
é sinal de que Woobat vivem ali.

While one alone doesn't have much power,.en: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
While one alone doesn't have much power,.zh-tw: 雖然單個 Tynamo 的力量並不大，但許多 Tynamo 的鏈條可以像閃電一樣強大。
While one alone doesn't have much power,.fr:
Tout seuls, ils ne dégagent pas beaucoup d'électricité, mais
un banc d'Anchwatt produit la même puissance qu'un éclair.
While one alone doesn't have much power,.es:
La electricidad de uno solo es insignificante,
pero, si multitud de Tynamo se conectan,
consiguen la potencia de un rayo.
While one alone doesn't have much power,.it:
La carica elettrica di un Tynamo è
debole, ma se più esemplari si uniscono
raggiungono la potenza di un fulmine.
While one alone doesn't have much power,.de:
Allein erzeugt es nur wenig Strom, doch wenn
sich viele Zapplardin miteinander verbinden,
gleicht ihre Kraft der eines Blitzes.
While one alone doesn't have much power,.pt-br:
Enquanto um sozinho não é tão poderoso, uma corrente
de vários Tynamo pode ser tão forte quanto um raio.

While young, it has six gorgeous tails..en: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
While young, it has six gorgeous tails..zh-tw: 年輕時，它有六條華麗的尾巴。當它長大時，會長出幾條新的尾巴。
While young, it has six gorgeous tails..fr:
Quand il est jeune, ce Pokémon a six queues magnifiques.
De nouvelles queues apparaissent tout au long de sa croissance.
While young, it has six gorgeous tails..es:
De pequeño, tiene seis colas de gran belleza.
A medida que crece, le van saliendo más.
While young, it has six gorgeous tails..it:
Quando è giovane ha sei meravigliose code,
che si moltiplicano durante la sua crescita.
While young, it has six gorgeous tails..de:
In seiner Jugend hat es sechs hinreißende
Schweife. Während es wächst, kommen noch
weitere neue Schweife hinzu.
While young, it has six gorgeous tails..pt-br:
Quando é jovem, tem seis belas caudas.
Quando cresce, várias novas caudas brotam.

With a horn that's harder than diamond,.en: With a horn that's harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.
With a horn that's harder than diamond,.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝擁有比鑽石還硬的角，在尋找月光石時會繞過破碎的巨石。
With a horn that's harder than diamond,.fr:
Il erre à la recherche d'une Pierre Lune,
brisant tous les rochers sur son passage
avec sa corne plus solide qu'un diamant.
With a horn that's harder than diamond,.es:
Dondequiera que va, parte rocas con su cuerno, más
duro que un diamante, en busca de una Piedra Lunar.
With a horn that's harder than diamond,.it:
Vaga alla ricerca di una Pietralunare frantumando
rocce con il suo corno più duro del diamante.
With a horn that's harder than diamond,.de:
Auf der Suche nach einem Mondstein
zerstört es Felsen mit seinem Horn,
das härter ist als ein Diamant.
With a horn that's harder than diamond,.pt-br:
Com um chifre mais duro que um diamente,
este Pokémon sai por aí destruindo rochas
enquanto busca por uma Pedra da Lua.

Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.en: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.
Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.zh-tw: 你的對手在下回合中不能使用手上的任何支持者卡。
Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.fr: Votre adversaire ne peut utiliser aucune carte Supporter de sa main lors de son prochain tour.
Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.es: Tu oponente no puede usar ninguna carta de Partidario de su mano durante su próximo turno.
Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.de: Dein Gegner kann in seinem nächsten Zug keine Unterstützerkarten aus seiner Hand verwenden.
Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.pt-br: Seu oponente não pode usar nenhuma carta de Apoiador de sua mão durante o próximo turno.
Your opponent can't use any Supporter ca.it: Il tuo avversario non può utilizzare alcuna carta Aiuto dalla sua mano durante il suo prossimo turno.

Your opponent reveals their hand..zh-tw: 你的對手亮出了他們的牌。
Your opponent reveals their hand..es: Tu rival enseña las cartas de su mano.
Your opponent reveals their hand..it: Il tuo avversario mostra le carte che ha in mano.
Your opponent reveals their hand..de: Dein Gegner zeigt dir seine Handkarten.
Your opponent reveals their hand..pt-br: Seu oponente revela a mão dele.

According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.en: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.zh-tw: 根據神奧傳說，這只神奇寶貝從蛋中誕生，塑造了這個世界的一切。
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.fr:
La mythologie de Sinnoh veut
qu'il soit apparu sous forme
d'Œuf et ait créé le monde.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.es:
Según la mitología de Sinnoh, Arceus surgió
de un huevo y después creó todo el mundo.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.it:
Secondo la mitologia di Sinnoh, Arceus è
nato da un uovo e poi ha creato il mondo.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.de:
In den Legenden Sinnohs heißt es, es sei aus einem Ei
geschlüpft und hätte die gesamte Welt geschaffen.
According to the legends of Sinnoh, this.pt-br:
De acordo com lendas de Sinnoh, este Pokémon surgiu
de um ovo e construiu tudo o que há neste mundo.

After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.en: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.zh-tw: 吸收了充足的陽光後，櫻桃就呈現出這種形態。這樣一來就充滿了活力，這種熱鬧會一直持續到日落。
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.fr:
Il prend cette forme lorsqu'il a fait le plein de soleil.
Il déborde alors d'énergie et reste très actif jusqu'au crépuscule.
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.es:
Adopta esta forma cuando lo bañan los rayos del sol. Siempre
está rebosante de energía y se mantiene activo hasta el ocaso.
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.it:
Assume questa forma dopo essersi esposto
alla luce solare e aver fatto il pieno di energia.
Resta vivace fino al crepuscolo.
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.de:
Diese Form nimmt Kinoso an, wenn es viel Sonne
getankt und dadurch seine Energie aufgefüllt hat.
Es bleibt bis zum Sonnenuntergang aktiv.
After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cher.pt-br:
Após absorver uma grande quantidade de luz solar,
Cherrim assume esta forma. Enquanto estiver assim, fica
cheio de energia, e seu vigor permanece até o cair do sol.

Although it always pretends to be a tree.en: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
Although it always pretends to be a tree.zh-tw: 雖然它總是假裝是一棵樹，但它的構成看起來更像岩石而不是植被。
Although it always pretends to be a tree.fr:
Bien qu'il fasse semblant d'être un arbre, par sa composition,
il semble plus proche d'un minéral que d'un végétal.
Although it always pretends to be a tree.es:
Aunque pretende ser un árbol, en su composición
se parece más a una roca que a una planta.
Although it always pretends to be a tree.it:
Sebbene finga di essere un albero, il suo corpo
ha una composizione più simile a quella di una
roccia che a quella di un vegetale.
Although it always pretends to be a tree.de:
Obwohl es vorgibt, ein Baum zu sein, kommt seine
Zusammensetzung einem Stein näher als einer Pflanze.
Although it always pretends to be a tree.pt-br:
Apesar de sempre fingir ser uma árvore, sua composição
tem mais semelhanças com pedras do que com vegetação.

Ancient people believed that the pattern.en: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.
Ancient people believed that the pattern.zh-tw: 古人相信青銅佐背上的圖案蘊含著神秘的力量。
Ancient people believed that the pattern.fr:
On croyait autrefois que les motifs qui ornent
son dos renfermaient une puissance mystique.
Ancient people believed that the pattern.es:
Antaño se creía que en el dibujo de su parte
posterior residía una fuerza misteriosa.
Ancient people believed that the pattern.it:
Nell'antichità si credeva che una forza misteriosa
dimorasse nei disegni sul dorso di Bronzor.
Ancient people believed that the pattern.de:
Früher glaubten die Menschen, dem Muster auf
seinem Rücken wohne eine mysteriöse Kraft inne.
Ancient people believed that the pattern.pt-br:
Os povos antigos acreditavam que o padrão nas costas
de Bronzor continha um poder misterioso.

As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.en: As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still, placidly waiting for sunlight to appear.
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.zh-tw: 作為一個花蕾，它幾乎不動。它靜靜地坐著，平靜地等待陽光的出現。
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.fr:
Pendant sa période de bourgeonnement, il reste
presque totalement immobile et attend que le soleil se lève.
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.es:
Permanece casi inmóvil cerrado en un capullo
a la espera de que lo bañen los rayos del sol.
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.it:
Quando è un bocciolo rimane pressoché
immobile in attesa che spunti il sole.
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.de:
Als Knospe verhält es sich ruhig und bewegt sich kaum,
während es geduldig auf Sonnenschein wartet.
As a bud, it barely moves. It sits still.pt-br:
Como um botão, quase não se move. Fica parado,
esperando tranquilamente a luz do sol aparecer.

As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.en: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.zh-tw: 當它在天空中疾馳時，這只神奇寶貝似乎在接收來歷不明的信號，同時發射目的不明的信號。
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.fr:
Il parcourt le ciel en émettant et en
recevant des ondes bien mystérieuses.
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.es:
Se dice que mientras vuela emite unas ondas eléctricas
misteriosas, a la vez que recibe otras ondas desconocidas.
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.it:
Vola per il cielo inviando misteriose onde
elettromagnetiche e ricevendo onde sconosciute.
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.de:
Es heißt, dass es beim Herumfliegen mysteriöse Funkwellen
aussende und unbekannte Wellen empfange.
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémo.pt-br:
Dizem que enquanto voa pelo céu, emite ondas
eletromagnéticas misteriosas enquanto recebe
ondas desconhecidas.

At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.en: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.
At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.zh-tw: 晚上，科比大約有一百隻，緊密地擠在一起睡覺。
At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.fr:
À la nuit tombée, les Apitrini s'agglutinent
par grappes de cent pour dormir.
At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.es:
Cuando llega la noche, se juntan unos cien
Combee y duermen formando una gran colmena.
At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.it:
Scesa la notte, formano dei grandi alveari di
circa 100 esemplari e dormono raggruppati.
At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.de:
Des Nachts schmiegen sich bis zu 100 Wadribie
aneinander und formieren sich so zum Schlafen
zu einem großen Gebilde.
At night, Combee sleep in a group of abo.pt-br:
À noite, Combee dormem amontados
em grupos de aproximadamente cem indivíduos.

Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.en: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.
Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝出生在地下深處，在吃掉足夠建造一座山的泥土後變成了蛹。
Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.fr:
Il naît dans les profondeurs terrestres. Après
avoir englouti une quantité de terre équivalente
à une montagne, il se transforme en chrysalide.
Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.es:
Nacido en las profundidades subterráneas,
este Pokémon se convierte en pupa al comer
la cantidad de tierra equivalente a una montaña.
Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.it:
Nasce nel profondo sottosuolo e dopo
aver mangiato una montagna di terra
si trasforma in una crisalide.
Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.de:
Es wird tief im Erdreich geboren. Hat es einen Berg
Erde gefressen, verpuppt sich dieses Pokémon.
Born deep underground, this Pokémon beco.pt-br:
Este Pokémon nasce no subsolo e se torna uma pupa
após comer terra o suficiente para fazer uma montanha.

Both of its legs have turned into wings..en: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.
Both of its legs have turned into wings..zh-tw: 它的兩條腿都變成了翅膀。鱷魚無聲地迅速飛向獵物，並將尖牙咬入目標的頸背。
Both of its legs have turned into wings..fr:
Ses pattes sont devenues des ailes.
Il fond sur sa proie furtivement puis
plante ses crocs dans sa nuque.
Both of its legs have turned into wings..es:
Sus patas se han convertido en alas. Se lanza
sobre su presa en un vuelo silencioso a alta
velocidad y le clava los colmillos en la nuca.
Both of its legs have turned into wings..it:
Le due zampe si sono mutate in ali. Vola verso
la preda ad alta velocità senza fare alcun
rumore e le affonda le zanne nella nuca.
Both of its legs have turned into wings..de:
Seine zwei Beine wurden zu Flügeln. Es fliegt
schnell und lautlos zu seiner Beute, um ihr dann
die Zähne in den Nacken zu bohren.
Both of its legs have turned into wings..pt-br:
Suas duas pernas se transformaram em asas.
Silenciosamente, Crobat voa de forma ágil em direção
à sua presa e afunda seus dentes na nuca de seu alvo.

Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.en: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.zh-tw: 唐凡全身覆蓋著堅韌的皮革，因此即使被車撞也不會困擾這只神奇寶貝。然而，它極易受雨影響。
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.fr:
Sa peau est si dure qu'une collision avec
une voiture le laisserait indifférent. En revanche,
il est extrêmement sensible à la pluie.
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.es:
Su dura piel podría resistir el choque contra un coche sin
sufrir un rasguño. La lluvia, sin embargo, es su punto débil.
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.it:
La sua pelle è così dura che anche se sbatte
contro una macchina non si fa un graffio.
La pioggia è il suo punto debole.
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.de:
Seine Haut ist so hart, dass ihm nicht einmal der
Zusammenprall mit einem Auto etwas anhaben kann.
Regen setzt ihm jedoch stark zu.
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so eve.pt-br:
Donphan é recoberto por uma couraça resistente
e não se abala nem quando é atingido por um carro.
No entanto, é extremamente vulnerável a chuva.

During cold seasons, it migrates to the.en: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the.zh-tw: 在寒冷的季節，它會遷徙到山的下游。春天，它又回到了白雪覆蓋的山頂。
During cold seasons, it migrates to the.fr:
Il s'aventure jusqu'au pied des montagnes en hiver,
mais se réfugie sur les pics neigeux au printemps.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the.es:
En las estaciones frías baja al pie de la montaña,
pero regresa a las cimas nevadas en primavera.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the.it:
In inverno scende fino ai piedi delle
montagne, ma in primavera se ne torna
sulle cime montuose dove c'è ancora neve.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the.de:
In der kalten Jahreszeit steigt es bis zum Fuß
der Berge hinab. Im Frühjahr kehrt es auf die
Gipfel zurück, wo noch Schnee liegt.
During cold seasons, it migrates to the.pt-br:
Durante as temporadas frias, migra para as partes baixas
da montanha. Na primavera, retorna para o cume nevado.

Extremamente forte, pode modificar a paisagem.
É tão insolente que não se preocupa com os outros.

If you are burned by the flames it shoot.en: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
If you are burned by the flames it shoot.zh-tw: 如果你被它嘴裡噴出的火焰燒傷，疼痛將永遠不會消失。
If you are burned by the flames it shoot.fr:
Les blessures provoquées par son souffle enflammé
sont permanentes, et la douleur ne disparaît jamais.
If you are burned by the flames it shoot.es:
Si alguien se quema con las llamas que lanza
por la boca, el dolor no desaparecerá nunca.
If you are burned by the flames it shoot.it:
Se si viene ustionati dalle fiamme che sputa
dalla bocca, il dolore rimarrà per sempre.
If you are burned by the flames it shoot.de:
Wird man von den Flammen getroffen, die es
aus seinem Maul schießt, so erleidet man eine
Brandwunde, deren Schmerz nie nachlässt.
If you are burned by the flames it shoot.pt-br:
Se você for queimado pelas chamas disparadas
de sua boca, a dor nunca passará.
