If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on.es:
Cuando carga contra un enemigo, se le erizan
los pelos del lomo. Es muy sensible al sonido.
If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on.it:
Quando carica il nemico, i peli gli si
rizzano sul dorso. È molto sensibile ai suoni.
If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on.de:
Beim Angriff auf einen Gegner stellen sich seine
Rückenhaare auf. Es hört außergewöhnlich gut.
If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on.pt-br:
Quando Piloswine dispara contra um oponente,
os pelos nas suas costas se arrepiam.
Este Pokémon é muito sensível ao som.

If it finds bad children who won't liste.en: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.
If it finds bad children who won't liste.zh-tw: 如果它發現不聽父母的話的壞孩子，它就會把他們偷走——至少是這麼說的。
If it finds bad children who won't liste.fr:
On dit que ce Pokémon emporte les
enfants désobéissants à la nuit tombée.
If it finds bad children who won't liste.es:
Corre el rumor de que, por las noches,
se lleva a los niños que no son obedientes.
If it finds bad children who won't liste.it:
Si racconta che questo Pokémon porti via nella
notte i bambini che sono stati disobbedienti.
If it finds bad children who won't liste.de:
Man sagt, es suche sich unartige Kinder und
verschleppe sie nachts an einen unbekannten Ort.
If it finds bad children who won't liste.pt-br:
Captura crianças malcriadas que não obedecem aos pais.
Ou pelo menos é o que dizem.

If the convection microwave oven is not.en: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.
If the convection microwave oven is not.zh-tw: 如果對流微波爐無法正常工作，那麼居住在其中的洛托姆就會變得昏昏欲睡。
If the convection microwave oven is not.fr:
Si le four dont il prend possession ne fonctionne
pas bien, Motisma perdra sa vitalité.
If the convection microwave oven is not.es:
Si el horno eléctrico se encuentra en mal estado, la salud
del Rotom que reside en su interior se deteriora también.
If the convection microwave oven is not.it:
Se il forno elettrico dentro cui si trova è in
cattive condizioni, anche Rotom ne risente.
If the convection microwave oven is not.de:
Funktioniert der Mikrowellenherd nicht richtig,
so leidet auch das Rotom darin.
If the convection microwave oven is not.pt-br:
Se o forno de micro-ondas não estiver funcionando
direito, o Rotom que habita dentro dele
se tornará letárgico.

If the Pokémon this card is attached to.en: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to.zh-tw: 這張卡所附著的寶可夢位於活動區域並因對方寶可夢的攻擊而受到傷害時，對攻擊的寶可夢造成 20 點傷害。
If the Pokémon this card is attached to.es: Si el Pokémon al que está unida esta carta está en el Punto Activo y es dañado por un ataque del Pokémon de tu rival, haz 20 puntos de daño al Pokémon Atacante.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to.fr: Si le Pokémon auquel cette carte est attachée se trouve dans le Point Actif et est endommagé par une attaque du Pokémon de votre adversaire, infligez 20 dégâts au Pokémon attaquant.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to.it: Se il Pokémon a cui è assegnata questa carta è in posizione attiva e viene danneggiato da un attacco dei Pokémon del tuo avversario, infliggi 20 danni al Pokémon attaccante.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to.de: Wenn sich das Pokémon, an das diese Karte angelegt ist, an der aktiven Stelle befindet und durch einen Angriff des Pokémon deines Gegners beschädigt wird, füge dem angreifenden Pokémon 20 Schadenspunkte zu.
If the Pokémon this card is attached to.pt-br: Se o Pokémon ao qual esta carta está ligada estiver no Ponto Ativo e for danificado por um ataque dos Pokémon do seu oponente, cause 20 pontos de dano ao Pokémon Atacante.

If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.en: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.
If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.zh-tw: 如果該神奇寶貝附加了神奇寶貝工具，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 30 點。
If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.fr: Si un Outil Pokémon est attaché à ce Pokémon, cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts supplémentaires.
If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.es: Si este Pokémon tiene 1 Herramienta Pokémon unida a él, este ataque hace 30 puntos de daño más.
If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.it: Se questo Pokémon ha un Oggetto Pokémon assegnato, questo attacco infligge 30 danni in più.
If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon 1 Pokémon-Ausrüstung angelegt ist, fügt diese Attacke 30 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attac.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver uma Ferramenta Pokémon ligada a ele, este ataque causará 30 pontos de dano a mais.

If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.en: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.
If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.zh-tw: 如果該神奇寶貝附加了任何能量，則它沒有撤退成本。
If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.fr: Si ce Pokémon a de l'Énergie attachée, il n'a pas de Coût de Retraite.
If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.es: Si este Pokémon tiene alguna Energía unida, no tiene Coste de Retirada.
If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver alguma Energia ligada, ela não terá Custo de Recuo.
If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.it: Se questo Pokémon ha delle Energie assegnate, non ha costo di ritirata.
If this Pokémon has any Energy attached,.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon Energie angelegt ist, fallen keine Rückzugskosten an.

If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.en: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L} Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.zh-tw: 如果這只神奇寶貝附加了至少 2 個額外的 {L} 能量，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 80 點。
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.fr: Si ce Pokémon a au moins 2 Énergies {L} de plus, cette attaque inflige 80 dégâts supplémentaires.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.es: Si este Pokémon tiene por lo menos 2 Energías {L} adicionales unidas a él, este ataque hace 80 puntos de daño más.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.it: Se questo Pokémon ha almeno 2 Energie {L} extra assegnate, questo attacco infligge 80 danni in più.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon mindestens 2 extra {L}-Energien angelegt sind, fügt diese Attacke 80 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {L}.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver pelo menos 2 Energia {L} extra ligada a ele, este ataque causará 80 pontos de dano a mais.

If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.en: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.zh-tw: 如果對手的活躍神奇寶貝附有神奇寶貝工具，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 30 點。
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.fr: Si un Outil Pokémon est attaché au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire, cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts supplémentaires.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.es: Si el Pokémon Activo de tu rival tiene 1 Herramienta Pokémon unida a él, este ataque hace 30 puntos de daño más.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.it: Se il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario ha un Oggetto Pokémon assegnato, questo attacco infligge 30 danni in più.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.de: Wenn an das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners eine Pokémon-Ausrüstung angelegt ist, fügt diese Attacke 30 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon has a.pt-br: Se o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente tiver uma Ferramenta Pokémon ligada a ele, este ataque causará 30 pontos de dano a mais.

If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.en: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {F} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.zh-tw: 如果對手的活躍寶可夢是{F}寶可夢，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 30 點。
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.fr: Si le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est un Pokémon {F}, cette attaque inflige 30 dégâts supplémentaires.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.es: Si el Pokémon Activo de tu rival es un Pokémon {F}, este ataque hace 30 puntos de daño más.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.it: Se il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è un Pokémon {F}, questo attacco infligge 30 danni in più.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.de: Wenn das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ein {F}-Pokémon ist, fügt diese Attacke 30 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {.pt-br: Se o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente for um Pokémon {F}, este ataque causará 30 pontos de dano a mais.

If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.en: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.zh-tw: 如果對手的寶可夢因這次攻擊而被擊倒，則該寶可夢也會對其自身造成 50 點傷害。
If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.fr: Si le Pokémon de l'adversaire est mis K.O. par les dégâts de cette attaque, ce Pokémon s'inflige aussi 50 dégâts.
If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.es: Si el Pokémon de tu rival queda Fuera de Combate por el daño de este ataque, este Pokémon también se hace 50 puntos de daño a sí mismo.
If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.it: Se un Pokémon del tuo avversario viene messo KO dai danni di questo attacco, questo Pokémon infligge anche 50 danni a se stesso.
If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.de: Wenn das Pokémon deines Gegners durch Schaden dieser Attacke kampfunfähig wird, fügt dieses Pokémon auch sich selbst 50 Schadenspunkte zu.
If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Ou.pt-br: Se o Pokémon do seu oponente for Nocauteado pelo dano deste ataque, este Pokémon também causará 50 pontos de dano a si mesmo.

In ancient times, people would dig up fo.en: In ancient times, people would dig up fossils of this Pokémon and use its skull, which is harder than steel, to make helmets.
In ancient times, people would dig up fo.zh-tw: 在古代，人們會挖掘這種神奇寶貝的化石，並用它比鋼鐵還硬的頭骨來製作頭盔。
In ancient times, people would dig up fo.fr:
Il y a bien longtemps, les hommes fabriquaient
des casques plus solides que l'acier à partir
de crânes de Charkos fossilisés.
In ancient times, people would dig up fo.es:
Los hombres de antaño que encontraban restos
fosilizados de Rampardos usaban su cráneo,
más duro que el metal, para fabricar cascos.
In ancient times, people would dig up fo.it:
In tempi antichi gli uomini si servivano dei fossili del cranio
di questi Pokémon, più duro dell'acciaio, per fabbricare elmi.
In ancient times, people would dig up fo.de:
Vor langer Zeit wurden die Fossilien dieses
Pokémon ausgegraben und aus den stahlharten
Schädeln Helme hergestellt.
In ancient times, people would dig up fo.pt-br:
Antigamente, as pessoas escavavam os fósseis
deste Pokémon e usavam seu crânio, que é mais duro
do que aço, para criar capacetes.

It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.en: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.zh-tw: 它通過從尾尖噴出難聞的液體來進行攻擊。來自上方的攻擊使其感到困惑。
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.fr:
Du bout de sa queue, il projette un liquide fétide sur ses
adversaires. Les attaques aériennes le prennent de court.
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.es:
Ataca emitiendo un fluido maloliente por la punta
de la cola. Los ataques aéreos lo confunden.
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.it:
Attacca spruzzando un fluido puzzolente dalla
punta della coda. Gli attacchi dall'alto lo confondono.
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.de:
Es greift mit einer übel riechenden Substanz an,
die es aus der Spitze seines Schweifs versprüht.
Angriffe von oben verblüffen es.
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly.pt-br:
Ele ataca ao espirrar um fluido com um cheiro horroroso
da ponta de sua cauda.
Os ataques de cima podem confundi-lo.

It busily makes its nest with stacks of.en: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of.zh-tw: 它忙著用鋒利的門牙切下的成堆的樹枝和樹根築巢。
It busily makes its nest with stacks of.fr:
Il tranche les branches et les racines de ses
incisives aiguisées pour construire des barrages.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of.es:
Con sus incisivos roe ramas y raíces y las apila
para construir sus madrigueras junto al río.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of.it:
Costruisce con zelo la tana in riva ai corsi d'acqua,
levigando radici e rami con gli affilati incisivi.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of.de:
Emsig durchbeißt es mit seinen scharfen Vorderzähnen
Wurzeln und Äste und baut daraus sein Nest.
It busily makes its nest with stacks of.pt-br:
Ele monta seu ninho com pilhas de galhos e raízes
de árvores que cortou com seus incisivos.

It can control its body temperature at w.en: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.
It can control its body temperature at w.zh-tw: 它可以隨意控制自己的體溫。這使得它能夠凍結大氣中的水分，產生鑽石塵埃。
It can control its body temperature at w.fr:
Il peut contrôler la température de son corps à volonté
et créer des cristaux de glace en gelant l'humidité de l'air.
It can control its body temperature at w.es:
Controla a su antojo la temperatura corporal
y congela las partículas de agua que flotan en
el aire para provocar ráfagas de nieve en polvo.
It can control its body temperature at w.it:
Può modificare a piacimento la sua temperatura
corporea. Così può congelare l'umidità dell'aria
e creare cristalli di ghiaccio intorno a sé.
It can control its body temperature at w.de:
Es kann seine Körpertemperatur frei regulieren.
Indem es die Wasserbestandteile der Luft
gefrieren lässt, wirbelt es Diamantstaub auf.
It can control its body temperature at w.pt-br:
Pode controlar a temperatura de seu corpo
como bem entender. Isso permite congelar a umidade
na atmosfera, criando flocos de pó de diamante.

It can load up to three projectiles per.en: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.
It can load up to three projectiles per.zh-tw: 它每隻手臂最多可以將三枚射彈裝入其手中的孔中。從這些洞中噴出的可能是岩石，也可能是羅根羅拉。
It can load up to three projectiles per.fr:
Il met des rochers ou des Nodulithe dans le creux de ses mains
et les tire comme des obus. Il peut ainsi en charger trois par bras.
It can load up to three projectiles per.es:
Introduce rocas o Roggenrola en las cavidades
de las manos y los dispara con fuerza. Es capaz
de cargar hasta tres proyectiles en cada brazo.
It can load up to three projectiles per.it:
Inserisce delle rocce o dei Roggenrola nelle cavità dei suoi
palmi e poi li lancia. Può caricarne fino a tre per braccio.
It can load up to three projectiles per.de:
Es bestückt die Vertiefungen in seinen Händen
mit Felsen oder Kiesling und feuert sie daraus ab.
In jeder Hand hat es Platz für drei Geschosse.
It can load up to three projectiles per.pt-br:
Pode carregar até três projéteis por braço dentro
dos buracos em suas mãos, de onde dispara tanto pedras
quanto Roggenrola.

It can see clearly through walls to trac.en: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
It can see clearly through walls to trac.zh-tw: 它可以清晰地透過牆壁追踪獵物並尋找丟失的幼崽。
It can see clearly through walls to trac.fr:
Il est capable de voir à travers les murs pour chasser
des proies ou retrouver ses petits s'ils s'égarent.
It can see clearly through walls to trac.es:
Puede ver claramente a través de las paredes para
buscar a las presas huidas o a sus crías si se pierden.
It can see clearly through walls to trac.it:
La sua capacità di vedere attraverso le pareti
è utile non solo quando incalza la preda in fuga,
ma anche per trovare i suoi cuccioli smarriti.
It can see clearly through walls to trac.de:
Es kann durch Wände sehen und spürt auf diese
Weise Beute und verloren gegangene Junge auf.
It can see clearly through walls to trac.pt-br:
Pode ver claramente através de paredes para rastrear
suas presas e procurar seus jovens perdidos.

It chases people and Pokémon from its te.en: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
It chases people and Pokémon from its te.zh-tw: 它通過讓人類和神奇寶貝經歷噩夢般的深度睡眠來將他們驅逐出其領地。
It chases people and Pokémon from its te.fr:
Il endort humains et Pokémon, et leur fait avoir
des cauchemars pour les chasser de son territoire.
It chases people and Pokémon from its te.es:
Defiende su territorio de personas y Pokémon
haciéndoles dormir y provocándoles pesadillas.
It chases people and Pokémon from its te.it:
Respinge umani e Pokémon dal suo
territorio inducendoli a un sonno
profondo e provocando incubi.
It chases people and Pokémon from its te.de:
Es vertreibt Eindringlinge aus seinem Revier, indem
es sie in Schlaf versetzt und mit Alpträumen quält.
It chases people and Pokémon from its te.pt-br:
Causa um sono profundo e cheio de pesadelos
em pessoas e Pokémon para afugentá-los
de seu território.

It claws if displeased and purrs when af.en: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
It claws if displeased and purrs when af.zh-tw: 當它不高興時，它會用爪子抓；當它充滿感情時，它會發出咕嚕聲。它的善變在一些人中很受歡迎。
It claws if displeased and purrs when af.fr:
Il griffe quand il est en colère et ronronne quand
il est heureux. Certains aiment ce côté lunatique.
It claws if displeased and purrs when af.es:
Araña cuando está enfadado y ronronea cuando
está cariñoso. Su imprevisibilidad es famosa.
It claws if displeased and purrs when af.it:
Se disturbato, tira fuori gli artigli; se soddisfatto,
fa le fusa. La sua incostanza piace a molti.
It claws if displeased and purrs when af.de:
Es schlägt mit Krallen zu oder schnurrt, je nachdem,
ob es gerade wütend oder zutraulich ist.
It claws if displeased and purrs when af.pt-br:
Arranha quando está descontente e ronrona
quando está carinhoso. Há quem goste muito
da sua natureza inconstante.

It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.en: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.
It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.zh-tw: 它不喜歡被照顧。它很難與它建立聯繫，因為它不聽訓練師的話。
It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.fr:
Ce Pokémon est difficile à entraîner car il est très
désobéissant et déteste qu'on lui rende service.
It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.es:
No le gusta que lo cuiden. Como no aprecia el apoyo
de su Entrenador, le cuesta coger confianza con él.
It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.it:
Molto orgoglioso. Difficile farci amicizia
perché non ascolta mai i consigli dell'Allenatore.
It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.de:
Einmischung kann es gar nicht leiden. Es ist bockig
und fasst nur schwer Zutrauen zu seinem Trainer.
It doesn't like to be taken care of. It'.pt-br:
Estes Pokémon não gostam que tomem conta deles.
É muito difícil criar laços com eles,
pois não costumam obedecer aos seus Treinadores.

It is born with a wondrous power that le.en: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.zh-tw: 它天生就擁有一種神奇的力量，可以與任何種類的神奇寶貝產生聯繫。
It is born with a wondrous power that le.fr:
Il est né avec le pouvoir incroyable de créer
des liens avec n'importe quel Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.es:
Nace con un maravilloso poder que le permite
establecer vínculos con cualquier tipo de Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.it:
Dispone di un potere innato che lo fa
legare con qualsiasi specie di Pokémon.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.de:
Es wird mit einer wundersamen Kraft geboren,
die eine Bindung zu jedem anderen Pokémon
möglich macht.
It is born with a wondrous power that le.pt-br:
Ele nasce com um poder extraordinário
que o permite se ligar a qualquer tipo de Pokémon.

It is merciless by nature. It is said th.en: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.
It is merciless by nature. It is said th.zh-tw: 它本質上是無情的。據說它永遠不會原諒暗鴉追隨者所犯的錯誤。
It is merciless by nature. It is said th.fr:
Ce Pokémon impitoyable ne tolère aucun
échec de la part de ses sbires, les Cornèbre.
It is merciless by nature. It is said th.es:
No perdona ni se apiada nunca. No consiente
fallos ni a los propios Murkrow que lo siguen.
It is merciless by nature. It is said th.it:
Ha un carattere spietato. Pare che non perdoni il
minimo errore commesso dai Murkrow suoi seguaci.
It is merciless by nature. It is said th.de:
Kramshef kennt kein Erbarmen. Man sagt,
einem untergebenen Kramurx verzeihe es
niemals einen Fehler.
It is merciless by nature. It is said th.pt-br:
Sua natureza é impiedosa. Diz-se que ele nunca perdoa
os erros de seus seguidores Murkrow.

It is said that when one runs at high sp.en: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
It is said that when one runs at high sp.zh-tw: 據說，當一個人高速奔跑時，它的翅膀會產生風葉，可以吹倒附近的樹木。
It is said that when one runs at high sp.fr:
Lorsqu'il est lancé à pleine vitesse, ses ailes créent des lames
de vent capables de trancher les arbres autour de lui.
It is said that when one runs at high sp.es:
Se dice que, cuando va a velocidad máxima, sus alas
crean cuchillas de viento que talan cualquier árbol.
It is said that when one runs at high sp.it:
Si dice che, quando va a tutta
velocità, le sue ali creino lame d'aria
in grado di abbattere gli alberi vicini.
It is said that when one runs at high sp.de:
Stürmt es schnell vorwärts, erzeugen seine Flügel Klingen
aus Wind, die in der Nähe stehende Bäume fällen.
It is said that when one runs at high sp.pt-br:
Diz-se que, quando um corre em alta velocidade,
suas asas criam lâminas de vento que podem derrubar
as árvores próximas.

It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.en: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.zh-tw: 據說，它用特殊的冰山、岩石和岩漿創造了與自己相似的神奇寶貝。
It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.fr:
On dit qu'il a créé des Pokémon à son image
à partir de glace, de roche et de magma.
It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.es:
Se dice que usó rocas, magma y un hielo especial
de montaña para crear Pokémon con su aspecto.
It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.it:
Si dice che abbia creato dei Pokémon simili a sé
usando una montagna ghiacciata, rocce e magma.
It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.de:
Man sagt, es habe Pokémon aus einem Eisberg,
Felsen und Magma nach seinem Abbild geschaffen.
It is said to have made Pokémon that loo.pt-br:
Diz-se que criaram Pokémon parecidos com eles mesmos
de uma montanha de gelo especial, rochas e magma.

It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.en: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.zh-tw: 它非常容易生氣。它張開嘴以展示其力量。
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.fr:
Ce Pokémon s'énerve facilement. Il ouvre ses mâchoires
au maximum pour intimider ses adversaires.
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.es:
Mantiene la boca abierta para mostrar su fuerza.
Se enfada con sorprendente rapidez.
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.it:
Si infuria molto facilmente. Per mostrare
la sua forza tiene la bocca spalancata.
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.de:
Es wird überraschend schnell wütend. Als Zeichen
seiner Stärke sperrt es sein Maul auf.
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It ho.pt-br:
É surpreendentemente rápido deixá-lo irritado.
Ele mantém a boca aberta como sinal de sua força.

It is whispered that any child who mista.en: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.
It is whispered that any child who mista.zh-tw: 有傳言說，任何將 Drifloon 誤認為氣球並抓住它的孩子都可能會失踪。
It is whispered that any child who mista.fr:
On dit que les jeunes enfants qui agrippent Baudrive après
l'avoir pris pour un ballon disparaissent sans laisser de traces.
It is whispered that any child who mista.es:
Se dice que a veces desaparecen niños que
agarran un Drifloon pensando que es un globo.
It is whispered that any child who mista.it:
Si dice che i bambini piccoli possano scomparire nel nulla
se tengono un Drifloon scambiandolo per un palloncino.
It is whispered that any child who mista.de:
So manches kleine Kind soll schon verschwunden
sein, weil es ein Driftlon festhielt, das es mit
einem Ballon verwechselt hatte.
It is whispered that any child who mista.pt-br:
Diz-se por aí que se uma criança confundir Drifloon
com um balão e o segurar, poderá acabar desaparecendo.

It launches kicks while spinning. If it.en: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
It launches kicks while spinning. If it.zh-tw: 它在旋轉時發射踢腿。如果它高速旋轉，它可能會鑽入地下。
It launches kicks while spinning. If it.fr:
Il assène des coups de pied tout en tournant sur lui-même.
Il va parfois si vite qu'il commence à s'enfoncer dans le sol.
It launches kicks while spinning. If it.es:
Lanza patadas mientras gira. Si alcanza mucha
velocidad, puede cavar un hoyo en la tierra.
It launches kicks while spinning. If it.it:
Gira su se stesso tirando calci. Se gira molto
velocemente può scavare una fossa nel terreno.
It launches kicks while spinning. If it.de:
Es dreht sich um sich selbst und verteilt Tritte.
Gewinnt es ausreichend an Schwung, bohrt es
sich dabei in den Boden.
It launches kicks while spinning. If it.pt-br:
Ele dá chutes enquanto gira. Se ele girar
em alta velocidade, faz um caminho no chão.

It lives alone, away from others. Appare.en: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
It lives alone, away from others. Appare.zh-tw: 它獨自生活，遠離他人。顯然，他們每個人都認為這是最重要的。
It lives alone, away from others. Appare.fr:
Il vit seul, à l'écart de ses pairs. Chaque individu
est convaincu d'être meilleur que les autres.
It lives alone, away from others. Appare.es:
Vive solo, alejado de los demás. Cada
uno piensa que es el más importante.
It lives alone, away from others. Appare.it:
Vive da solo lontano dagli altri. Apparentemente
ogni esemplare crede di essere il più importante.
It lives alone, away from others. Appare.de:
Es lebt allein, entfernt von anderen. Jedes von
ihnen denkt, es sei das Bedeutendste unter ihnen.
It lives alone, away from others. Appare.pt-br:
Vivem sozinhos, longe de todos. Pelo que parece,
todos eles se acham a última bolacha do pacote.

It lives along water in forests. In the.en: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
It lives along water in forests. In the.zh-tw: 它生活在森林裡的水邊。白天，它離開森林去曬樹殼上的日光浴。
It lives along water in forests. In the.fr:
Il vit en forêt près de l'eau. En journée, il la
quitte pour dorer sa carapace feuillue au soleil.
It lives along water in forests. In the.es:
Vive en los bosques cerca del agua. Por el día,
sale a que les dé el sol a las plantas de su espalda.
It lives along water in forests. In the.it:
Vive nelle foreste vicino all'acqua, ma esce di
giorno per far prendere sole alle piante sul guscio.
It lives along water in forests. In the.de:
Es lebt in der Nähe von Wasser in Wäldern.
Tagsüber verlässt es diese, um ein Sonnenbad
zu nehmen.
It lives along water in forests. In the.pt-br:
Mora à beira d'água nas florestas. Durante o dia,
deixa a mata para seu casco arbóreo tomar sol.

It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.en: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.zh-tw: 它模仿其他神奇寶貝的叫聲，讓它們誤以為它是其中之一。這樣他們就不會攻擊它。
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.fr:
Il reproduit le cri de ses ennemis pour faire
croire qu'il est des leurs et éviter d'être attaqué.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.es:
Imita los sonidos de sus rivales, haciéndoles creer
que son amigos e impidiendo que le ataquen.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.it:
Imita la voce dei nemici per far credere che
è dei loro, evitando così di essere assalito.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.de:
Es versucht Attacken zu entgehen, indem es den Ruf
des Gegners nachahmt und einen Artgenossen mimt.
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to.pt-br:
Imita os gritos dos outros Pokémon para levá-los a acreditar
que é um deles. Assim, eles não o atacam.

It observes prey while hanging inverted.en: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
It observes prey while hanging inverted.zh-tw: 它倒掛在樹枝上觀察獵物。當機會出現時，它就會猛撲過去！
It observes prey while hanging inverted.fr:
Il guette sa proie, pendu à une branche la tête
en bas, et s'en saisit à la première occasion.
It observes prey while hanging inverted.es:
Espera a sus presas colgado de una rama bocabajo.
Cuando llega su oportunidad, se lanza en picado.
It observes prey while hanging inverted.it:
Sta appeso ai rami con la testa in giù. Alla prima
occasione, si butta a capofitto sulla preda.
It observes prey while hanging inverted.de:
Es hängt kopfüber von einem Ast und beobachtet
seine Beute. Bei Gelegenheit stürzt es sich auf sie.
It observes prey while hanging inverted.pt-br:
Observa as presas enquanto se pendura de cabeça
para baixo nos galhos. Quando a chance surge, ele ataca!

It rubs its snout on the ground to find.en: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find.zh-tw: 它用鼻子在地上摩擦來尋找和挖掘食物。有時它會發現溫泉。
It rubs its snout on the ground to find.fr:
Il creuse le sol avec son groin pour y dénicher de
la nourriture. Il trouve parfois des sources d'eau chaude.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find.es:
Frota el hocico contra el suelo para desenterrar
comida. A veces descubre aguas termales.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find.it:
Scava con il muso nel terreno per scovare
del cibo. Talvolta scopre sorgenti d'acqua calda.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find.de:
Auf Nahrungssuche wühlt es sich mit der Nase
durch den Erdboden. Manchmal entdeckt es
dabei auch heiße Quellen.
It rubs its snout on the ground to find.pt-br:
Ele esfrega o focinho no chão para encontrar
e cavar alimento. Algumas vezes, descobre fontes
de água quente.

It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.en: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.zh-tw: 它尋找漂浮的鬼火，並將它們吸進它空蕩蕩的身體裡。裡面發生的事情是個謎。
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.fr:
Il cherche des feux follets pour les avaler.
Ce qu'il se passe alors à l'intérieur
de son corps vide est un mystère.
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.es:
Busca fuegos fatuos y los absorbe en su cuerpo
hueco. Lo que pasa dentro luego es un misterio.
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.it:
Va in cerca di fuochi fatui e li risucchia nel suo
corpo vuoto. Cosa succeda all'interno è un mistero.
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.de:
Es sucht umherirrende Seelen und saugt sie in
seinen leeren Körper. Was dann mit ihnen
passiert, ist ein Rätsel.
It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and.pt-br:
Ele procura fogos-fátuos e os suga para seu corpo vazio.
O que acontece lá dentro é um mistério.

It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.en: It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.zh-tw: 它緊緊閉上鼻孔，然後像走路一樣穿過沙子。它們形成大約 10 個的群體。
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.fr:
Ce Pokémon peut obturer ses narines et avancer dans le sable
avec aisance. Il vit en colonies d'environ dix individus.
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.es:
Cierra los orificios nasales y luego se
desplaza por la arena con total tranquilidad.
Suele formar colonias de diez individuos.
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.it:
Chiude le narici e poi avanza nella sabbia in tutta
tranquillità. Vive in gruppi di una decina di esemplari.
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.de:
Dieses Pokémon schließt seine Nasenlöcher und
reist dann durch den Sand. Es lebt in Kolonien
mit einer Größe von circa zehn Hippopotas.
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travel.pt-br:
Ele aperta as narinas enquanto viaja pela areia
como se estivesse andando.
Eles formam colônias com cerca de 10.

It skillfully controls the intensity of.en: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
It skillfully controls the intensity of.zh-tw: 它巧妙地控制尾部火焰的強度，使敵人保持在理想的距離。
It skillfully controls the intensity of.fr:
Il contrôle habilement l'intensité de la flamme
de sa queue pour maintenir une distance idéale
entre lui et ses adversaires lors des combats.
It skillfully controls the intensity of.es:
Controla hábilmente la intensidad del fuego de la cola
para mantener al enemigo a una distancia ideal.
It skillfully controls the intensity of.it:
Controlla abilmente l'intensità delle fiamme sulla
sua coda per tenere i nemici alla distanza ideale.
It skillfully controls the intensity of.de:
Es kontrolliert die Stärke des Feuers an seinem Schweif
geschickt, um Gegner auf idealer Distanz zu halten.
It skillfully controls the intensity of.pt-br:
Controla habilmente a intensidade do fogo em sua cauda
para manter seus inimigos a uma distância ideal.

It spins its two tails like a screw to p.en: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
It spins its two tails like a screw to p.zh-tw: 它像螺絲一樣旋轉兩條尾巴，在水中推進自己。尾巴還可以切掉附著的海藻。
It spins its two tails like a screw to p.fr:
Il se propulse sous l'eau et tranche les algues qui le gênent
à l'aide de ses deux queues, qu'il utilise comme une hélice.
It spins its two tails like a screw to p.es:
Para impulsarse por el agua, gira sus dos colas como
una hélice. Así también corta las algas del camino.
It spins its two tails like a screw to p.it:
Facendo girare le sue code a mo' di elica
si sposta nell'acqua e riesce anche a
falciare le alghe quando rimane impigliato.
It spins its two tails like a screw to p.de:
Es lässt seine Ruten wie eine Schiffsschraube
rotieren, um sich im Wasser fortzubewegen und
Algen zu zerschneiden, die an ihm haften.
It spins its two tails like a screw to p.pt-br:
Ele gira suas duas caudas como um parafuso
para se deslocar pela água.
As caudas também retalham as algas pegajosas.

It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.en: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.zh-tw: 它從後部噴出骯髒的液體。它的惡臭蔓延一英里半徑，將神奇寶貝趕走了。
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.fr:
Son derrière expulse un fluide nauséabond capable de faire
fuir les Pokémon dans un rayon de deux kilomètres.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.es:
Expulsa un fluido maloliente por sus cuartos traseros.
El hedor repele Pokémon en un radio de 2 km.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.it:
Emette un fluido puzzolente dal posteriore. Il
tanfo tiene lontani i Pokémon nel raggio di 2 km.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.de:
Der Gestank der Substanz, die es aus seinem
Hinterleib versprüht, verbreitet sich in einem
Radius von 2 km und vertreibt andere Pokémon.
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. It.pt-br:
Espirra um fluído malcheiroso das costas.
Seu fedor espalha-se por mais de 1 quilômetro,
afastando outros Pokémon.

It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.en: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.zh-tw: 它游得像噴射艇一樣快。它的翅膀邊緣很鋒利，可以切開流冰。
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.fr:
Il nage aussi vite qu'un hors-bord. Le tranchant de
ses ailes peut fendre un bloc de glace à la dérive.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.es:
Nada tan rápido como un fueraborda. Con los
afilados bordes de sus alas puede cortar el hielo.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.it:
Nuota veloce come una moto d'acqua. Le estremità
delle ali sono aguzze e spaccano anche il ghiaccio.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.de:
Es schwimmt so schnell wie ein Rennboot. Seine Flügel
haben scharfe Seiten und können Packeis schneiden.
It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edge.pt-br:
Movimenta-se tão rápido quanto uma lancha.
As suas asas afiadas são capazes de fatiar icebergs.

It used to have a shell on its back long.en: It used to have a shell on its back long ago. This species is closely related to Pokémon like Shellder.
It used to have a shell on its back long.zh-tw: 很久以前，它的背上曾經有一個殼。這個物種與貝殼怪等神奇寶貝有密切關係。
It used to have a shell on its back long.fr:
Il avait autrefois une coquille sur le dos. C'est un proche parent
de Kokiyas et d'autres espèces de Pokémon similaires.
It used to have a shell on its back long.es:
Antiguamente cargaba con un caparazón al lomo.
Es un Pokémon estrechamente emparentado
con los Shellder y otras especies similares.
It used to have a shell on its back long.it:
In passato aveva una conchiglia sul dorso.
La sua specie è strettamente imparentata
con quella di Shellder e altri Pokémon simili.
It used to have a shell on its back long.de:
Vor langer Zeit hatte es eine Muschelschale
auf dem Rücken. Diese Art ist eng verwandt
mit Pokémon wie Muschas.
It used to have a shell on its back long.pt-br:
Antigamente, tinha uma concha em suas costas.
Esta espécie está fortemente relacionada a
Pokémon como Shellder.

It uses its tails for everything. If it.en: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.
It uses its tails for everything. If it.zh-tw: 它用尾巴做一切事情。如果它用兩條尾巴纏住你並擠壓你，那就證明它真的喜歡你。
It uses its tails for everything. If it.fr:
Il utilise toujours ses deux queues pour faire
la moindre tâche. Il s'en sert aussi pour enlacer
les gens qu'il affectionne tout particulièrement.
It uses its tails for everything. If it.es:
Utiliza las dos colas para todo. Cuando abraza
a alguien con ellas significa que esa persona
se ha ganado por completo su confianza.
It uses its tails for everything. If it.it:
Usa le code per fare tutto. Se abbraccia
qualcuno con entrambe le code, significa che
prova un grande affetto per questa persona.
It uses its tails for everything. If it.de:
Es benutzt seine zwei Schweife für alles, was es tut.
Wenn es jemanden mit ihnen umarmt, ist das ein
Beweis seiner Zuneigung.
It uses its tails for everything. If it.pt-br:
Usa suas caudas para tudo. Se enroscar você com suas
duas caudas e der um apertão, é sinal de que gosta muito
de você.

It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.en: It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from hardened soil.
It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.zh-tw: 當暴露在陽光下時，它會利用整個身體進行光合作用。它的外殼是由硬化的土壤製成的。
It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.fr:
Il s'expose à la lumière du soleil pour que
son corps l'assimile par photosynthèse.
Sa carapace est composée de terre durcie.
It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.es:
Al bañarlo los rayos de sol, realiza la fotosíntesis con todo
el cuerpo. Su caparazón está formado por tierra endurecida.
It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.it:
Si espone ai raggi solari ed esegue la fotosintesi con
tutto il corpo. La sua corazza è fatta di terra rassodata.
It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.de:
Es badet im Sonnenlicht und betreibt dabei mit
dem ganzen Körper Fotosynthese. Sein Panzer
besteht aus hartem Lehm.
It uses its whole body to photosynthesiz.pt-br:
Usa o corpo todo para fazer fotossíntese ao se expor
à luz do sol. Seu casco é feito de solo endurecido.

It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.en: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.zh-tw: 它通常緊貼懸崖。當它發現獵物時，它會展開翅膀並滑翔下來進行攻擊。
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.fr:
Il s'accroche souvent aux falaises. Sa proie
repérée, il plane vers elle pour l'attaquer.
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.es:
A veces se sujeta a los precipicios. Cuando divisa
una presa, despliega sus alas y planea para atacar.
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.it:
Di solito sta attaccato agli scogli. Attacca
la preda spalancando le ali e planando.
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.de:
Es hängt meist an Klippen. Erspäht es Beute,
spreizt es seine Flügel und greift diese sofort an.
It usually clings to cliffs. When it spo.pt-br:
Costuma agarrar-se a penhascos. Ao avistar sua presa,
abre as asas e mergulha para o ataque.

It will always obey the commands of a sk.en: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
It will always obey the commands of a sk.zh-tw: 它總是服從熟練訓練師的命令。它的行為源於遠古時期的群居生活。
It will always obey the commands of a sk.fr:
Il obéit toujours aux ordres de son Dresseur
si celui-ci est très doué. Son comportement
vient de l'époque reculée où il vivait en meute.
It will always obey the commands of a sk.es:
Siempre obedece a los buenos Entrenadores.
Está acostumbrado a vivir en jaurías en estado salvaje.
It will always obey the commands of a sk.it:
La sua eccezionale obbedienza verso gli Allenatori
esperti deriva dall'antica abitudine di vivere in branchi.
It will always obey the commands of a sk.de:
Es wird stets die Befehle eines begabten Trainers
befolgen. Dieses Verhalten geht darauf zurück,
dass es früher im Rudel lebte.
It will always obey the commands of a sk.pt-br:
Sempre obedece aos comandos de um Treinador
habilidoso. Seu comportamento é o resultado de viver
em matilhas eras atrás.

It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.en: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.zh-tw: 如果它發現一個足夠舒適的巢穴，它會聲稱另一個神奇寶貝的巢穴是自己的。
It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.fr:
Il n'hésitera pas à voler le nid d'autres Pokémon
et à s'y installer si celui-ci est confortable.
It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.es:
Si se siente a gusto, no tiene ningún reparo en
apropiarse de las moradas de otros Pokémon.
It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.it:
Si introduce sfacciatamente nelle tane degli
altri Pokémon rivendicandole poi come proprie.
It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.de:
Behagt ihm die Behausung eines anderen Pokémon,
bleibt Shnurgarst einfach da und nistet sich dort ein.
It would claim another Pokémon's nest as.pt-br:
Se encontra um ninho de outro Pokémon que acha
confortável o bastante, toma-o para si.

It's said that no foe can remain invisib.en: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.
It's said that no foe can remain invisib.zh-tw: 據說路卡利歐無法對任何敵人保持隱形，因為它可以探測到光環——甚至是它無法看到的敵人的光環。
It's said that no foe can remain invisib.fr:
On dit qu'il peut repérer ses ennemis, même
lorsqu'ils sont invisibles, car il ressent leur aura.
It's said that no foe can remain invisib.es:
Dicen que, como es capaz de detectar auras,
puede percibir a sus rivales aunque no los vea.
It's said that no foe can remain invisib.it:
Si dice che riesca a individuare anche
gli avversari invisibili percependone l'aura.
It's said that no foe can remain invisib.de:
Man sagt, es könne sogar unsichtbare Gegner ausmachen,
weil es dazu fähig ist, Auren wahrzunehmen.
It's said that no foe can remain invisib.pt-br:
Como Lucario pode detectar auras, acredita-se
que nenhum inimigo é invisível a seus olhos.
Até mesmo aqueles que ele não consegue ver.

Its appearance changes depending on wher.en: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
Its appearance changes depending on wher.zh-tw: 它的外觀會根據它的進化位置而變化。手上的材料變成了它身體的一部分。
Its appearance changes depending on wher.fr:
Son apparence varie selon le lieu d'évolution.
Son corps est façonné avec les matériaux à disposition.
Its appearance changes depending on wher.es:
Su apariencia varía según dónde evolucione.
Los materiales que haya pasan a formar parte de su cuerpo.
Its appearance changes depending on wher.it:
Il suo aspetto dipende dal luogo in cui si evolve.
Tutto ciò che ha intorno va a costituire il suo corpo.
Its appearance changes depending on wher.de:
Die Umgebung, in der es sich entwickelt, bestimmt
sein Aussehen. Es formt seinen Körper mithilfe
der umliegenden Materialien.
Its appearance changes depending on wher.pt-br:
Muda de aparência dependendo do local
de sua evolução. Os materiais que tiver
à mão se tornam parte de seu corpo.

Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.en: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.zh-tw: 它脆弱的外殼偶爾會噴出強烈的火焰，並在其全身循環。
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.fr:
Sa coquille, très fragile, projette régulièrement
des flammes qui circulent dans son corps.
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.es:
En ocasiones, su resbaladiza concha lanza
intensas llamaradas que recorren todo su cuerpo.
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.it:
A volte intense fiamme partono dal fragile
guscio e avvolgono tutto il suo corpo.
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.de:
Aus seinem porösen Schneckengehäuse sprudeln
Feuerfontänen, die seinen Körper durchfluten.
Its brittle shell occasionally spouts in.pt-br:
Sua frágil concha ocasionalmente lança chamas intensas
que circulam em volta do seu corpo.

Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.en: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.zh-tw: 它不斷的惡作劇和惡行導致它被一個神秘的咒語束縛在一個奇怪的基石上。
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.fr:
Son mauvais comportement lui a valu d'être enchaîné
à une Clé de Voûte par un mystérieux sortilège.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.es:
Por sus constantes fechorías se le acabó uniendo
a una Piedra Espíritu con un misterioso hechizo.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.it:
A causa del suo comportamento molesto
è stato imprigionato in una Roccianima
con un misterioso incantesimo.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.de:
Aufgrund seiner ständigen Untaten wurde es mit
mysteriösen Künsten an einen Spiritkern gebunden.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resul.pt-br:
Sua constante malvadeza e seus delitos causaram
sua ligação a uma pedra por um feitiço misterioso.

Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.en: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.zh-tw: 它的眼睛無需移動頭部即可看到 360 度。它不會錯過獵物——甚至是獵物背後的獵物。
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.fr:
Il voit à 360° sans avoir à tourner la tête.
Il ne loupe jamais une proie, même dans son dos.
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.es:
Su campo visual es de 360° sin girar la cabeza.
Detecta hasta las presas que están a su espalda.
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.it:
Ha un campo visivo a 360 gradi senza muovere la
testa. Riesce a vedere persino le prede alle sue spalle.
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.de:
Mit seinen Augen hat es einen Blickwinkel von 360 Grad.
Es sieht sogar Beute, die sich hinter ihm befindet.
Its eyes can see 360 degrees without mov.pt-br:
Seus olhos podem enxergar 360 graus sem que ele mova
a cabeça. Ele não perde uma presa – mesmo aquela
que está atrás.

Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.en: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.zh-tw: 它燃燒的後端由腹部產生的氣體提供燃料。即使下雨也無法撲滅大火。
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.fr:
La flamme de sa queue est alimentée par un gaz de
son estomac. Même la pluie ne saurait l'éteindre.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.es:
El gas de su panza alimenta el fuego de su
parte trasera, que ni la lluvia puede extinguir.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.it:
Le fiamme sulla coda, alimentate dai gas della
pancia, non si spengono neppure quando piove.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.de:
Das Feuer an seinem Hinterteil wird durch Gase
im Bauch genährt. Selbst Regen löscht es nicht.
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made.pt-br:
Sua cauda flamejante é alimentada pelos gases
gerados em seu estômago.
Nem mesmo a chuva consegue apagar o fogo.

Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.en: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.zh-tw: 它的花朵散發出令人放鬆的香味。 Roselia 的香氣越濃，就越健康。
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.fr:
Ses fleurs dégagent un parfum relaxant. Plus cet
arôme est fort, meilleure est la santé de Rosélia.
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.es:
Las flores que tiene emanan un aroma relajante.
Cuanto más intenso, mejor es su estado de salud.
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.it:
Dai suoi fiori si diffonde una fragranza rilassante. Più
è intenso il suo profumo, più il Pokémon è in salute.
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.de:
Seine Blüten verströmen einen entspannenden Duft.
Je stärker dieser Duft ist, desto gesünder ist Roselia.
Its flowers give off a relaxing fragranc.pt-br:
As suas flores exalam uma fragrância relaxante.
Quanto mais forte for o seu aroma,
mais saudável será Roselia.

Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.en: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.zh-tw: 它的腿很短。每當它絆倒時，它僵硬的觸角就會發出木琴般的聲音。
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.fr:
Il possède de courtes pattes. Quand il tombe,
ses antennes solides s'entrechoquent et émettent
des sons semblables à ceux d'un xylophone.
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.es:
Tiene las patas cortas. Cada vez que se tropieza,
sus antenas chocan y suenan como un xilófono.
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.it:
Quando inciampa con le sue zampe corte, le antenne si
urtano producendo un suono simile a quello di uno xilofono.
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.de:
Seine Beine sind kurz. Stolpert es, reiben seine
starren Antennen aneinander und klingen dabei
wie ein Xylofon.
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles.pt-br:
Suas pernas são curtas. Sempre que ele tropeça,
suas pomposas antenas estalam com um som
parecido com um xilofone.

Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.en: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.zh-tw: 它的毒力很強，但很少有人使用。這種神奇寶貝更喜歡使用物理力量，利用其碾碎汽車的力量進行狂暴。
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.fr:
Son poison est violent, mais il s'en sert très
rarement. Il se déchaîne avec une telle force
qu'il pourrait réduire une voiture en pièces.
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.es:
Posee un veneno muy potente, pero que usa muy
poco. Con la extraordinaria fuerza que concentra
al enfurecerse podría hacer añicos un coche.
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.it:
Le sue tossine sono letali ma se ne serve di rado.
Semina distruzione con la sua forza prodigiosa
che gli permette di sfasciare persino automobili.
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.de:
Sein Gift ist stark, aber es setzt es nur selten ein.
Ist es richtig wütend, schlägt es mit einer Wucht zu,
die selbst Autos zu Schrott verarbeitet.
Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees.pt-br:
Seu veneno é poderoso, mas é raramente usado.
Este Pokémon prefere usar sua força física, partindo
para a briga com um vigor destrutivo.

Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.en:
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught
humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.zh-tw:
被稱為“情感的存在”。它教導了
人類是悲傷、痛苦和歡樂的高貴。
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.fr:
On l'appelle " être de l'émotion ". Il enseigne aux
hommes la beauté de la tristesse, la douleur et la joie.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.es:
Se le conoce como el Ser de la Emoción. Enseñó
a los humanos la nobleza del dolor y la alegría.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.it:
Detto "Essere delle emozioni". Ha insegnato agli
uomini la nobiltà di tristezza, gioia e dolore.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.de:
"Das fühlende Wesen". Es lehrt die Menschen
die Ideale von Trauer, Schmerz und Freude.
Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taug.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é conhecido como o ser de emoção
e ensinou aos humanos a nobreza do sofrimento,
da dor e da alegria.

Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.en:
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said
that it can wipe out the memory of those who see
its eyes.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.zh-tw:
被稱為“知識的存在”。據說
它可以抹去那些看過的人的記憶
它的眼睛。
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.fr:
On l'appelle " être du savoir ". On raconte que
son regard a le pouvoir d'effacer la mémoire.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.es:
Se le conoce como el Ser de la Sabiduría. Se dice
que puede borrar la memoria con una mirada.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.it:
Noto come "Essere della conoscenza". Pare che
faccia perdere la memoria a chiunque lo fissi.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.de:
"Das wissende Wesen". Es soll die Erinnerungen
derer löschen, die ihm in die Augen sehen.
Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é conhecido como o ser de conhecimento
e dizem que pode apagar a memória daqueles
que veem os seus olhos.

Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.en:
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the
bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.zh-tw:
被稱為“意志力的存在”。它睡在
湖底維持世界平衡。
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.fr:
On l'appelle " être de la volonté ". Il dort au fond
d'un lac pour maintenir l'équilibre du monde.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.es:
Se le conoce como el Ser de la Voluntad. Duerme
en el fondo de un lago para equilibrar el mundo.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.it:
Detto "Essere della volontà". Dorme sul fondo di
un lago per mantenere il mondo in equilibrio.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.de:
"Das starke Wesen". Es schläft auf dem Grund
eines Sees und hält so die Welt in Balance.
Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sl.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é conhecido como o ser de força
de vontade e dorme no leito de um lago para garantir
o equilíbrio do mundo.

Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.en: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.zh-tw: Lopunny 不斷監視著周圍的環境。如果危險臨近，這只神奇寶貝會用超破壞性的踢來回應。
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.fr:
Constamment sur le qui-vive, il donne des coups de pied
particulièrement dévastateurs si une menace approche.
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.es:
Está siempre atento a lo que ocurre a su
alrededor. Si advierte peligro, se defenderá
con patadas de potencia devastadora.
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.it:
Presta sempre attenzione all'ambiente
circostante e in caso di pericolo sfodera
calci di straordinaria potenza distruttiva.
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.de:
Schlapor behält seine Umgebung stets im Auge.
Wenn Gefahr im Verzug ist, setzt es sich mit
vernichtenden Tritten zur Wehr.
Lopunny is constantly monitoring its sur.pt-br:
Lopunny está constantemente monitorando seus
arredores. Se o perigo se aproxima, este Pokémon
responde com chutes superdestrutivos.

Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.en: Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.
Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.zh-tw: 將能量從你的 1 個後備神奇寶貝轉移到你的活躍神奇寶貝上。
Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.it: Sposta un'Energia da 1 dei tuoi Pokémon in panchina al tuo Pokémon attivo.
Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.fr: Déplacez une Énergie de l'un de vos Pokémon de Banc vers votre Pokémon Actif.
Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.es: Mueve una Energía de 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca a tu Pokémon Activo.
Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.pt-br: Mova uma Energia de 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco para o seu Pokémon Ativo.
Move an Energy from 1 of your Benched Po.de: Verschiebe eine Energie von einem deiner Bank-Pokémon auf dein Aktives Pokémon.

Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.en: Once during your turn, you may heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.zh-tw: 在你的回合中，你可以治療每隻神奇寶貝造成的 10 點傷害。
Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes curar 10 daños de cada uno de tus Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi curare 10 danni a ciascuno dei tuoi Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez soigner 10 dégâts de chacun de vos Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você pode curar 10 pontos de dano de cada um dos seus Pokémon.
Once during your turn, you may heal 10 d.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 10 Schadenspunkte bei jedem deiner Pokémon heilen.

People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.en: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.
People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.zh-tw: 人們用斯卡莫里脫落的羽毛製作劍，因此這只神奇寶貝是紋章設計中的流行元素。
People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.fr:
Ce Pokémon orne souvent les blasons, car les plumes
qu'il perd sont utilisées pour forger des épées.
People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.es:
Aparece a menudo en escudos heráldicos, pues se
pueden forjar espadas a partir de las plumas que pierde.
People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.it:
Le piume perse da Skarmory sono utilizzate
per produrre spade. Per questo è molto
apprezzato come motivo degli stemmi nobiliari.
People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.de:
Es wird gern als Vorlage für Wappenmotive
genutzt, da aus den Federn, die ihm ausfallen,
Schwerter hergestellt werden.
People fashion swords from Skarmory's sh.pt-br:
As pessoas forjam espadas com as penas que caíram
de Skarmory, por isso, a imagem deste Pokémon é
um elemento popular em brasões.

Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.en: Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic {C} Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. This card can't retreat.
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.zh-tw: 像使用 40 HP 基本 {C} 神奇寶貝一樣使用這張卡。在你回合中的任何時候，你都可以將這張牌從遊戲中丟棄。這張卡不能撤退。
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.fr: Jouez cette carte comme si c'était un Pokémon {C} de base avec 40 PV. N'importe quand pendant votre tour, vous pouvez défausser cette carte du jeu. Cette carte ne peut pas battre en retraite.
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.es:
Juega esta carta como si fuera un Pokémon {C} Básico de 40 PS. En cualquier momento durante tu turno, puedes descartar esta carta del juego.
Esta carta no puede retirarse.
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.it: Gioca questa carta come se fosse un Pokémon Base {C} con 40 PS. Durante il tuo turno, in qualsiasi momento, puoi scartare questa carta dal gioco. Questa carta non può ritirarsi.
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.de:
Spiele diese Karte, als ob sie ein Basis-{C}-Pokémon mit 40 KP wäre. Du kannst diese Karte jederzeit während deines Zuges aus dem Spiel nehmen und auf deinen Ablagestapel legen.
Diese Karte kann sich nicht zurückziehen.
Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Bas.pt-br:
Jogue esta carta como se fosse um Pokémon {C} Básico com PS 40.
A qualquer momento, durante o seu turno, você poderá descartar esta carta do jogo.
Esta carta não pode recuar.

Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.en: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.zh-tw: 熱帶地區資源豐富。當它跳舞時，花瓣相互摩擦，發出悅耳的鈴聲。
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.fr:
Ce Pokémon vit en nombre dans les tropiques.
Quand il danse, ses pétales frottent les uns
contre les autres et émettent un son mélodieux.
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.es:
Abunda en los trópicos. Al bailar, sus pétalos
se rozan y emiten un agradable sonido.
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.it:
Molto comune ai tropici. Quando danza, i petali
sfregano uno contro l'altro producendo un piacevole suono.
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.de:
Es lebt in den Tropen. Beim Tanzen reiben seine Blüten
aneinander und erzeugen ein wohliges Geräusch.
Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances.pt-br:
Recorrente nos trópicos. Quando dança,
suas pétalas se esfregam umas nas outras
e emitem um som agradável.

Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.en: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.
Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.zh-tw: Porygon-Z 安裝了一個程序，允許它在維度之間移動，但該程序也導致了 Porygon-Z 行為的不穩定。
Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.fr:
Depuis qu'on lui a ajouté un programme
permettant de voyager entre les dimensions,
son comportement est devenu instable.
Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.es:
Se le instaló un software que le permite entrar
y salir de otras dimensiones, pero que provocó
que su comportamiento se volviese inestable.
Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.it:
Da quando gli è stato installato un programma che gli permette
di viaggiare in altre dimensioni, mostra un comportamento instabile.
Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.de:
Seit eine neue Software installiert wurde, die es
zu interdimensionalen Reisen befähigen sollte,
wurde sein Verhalten instabil.
Porygon-Z had a program installed to all.pt-br:
Porygon-Z tem um programa instalado permitindo
que se desloque entre dimensões. Porém, este programa
causou uma certa instabilidade em seu comportamento.

Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.en: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.zh-tw: 阻止對方寶可夢對這只寶可夢的所有攻擊效果。
Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.fr: Évitez tous les effets d'attaques utilisées par les Pokémon de votre adversaire infligés à ce Pokémon.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.es: Se evitan todos los efectos de los ataques usados por los Pokémon de tu rival e infligidos a este Pokémon.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.it: Previeni tutti gli effetti inflitti a questo Pokémon dagli attacchi usati dai Pokémon del tuo avversario.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.de: Verhindere alle Effekte der von Pokémon deines Gegners eingesetzten Attacken, die diesem Pokémon zugefügt werden.
Prevent all effects of attacks used by y.pt-br: Previna todos os efeitos de ataques usados pelos Pokémon do seu oponente causados a este Pokémon.

Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.en: Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your deck onto your Bench.
Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.zh-tw: 從你的牌組中隨機將 1 只基礎寶可夢放到你的備戰區上。
Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.fr: Placez un Pokémon de base au hasard de votre deck sur votre Banc.
Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.es: Pon 1 Pokémon Básico aleatorio de tu baraja en tu Banca.
Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.it: Prendi un Pokémon Base a caso dal tuo mazzo e mettilo nella tua panchina.
Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.de: Lege 1 zufälliges Basis-Pokémon aus deinem Deck auf deine Bank.
Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your dec.pt-br: Coloque 1 Pokémon Básico aleatório do seu baralho no seu Banco.

Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.en: Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagunk from your deck into your hand.
Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.zh-tw: 從你的牌組中隨機將 1 只 Glameow、Stunky 或 Croagunk 置入你的手牌。
Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.fr: Ajoutez une carte au hasard parmi Chaglam, Moufouette, et Cradopaud de votre deck à votre main.
Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.es: Pon 1 carta aleatoria de entre Glameow, Stunky o Croagunk de tu baraja en tu mano.
Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.it: Prendi una carta a caso dal tuo mazzo fra le seguenti: Glameow, Stunky e Croagunk. Poi aggiungila alle carte che hai in mano.
Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.de: Nimm von den Karten Charmian, Skunkapuh und Glibunkel 1 zufällige aus deinem Deck auf deine Hand.
Put 1 random Glameow, Stunky, or Croagun.pt-br: Coloque aleatoriamente 1 carta dentre Glameow, Stunky e Croagunk do seu baralho na sua mão.

Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.en: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.
Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.zh-tw: Registeel 的身體由一種奇怪的材料製成，這種材料具有足夠的柔韌性，可以拉伸和收縮，但也比任何金屬都更耐用。
Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.fr:
Il est fait d'une matière mystérieuse plus solide que n'importe
quel métal, mais assez souple pour pouvoir s'étirer ou se rétrécir.
Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.es:
Está hecho de una misteriosa sustancia
que, pese a ser más dura que cualquier
metal, se contrae y dilata con facilidad.
Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.it:
È composto da un materiale misterioso più
resistente di qualsiasi metallo, ma al contempo
abbastanza morbido da essere elastico.
Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.de:
Es besteht aus einer seltsamen Substanz,
die robuster als jedes Metall, jedoch zugleich
auch weich und elastisch ist.
Registeel's body is made of a strange ma.pt-br:
O corpo de Registeel é composto de um material
estranho que é flexível o bastante para esticar e encolher,
mas mais resistente do que qualquer metal.

Shiny particles are released from its wi.en: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
Shiny particles are released from its wi.zh-tw: 閃亮的粒子像面紗一樣從翅膀上釋放出來。據說它代表新月。
Shiny particles are released from its wi.fr:
Ses ailes libèrent un rideau de particules brillantes.
Ce Pokémon symboliserait le croissant de lune.
Shiny particles are released from its wi.es:
Sus alas emiten un velo de partículas brillantes.
Se dice que representa un cuarto lunar.
Shiny particles are released from its wi.it:
Volando rilascia un velo di particelle brillanti.
Si dice che rappresenti la luna crescente.
Shiny particles are released from its wi.de:
Seine Flügel geben schimmernde Partikel ab,
die wie ein Schleier herabrieseln. Man sagt,
es verkörpere die Mondsichel.
Shiny particles are released from its wi.pt-br:
Suas asas liberam partículas brilhantes como um véu.
Dizem que representa a lua crescente.

Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.en: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.zh-tw: 有人說，這只神奇寶貝是一群帶著遺憾的靈魂的集合，在黃昏中默默地漂流。
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.fr:
Ce Pokémon, qui flotte silencieusement au crépuscule,
serait né des âmes des défunts rongés par les regrets.
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.es:
Se dice que está formado por almas en pena.
Al caer la noche, flota a la deriva en silencio sepulcral.
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.it:
Si dice che sia formato dall'aggregazione
di anime che hanno lasciato la vita con dei
rimpianti. Fluttua silenzioso all'imbrunire.
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.de:
Man sagt, es bestehe aus den Seelen derer,
die voller Groll verstorben sind. Es treibt lautlos
im Zwielicht dahin.
Some say this Pokémon is a collection of.pt-br:
Dizem que este Pokémon é um conjunto de almas cheias
de arrependimentos, flutuando silenciosamente
ao anoitecer.

Strong electricity courses through the t.en: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
Strong electricity courses through the t.zh-tw: 強大的電流穿過它鋒利的爪子的尖端。輕微的抓傷會使敵人昏厥。
Strong electricity courses through the t.fr:
Le courant qui circule à la pointe de ses griffes
aiguisées est tellement puissant que ses ennemis
perdent connaissance au moindre effleurement.
Strong electricity courses through the t.es:
Por las puntas de sus garras pasa una fuerte corriente
eléctrica. El mínimo roce debilita al enemigo.
Strong electricity courses through the t.it:
Dalla punta degli artigli affilati rilascia
una corrente elettrica così intensa che
gli basta sfiorare i nemici per metterli KO.
Strong electricity courses through the t.de:
Durch die Spitzen seiner scharfen Krallen strömt Elektrizität.
Selbst kleine Kratzer verursachen Ohnmacht.
Strong electricity courses through the t.pt-br:
Uma poderosa eletricidade flui pelas pontas
de suas garras afiadas. Um pequeno arranhão
é suficiente para causar desmaios nos inimigos.

Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched P.en: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it to the Active Spot.
Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched P.zh-tw: 將對手後備場的 1 只受到傷害的寶可夢切換到活躍點。

Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to Mesprit or Azelf.
Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區獲取 {P} 能量並將其附加到 Mesprit 或 Azelf 上。

Take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {P} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a Mesprit o Azelf.

Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {R} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a questo Pokémon.

Take a {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue 1 Energia {R} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a a este Pokémon.

Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.en: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.zh-tw: Tangrowth 有兩條手臂，可以隨意伸展。最近的研究表明，這些手臂實際上是一束藤蔓。
Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.fr:
La science a récemment découvert que
les deux bras qu'il peut allonger à volonté
sont en fait des lianes entrelacées.
Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.es:
Se ha descubierto recientemente que los dos brazos que
estira a voluntad son en realidad lianas enredadas entre sí.
Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.it:
Può estendere le braccia a piacimento. In seguito a recenti
ricerche si è scoperto che sono in realtà fasci di liane.
Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.de:
Jüngsten Erkenntnissen zufolge bestehen seine
zwei Arme, die es beliebig verlängern kann,
aus gebündelten Ranken.
Tangrowth has two arms that it can exten.pt-br:
Tangrowth tem dois braços, os quais pode estender como
bem quiser. Pesquisas recentes mostraram que esses
braços são, na verdade, um monte de trepadeiras.

The amount of electrical energy this Pok.en: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
The amount of electrical energy this Pok.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝產生的電能與其脈衝頻率成正比。當 Electiire 處於戰斗狀態時，電壓會跳躍。
The amount of electrical energy this Pok.fr:
La quantité d'électricité qu'il génère est
proportionnelle à son pouls. Quand il livre
un combat, son voltage augmente aussitôt.
The amount of electrical energy this Pok.es:
La cantidad de electricidad que genera es
proporcional a su pulso. Al enzarzarse en
combate, su voltaje aumenta drásticamente.
The amount of electrical energy this Pok.it:
Produce una quantità di elettricità direttamente
proporzionale alla sua frequenza cardiaca.
Durante la lotta il voltaggio si alza all'istante.
The amount of electrical energy this Pok.de:
Wie viel Strom es erzeugt, ist abhängig von
seinem Puls. Im Kampf steigt Elevolteks
elektrische Spannung schlagartig an.
The amount of electrical energy this Pok.pt-br:
A quantidade de energia elétrica que este Pokémon
produz é proporcional à sua pulsação. A voltagem
aumenta drasticamente quando Electivire está batalhando.

The bones of its face are huge and hard,.en: The bones of its face are huge and hard, so they were mistaken for its spine until after this Pokémon was successfully restored.
The bones of its face are huge and hard,.zh-tw: 它的臉部骨骼巨大且堅硬，因此被誤認為是它的脊柱，直到這只神奇寶貝被成功修復後。
The bones of its face are huge and hard,.fr:
Jusqu'à ce qu'on reconstitue ce Pokémon
avec succès, on prenait les grands os solides qui
couvrent son visage pour sa colonne vertébrale.
The bones of its face are huge and hard,.es:
Hasta que no se regeneró por completo a este
Pokémon, se pensaba que los grandes y recios
huesos de su rostro eran su columna vertebral.
The bones of its face are huge and hard,.it:
Prima che venisse rigenerato si riteneva
erroneamente che le grandi e solide
ossa del muso facessero parte del dorso.
The bones of its face are huge and hard,.de:
Als man Fossilien noch nicht zurückverwandeln
konnte, war man der Ansicht, sein großer, harter
Gesichtsknochen sei sein Rücken.
The bones of its face are huge and hard,.pt-br:
Os ossos de seu rosto são enormes e resistentes e,
por isso, eram confundidos com sua espinha
até este Pokémon ser restaurado.

The extension and contraction of its mus.en: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
The extension and contraction of its mus.zh-tw: 其肌肉的伸展和收縮會產生電力。當遇到困難時它會發光。
The extension and contraction of its mus.fr:
Ses muscles génèrent un courant électrique lorsqu'ils
travaillent. Son corps s'illumine en cas de danger.
The extension and contraction of its mus.es:
La extensión y contracción de sus músculos
genera electricidad. Brilla cuando está en peligro.
The extension and contraction of its mus.it:
Quando si muove, le contrazioni dei suoi muscoli producono
elettricità. Se si sente minacciato, il suo corpo si illumina.
The extension and contraction of its mus.de:
Mit jeder Bewegung erzeugt es durch das Strecken
und Zusammenziehen seiner Muskeln Elektrizität.
Steckt es in der Klemme, leuchtet es.
The extension and contraction of its mus.pt-br:
A expansão e contração de seus músculos
gera eletricidade. Ele brilha quando está em perigo.

The lawn mower is one of the household a.en: The lawn mower is one of the household appliances that led to the development of the Rotom Dex.
The lawn mower is one of the household a.zh-tw: 割草機是推動 Rotom Dex 發展的家用電器之一。
The lawn mower is one of the household a.fr:
La tondeuse à gazon est l'un des appareils électroménagers
qui ont permis la création du Motisma-Dex.
The lawn mower is one of the household a.es:
El cortacésped es uno de los aparatos que
impulsaron el desarrollo de la RotomDex.
The lawn mower is one of the household a.it:
Il tagliaerba è uno degli elettrodomestici che hanno
reso possibile la creazione del Pokédex Rotom.
The lawn mower is one of the household a.de:
Der Rasenmäher ist eines der elektrischen
Haushaltsgeräte, die zur Entwicklung des
Rotom-Pokédex führten.
The lawn mower is one of the household a.pt-br:
O cortador de grama é um dos eletrodomésticos
que levaram ao desenvolvimento do Pokédex Rotom.

The line running down its side can store.en: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
The line running down its side can store.zh-tw: 沿著其側面延伸的線可以儲存陽光。它在夜間閃閃發光。
The line running down its side can store.fr:
La ligne qui fait le tour de son corps emmagasine
l'énergie solaire et brille intensément la nuit.
The line running down its side can store.es:
La línea que le recorre el costado puede almacenar
luz solar. Brilla con mucha fuerza por la noche.
The line running down its side can store.it:
La linea che contorna il suo corpo immagazzina la luce
solare. Di notte si illumina di una luce splendente.
The line running down its side can store.de:
Die Linie an seiner Seite kann Sonnenlicht
speichern. Nachts leuchtet es sehr intensiv.
The line running down its side can store.pt-br:
A linha na lateral de seu corpo armazena luz solar
e brilha intensamente à noite.
