The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.en: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.zh-tw: 貝殼裡似乎充滿了喜悅。據說，如果受到善待，它會分享好運。
The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.fr:
Sa coquille est remplie de joie.
On dit que s'il est bien traité, il porte chance.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.es:
El cascarón parece estar lleno de alegría.
Dicen que trae buena suerte si se le trata con cariño.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.it:
Sembra che il suo guscio sia ricolmo di felicità.
Si dice che porti fortuna se lo si tratta bene.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.de:
Seine Schale ist voll von Freude. Es heißt,
wenn man es freundlich und gut behandelt,
teile es sein Glück.
The shell seems to be filled with joy. I.pt-br:
Sua casca parece ser cheia de alegria e dizem que
compartilha a boa sorte quando é tratado com carinho.

These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.en: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.zh-tw: 這些神奇寶貝從未出現在衝突或動亂附近。最近一段時間，幾乎看不到他們的身影了。
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.fr:
Il ne se montre jamais en temps de guerre ou de
conflit. Ces derniers temps, il est rare de le croiser.
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.es:
Este Pokémon jamás se muestra en lugares
donde reine la discordia y la disensión.
Últimamente apenas se avistan ejemplares.
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.it:
Non appare dove è in corso un conflitto o
un litigio. Di recente non si vede quasi mai.
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.de:
Es zeigt sich nie an Orten, wo Streit und
Zwietracht herrschen. In letzter Zeit wird es
kaum noch gesehen.
These Pokémon are never seen anywhere ne.pt-br:
Estes Pokémon nunca são vistos perto de conflitos
ou confusão. Na verdade, têm sido vistos
muito raramente em tempos recentes.

They communicate with one another using.en: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
They communicate with one another using.zh-tw: 他們利用自己的氣場相互交流。他們能夠整夜奔跑。
They communicate with one another using.fr:
Les Riolu communiquent entre eux à l'aide de
leur aura. Ils sont capables de courir toute la nuit.
They communicate with one another using.es:
Se comunica con los suyos emitiendo ondas.
Puede pasarse toda una noche corriendo.
They communicate with one another using.it:
Comunica con i suoi simili tramite l'aura.
Può correre un'intera notte senza stancarsi.
They communicate with one another using.de:
Dieses Pokémon nutzt seine Aura, um mit seinen
Artgenossen zu kommunizieren. Es kann eine
ganze Nacht lang laufen.
They communicate with one another using.pt-br:
Eles comunicam-se uns com os outros usando suas auras.
São capazes de correr a noite inteira.

They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.en: They normally inhabit rocky seashores, but in times of continuous rain, they can sometimes be found in the mountains, far from the sea.
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.zh-tw: 它們通常棲息在岩石海岸，但在持續下雨的時候，有時也可以在遠離大海的山上找到它們。
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.fr:
On le rencontre généralement sur les côtes, mais
quand il pleut suffisamment longtemps, on peut
l'apercevoir dans les montagnes, loin de la mer.
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.es:
Normalmente viven en la costa, pero también
es posible encontrarlos en montañas alejadas
del mar cuando caen lluvias persistentes.
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.it:
Di solito vive sui litorali rocciosi, ma in periodi
di piogge durature può capitare di trovarlo
anche su monti molto distanti dal mare.
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.de:
Normalerweise hält es sich an der Küste auf,
doch bei fortdauerndem Regen trifft man es
auch fernab vom Meer in den Bergen an.
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, b.pt-br:
Costumam habitar litorais rochosos, mas, em épocas
de chuvas constantes, podem ser encontrados
nas montanhas, longe do mar.

They say that it will appear before kind.en: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
They say that it will appear before kind.zh-tw: 據說它會出現在善良、有愛心的人面前，給他們帶來幸福。
They say that it will appear before kind.fr:
On dit qu'il se montre aux personnes dotées
d'un cœur pur pour leur apporter joie et bonheur.
They say that it will appear before kind.es:
Dicen que se le aparece a la gente de
buen corazón y la inunda de felicidad.
They say that it will appear before kind.it:
Si dice che appaia alle persone buone
e premurose, inondandole di felicità.
They say that it will appear before kind.de:
Man sagt, es zeige sich nur gutherzigen und
einfühlsamen Menschen und überschütte sie
dann mit Freude.
They say that it will appear before kind.pt-br:
Diz-se que ele surgirá perante pessoas afetuosas
e de bom coração para inundá-las de felicidade.

This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of.pt-br: Este ataque também causa 30 pontos de dano a 1 dos Pokémon no Banco do seu oponente.

This attack does 10 damage to each of yo.fr: Cette attaque inflige 10 dégâts à chacun des Pokémon de votre adversaire.
This attack does 10 damage to each of yo.es: Este ataque hace 10 puntos de daño a cada uno de los Pokémon de tu rival.
This attack does 10 damage to each of yo.it: Questo attacco infligge 10 danni a ciascuno dei Pokémon del tuo avversario.
This attack does 10 damage to each of yo.de: Diese Attacke fügt jedem Pokémon deines Gegners 10 Schadenspunkte zu.
This attack does 10 damage to each of yo.pt-br: Este ataque causa 10 pontos de dano a cada um dos Pokémon do seu oponente.

This attack does more damage equal to th.en: This attack does more damage equal to the damage this Pokémon has on it.
This attack does more damage equal to th.zh-tw: 這次攻擊造成的傷害等於該寶可夢對其造成的傷害。

This attack does more damage equal to th.es: Este ataque hace una cantidad de daño adicional igual al daño que ya tenga este Pokémon.

This attack does more damage equal to th.de: Diese Attacke fügt zusätzlichen Schaden in Höhe des Schadens zu, der diesem Pokémon bereits zugefügt wurde.
This attack does more damage equal to th.pt-br: Este ataque causa dano a mais, equivalente ao dano que este Pokémon tiver nele.

This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.en: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.zh-tw: 這種狡猾的神奇寶貝隱藏在黑暗的掩護下，等待攻擊獵物。
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.fr:
Ce Pokémon rusé se cache dans l'ombre
et attend patiemment de fondre sur sa proie.
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.es:
Este Pokémon es muy astuto. Se vale de la
oscuridad de la noche para atacar a su presa.
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.it:
Questo scaltro Pokémon si cela
nell'oscurità per lanciarsi sulla preda.
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.de:
Dieses hinterlistige Pokémon nutzt den Schutz der
Dunkelheit, um ahnungsloser Beute aufzulauern.
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cov.pt-br:
Este Pokémon astuto se esconde na escuridão,
esperando para atacar sua presa.

This is a Porygon that was updated with.en: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.
This is a Porygon that was updated with.zh-tw: 這是一個用特殊數據更新的 Porygon。 Porygon2 通過自行學習許多不同的主題來發展自己。
This is a Porygon that was updated with.fr:
Fruit de la mise à jour d'un Porygon avec des données spéciales,
il peut apprendre et se développer de manière autonome.
This is a Porygon that was updated with.es:
Se trata de una versión mejorada de Porygon mediante un
software especial. Tiene capacidad de aprendizaje autónomo.
This is a Porygon that was updated with.it:
È un Porygon aggiornato con dei dati particolari.
Cresce imparando autonomamente svariate cose.
This is a Porygon that was updated with.de:
Durch ein Update mit besonderen Daten wurde
Porygon zu Porygon2. Es erweitert sein Wissen,
indem es selbstständig verschiedene Dinge lernt.
This is a Porygon that was updated with.pt-br:
Este é um Porygon que foi atualizado com dados
especiais. Porygon2 se desenvolve ao aprender
sobre diversos assuntos por conta própria.

This Pokémon can be spotted in wall pain.zh-tw: 這種神奇寶貝可以追溯到一萬年前的壁畫中。有一段時間，人們認為它已經滅絕了。
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall pain.fr:
On le retrouve dessiné sur des fresques
murales vieilles de 10 000 ans. On a cru pendant
un temps que son espèce s'était éteinte.
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall pain.es:
Aparece representado en pinturas rupestres de hace 10 000
años. Hubo un tiempo en el que se lo consideró extinto.
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall pain.it:
Si trova raffigurato nelle pitture rupestri di 10.000
anni fa. Per un periodo si riteneva che fosse estinto.
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall pain.de:
Sie sind schon auf 10 000 Jahre alten
Wandmalereien abgebildet. Es gab Zeiten,
in denen man sie für ausgestorben hielt.
This Pokémon can be spotted in wall pain.pt-br:
Imagens deste Pokémon já foram encontradas em pinturas
rupestres que remontam a 10.000 anos. Antigamente,
acreditava-se que Mamoswine estava extinto.

This Pokémon startles people in the midd.en: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.
This Pokémon startles people in the midd.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝會在半夜嚇到人們。它聚集恐懼作為能量。
This Pokémon startles people in the midd.fr: Il fait peur aux gens en pleine nuit et se nourrit de leur frayeur.
This Pokémon startles people in the midd.es:
Sorprende a la gente en mitad de la noche
y acumula su miedo como energía.
This Pokémon startles people in the midd.it:
Un Pokémon che terrorizza la gente nel cuore della
notte. Assorbe la paura per usarla come energia.
This Pokémon startles people in the midd.de:
Ein Pokémon, das Menschen mitten in der Nacht
erschreckt. Es sammelt die Angst als seine Energie.
This Pokémon startles people in the midd.pt-br:
Este Pokémon assusta pessoas no meio da noite.
Acumula o medo para usar como energia.

This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.en: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks from {R} or {W} Pokémon.
This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.zh-tw: 該神奇寶貝因 {R} 或 {W} 神奇寶貝的攻擊而受到 -20 點傷害。
This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.fr: Ce Pokémon subit − 20 dégâts provenant des attaques des Pokémon {R} ou {W}.
This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.es: Los ataques de los Pokémon {R} o {W} hacen -20 puntos de daño a este Pokémon.
This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.it: Questo Pokémon subisce -20 danni dagli attacchi dei Pokémon {R} o {W}.
This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.de: Diesem Pokémon werden durch Attacken von {R}- oder {W}-Pokémon − 20 Schadenspunkte zugefügt.
This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attac.pt-br: Este Pokémon recebe −20 pontos de dano de ataques de Pokémon {R} ou {W}.

This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.en: This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. It leaps around gleefully after it uses cold air to freeze the area around it.
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.zh-tw: 這個洛托姆已經進入了冰箱。當它使用冷空氣凍結周圍區域後，它會高興地跳來跳去。
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.fr:
Ce Motisma a pris possession d'un réfrigérateur.
Il gèle les alentours grâce à l'air froid qu'il produit,
puis il saute gaiement dans tous les sens.
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.es:
Asume esta forma cuando toma posesión de
un frigorífico. Congela todo a su alrededor con
aire gélido para acto seguido brincar de alegría.
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.it:
Ha assunto questa forma entrando in un frigorifero. Congela ciò
che ha intorno con aria ghiacciata per poi saltellare tutto contento.
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.de:
Dieses Rotom ist in einen Kühlschrank eingedrungen.
Mit eiskalter Luft friert es seine Umgebung ein und
springt dann fröhlich umher.
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. I.pt-br:
Este Rotom entrou em uma geladeira. Salta alegremente
após usar ar glacial para congelar a área ao redor.

This Rotom has entered a washing machine.en: This Rotom has entered a washing machine. It nods with satisfaction after it floods the surrounding area.
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.zh-tw: 這個洛托姆已經進入了洗衣機。當它淹沒了周圍區域後，它滿意地點點頭。
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.fr:
Ce Motisma a pris possession d'une machine à laver.
Il provoque des inondations puis hoche la tête d'un air satisfait.
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.es:
Asume esta forma cuando toma posesión
de una lavadora. Inunda todo a su alrededor
para acto seguido asentir con satisfacción.
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.it:
Ha assunto questa forma entrando in una lavatrice.
Inonda i dintorni per poi annuire soddisfatto.
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.de:
Dieses Rotom ist in eine Waschmaschine
eingedrungen. Es setzt alles um sich herum
unter Wasser und nickt dann selbstgefällig.
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.pt-br:
Este Rotom entrou em uma máquina de lavar.
Acena com a cabeça com satisfação após inundar
os arredores.

This Rotom has entered an electric fan..en: This Rotom has entered an electric fan. It smirks with satisfaction over a prank well pulled after it blows away everything around it.
This Rotom has entered an electric fan..zh-tw: 這個洛托姆已經進入了電風扇之中。當它吹走了周圍的一切後，它對一個精心策劃的惡作劇感到滿意地傻笑。
This Rotom has entered an electric fan..fr:
Ce Motisma a pris possession d'un ventilateur. Il fait
s'envoler tout objet à proximité puis ricane, content de lui.
This Rotom has entered an electric fan..es:
Asume esta forma cuando toma posesión de un
ventilador. Hace volar por los aires los objetos
que tiene alrededor y acto seguido ríe para sí.
This Rotom has entered an electric fan..it:
Ha assunto questa forma entrando in
un ventilatore. Fa volare via tutto ciò che ha
intorno per poi gioire compiaciuto del risultato.
This Rotom has entered an electric fan..de:
Dieses Rotom ist in einen Ventilator eingedrungen.
Es wirbelt Dinge ringsum wild durch die Luft und
lächelt dann hämisch.
This Rotom has entered an electric fan..pt-br:
Este Rotom entrou em um ventilador.
Sorri com satisfação de sua travessura após soprar
para longe tudo que estiver ao seu redor.

To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.en: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.zh-tw: 為了躲避寒冷的冬風，它用樹枝和樹葉製成的斗篷蓋住自己。
To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.fr:
Pour se protéger des vents glacés de l'hiver,
il s'est tissé une cape de feuilles et de brindilles.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.es:
Para protegerse de los vientos fríos invernales,
se cubre con un caparazón de ramas y hojas.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.it:
Per ripararsi dal freddo e dai venti invernali
si copre con un manto fatto di rami e foglie.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.de:
Um sich vor dem eisigen Winterwind zu schützen,
legt es sich unter einen Umhang aus Ästen und Laub.
To shelter itself from cold, wintry wind.pt-br:
Para se proteger dos ventos gelados do inverno, cobre-se
com um manto feito de galhos e folhas.

When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.en: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.zh-tw: 當瑪格莫塔深吸一口氣時，其腹部燃燒的火焰會加劇，溫度升至 3,600 華氏度以上。
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.fr:
Quand il inspire profondément, les flammes dans son
ventre gagnent en intensité et atteignent les 2 000 °C.
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.es:
Al respirar profundamente, el fuego del interior de su
vientre gana intensidad y puede alcanzar los 2000 °C.
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.it:
Quando respira profondamente, le fiamme all'interno del
suo ventre aumentano d'intensità, raggiungendo i 2.000 ºC.
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.de:
Holt es tief Luft, werden die Flammen in seinem Bauch
stärker und erreichen eine Temperatur von 2000 ºC.
When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire.pt-br:
Quando Magmortar respira fundo, o fogo na sua barriga
se intensifica, chegando a atingir temperaturas superiores
a 2.000 ºC.

When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.en: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.zh-tw: 當你看到Leafeon在陽光下熟睡時，你就會知道它正在利用光合作用來產生清潔的空氣。
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.fr:
Un Phyllali qui dort par beau temps produit
un air frais et pur par photosynthèse.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.es:
En días soleados, duerme y hace la fotosíntesis,
con la que emite aire puro a su alrededor.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.it:
Nelle belle giornate dorme al sole e usa
la fotosintesi, producendo aria pulita.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.de:
An klaren Tagen erzeugt ein schlafendes Folipurba
saubere Luft, indem es Fotosynthese betreibt.
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch o.pt-br:
Quando vir um Leafeon adormecido sob os raios de sol,
você saberá que ele está fazendo fotossíntese
para produzir ar fresco.

Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.en: Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, do 20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.zh-tw: 每當你將能量區中的 {D} 能量附加到這只神奇寶貝上時，就會對對手的活躍神奇寶貝造成 20 點傷害。
Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.es: Siempre que unes una Energía {D} de tu Zona de Energía a este Pokémon, haz 20 puntos de daño al Pokémon Activo de tu rival.
Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.fr: Chaque fois que vous attachez une Énergie {D} de votre Zone d'Énergie à ce Pokémon, infligez 20 dégâts au Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire.
Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.de: Immer wenn du diesem Pokémon eine {D}-Energie aus deiner Energiezone anlegst, füge dem Aktiven Pokémon deines Gegners 20 Schadenspunkte zu.
Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.pt-br: Sempre que você associar uma Energia {D} da sua Zona de Energia a este Pokémon, cause 20 pontos de dano ao Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente.
Whenever you attach a {D} Energy from yo.it: Ogni volta che assegni un'Energia {D} dalla tua Zona delle Energie a questo Pokémon, infliggi 20 danni al Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario.

With cold air that can reach temperature.en: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.
With cold air that can reach temperature.zh-tw: 雷吉斯的冷空氣溫度可低至-328華氏度，會立即凍結任何接近它的生物。
With cold air that can reach temperature.fr:
Regice gèle quiconque s'approche de lui en un instant
avec de l'air glacé pouvant atteindre -200 °C.
With cold air that can reach temperature.es:
Usa corrientes de aire gélido de hasta -200 °C para
congelar en un instante a cualquiera que se le acerque.
With cold air that can reach temperature.it:
Utilizza aria gelida fino a -200 ºC per
congelare all'istante chiunque gli si avvicini.
With cold air that can reach temperature.de:
Regice kontrolliert bis zu −200 ºC kalte Luft,
mit der es alles und jeden in seiner Nähe im
Handumdrehen gefrieren lässt.
With cold air that can reach temperature.pt-br:
Regice usa um ar gelado, que pode alcançar temperaturas
de até -200 °C, para congelar instantaneamente
qualquer criatura que se aproximar.

With its flotation sac inflated, it can.en: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.
With its flotation sac inflated, it can.zh-tw: 當浮囊膨脹時，它可以背著人。它在潛水前將囊放氣。
With its flotation sac inflated, it can.fr:
Il gonfle sa bouée pour permettre aux gens de
monter sur son dos et il la dégonfle pour plonger.
With its flotation sac inflated, it can.es:
Con la vejiga natatoria inflada, puede llevar a personas
sobre su espalda. Antes de bucear, la desinfla.
With its flotation sac inflated, it can.it:
Col galleggiante gonfio, può trasportare delle
persone sul dorso. Per immergersi lo sgonfia.
With its flotation sac inflated, it can.de:
Mit gefüllter Schwimmblase kann es Menschen
auf seinem Rücken tragen. Lässt es Luft aus ihr
heraus, taucht es unter.
With its flotation sac inflated, it can.pt-br:
Com sua bolsa de flutuação inflada, pode transportar
pessoas nas costas. Esvazia a bolsa antes de mergulhar.

With its shining light, it lures its pre.en: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.
With its shining light, it lures its pre.zh-tw: 它用耀眼的光芒引誘獵物靠近。然而，光線也恰好吸引了兇猛的魚類神奇寶貝——它的天敵。
With its shining light, it lures its pre.fr:
La lumière qu'il émet pour attirer ses
proies attire également ses prédateurs,
des Pokémon poissons féroces.
With its shining light, it lures its pre.es:
Atrae a sus presas con el destello que emite,
aunque eso también llama la atención de sus
feroces depredadores marinos.
With its shining light, it lures its pre.it:
Con la sua luce attira le prede, ma anche i feroci
Pokémon acquatici che sono suoi predatori naturali.
With its shining light, it lures its pre.de:
Mit seinem Licht lockt es Beute an. Leider
werden dadurch auch grausame Fisch-Pokémon
angezogen – seine natürlichen Fressfeinde.
With its shining light, it lures its pre.pt-br:
Ao brilhar intensamente, atrai as presas para perto. Porém,
a luz também chega a atrair Pokémon peixe ferozes, seus
predadores naturais.

With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.en: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.zh-tw: 有著鋼鐵般的意志，沒有什麼可以擾亂它。它比看上去更加敏捷和活躍。
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.fr:
Rien ne peut perturber ses nerfs d'acier.
Il est plus agile et énergique qu'il n'y paraît.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.es:
Tiene nervios de acero y nada puede perturbarlo.
Es más ágil y activo de lo que aparenta.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.it:
Ha i nervi d'acciaio e niente può turbarlo.
È più agile e attivo di quanto sembri.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.de:
Es hat Nerven wie Drahtseile, nichts kann es erschüttern.
Es ist agiler und aktiver, als es scheint.
With nerves of steel, nothing can pertur.pt-br:
Com nervos de aço, nada pode perturbá-lo.
É mais ágil e ativo do que parece.

You can use this attack only if you have.en: You can use this attack only if you have Uxie and Azelf on your Bench. Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
You can use this attack only if you have.zh-tw: 僅當您的替補席上有 Uxie 和 Azelf 時，您才能使用此攻擊。丟棄該神奇寶貝的所有能量。
You can use this attack only if you have.fr: Vous ne pouvez utiliser cette attaque que si vous avez Créhelf et Créfadet sur votre Banc. Défaussez toutes les Énergies de ce Pokémon.
You can use this attack only if you have.es: Puedes usar este ataque solo si tienes a Uxie y a Azelf en tu Banca. Descarta todas las Energías de este Pokémon.
You can use this attack only if you have.it: Puoi usare questo attacco solo se hai Uxie e Azelf in panchina. Rimuovi tutte le Energie assegnate a questo Pokémon.
You can use this attack only if you have.de: Du kannst diese Attacke nur einsetzen, wenn du Selfe und Tobutz auf deiner Bank hast. Lege alle Energien von diesem Pokémon ab.
You can use this attack only if you have.pt-br: Você só pode usar este ataque se tiver Uxie e Azelf no seu Banco. Descarte todas as Energias deste Pokémon.

You must discard a card from your hand i.en: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.
You must discard a card from your hand i.zh-tw: 您必須從手上棄掉一張牌才能使用此能力。在你的回合中，你可以抽一張牌。
You must discard a card from your hand i.fr: Vous devez défausser une carte de votre main pour pouvoir utiliser ce talent. Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez piocher une carte.
You must discard a card from your hand i.es: Debes descartar 1 carta de tu mano para poder usar esta habilidad. Una vez durante tu turno, puedes robar 1 carta.
You must discard a card from your hand i.it: Devi scartare una carta che hai in mano per usare questa abilità. Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi pescare una carta.
You must discard a card from your hand i.de: Du musst 1 Karte von deiner Hand auf deinen Ablagestapel legen, um diese Fähigkeit einzusetzen. Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 1 Karte ziehen.
You must discard a card from your hand i.pt-br: Você deve descartar 1 carta da sua mão para usar esta Habilidade. Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá comprar 1 carta.

Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.en: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card you find there and shuffle it into your opponent's deck.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.zh-tw: 你的對手亮出了他們的牌。選擇在那裡找到的一張牌並將其洗入對手的牌庫中。
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.fr: Votre adversaire dévoile sa main. Choisissez une carte que vous y trouvez et mélangez-la avec le deck de votre adversaire.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.es: Tu rival enseña las cartas de su mano. Elige 1 carta que encuentres entre ellas, ponla en su baraja y barájalas todas.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.it: Il tuo avversario mostra le carte che ha in mano. Scegline una e rimischiala nel suo mazzo.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.de: Dein Gegner zeigt dir seine Handkarten. Wähle 1 Karte, die du dort findest, und mische sie in das Deck deines Gegners.
Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose.pt-br: Seu oponente revela a mão dele. Escolha 1 carta que encontrar lá e embaralhe-a no baralho do seu oponente.

Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.en: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws a card for each of their remaining points needed to win.
Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.zh-tw: 你的對手將他們的手牌洗入牌庫，並根據獲勝所需的剩餘點數抽一張牌。
Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.es: Tu oponente baraja su mano en su mazo y roba una carta por cada uno de los puntos restantes necesarios para ganar.
Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.fr: Votre adversaire mélange sa main dans son deck et pioche une carte pour chacun de ses points restants nécessaires pour gagner.
Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.pt-br: Seu oponente embaralha a mão no baralho e compra uma carta para cada um dos pontos restantes necessários para vencer.
Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.it: Il tuo avversario mescola la sua mano nel suo mazzo e pesca una carta per ciascuno dei punti rimanenti necessari per vincere.
Your opponent shuffles their hand into t.de: Ihr Gegner mischt seine Hand in sein Deck und zieht eine Karte für jeden seiner verbleibenden Punkte, die er zum Sieg benötigt.

1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.en: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 50 damage to it.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.zh-tw: 隨機選擇 1 只對手的神奇寶貝 3 次。每次選擇一隻神奇寶貝，對其造成 50 點傷害。
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.es: 1 de los Pokémon de tu oponente se elige al azar 3 veces. Por cada vez que se elija un Pokémon, hazle 50 daños.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.pt-br: 1 dos Pokémon do seu oponente é escolhido aleatoriamente 3 vezes. Para cada vez que um Pokémon for escolhido, cause 50 de dano a ele.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.fr: 1 des Pokémon de votre adversaire est choisi au hasard 3 fois. À chaque fois qu'un Pokémon est choisi, infligez-lui 50 dégâts.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.de: 1 Pokémon deines Gegners wird dreimal zufällig ausgewählt. Füge ihm jedes Mal, wenn ein Pokémon ausgewählt wurde, 50 Schadenspunkte zu.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.it: 1 dei Pokémon del tuo avversario viene scelto a caso 3 volte. Per ogni volta che viene scelto un Pokémon, infliggigli 50 danni.

1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.en: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random. Do 30 damage to it.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.zh-tw: 隨機選擇 1 只對手的神奇寶貝。對其造成 30 點傷害。
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.fr: 1 des Pokémon de votre adversaire est choisi au hasard. Faites-lui 30 dégâts.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.pt-br: 1 dos Pokémon do seu oponente é escolhido aleatoriamente. Cause 30 de dano a ele.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.es: 1 de los Pokémon de tu oponente se elige al azar. Hazle 30 daños.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.de: 1 Pokémon deines Gegners wird zufällig ausgewählt. Füge ihm 30 Schaden zu.
1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen a.it: Viene scelto a caso 1 dei Pokémon del tuo avversario. Infliggigli 30 danni.

After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.en: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.
After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.zh-tw: 在領土爭奪戰中失敗後，伍珀開始在陸地上生活。隨著時間的推移，神奇寶貝發生了變化，產生了一層有毒的薄膜來保護它的身體。
After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.fr:
Depuis qu'une dispute territoriale l'a contraint
à vivre sur la terre ferme, il protège son corps
en le recouvrant d'un fluide toxique.
After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.es:
Tras perder una disputa territorial, se vio forzado
a vivir en tierra firme y desarrolló una membrana
mucosa tóxica con la que proteger su cuerpo.
After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.it:
Vive sulla terraferma da quando perse una
lotta territoriale. Per proteggere il corpo ha
sviluppato una membrana mucosa tossica.
After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.de:
Ein verlorener Revierkampf zwang es, an Land
zu leben. Um sich zu schützen, entwickelte es
eine giftige Schleimschicht auf seinem Körper.
After losing a territorial struggle, Woo.pt-br:
Após perder uma disputa por território, Wooper passou a
viver em terra firme. Seu corpo mudou ao longo do tempo,
desenvolvendo uma camada venenosa para protegê-lo.

After stunning its opponents with the pa.en: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.
After stunning its opponents with the pa.zh-tw: 用腹部的圖案擊暈對手後，它會迅速將對手包裹在自己的身體中，等待他們停止移動。
After stunning its opponents with the pa.fr:
Il intimide sa proie grâce au motif situé sur
le devant de son capuchon, puis l'enserre
jusqu'à ce que son cœur cesse de battre.
After stunning its opponents with the pa.es:
Tras confundir a su presa con el motivo de su cuerpo, se enrosca
a su alrededor y la aferra, a la espera de que su pulso se detenga.
After stunning its opponents with the pa.it:
Spiazza l'avversario con il disegno sul ventre,
poi gli si avvinghia rapidamente e aspetta
che il suo battito cardiaco si fermi.
After stunning its opponents with the pa.de:
Es schüchtert seinen Gegner mit dem Muster auf seinem
Bauch ein und nimmt ihn dann in den Würgegriff, bis es
keinen Widerstand mehr spürt.
After stunning its opponents with the pa.pt-br:
Após atordoar os seus oponentes com as marcas
em seu estômago, enrola-os rapidamente contra seu
corpo e espera eles pararem de se mover.

Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.en: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.zh-tw: 顯然 Cyclizar 自古以來就允許人們騎在它的背上。一萬年前的壁畫中就發現了對此的描述。
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.fr:
Des fresques vieilles de 10 000 ans laissent penser
que ce Pokémon transporte des êtres humains
sur son dos depuis les temps anciens.
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.es:
Según parece, ha permitido que los humanos
monten en él desde tiempos remotos. Aparece
en pinturas rupestres de hace diez mil años.
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.it:
Sembra che trasportasse esseri umani sul
dorso già nell'antichità. È rappresentato in
pitture rupestri risalenti a 10.000 anni fa.
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.de:
Seit uralten Zeiten soll es Menschen auf seinem
Rücken reiten lassen. Darstellungen davon finden
sich auf 10 000 Jahre alten Wandmalereien.
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing pe.pt-br:
Aparentemente, Cyclizar permite que as pessoas o
montem desde os tempos antigos. Representações deste
ato foram encontradas em murais com mais de 10.000 anos.

During this turn, attacks used by your P.zh-tw: 這個回合中，自己的寶可夢的攻擊對對手的現役寶可夢造成+20點傷害。

During this turn, attacks used by your P.fr: Durant ce tour, les attaques utilisées par votre Pokémon infligent +20 dégâts au Pokémon Actif ex de votre adversaire.

During this turn, attacks used by your P.it: Durante questo turno, gli attacchi usati dai tuoi Pokémon infliggono +20 danni al Pokémon attivo ex del tuo avversario.
During this turn, attacks used by your P.de: Während dieser Runde fügen Angriffe deines Pokémon dem aktiven Pokémon ex deines Gegners +20 Schaden zu.

During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.en: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overacceleration attack does +20 damage.
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.zh-tw: 在你的下一個回合中，這只神奇寶貝的過度加速攻擊造成+20點傷害。
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.it: Durante il tuo prossimo turno, l'attacco Accelerazione eccessiva di questo Pokémon infligge +20 danni.
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.fr: Lors de votre prochain tour, l'attaque Suraccélération de ce Pokémon inflige +20 dégâts.
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.es: Durante tu próximo turno, el ataque Sobreaceleración de este Pokémon hace +20 de daño.
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.de: Während deines nächsten Zuges verursacht der Überbeschleunigungsangriff dieses Pokémon +20 Schaden.
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Ov.pt-br: Durante o seu próximo turno, o ataque de Superaceleração deste Pokémon causará +20 de dano.

Each player shuffles the cards in their.en: Each player shuffles the cards in their hand into their deck, then draws that many cards.
Each player shuffles the cards in their.zh-tw: 每個玩家將手中的牌洗入自己的牌庫，然後抽出相應數量的牌。
Each player shuffles the cards in their.fr: Chaque joueur mélange les cartes de sa main dans son deck, puis pioche autant de cartes.
Each player shuffles the cards in their.de: Jeder Spieler mischt die Karten auf seiner Hand in sein Deck und zieht dann entsprechend viele Karten.
Each player shuffles the cards in their.es: Cada jugador baraja las cartas que tiene en la mano en su mazo y luego roba esa cantidad de cartas.
Each player shuffles the cards in their.pt-br: Cada jogador embaralha as cartas de sua mão em seu baralho e, em seguida, compra aquela quantidade de cartas.
Each player shuffles the cards in their.it: Ogni giocatore mescola le carte che ha in mano nel proprio mazzo, poi pesca altrettante carte.

Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.en: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.zh-tw: 翻轉 4 個硬幣。這次攻擊對每個頭造成 20 點傷害。
Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.fr: Lancez 4 pièces. Cette attaque inflige 20 dégâts pour chaque côté face.
Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.es: Lanza 4 monedas. Este ataque hace 20 puntos de daño por cada cara.
Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.it: Lancia 4 volte una moneta. Questo attacco infligge 20 danni ogni volta che esce testa.
Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.de: Wirf 4 Münzen. Diese Attacke fügt 20 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.
Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage.pt-br: Jogue 4 moedas. Este ataque causa 20 pontos de dano para cada cara.

Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.en: Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.zh-tw: 為該寶可夢附加的每 {M} 能量拋一枚硬幣。這次攻擊對每個頭造成 50 點傷害。
Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.fr: Lancez une pièce pour chaque Énergie {M} attachée à ce Pokémon. Cette attaque inflige 50 dégâts pour chaque côté face.
Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.es: Lanza 1 moneda por cada Energía {M} unida a este Pokémon. Este ataque hace 50 puntos de daño por cada cara.
Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.it: Lancia una moneta per ogni Energia {M} assegnata a questo Pokémon. Questo attacco infligge 50 danni ogni volta che esce testa.
Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.de: Wirf 1 Münze für jede an dieses Pokémon angelegte {M}-Energie. Diese Attacke fügt 50 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.
Flip a coin for each {M} Energy attached.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda para cada Energia de {M} ligada a este Pokémon. Este ataque causa 50 pontos de dano para cada cara.

Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.en: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.zh-tw: 拋一枚硬幣。如果正面，此攻擊會造成 80 點額外傷害。
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.es: Lanza una moneda. Si sale cara, este ataque hace 80 puntos de daño más.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.it: Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, questo attacco infligge 80 danni in più.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.fr: Lancez une pièce de monnaie. Si c’est face, cette attaque inflige 80 dégâts supplémentaires.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se der cara, este ataque causa 80 de dano a mais.
Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does.de: Wirf eine Münze. Bei „Kopf“ fügt dieser Angriff 80 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.en: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.zh-tw: 拋一枚硬幣。如果出現正面，則對手的活躍神奇寶貝現在處於混亂狀態。
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.fr: Lancez une pièce. Si c'est face, le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est maintenant Confus.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.es: Lanza 1 moneda. Si sale cara, el Pokémon Activo de tu rival pasa a estar Confundido.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.it: Lancia una moneta. Se esce testa, il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario viene confuso.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.de: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Kopf ist das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners jetzt verwirrt.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's A.pt-br: Jogue uma moeda. Se sair cara, o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora estará Confuso.

Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.en: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.zh-tw: 弗洛拉加托巧妙地揮舞著隱藏在長毛皮下的藤蔓，將堅硬的花蕾​​猛擊對手。
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.fr:
Il manie avec habileté la liane dissimulée
sous ses longs poils et frappe ses adversaires
avec le bourgeon dur situé à son extrémité.
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.es:
Maneja diestramente la vid oculta bajo su largo pelaje y propina
latigazos al enemigo con el capullo endurecido de la punta.
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.it:
Muove con agilità la liana nascosta
sotto il lungo pelo e sferza il nemico
con il duro bocciolo sulla punta.
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.de:
Es lenkt geschickt die Ranke, die es unter
seinem langen Fell verbirgt, und schleudert
die harte Knospe an ihrem Ende auf Gegner.
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden.pt-br:
Floragato empunha com maestria o cipó escondido
entre seus pelos longos. Golpeia seus oponentes
com o botão de flor rígido.

Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.en: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions.
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.zh-tw: 治療你的 1 只神奇寶貝造成的 30 點傷害，並且它會從所有特殊狀況中恢復。
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.fr: Soignez 30 dégâts de l'un de vos Pokémon, et il guérit de tous les États Spéciaux.
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.es: Cura 30 puntos de daño a 1 de tus Pokémon, y este se recupera de todas las Condiciones Especiales.
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.it: Cura uno dei tuoi Pokémon da 30 danni. Quel Pokémon guarisce da tutte le condizioni speciali.
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.de: Heile 30 Schadenspunkte bei 1 deiner Pokémon, und es erholt sich von allen Speziellen Zuständen.
Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, a.pt-br: Cure 30 pontos de dano de 1 dos seus Pokémon, e ele se recupera de todas as Condições Especiais.

If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {F}.zh-tw: 如果這只神奇寶貝附加了至少 2 個額外的 {F} 能量，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 50 點。
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {F}.fr: Si ce Pokémon a au moins 2 Énergies {F} de plus, cette attaque inflige 50 dégâts supplémentaires.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {F}.es: Si este Pokémon tiene por lo menos 2 Energías {F} adicionales unidas a él, este ataque hace 50 puntos de daño más.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {F}.it: Se questo Pokémon ha almeno 2 Energie {F} extra assegnate, questo attacco infligge 50 danni in più.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {F}.de: Wenn an dieses Pokémon mindestens 2 extra {F}-Energien angelegt sind, fügt diese Attacke 50 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.
If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra {F}.pt-br: Se este Pokémon tiver pelo menos 2 Energia {F} extra ligada a ele, este ataque causará 50 pontos de dano a mais.

If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.en: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 70 more damage.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.zh-tw: 如果對手的戰鬥寶可夢是寶可夢 {ex}，則此攻擊造成的傷害增加 70 點。
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.es: Si el Pokémon Activo de tu rival es un Pokémon ex, este ataque hace 70 puntos de daño más.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.fr: Si le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est un ex Pokémon, cette attaque inflige 70 dégâts supplémentaires.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.pt-br: Se o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente for um Pokémon ex, este ataque causará 70 de dano a mais.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.it: Se il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è un Pokémon ex, questo attacco infligge 70 danni in più.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a P.de: Wenn das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ein Pokémon-Ex ist, fügt dieser Angriff 70 weitere Schadenspunkte zu.

If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.en: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 60 more damage.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.zh-tw: 如果對手的活躍寶可夢中毒，則這次攻擊造成的傷害增加 60 點。
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.fr: Si le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est Empoisonné, cette attaque inflige 60 dégâts supplémentaires.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.es: Si el Pokémon Activo de tu rival está Envenenado, este ataque hace 60 puntos de daño más.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.it: Se il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario è avvelenato, questo attacco infligge 60 danni in più.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.pt-br: Se o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente estiver Envenenado, este ataque causará 60 de dano a mais.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poi.de: Wenn das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners vergiftet ist, fügt dieser Angriff 60 weitere Schadenspunkte zu.

It can generate and release gas within i.en: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.
It can generate and release gas within i.zh-tw: 它可以在體內產生並釋放氣體。這就是它如何控制漂移高度的方法。
It can generate and release gas within i.fr:
Il contrôle son altitude en produisant des gaz
à l'intérieur de son corps puis en les expulsant.
It can generate and release gas within i.es:
Crea en su interior gases y los expulsa. De esta
forma es capaz de volar y controlar su altura.
It can generate and release gas within i.it:
Può regolare l'altitudine di volo grazie
alla capacità di produrre gas all'interno
del proprio corpo e di espellerli.
It can generate and release gas within i.de:
Indem es Gas in seinem Körper erzeugt und
wieder ausstößt, reguliert es seine Flughöhe.
It can generate and release gas within i.pt-br:
Ele pode gerar e soltar gases dentro do seu corpo.
É assim que ele pode controlar a altitude da sua flutuação.

It creates a gas out of poison and miner.en: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.
It creates a gas out of poison and miner.zh-tw: 它利用岩石中的毒物和礦物質產生氣體。然後它引爆其氣瓶（現在有八個）中的氣體來產生能量。
It creates a gas out of poison and miner.fr:
Il produit de l'énergie en faisant exploser dans
ses huit cylindres un mélange gazeux qui
contient une substance toxique et des minéraux.
It creates a gas out of poison and miner.es:
Posee ocho cilindros, con los que genera energía
haciendo estallar el gas que produce al mezclar
los minerales de las rocas con su veneno.
It creates a gas out of poison and miner.it:
Produce energia facendo esplodere
nei suoi otto cilindri un gas che forma
mescolando tossine e minerali delle rocce.
It creates a gas out of poison and miner.de:
Mit seinen nunmehr acht Zylindern lässt es ein
Gasgemisch aus Gift und Gesteinsmineralien
explodieren, um daraus Energie zu gewinnen.
It creates a gas out of poison and miner.pt-br:
Cria um gás a partir de veneno e minerais de pedras.
Então, detona o gás em seus cilindros,
que agora são oito, para gerar energia.

It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.en: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.zh-tw: 它的臉頰上有不發達的電囊。只有當波米用前爪上的肉墊猛烈摩擦時，這些囊才能產生電力。
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.fr:
Les poches sur ses joues sont peu développées.
Elles ne produisent de l'électricité que
lorsqu'il les frotte avec ses coussinets.
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.es:
Como las bolsas de sus mejillas están poco desarrolladas, genera
electricidad frotándolas con las almohadillas de sus patas delanteras.
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.it:
Le sacche elettriche sulle sue guance non si sono
sviluppate del tutto e per generare energia deve
sfregarle vigorosamente con le zampe anteriori.
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.de:
Seine elektrischen Backentaschen sind nicht ganz
ausgebildet. Um Strom zu erzeugen, muss es mit
den Ballen der Vorderpfoten kräftig daran reiben.
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on i.pt-br:
Possui bolsas de eletricidade subdesenvolvidas em suas
bochechas. Elas só produzem eletricidade se Pawmi esfregá-las
furiosamente com as almofadas de suas patas dianteiras.

It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.en: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.zh-tw: 它的胃膨脹得很厲害，唱著神秘的旋律。如果你聽到這個旋律，你會立刻昏昏欲睡。
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.fr:
Ce Pokémon aime inspirer profondément
et chanter une mélodie mystérieuse qui endort
immédiatement tous ceux qui l'entendent.
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.es:
Hincha su vientre considerablemente y entona una melodía
misteriosa que duerme en el acto a todo aquel que la oye.
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.it:
Gonfia la pancia per cantare una melodia
misteriosa che fa addormentare chiunque l'ascolti.
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.de:
Es kann tief einatmen und seinen Bauch mit Luft
füllen, um ein sonderbares Lied anzustimmen.
Wer dieses hört, schläft auf der Stelle ein.
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings.pt-br:
Infla seu estômago e canta uma melodia misteriosa.
Se você ouvir esta melodia,
acabará dormindo na mesma hora.

It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.en: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.zh-tw: 它會膨脹浮囊，將臉保持在水面以上，以觀察獵物的運動。
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.fr:
La bouée autour de son cou lui permet de
garder la tête hors de l'eau. Ainsi, il peut scruter
les mouvements de ses proies sur la terre ferme.
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.es:
La vejiga natatoria alrededor del cuello le permite flotar
en el agua con la cabeza fuera para divisar a sus presas.
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.it:
Gonfia il suo collare galleggiante e
rimane con la testa fuori dall'acqua
in cerca di prede sulla terraferma.
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.de:
Füllt es die Schwimmblase um seinen Hals mit Luft,
ragt sein Kopf aus dem Wasser und es kann die
Bewegungen von Beute an Land beobachten.
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping i.pt-br:
Infla sua bolsa de flutuação e mantém o rosto acima
da água para procurar o movimento de presas.

It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.en: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.zh-tw: 據說這只神奇寶貝是在一種未知的有毒神奇寶貝進入並激發了廢品加工廠留下的引擎時誕生的。
It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.fr:
On raconte qu'il est né lorsqu'un mystérieux Pokémon Poison
a pris possession d'un moteur laissé à l'abandon dans une casse.
It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.es:
Se dice que surgió cuando un misterioso Pokémon venenoso
tomó posesión de un motor abandonado en un desguace.
It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.it:
Pare sia nato quando un misterioso Pokémon
di tipo Veleno prese possesso di un motore
abbandonato in un deposito di rottami.
It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.de:
Es soll entstanden sein, als ein unbekanntes
Gift-Pokémon von einem Motor Besitz ergriff,
der in einer Schrottfabrik zurückgelassen wurde.
It is said that this Pokémon was born wh.pt-br:
Acredita-se que este Pokémon nasceu quando um
Pokémon venenoso desconhecido possuiu um motor
abandonado em uma fábrica que processa ferro-velho.

It swings its handmade hammer around to.en: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
It swings its handmade hammer around to.zh-tw: 它會揮動手工製作的錘子來保護自己，但錘子經常被吃金屬的神奇寶貝偷走。
It swings its handmade hammer around to.fr:
Il se défend en brandissant un marteau qu'il a créé
lui-même, mais les Pokémon qui se nourrissent
de métaux ont tendance à le lui voler.
It swings its handmade hammer around to.es:
Agita su martillo forjado a mano para ahuyentar
a posibles amenazas, pero los Pokémon que se
alimentan a base de metal suelen robárselo.
It swings its handmade hammer around to.it:
Si difende adoperando un martello che ha
forgiato personalmente, anche se spesso
i Pokémon ghiotti di metallo glielo rubano.
It swings its handmade hammer around to.de:
Es schwingt seinen handgeschmiedeten Hammer,
um sich zu schützen. Dieser wird ihm allerdings oft
von Pokémon gestohlen, die Metall fressen.
It swings its handmade hammer around to.pt-br:
Balança seu martelo feito à mão para se proteger,
mas o martelo é roubado com frequência
por Pokémon que comem metal.

It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.en: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.zh-tw: 它是帶有電動頰囊的神奇寶貝之一。它從尾巴發射電荷。
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.fr:
Pachirisu fait partie des Pokémon aux joues électriques.
Il libère l'énergie qu'il accumule par la queue.
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.es:
Forma parte del grupo de Pokémon que
posee bolsas de electricidad en las mejillas.
Descarga por la cola la electricidad que acumula.
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.it:
Appartiene alla tipologia di Pokémon
muniti di sacche elettriche sulle guance.
Rilascia dalla coda l'elettricità accumulata.
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.de:
Pachirisu ist eines der Pokémon, die mit ihren
Backentaschen Elektrizität erzeugen. Den so
gesammelten Strom gibt es über den Schweif ab.
It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with el.pt-br:
É um dos tipos de Pokémon com bolsas elétricas
nas bochechas. Ele dispara cargas de sua cauda.

Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.en: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.zh-tw: 它的身體似乎是由1000枚硬幣組成的。這隻寶可夢與其他人相處得很好，很快就能和任何人成為朋友。
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.fr:
Son corps serait composé de 1 000 pièces. Sociable,
il peut se lier d'amitié très rapidement avec n'importe qui.
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.es:
Se dice que su cuerpo está formado por 1000
monedas. Es capaz de hacer buenas migas con
cualquiera rápidamente por su sociabilidad.
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.it:
Pare che il suo corpo sia formato da
1.000 monete. È molto socievole e
fa subito amicizia con chiunque.
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.de:
Sein Körper soll aus 1000 Münzen bestehen.
Es ist sehr umgänglich und schließt mit jedem
rasch Freundschaft.
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 co.pt-br:
Seu corpo parece ser feito de 1.000 moedas.
Este Pokémon se dá bem com os outros
e faz amizades com qualquer um rapidamente.

Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.en: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.zh-tw: 它蓬鬆的皮毛與植物的成分相似。這只神奇寶貝經常洗臉以防止臉乾燥。
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.fr:
Ce Pokémon lave assidûment son visage pour
éviter qu'il ne s'assèche. La composition de son
pelage soyeux est proche de celle des plantes.
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.es:
Su sedoso pelaje se asemeja en composición a las plantas.
Se lava la cara con diligencia para que no se le seque.
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.it:
Il suo pelo vellutato ha una composizione simile a quella delle
piante. Si lava il muso di frequente per evitare che si disidrati.
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.de:
Die Zusammensetzung seines weichen Fells ähnelt
der von Pflanzen. Es reinigt penibel sein Gesicht,
um zu verhindern, dass dieses austrocknet.
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition.pt-br:
A composição de seu pelo fofinho é semelhante
à das plantas. Este Pokémon lava o rosto frequentemente
para evitar que fique ressecado.

Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.en: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.zh-tw: Lickilicky 奇怪的舌頭可以伸展到其身體長度的許多倍。到目前為止，還沒有人知道 Lickilicky 的舌頭是如何伸展的。
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.fr:
Sa langue a l'incroyable faculté de s'allonger et
d'atteindre plusieurs fois la taille de son corps.
Ce mystère de la nature reste entier.
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.es:
Su lengua es un misterio sin resolver: no se sabe
cómo puede extenderla hasta alcanzar longitudes
que superan varias veces la de su propio cuerpo.
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.it:
La sua lingua può misteriosamente allungarsi
fino a molte volte la lunghezza del corpo.
Ancora non si è capito come faccia.
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.de:
Seine sonderbare Zunge kann sich bis auf ein
Vielfaches seiner Körpergröße ausdehnen.
Niemand weiß, wie das möglich ist.
Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch.pt-br:
A língua estranha de Lickilicky pode esticar e ficar
mais longa do que seu corpo. Ninguém jamais descobriu
como a língua deste Pokémon pode esticar tanto.

Once during your turn, you may flip a co.en: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
Once during your turn, you may flip a co.zh-tw: 在你的回合中，你可以拋一次硬幣。如果正面，則對手的活躍神奇寶貝現在中毒。
Once during your turn, you may flip a co.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez lancer une pièce. Si c'est face, le Pokémon Actif de votre adversaire est maintenant Empoisonné.
Once during your turn, you may flip a co.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes lanzar 1 moneda. Si sale cara, el Pokémon Activo de tu rival pasa a estar Envenenado.
Once during your turn, you may flip a co.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi lanciare una moneta. Se esce testa, il Pokémon attivo del tuo avversario viene avvelenato.
Once during your turn, you may flip a co.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du 1 Münze werfen. Bei Kopf ist das Aktive Pokémon jetzt vergiftet.
Once during your turn, you may flip a co.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você poderá jogar uma moeda. Se sair cara, o Pokémon Ativo do seu oponente agora estará Envenenado.

Once during your turn, you may take a {P.en: Once during your turn, you may take a {P} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.
Once during your turn, you may take a {P.zh-tw: 在你的回合中，你可以從你的能量區取出一個{P}能量並將其附加到這只神奇寶貝身上。如果你使用了這個能力，你的回合就結束了。
Once during your turn, you may take a {P.fr: Une fois pendant votre tour, vous pouvez prendre une Énergie {P} de votre Zone d'Énergie et l'attacher à ce Pokémon. Si vous utilisez cette Capacité, votre tour se termine.
Once during your turn, you may take a {P.es: Una vez durante tu turno, puedes tomar una Energía {P} de tu Zona de Energía y unirla a este Pokémon. Si usas esta habilidad, tu turno termina.
Once during your turn, you may take a {P.it: Una sola volta durante il tuo turno, puoi prendere un'Energia {P} dalla tua Zona Energetica e assegnarla a questo Pokémon. Se usi questa Abilità, il tuo turno termina.
Once during your turn, you may take a {P.pt-br: Uma vez durante o seu turno, você pode pegar uma Energia {P} da sua Zona de Energia e associá-la a este Pokémon. Se você usar esta habilidade, seu turno termina.
Once during your turn, you may take a {P.de: Einmal während deines Zuges kannst du eine {P}-Energie aus deiner Energiezone nehmen und sie an dieses Pokémon anlegen. Wenn du diese Fähigkeit nutzt, endet dein Zug.

Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.en: Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto your Bench.
Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.zh-tw: 將 1 個隨機雜草從你的牌組放到你的替補席上。
Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.es: Coloca 1 Weedle aleatorio de tu mazo en tu Banca.
Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.fr: Placez 1 Weedle aléatoire de votre deck sur votre Banc.
Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.pt-br: Coloque 1 Weedle aleatório do seu deck no seu Banco.
Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.it: Metti 1 Weedle a caso dal tuo mazzo nella tua panchina.
Put 1 random Weedle from your deck onto.de: Lege 1 zufälliges Unkraut aus deinem Deck auf deine Bank.

Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.en: Put a random Basic Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.zh-tw: 從你的牌組中隨機將一隻基礎寶可夢置入你的手牌。
Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.fr: Ajoutez au hasard un Pokémon de base de votre deck à votre main.
Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.es: Pon 1 Pokémon Básico aleatorio de tu baraja en tu mano.
Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.it: Prendi un Pokémon Base a caso dal tuo mazzo e aggiungilo alle carte che hai in mano.
Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.de: Nimm 1 zufälliges Basis-Pokémon aus deinem Deck auf deine Hand.
Put a random Basic Pokémon from your dec.pt-br: Coloque 1 Pokémon Básico aleatório do seu baralho na sua mão.

Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區取出 3 個 {R} 能量並將其附加到這只神奇寶貝身上。
Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Toma 3 Energías {R} de tu Zona de Energía y únelas a este Pokémon.
Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez 3 {R} Énergie de votre Zone d'Énergie et attachez-la à ce Pokémon.
Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi 3 Energie {R} dalla tua Zona Energetica e assegnale a questo Pokémon.
Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Nimm 3 {R}-Energie aus deiner Energiezone und lege sie an dieses Pokémon an.
Take 3 {R} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue 3 {R} Energias da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-as a este Pokémon.

Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.en: Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched  Pokémon.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.zh-tw: 從你的能量區取出一個{L}能量並將其附加到你的1只後備神奇寶貝上。
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.fr: Prenez une Énergie {L} de votre zone Énergie et attachez-la à l'un de vos Pokémon de Banc.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.es: Une 1 Energía {L} de tu área de Energía a 1 de tus Pokémon en Banca.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.it: Prendi un'Energia {L} dalla tua Zona Energia e assegnala a uno dei tuoi Pokémon in panchina.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.de: Lege 1 {L}-Energie aus deinem Energiebereich an 1 Pokémon auf deiner Bank an.
Take a {L} Energy from your Energy Zone.pt-br: Pegue uma Energia {L} da sua Zona de Energia e ligue-a 1 dos seus Pokémon no Banco.

The color of the poisonous saliva depend.en: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
The color of the poisonous saliva depend.zh-tw: 有毒唾液的顏色取決於神奇寶貝吃的東西。 Grafaiai 用唾液覆蓋手指，在森林裡的樹木上畫出圖案。
The color of the poisonous saliva depend.fr:
Sa salive toxique change de couleur selon
son alimentation. Il en enduit ses doigts pour
dessiner des motifs sur les arbres de la forêt.
The color of the poisonous saliva depend.es:
El color de su saliva venenosa varía según su
alimentación. Se embadurna los dedos con ella
para pintar motivos en los árboles del bosque.
The color of the poisonous saliva depend.it:
Traccia dei motivi sugli alberi della foresta
con le dita imbrattate di saliva velenosa, il
cui colore cambia in base all'alimentazione.
The color of the poisonous saliva depend.de:
Es beschmiert seine Finger mit giftigem Speichel,
der je nach Futter anders gefärbt ist, und malt
damit Muster auf die Bäume im Wald.
The color of the poisonous saliva depend.pt-br:
A cor da saliva venenosa deste Pokémon depende
da sua dieta. Grafaiai cobre seus dedos com saliva
e desenha em árvores da floresta.

This attack also does 20 damage to each.en: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy attached.
This attack also does 20 damage to each.zh-tw: 此攻擊還會對對手後備戰中每隻帶有能量的神奇寶貝造成 20 點傷害。
This attack also does 20 damage to each.fr: Cette attaque inflige aussi 20 dégâts à chacun des Pokémon de Banc de votre adversaire auxquels au moins une Énergie est attachée.
This attack also does 20 damage to each.es: Este ataque también hace 20 puntos de daño a cada uno de los Pokémon en Banca de tu rival que tenga alguna Energía unida a él.
This attack also does 20 damage to each.it: Questo attacco infligge anche 20 danni a ciascuno dei Pokémon nella panchina del tuo avversario che ha delle Energie assegnate.
This attack also does 20 damage to each.de: Diese Attacke fügt auch jedem Pokémon auf der Bank deines Gegners, an das mindestens 1 Energie angelegt ist, 20 Schadenspunkte zu.
This attack also does 20 damage to each.pt-br: Este ataque também causa 20 pontos de dano a cada um dos Pokémon no Banco do seu oponente que tiver alguma Energia ligada a ele.

This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.en: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.zh-tw: 這是小型龍系神奇寶貝。它生活在棟多佐的嘴裡，以保護自己免受外部敵人的侵害。
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.fr:
Ce petit Pokémon Dragon vit dans la gueule
d'Oyacata, à l'abri de ses adversaires.
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.es:
Pokémon dragón de pequeño tamaño. Vive en la boca de un
Dondozo para protegerse de los ataques de los depredadores.
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.it:
Un Pokémon di tipo Drago di piccole
dimensioni. Vive all'interno della bocca di
Dondozo, protetto dagli attacchi dei nemici.
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.de:
Dieses kleine Drachen-Pokémon lebt im Maul von
Heerashai, wodurch es vor Feinden geschützt ist.
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives.pt-br:
Este é um pequeno Pokémon dragão. Mora dentro da
boca de Dondozo para proteger-se
de inimigos do mundo externo.

This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.en: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝顯然將它的脖子根部打成一個結，這樣儲存在腹部的能量就不會從它的喙中逸出。
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.fr:
On pense qu'il fait un nœud à la base de son cou
afin d'empêcher l'énergie qu'il accumule
dans son ventre de s'échapper par son bec.
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.es:
Al parecer, se anudan la base del cuello para
impedir que la energía que tienen almacenada
en el estómago escape por el pico.
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.it:
Sembra che il nodo che fa alla base del collo
serva a evitare che l'energia accumulata
nel suo stomaco fuoriesca dal becco.
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.de:
Dieses Pokémon verknotet offenbar seinen Hals
am Ansatz, damit die im Bauch gespeicherte Energie
nicht über den Schnabel entweicht.
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of.pt-br:
Pelo visto, este Pokémon amarra a base de seu pescoço
em um nó para que a energia armazenada
em sua barriga não escape pelo bico.

This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.en: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝可以在 65 英尺外捕捉到貝魯扎的氣味，並將自己隱藏在沙子裡。
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.fr:
Il détecte l'odeur de Délestin à plus de vingt mètres,
ce qui lui donne le temps de s'enfouir dans le sable.
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.es:
Puede percibir el olor de los Veluza a 20 m de distancia,
lo que le permite ocultarse bajo la arena a tiempo.
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.it:
Fiuta l'odore di un Veluza da 20 metri
di distanza e si nasconde nella sabbia.
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.de:
Es kann den Geruch eines Agiluza auf 20 m Entfernung
wahrnehmen und versteckt sich daraufhin flugs im Sand.
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é capaz de sentir o cheiro de Veluza
a mais de 20 metros de distância e se esconderá na areia.

This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.en: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.zh-tw: 該寶可夢雖然貪吃，但不擅長獲取食物。它與龍切合作捕捉獵物。
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.fr:
Comme il n'est pas très doué pour attraper ses proies,
ce Pokémon vorace fait équipe avec Nigirigon pour chasser.
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.es:
Le gusta mucho comer, pero no se le da bien cazar, por lo
que aúna fuerzas con Tatsugiri con el fin de capturar presas.
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.it:
È un Pokémon vorace, ma non è molto abile
nel procacciarsi il cibo. Cattura le sue prede
collaborando con il Tatsugiri che è con lui.
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.de:
Es ist zwar ein Vielfraß, doch die Jagd liegt
ihm nicht. Deshalb schließt es sich mit
Nigiragi zusammen, um Beute zu fangen.
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad.pt-br:
Este Pokémon é guloso, mas não é nada
bom em conseguir comida. Alia-se a
Tatsugiri para pegar suas presas.

This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.en: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.zh-tw: 這種神奇寶貝通常反應遲緩，但一旦進入戰鬥，就會以閃電般的動作擊倒敵人。
This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.fr:
D'ordinaire, ce Pokémon est plutôt calme,
mais lorsqu'il se bat, il élimine ses adversaires
avec des mouvements rapides comme l'éclair.
This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.es:
Este Pokémon es normalmente bastante calmado,
pero, una vez en combate, derriba a sus rivales
con movimientos de una velocidad vertiginosa.
This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.it:
Di solito è piuttosto flemmatico, ma
quando si trova a lottare atterra il
nemico con movimenti fulminei.
This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.de:
Dieses Pokémon ist für gewöhnlich sehr gelassen,
doch sobald ein Kampf beginnt, streckt es den Gegner
mit blitzschnellen Bewegungen zu Boden.
This Pokémon normally is slow to react,.pt-br:
Este Pokémon costuma demorar para reagir, mas quando
entra na batalha, derrota seus oponentes
com golpes na velocidade da luz.

This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.en: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.zh-tw: 這隻寶可夢使用斗篷內襯的反光毛皮來偽裝花莖，創造出花朵漂浮的錯覺。
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.fr:
Il se sert de la réverbération de la lumière sur
la fourrure de sa cape pour camoufler sa tige,
ce qui donne l'illusion que sa fleur flotte dans les airs.
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.es:
Se sirve de la luz que reflejan los tricomas de
su manto de hojas para camuflar la vid y crear
la ilusión óptica de que la flor flota en el aire.
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.it:
I riflessi del pelo all'interno del mantello
camuffano lo stelo del suo fiore, che
così sembra fluttuare nell'aria.
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.de:
Es erweckt den Eindruck, als würde seine Blume
schweben, indem es ihren Stiel mit der Reflexion
des Fells an der Innenseite seines Mantels tarnt.
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lin.pt-br:
Este Pokémon usa a pelugem reflexiva da sua capa
para camuflar o caule da sua flor, criando a ilusão
de que a flor está flutuando.

This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.en: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.zh-tw: 這只神奇寶貝誕生於大約 1500 年前的寶箱內。它會吸走試圖偷竊寶藏的惡棍的生命力。
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.fr:
Ce Pokémon est né dans un coffre au trésor,
il y a environ 1 500 ans. Il absorbe l'énergie
vitale des voyous qui osent voler son magot.
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.es:
El cofre en el que nació data de hace 1500 años
aproximadamente. Absorbe la energía vital de los
granujas que intentan hacerse con su tesoro.
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.it:
Nacque all'interno di un forziere circa 1.500
anni fa. Assorbe l'energia vitale dei furfanti
che provano a rubare il suo tesoro.
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.de:
Es entstand vor etwa 1500 Jahren in einer Schatztruhe.
Wenn Diebe versuchen, den Schatz zu stehlen, saugt es
ihnen die Lebensenergie aus.
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure.pt-br:
Este Pokémon nasceu em um baú do tesouro cerca
de 1.500 anos atrás. Suga a força vital de
fanfarrões que tentam roubar o tesouro.

This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.en: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.zh-tw: 這種神奇寶貝會攻擊成群的典當者和雙刃者，從他們身上收集金屬，以製造一把大而堅固的錘子。
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.fr:
Ce Pokémon attaque des cohortes de Scalpion
et de Scalproie pour rassembler le métal nécessaire
à la confection d'un grand marteau robuste.
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.es:
Asalta el séquito entero de un Bisharp para reunir
metal con el que forjar su enorme y robusto martillo.
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.it:
Assalta i branchi capeggiati da Bisharp
per procurarsi il metallo necessario a
realizzare il suo martello grande e resistente.
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.de:
Es überfällt Gruppen von Gladiantri und Caesurio,
um Metall zu sammeln, das es zum Herstellen seines
großen, robusten Hammers benötigt.
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawni.pt-br:
Este Pokémon ataca grupos de Pawniard e Bisharp com
o intuito de coletar metal deles e
criar um martelo grande e resistente.

Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.en: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.zh-tw: 雖然它通常是性情溫和的神奇寶貝，但它會用鋒利的、浸有毒液的門牙咬住任何激怒它的東西，導致它憤怒的對象癱瘓。
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.fr:
Ce Pokémon est d'un naturel doux, mais lorsqu'il
se met en colère, il mord à l'aide de ses incisives
acérées et imprégnées de venin paralysant.
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.es:
Es manso, pero muerde y paraliza a quien lo enfada
con sus afilados incisivos impregnados de toxinas.
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.it:
È di natura mite, ma se qualcuno lo
fa arrabbiare lo morde con gli incisivi
impregnati di un veleno paralizzante.
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.de:
Wer dieses friedfertige Pokémon verärgert,
wird durch einen Biss mit seinen scharfen,
giftgetränkten Schneidezähnen gelähmt.
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will.pt-br:
Apesar de normalmente ser manso, este Pokémon finca
seus dentes frontais afiados e venenosos em
qualquer um que o irritar, causando paralisia.

When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.en: When heated by fire energy, its horns can get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.
When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.zh-tw: 當被火能量加熱時，它的角的溫度會超過 1,800 華氏度。被它們刺傷的人會受傷和燒傷。
When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.fr:
Ses cornes atteignent les 1 000 °C lorsqu'elles
sont chauffées par énergie incandescente.
Elles infligent blessures et brûlures à ses adversaires.
When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.es:
Sus cuernos alcanzan los 1000 °C cuando los
calienta con energía ígnea. Quienes reciben una
de sus cornadas sufren heridas y quemaduras.
When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.it:
Le corna arroventate dalla sua energia
Fuoco raggiungono i 1.000 ºC e causano
al nemico trafitto sia ferite che ustioni.
When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.de:
Seine Hörner erreichen mithilfe von Feuer-Energie
1000 ºC. Spießt es damit Gegner auf, so erleiden
diese Verletzungen und Verbrennungen.
When heated by fire energy, its horns ca.pt-br:
Quando aquecido por energia de fogo, seus chifres podem
chegar a mais de 980 ºC. Aqueles que forem atacados
por eles sofrerão com feridas e queimaduras.

When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the.en: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the.zh-tw: 當群體受到攻擊時，Pawmo 會第一個投入戰鬥，用電擊的戰鬥技術擊敗敵人。
When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the.fr:
Quand on attaque son groupe, ce Pokémon
est le premier à riposter. Il défait ses adversaires
avec un art martial qui repose sur l'électricité.
When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the.es:
Cuando su manada se ve amenazada, atacan a la
vanguardia usando un arte marcial caracterizado
por el empleo de descargas eléctricas.

contrôle de Necrozma, il expulse continuellement toute son énergie.

露娜拉不再有自己的意志。現在在
控制奈克洛茲瑪，它不斷地排出其所有能量。

Lunala hat keinen eigenen Willen mehr. Jetzt unter dem
Wenn es die Kontrolle über Necrozma erlangt, stößt es kontinuierlich seine gesamte Energie aus.

Lunala não tem mais vontade própria. Agora sob o
controle de Necrozma, ele expele continuamente toda a sua energia.

Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.en:
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its
sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys
the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.zh-tw:
狼人用其攻擊獵物
鋒利的爪子和尖牙。它忠實地服從
它信任的培訓師的指示。
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.fr:
Il attaque ses proies à l'aide de ses griffes
et de ses crocs acérés. Il obéira toujours
à son Dresseur s'il lui fait confiance.
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.es:
Ataca a sus presas con sus afilados colmillos y
garras. Solo obedece las órdenes de aquellos
Entrenadores que logran ganarse su confianza.
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.it:
Caccia la sua preda usando le zanne e gli artigli affilatissimi.
Ascolta fedelmente le indicazioni degli Allenatori di cui si fida.
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.de:
Es greift seine Beute mit scharfen Fangzähnen
und Krallen an. Vertraut es einem Trainer,
befolgt es treu dessen Anweisungen.
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its\nshar.pt-br:
Lycanroc ataca suas presas com seus caninos
e garras afiadas. Obedece lealmente às instruções
de um Treinador em quem confia.

Ce Pokémon orne souvent les blasons, car les plumes
qu'il perd sont utilisées pour forger des épées.

Aparece a menudo en escudos heráldicos, pues se
pueden forjar espadas a partir de las plumas que pierde.

Schwerter hergestellt werden.

As pessoas forjam espadas com as penas que caíram
de Skarmory, por isso, a imagem deste Pokémon é
um elemento popular em brasões.

The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves
as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire
situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

這種情況下，莖也可以當食物。

como espada para derribar a los oponentes. en una situación terrible
situación, el tallo también puede servir como alimento.

La tige que ce Pokémon porte dans ses ailes sert
comme une épée pour abattre les adversaires. Dans une situation désastreuse

Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard
workers who eat a lot of trash.

他們大約有一百多人居住在
阿羅拉的垃圾處理場。他們都很難

Sitio de eliminación de desechos de Alola. son todos duros
trabajadores que comen mucha basura.

Ci vivono un centinaio o giù di lì
Il sito di smaltimento dei rifiuti di Alola. Sono tutti difficili
lavoratori che mangiano molta spazzatura.

Local de eliminação de resíduos de Alola. Eles são todos difíceis

Ils sont une centaine à vivre à
Décharge d'Alola. Ils sont tous durs
des travailleurs qui mangent beaucoup de déchets.

Alolas Mülldeponie. Sie sind alle hart
Arbeiter, die viel Müll essen.

giorno in cui questo Pokémon è nato. Il seme lentamente
diventa più grande.

Auf der Rückseite befindet sich ein Pflanzensamen
Tag, an dem dieses Pokémon geboren wird. Der Samen langsam

Há uma semente de planta em suas costas, desde o
dia em que este Pokémon nasce. A semente lentamente
fica maior.

They smack beaks with others of their ki.en:
They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate.
The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

它們用喙與同類進行交流。
攻擊的強度和次數可以告訴對方他們的感受。
They smack beaks with others of their ki.fr:
Ils communiquent entre eux en se frappant
mutuellement sur le bec. La force et la cadence
des coups en disent long sur leur état d'esprit.
They smack beaks with others of their ki.es:
Se comunican con sus compañeros chocando los
picos. El número de veces y la fuerza con la que
lo hacen transmiten sus distintos sentimientos.
They smack beaks with others of their ki.it:
I Toucannon comunicano tra di loro sbattendo i becchi. La forza
e il numero dei colpi indicano i sentimenti che vogliono esprimere.
They smack beaks with others of their ki.de:
Sie kommunizieren miteinander, indem sie ihre
Schnäbel gegeneinanderschlagen. Stärke und
Anzahl der Schläge übermitteln ihre Gefühle.
They smack beaks with others of their ki.pt-br:
Batem os bicos com outros de sua espécie
para se comunicar. A quantidade e a força das bicadas
demonstram como estão se sentindo.

Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes

這是它吞噬光芒時的形態
索爾迦雷歐。它會撲向敵人，然後進行砍擊
它們的四肢和背部都有爪子。

Solgaléo. Il se jette sur les ennemis puis les tranche

Questa è la sua forma mentre divora la luce dell'
Solgaleo. Si avventa sui nemici e poi colpisce

This is its form while it is devouring t.pt-br:
Esta é a sua forma enquanto devora a luz do
Solgaleo. Ele ataca os inimigos e depois corta
eles com as garras em seus quatro membros e nas costas.
This is its form while it is devouring t.de:
Dies ist seine Form, während es das Licht verschlingt
Solgaleo. Es stürzt sich auf Feinde und schlägt dann zu
sie mit den Krallen an seinen vier Gliedmaßen und am Rücken.
This is its form while it is devouring t.es:
Forma que adopta tras alimentarse de la luz de Solgaleo.
Se lanza sobre su oponente y lo desgarra sin piedad.

Audino can gauge other creatures' feelings and physical conditions.

Ce Pokémon a un bon cœur. En touchant avec ses palpeurs,
Audino peut évaluer les sentiments et les conditions physiques des autres créatures.
